jobs.title: AI Engineer | PAM Health Corporate
jobs.description: Overview: The AI Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, and deploying AI\-driven automation solutions across PAM Health. Acting as a crucial technical contributor, this individual will partner with business stakeholders across the organization to identify workflows that can be optimized. Leveraging large language models (LLMs) and agentic frameworks, the AI Engineer will build tools that enhance organizational efficiency and support patient care. This role spans a broad range of experience levels (Junior to Senior, with expectations scaling accordingly) and requires a strong commitment to deploying technology within a secure, HIPAA\-compliant healthcare environment. Responsibilities: **I. Position Responsibilities*** AI Development \& Automation: Design, build, and maintain AI agents and automation workflows using Python to streamline processes across clinical, financial, HR, and administrative departments * Framework Utilization: Leverage modern agent development SDKs and frameworks (such as LangChain, Pydantic AI, Google ADK, or the OpenAI Agents SDK) to build robust, scalable AI applications * System Integration: Integrate AI solutions with existing enterprise applications and Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems, facilitating secure and efficient data exchange * Cloud Deployment: Deploy, host, and manage AI models and applications within cloud infrastructure * AI\-Assisted Engineering: Accelerate development timelines and maintain high code quality by actively utilizing AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, or Antigravity) * Security \& Compliance: Ensure all AI tools and automated workflows adhere to strict healthcare compliance standards, maintaining data privacy, security, and HIPAA compliance when handling Protected Health Information (PHI) * Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with non\-technical stakeholders across the organization to gather requirements, scope automation projects, and translate business challenges into actionable AI solutions * Continuous Innovation: Actively monitor, test, and evaluate emerging AI technologies, models, and industry best practices **II. Leadership*** Inclusiveness: Promotes cooperation, fairness and equity; shows respect for people and their differences; works to understand perspectives of others; demonstrates empathy; brings out the best in others and in his/her team * Managing Staff: Coaches, evaluates, develops, and inspires staff; sets expectations; recognizes achievements * Stewardship and Resource Management: Demonstrates accountability and sound judgment in managing company resources; appropriate understanding of confidentiality and company values; adheres to and supports company policies, procedures and safety guidelines * Problem\-Solving: Identifies problems and involves others in seeking solutions; conducts appropriate analysis and searches for best solutions; effectively and efficiently implements appropriate responses to correct problems; responds promptly and effectively to new challenges * Decision\-Making: Makes clear, consistent decisions; acts with integrity in all decisions; distinguishes relevant from irrelevant information; makes timely, appropriate decisions. * Strategic Planning and Organizing: Understands company vision and aligns priorities accordingly; measures outcomes; uses feedback to redirect as required; evaluates alternatives; appropriately organizes complex issues to desirable resolution * Communication: Connects with peers, subordinate employees and all customers; actively listens; clearly and effectively shares information; demonstrates effective oral and written communication skills; negotiates effectively. * Quality Improvement: Strives for efficient, effective, high\-quality performance in self and in the department; delivers timely and accurate results; resilient when responding to matters that are challenging; takes initiative to make improvements * Leadership: Motivates others; accepts responsibility; maintains high morale in department; develops trust and credibility; expects honest and ethical behavior of self and staff * Teamwork: Encourages cooperation and collaboration; builds effective teams; works in partnership with others; is flexible; responsive to the needs of others * Development: Maintains up\-to\-date skills through involvement with professional organizations and/or continuing education **III. Customer Service*** Maintains the highest level of customer service via courtesy, compassion and positive communication. * Promotes the mission and vision of PAM Health within the work environment and the community. * Respects dignity and confidentiality by adherence to all applicable policies and procedures. **IV. Health and Safety*** Works in a manner that promotes safety; wears clothing appropriate to the performance of the job. * Participates in OSHA required training. * Follows universal precautions as appropriate for position; complies with Employee Health requirements for continued employment. * Reports unsafe practices to management. * Knows own role in case of an emergency Qualifications: **POSITION QUALIFICATIONS:** **Education and Training:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical field; OR equivalent practical/professional experience. **Experience:*** Proven software engineering experience (level commensurate with Junior to Senior expectations), with a primary focus on Python development * Demonstrated hands\-on experience building, testing, and deploying AI\-driven applications, LLMs, or autonomous aagents * Preferred: Familiarity with the healthcare industry; especially in the post\-acute care sector * Preferred: Experience integrating with, or extracting data from, Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems * Preferred: Experience deploying AI and software solutions in secure, HIPAA\-compliant environments handling sensitive data * Preferred: Experience with cloud computing platforms, specifically Microsoft Azure and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP) **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:*** Strong proficiency in Python programming and its broader data/AI ecosystem * Familiarity with agent development SDKs (e.g., LangChain, Pydantic AI, Google ADK, OpenAI Agents SDK) * High proficiency with modern AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity) * Solid understanding of Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) fundamentals (embeddings, vector stores, multi\-modal data processing * Strong understanding of RESTful API development and third\-party system integrations * Knowledge of data privacy principles, security best practices, and healthcare regulatory requirements (HIPAA) * Excellent problem\-solving skills with the ability to operate as a technical generalist across varied business domains * Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex AI concepts to non\-technical stakeholders clearly and effectively About PAM Health: **PAM HEALTH (PAM)** based in Enola, Pennsylvania, provides specialty healthcare services through more than 80 locations, as well as wound clinics and outpatient physical therapy locations, in 17 states. PAM Health is committed to providing high\-quality patient care and outstanding customer service, coupled with the loyalty and dedication of highly trained staff, to be the most trusted source for post\-acute services in every community it serves. Its mission is to serve people by providing compassionate, expert care, and to support recovery through education and research. Joining our PAMily allows you to work in a collaborative environment with colleagues and leadership with exposure to a variety of patient care levels. Aside from our competitive pay, generous paid benefit time, and excellent insurance options, you will also have opportunities for professional growth through our Education Advancement Program. We are excited to learn more about you and hope that you consider joining us on a shared mission to improve the lives of others by being an integral part of our We Care Program. Please take a moment to visit us online at **www.PAMHealth.com** for a comprehensive look at how we're able to positively impact our local communities. PAM Health does not discriminate and does not permit discrimination, including, without limitation, bullying, abuse or harassment, on the basis of actual or perceived race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, gender, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression or HIV status, or based on association with another person on account of that person's actual or perceived race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, gender, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression or HIV status.

jobs.title: AI Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: **What is PlayerZero?** ----------------------- Building great software takes more than writing code. It takes teams working together, and too often, the information they need is scattered across tools, conversations, and systems. PlayerZero is an AI platform that connects work across enterprise Support, Engineering, Product, QA, and SRE teams, helping them resolve issues faster, improve software quality, and plan what to build next. At its core is our Engineering World Model: a living understanding of a company’s software, how it runs, and the people and decisions behind it. By connecting codebases, tickets, production telemetry, and the conversations that shape the work, our model links what software is intended to do with how it actually behaves in production—and learns from where the two diverge. Our agents (we call them Players :) use that context to take on work across the software lifecycle. They learn from each outcome, earning trust and taking on more responsibility over time. We’re building a future where AI plays an active role in how teams plan, build, and run software. We’re looking for people across disciplines to help shape it. **About the AI Infra team** --------------------------- Most AI tools help one person perform a task faster, a session at a time. But real software work doesn’t happen in one session or one tool. A bug moves from a customer to a ticket to a Slack thread to a PR to a deploy, across people and systems that never see the whole picture. The most interesting context lives between those systems of record, and so does the real work. For our agents to take on that work, something has to sit in between. The AI Infrastructure team builds it: where agents execute, what context they access, and how work moves between agents and people. Because the work runs through this infrastructure, it’s also what lets the Engineering World Model learn from every outcome and earn our agents the right to do more. It has to be fast, composable, and built to scale. We’re hiring infrastructure engineers who like hard distributed\-systems problems and want to own them end to end. **What you will do** -------------------- * **Build agentic infrastructure.** Our agents don’t answer a question and disappear. They take on units of work that run for hours or days, change hands, and keep driving toward completion. You’ll build the runtime that creates continuity for that work: long\-running sessions that survive failures, durable workflow state, lifecycle and cancellation, and workflows that track each piece of work across every stage and every party involved. * **Architect how context is represented and delivered.** Because work flows through our platform, we’re present when the connections between code, tickets, units of work, and past decisions are made. The context between these systems of record is necessary for agents to do their work well, and the data models behind it shape everything an agent can know. You’ll design how that context is represented and delivered: what gets precomputed ahead of time versus resolved on demand, and how the right slice reaches each agent at the right moment. * **Build the communication layer.** Real work doesn’t happen in isolation. Agents work alongside other agents (subagents, teammates, agents on customer machines, agents over MCP) and alongside people. You’ll build the layer that connects them: messaging between agents within and across sessions, escalations that pull in the right person at the right time, and agents that can be interrupted when new information arrives. * **Scale sandboxes and fleets.** An organization’s work is spread across laptops, QA fleets, production hosts, and ephemeral scripts. You’ll build our own sandbox infrastructure, environments that spin up instantly and run by the hundreds, and the fleet layer that lets agents work on the machines where customer work already happens. You don’t need experience in all of these. We expect you to go deep on one or two and pick up the rest along the way. **What you bring** ------------------ * A builder mindset. You own projects end to end, think carefully about data models, performance, and maintainability, and have taken prototypes to production with a clear sense of the reliability and scale tradeoffs. * 3–5\+ years building backend systems, ideally real\-time, stateful, or event\-driven workloads, with strong distributed systems fundamentals: message queues (Pulsar, Kafka), distributed locks, pub/sub, and their failure modes. * Experience building infrastructure for LLMs in production: tool calling, streaming, token budgets, or evaluation harnesses, and a sense of what agents need from the systems beneath them. * Experience designing data models for messy, interconnected domains. You know how to structure data so it stays correct as it grows and changes, and you think about how it will be queried and served before you write the schema. You’ve made schema and storage decisions that held up under scale, and you know the cost of getting them wrong. * You keep work moving. You balance speed of execution with code quality, unblock yourself when you can, and pull in the right people at the right time when you can’t. **Bonus Points** * Hands\-on with vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone, Turbopuffer) or hybrid search systems * Experience with Kotlin/JVM (our primary stack) or Rust, MongoDB, Turbopuffer, or Redis, and WebSockets or other real\-time patterns * You’ve built sandboxing or isolation systems with containers or microVMs (e.g., Firecracker, gVisor), or managed fleets across heterogeneous machines * You’ve worked on filesystem layers such as FUSE, overlay filesystems, or remote\-backed storage * You’ve worked with event sourcing, lineage, or provenance data, where the record of what happened is itself a product **What success looks like** --------------------------- In your first month, you’ve shipped to production, learned how work moves through the platform end to end, and taken ownership of a real component in one of the layers above. By three months, you own a meaningful piece of the system and have made it measurably better: longer\-running work that survives failures, faster sandbox startup, context that reaches agents more reliably, or fewer dropped handoffs between agents and people. By six months to a year, you’re the person the team trusts with a layer of the machine. You set its technical direction, anticipate where it will break as customers and workloads grow, and your work shows up directly in how much our agents can take on. **Why PlayerZero?** ------------------- PlayerZero is an early leader in AI\-powered production engineering, defining how enterprises use AI to understand, improve, and operate their software. We’re a small team with meaningful problems to solve and room for each person to make their mark. Whether you’re building the technology, working with customers, or growing the business, you’ll help shape the product, the company, and what customers expect from this emerging category. If you’re excited by work where the answers aren’t all written yet, and want a hand in writing them, you’ll fit right in. Compensation Range: $150K \- $210K

jobs.title: AI Solutions Developer
jobs.description: **JOB POSTING** =============== **TITLE:** AI Solutions Developer **STATUS:** Full\-time, Exempt **DEPARTMENT:** Information Technology **LOCATION:** Atlanta, GA (Hybrid) **REPORTS TO:** VP, Member Technology **DATE:** 10/1/2026 **ABOUT THE ROLE** ------------------ UniPro Foodservice is hiring its first dedicated AI Solutions Developer. The job is not to run a research lab or train models from scratch. It is to work with our IT teams and the people closest to the business, build software that uses AI where it genuinely helps, and turn the ideas that work into secure, maintainable solutions. The work will also extend beyond UniPro. This role will consult directly with our Members on practical AI opportunities, help them think through tools and implementation approaches, and support Member\-facing pilots and solutions. Successful work here can have a meaningful impact across our membership, not only inside our own organization. **ABOUT UNIPRO** ---------------- We're a cooperative of independent foodservice distributors. Our Members compete against companies many times their size, and they win by staying closer to their customers and moving faster. UniPro gives them the scale, buying power, Supplier relationships, data, and technology that would otherwise be much harder to access on their own. That makes the scope of this role broader than a typical internal development position. Something we build for UniPro may improve our own operations first, become part of a Member\-facing product, or turn into a practical approach we can help Members apply in their own businesses. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** ------------------ You'll start by learning how UniPro actually works and where AI can improve a real process. You won't be doing that work on your own. You'll work side by side with Member Technology, Development, Data, Operations, Security, and business teams, using the same standards and delivery processes that support the rest of our technology environment. **Build and deliver useful AI solutions** * Design and build AI\-enabled software, services, agents, integrations, and automation using appropriate technologies for the problem and the environment. * Prototype quickly, then take the ideas that work through architecture, testing, security, deployment, monitoring, documentation, and support. * Work directly with model APIs and practical patterns such as structured outputs, tool or function calling, agents, retrieval\-augmented generation, semantic search, and human review where they make sense. * Work through established Git, pull request, code review, testing, and CI/CD practices with the IT teams responsible for the systems you are changing. * Work with the teams that own the data to make sure the information behind a solution is reliable enough to build on, and build evaluation and monitoring into what you ship. **Work with UniPro teams and our Members** * Sit with teams across IT, finance, procurement, rebates, Member operations, and Supplier relationships to understand where the friction really is before deciding what to build. * Consult directly with Members on practical AI opportunities, tool choices, implementation approaches, controls, and adoption, working with Member Technology and the other UniPro teams needed to support the work. * Help Members and internal teams understand what is realistic, where the tradeoffs are, and what needs more validation before it is ready for production use. * Run pilots with the people who will use the result, including Members where appropriate, measure what worked and what did not, and use that feedback to improve the next version. * Bring what we learn from Member work back into UniPro standards, reusable patterns, and Member\-facing solutions where it can help the broader membership. **Help establish how AI is used responsibly** * Work with IT leadership and the appropriate IT teams to establish a standard process for evaluating, approving, building, and releasing AI capabilities across UniPro. * Help put the right controls around each use case, including risk assessment, data handling and security, architecture and code quality, testing and evaluation, documentation, ownership, monitoring, and long\-term maintainability. * Help define when additional review, approval, or training is needed before a tool or feature is made broadly available, and make sure users have the guidance they need to use it well. * Contribute to UniPro's AI roadmap, bring a practical technical point of view to what is feasible and worth doing, and work with the responsible teams to deliver against it. * Test new models, tools, and frameworks when there is a reason to do so, and document what each material effort was meant to achieve and what it actually delivered. **WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** -------------------------- We're looking for someone who already knows how to build software and has gone far enough into applied AI to be useful on day one. You do not need to have trained models from scratch or spent years in an ML research lab. You do need strong development fundamentals, sound judgment, and evidence that you can turn new technology into something people can actually use and support. * Three to five years of professional software development experience, including hands\-on work with applied AI, automation, data\-intensive applications, or integrations. * Strong working knowledge of appropriate software development technologies, plus experience with APIs, authentication, SQL, Git, and modern software development practices. * Hands\-on experience with large language model APIs and patterns such as structured outputs, tool or function calling, agents, retrieval\-augmented generation, embeddings, or semantic search. * Experience taking software past the proof\-of\-concept stage, including automated testing, CI/CD, cloud deployment, logging and monitoring, production support, and the tradeoffs around quality, cost, latency, security, and maintainability. * Enough comfort with data to query it, combine sources, validate quality, and work with the people who own it when the answer is not sitting in one clean table. * The ability to sit down with a non\-technical colleague or Member, understand the real problem, explain the options and tradeoffs without jargon, and keep iterating when the first idea is not the right one. * A collaborative approach and comfort working across multiple IT and business teams rather than operating as a separate AI function. **Nice to have** * Experience with cloud and data platforms such as AWS, Azure, Snowflake, or similar. * Experience with Laravel/PHP, Vue, or working alongside a modern software application team. * Familiarity with Microsoft 365 and Copilot, Power Platform, D365 F\&O, or a background in foodservice, distribution, procurement, or supply chain. **WHY YOU MIGHT WANT THIS JOB** ------------------------------- * You'll help shape how UniPro uses AI at a point when the standards, reusable patterns, and operating model are still being established. * Your work gets used. We're small enough that you'll see what you build running in the business, and successful work can also reach our Members. * The scope is intentionally broad: internal software, operational automation, data\-heavy workflows, Member\-facing solutions, and Member consulting can all be part of the role. * You will work with experienced IT and business teams that can help turn good ideas into solutions that are supportable for the long term. **PRACTICAL DETAILS** --------------------- * Reports to the Vice President, Member Technology and works across the IT organization on architecture, standards, data, security, deployment, and production delivery. * Based in Atlanta, GA on a hybrid schedule. We'll consider fully remote for the right person. * Occasional travel, under 10 percent. * Occasional work outside normal hours to support projects or issues. * Other duties as assigned.

jobs.title: Associate Application Engineer
jobs.description: **Protecting the World’s Water.** Since 1969, Aqua\-Aerobic Systems, Inc. has led the water and wastewater treatment industry by providing advanced solutions in aeration and mixing, biological processes, cloth media filtration, membranes, PFAS solutions, disinfection and process control. As an applied engineering company serving both municipal and industrial customers, we work collaboratively with consulting engineers, owners, plant managers and operators to design and manufacture the best treatment solution with the lowest lifecycle cost. Our “Customer for Life” philosophy ensures that every customer will receive unparalleled service before, during and after the installation of Aqua\-Aerobic products. Protecting the World’s Water. It’s our mission \- powered by People and driven by Innovation. The Associate Application Engineer evaluates design requests and assists in the preliminary designs and costing of water and wastewater treatment. This position performs bench\-scale testing, monitors data and reports findings for pilot studies with other departments The Associate Application Engineer provides technical expertise to both Internal and External Customers including Consulting Engineers, end users, Plant Operators, Sales Representatives, Cost Estimating, and Customer Service. ***This position will be onsite at Aqua\-Aerobic Systems, Inc. in Loves Park, IL, with up to 30% travel.*** **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** * Evaluate design requests and size equipment for water and wastewater treatment. Make recommendations suitable for the requested application. * Develop preliminary process design reports for biological and filtration treatment systems. * Determine electrical and mechanical equipment costs for preliminary process designs. * Perform bench\-scale filtration testing. * Manage pilot data collection and interpretation to prepare meaningful statistical evaluations, graphs, tabulations and accessibility by other internal departments. * Create effective written reports to convey findings and conclusions of bench\-scale and pilot testing to both internal and external customers. * Provide technical assistance to Internal and External clients including Consulting Engineers, End Users, Plant Operators, Sales Representatives, Sales Cost Estimating, and Customer Service. * Travel (up to 30%) to give technical presentations and provide technical assistance to existing and potential customers. * Other related duties as assigned. **Work Environment** Usual office working conditions with moderate noise such as computers and printers, telephones and coworkers. Occasional exposure to elements such as noise, odor, dust, heat, cold or chemicals. Occasional travel to treatment plants in various locations. **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or related Technical field plus a minimum of 1 year of related training and experience or any equivalent combination of training and experience. * Ability to travel up to 30%. * Must possess a strong process related background with proficient technical writing skills. * Strong verbal and written communication skills. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office. * Must possess basic mechanical and electrical aptitude. * EIT, is a plus. Salary Range: $70,000 \- $72,000 Annually **Benefits Include:** Medical (prescription coverage included), Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Short Term Disability, Long term Disability, Accidental Death and Dismemberment, Business Travel Insurance, Paid Parental Leave, Medical Flexible Spending, Dependent Care Flex Spending, Lifestyle Spending Account, EAP, 401k plus 3% match– both pretax and post, Profit sharing, Bonus, Summer Hours, Paid Christmas Shutdown, Paid Volunteer Hours, Vacation \& Paid Leave for All Workers, Vacation Purchase Program, Tuition Reimbursement, Telecommuting up to 2 days a week, Flex work schedule, Identity Theft Protection

jobs.title: Battery and Power Systems Engineer
jobs.description: At SiFly, we're building a new category of aircraft: vertical\-takeoff, long\-endurance drones that deliver helicopter\-level performance at drone economics. After thousands of flight tests and years of engineering, our NDAA\-compliant platform flies more than 2 hours in hover or 3 hours in forward flight on a single charge — matching the capability of traditional helicopters at a fraction of their cost and operational burden. We merge aerial robotics, perception, and onboard intelligence to cut complexity and minimize human intervention, and our unique approach to communications and networking unlocks remote operations from day one. It's an ambitious mission, and we're a small team that moves fast. **The role** A lead engineer for battery packs and high current distribution in our products. This can include cell selection, architecture, thermal and electrical design, BMS tuning and characterization on the bench. You’ll also play a role in cell and pack vendor relationships, our manufacturing partners, and the safety testing and certification. **What you'll do** * Drive pack architecture and future cell evalutions * Understand and evolve our pack designs including structure, materials, thermal paths, tolerance analysis — and characterize them on the bench. * Drive BMS hardware architecture, and specify the BMS firmware requirements: what it must do, and how it must fail. * Own charge control: charger architecture, charge\-rate strategy, and the throughput consequences of both. * Drive battery safety — the analysis, the test campaigns, and the documentation — including UN 38\.3 and IEC 62133\. * Lead hardware analysis in support of safety: worst\-case circuit analysis, DFMEA, derating, thermal assessment, protection coordination. * Support Manufacturing, Quality, and Supply Chain through NPI and production ramp. **What we're looking for** * Electrical engineering depth with real high\-voltage or high\-energy battery system experience. * You've taken a lithium\-ion pack from cell selection through to a shipping product. * BMS electronics experience. Ability to specify architecture options and firmware behavior. History of working with cell monitoring, balancing, protection circuits, isolation measurement. * Hands\-on bench capability: you can instrument a pack, run the thermal characterization, and interpret the data. * Battery safety test experience * You anticipate failure systematically — DFMEA, worst\-case circuit analysis, derating and stress analysis, thermal margin. * First\-principles thinking and a drive to understand the “why” behind traditional approaches to propulsion, power systems, and even radio technologies. * This is a hands\-on job at a company that is still small. You'll be at the bench, in the shop, on the flight line, and sometimes at a customer site working out why a deployed system is misbehaving — alongside new product development, not instead of it. * You use AI as a real tool, not a talking point. We want to hear one specific example of something you did with AI that surprised you — a workflow you rebuilt, a problem you came at sideways, an analysis that wouldn't have been worth doing by hand. We care less about which tools you use than about what you've changed about how you work. We're enthusiastic about the leverage and unforgiving about errors. **Nice to have** * Both aerospace and automotive high\-voltage battery context. * Charging infrastructure design, and mechanical pack design alongside the electrical side. **Details** * Onsite in Santa Clara, CA. * Compensation range $120\-165K

jobs.title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** As a Cloud Infrastructure Engineer, you’ll build, automate, and maintain reliable cloud and IT infrastructure. You’ll support cloud services across public cloud and virtualized environments, strengthen security, and partner with software and operations teams to keep applications scalable and available. **Responsibilities** * Design and manage cloud architecture, infrastructure, and services across AWS, Google Cloud Platform, Azure, and other environments as applicable. * Automate deployment processes and infrastructure management using Infrastructure as Code (IaC), DevOps automation, and CI/CD practices. * Operate Linux and Windows systems, virtualization platforms, containers, and Kubernetes; maintain system hardening and identity and access management (IAM). * Support distributed systems, microservices, service\-oriented architecture, APIs, RESTful web services, databases, and storage such as S3\. * Your impact: Reliable, secure infrastructure helps development and operations teams deliver cloud services and applications with confidence. **Requirements** * Experience managing IT infrastructure, cloud computing, cloud management, and cloud infrastructure; familiarity with IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, Virtual Private Clouds, VPNs, and scalability. * Hands\-on knowledge of tools and platforms such as VMware, OpenStack, Rackspace, Citrix, Docker, Terraform, Ansible, Chef, Puppet, Jenkins, Git, and Meraki; relevant experience may vary by environment. * Scripting skills with Python, Go, JavaScript, Java, Ruby, PowerShell, Bash (Unix shell), or shell scripting; familiarity with.NET, Node.js, or Ruby on Rails is useful. * Understanding of SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, NoSQL, T\-SQL, or PL/SQL; exposure to software development, application development, Agile, and Internet of Things (IoT) workloads is a plus. * Knowledge of computer science, operating systems, computer management, and IT; experience with cloud development and software deployment is preferred. Pay: $95,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Cloud Security Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role** Prysm Technology Solutions is hiring a Cloud Security Engineer in Louisville to design secure cloud environments and review client cloud accounts. jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.description: **About the Role** Data centers run on thousands of sensors, meters, and control systems, and the teams who run their power infrastructure have to make sense of all of it in real time. Teserac is building Neuron™, an AI\-native observability and automation platform that gives those teams full visibility into their power operations and helps them get ahead of problems. At its core is an AI teammate that works alongside every operator around the clock: detecting anomalies, correlating events, and recommending what to do next. As a Full Stack Developer, you'll own features end to end, from the ingestion path that pulls telemetry off a BMS in a live facility, through the time\-series layer that stores it, to the dashboard an operator is watching at 2am. This is a small team with real customers in production. Your code ships in days, not quarters, and it runs in facilities where being wrong has physical consequences. You'll work directly with the Principal Software \& Architecture Lead, Product, and Solution Engineering. We move fast, avoid bureaucracy, and expect engineers to own outcomes rather than tickets. This is a hybrid role based in our Santa Clara office, and visa sponsorship is available. **Who We Are Looking For** You're a full\-stack engineer who is comfortable on both sides of the line, and who gets interested rather than annoyed when the data is messy, the vendor's API is undocumented, and the protocol spec is a PDF from 2009\. You likely: * Build front to back. You can trace a value from a Modbus register to a rendered chart without handing off, and you know where it's likely to break. * Take databases seriously. You know that a query plan, an index, and a migration on a large table are engineering decisions, not configuration. * Have worked with real time\-series data at a volume where naive approaches stop working, and understand what that costs at read time and write time. * Debug production calmly. When CPU is pinned and a queue is backing up, you reason from evidence rather than restarting things. * Use AI tooling well. You get real leverage from Cursor, Claude Code, or similar, and your standards didn't drop when you started using it. **What You'll Do** **Product and front end** * Build operator\-facing features for Neuron™ in React and TypeScript: real\-time dashboards, alerting, alarm and ticket workflows, capacity planning views, and power\-flow visualizations. * Build the interfaces the AI teammate works through: interaction panels, recommendation displays, approval workflows, and audit trails. * Keep large, data\-dense views fast and responsive across devices. **Data ingestion and integrations** * Build and maintain the ingestion path that brings telemetry from customer sites into Neuron™: edge collectors, MQTT over AWS IoT Core, queue\-based workers, and normalization into a canonical metric model. * Write integration modules against real building and power systems: Siemens Desigo, Schneider PME and EcoStruxure, Niagara, Eaton, and generic BACnet, Modbus, and SNMP sources. * Own the correctness of what lands: point mapping, unit and phase semantics, deduplication, and backfill. **Time\-series platform** * Develop against PostgreSQL and TimescaleDB: hypertables, continuous aggregates, compression, and retention. * Design schema and migrations that stay safe as tables grow into the billions of rows. * Find and fix the performance problems that only appear with real customer data volumes. **Quality and operations** * Write tested, reviewed code, and contribute to CI/CD and automated testing. * Troubleshoot production issues across the stack, and share on\-call as the platform scales. **Why Teserac** We're not building incremental improvements to legacy tools. We're re\-architecting how data centers see, understand, and act on their own operations. * Ship features that directly shape how some of the world's most critical AI infrastructure is powered and managed. * Join a small engineering team where every developer has outsized impact and direct visibility into product decisions. * Work where AI, real\-time systems, and physical infrastructure meet. * Grow with the company from Series A through scale. **Requirements** * **Required** * + 7\+ years building and shipping production software across the stack + Strong Python, ideally Django. Our backend is Django and Celery, and it's the language you'll write most days. + Strong PostgreSQL: schema design, query performance, and migrations you'd run against a live production database + Practical time\-series experience. TimescaleDB is ideal, and deep experience with another time\-series or high\-volume streaming store transfers. + Solid React and TypeScript, and the judgment to keep a data\-heavy interface fast + Experience with asynchronous and event\-driven systems: task queues, pub/sub, streaming, or WebSockets + Comfortable on AWS. We run ECS Fargate, RDS, ElastiCache, and IoT Core. + Able to work independently, define your own scope from a rough requirement, and ship * **Preferred** * + Industrial or IoT telemetry experience: BMS, EPMS, DCIM, SCADA, or similar OT data sources + Hands\-on experience with industrial protocols: BACnet, Modbus, SNMP, or vendor BMS APIs + Data center infrastructure familiarity: power distribution topology, UPS and PDU behavior, or PUE + Experience building observability or monitoring products, commercial or internal + Early\-stage startup experience, Seed through Series B * Nobody checks every box here. If some of these describe you, apply. **Benefits** * Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental \& Vision) * Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick \& Public Holidays) * Free Food \& Snacks * Stock Option Plan * 401(k)

jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description: **Manufacturing Engineer** At SiFly, we're building a new category of aircraft: vertical\-takeoff, long\-endurance drones that deliver helicopter\-level performance at drone economics. After thousands of flight tests and years of engineering, our NDAA\-compliant platform flies more than 2 hours in hover or 3 hours in forward flight on a single charge — matching the capability of traditional helicopters at a fraction of their cost and operational burden. We merge aerial robotics, perception, and onboard intelligence to cut complexity and minimize human intervention, and our unique approach to communications and networking unlocks remote operations from day one. It's an ambitious mission, and we're a small team that moves fast. **Position Summary** We are seeking a hands\-on Manufacturing Engineer to develop, implement, and improve manufacturing processes for complex electromechanical products. The role is heavily focused on electromechanical assembly, process development, tooling/fixtures, work instructions, DFM/DFA, production\-line development, and PCBA integration. The successful candidate must have direct experience supporting products through NPI, production ramp, sustained manufacturing, and customer shipment; prototype\-only or R\&D\-only experience is not sufficient. Working knowledge of PCB fabrication and PCBA manufacturing/assembly is required. **Key Responsibilities** * Develop, validate, and continuously improve electromechanical assembly processes from NPI through production ramp and sustained manufacturing. * Define assembly sequences, process flows, workstation layouts, critical process parameters, inspection points, and acceptance criteria. * Create and maintain work instructions, process specifications, manufacturing documentation, and standard work. * Develop and qualify tooling, fixtures, jigs, gauges, and production equipment. * Establish and control assembly processes including fastening/torque, adhesives, soldering, wiring/cables, connectors, thermal interfaces, and mechanical alignment. * Develop PCBA integration processes and support PCB/PCBA manufacturing issues including SMT, through\-hole, soldering, rework, handling, connectors, and mechanical interfaces. * Lead/support DFM/DFA, PFMEA, control plans, process qualification, root\-cause analysis, corrective actions, and manufacturing readiness reviews. * Improve cycle time, throughput, labor efficiency, FPY, quality, line balance, and production capacity; support production\-floor and supplier/CM troubleshooting. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, or related discipline; equivalent relevant technical education and experience may be considered. * 5\+ years of manufacturing engineering experience supporting complex electromechanical products. * Required: direct experience with products that have been built, tested, released, and shipped to customers in a production environment. * Experience supporting NPI, production launch/ramp, and sustained manufacturing. * Strong hands\-on experience with electromechanical assembly processes and products combining mechanical components, PCBAs, wiring/cabling, connectors, sensors, motors/actuators, and embedded electronics. * Working knowledge of PCB fabrication and PCBA manufacturing/assembly, including SMT, through\-hole, soldering, rework, inspection, and handling. * Experience with DFM/DFA, tooling/fixtures, process validation, PFMEA/control plans, root\-cause analysis, and continuous improvement. * Demonstrated ability to improve cycle time, throughput, FPY, quality, and manufacturing efficiency and resolve issues directly on the production floor. * Ability and willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required to support production builds, manufacturing transfers, suppliers, and contract manufacturers. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with UAVs/drones, robotics, autonomous systems, consumer electronics, industrial automation, or similar electromechanical products. * Experience with PCB/PCBA/EMS suppliers, IPC workmanship standards, MES/ERP, manufacturing BOMs/routings, and serial\-number traceability. * Experience with contract manufacturers, manufacturing transfers, Lean/5S/standard work, and processes such as machining, molding, sheet metal, extrusion, composites, or finishing. **Details** **On site in Santa Clara, CA** **Compensation: $130\-$160k**

jobs.title: Postdoctoral AI Scientist
jobs.description: **Postdoctoral AI Scientist** **Palo Alto, California \| 12\-24Month Appointment** **About AIVista** NTT DATA AIVista, Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of NTT DATA, develops AI products for enterprises operating in complex regulatory environments. Based in Palo Alto, we combine deep AI product expertise with NTT DATA's industry knowledge and systems\-integration experience, working with NTT companies to deploy solutions for enterprise clients. **The Opportunity** AIVista is seeking a **Postdoctoral AI Scientist** to conduct research on foundational problems at the intersection of machine learning, knowledge representation, formal methods, and AI agents for enterprise systems. You will work alongside scientists and engineers to define and pursue ambitious research questions, develop new methods and systems, and evaluate them against complex, production\-scale problems and data. You will conduct research that advances the state of the art while creating a path toward performant and trustworthy AI systems that can operate reliably in real enterprise environments. This is an an initial 12\-month appointment with the option to extend it to 24 months **postdoctoral research appointment** designed for researchers who have completed their PhD and want to continue developing a strong research agenda while working closely with real\-world AI systems. Pursuing publication of research at top\-tier conferences and journals is highly encouraged, and projects are selected to support both rigorous scientific contribution and practical relevance. **Science Focus** * **Neurosymbolic methods and trustworthy reasoning:** Combine learning\-based and symbolic techniques to improve reliability, transparency, and alignment with domain constraints. * **Knowledge representation and semantic AI:** Develop methods that help AI systems organize, connect, and reason over complex enterprise information. * **Adaptive and model\-agnostic AI systems:** Explore flexible approaches that integrate models, tools, context, and memory across diverse tasks and environments. **Scalable domain model development:** Develop scalable methods for building domain\-specialized models, spanning automated generation of training and agentic environments, mid\-training on domain data, post\-training through fine\-tuning and reinforcement learning, and rigorous domain\-grounded evaluation. * **Learning from feedback:** Develop methods that enable AI systems to improve safely and effectively from human and operational feedback. * **Evaluation, verification, and interpretability:** Advance rigorous approaches to assessing AI reliability, robustness, safety, and transparency. * **AI for complex workflows:** Explore how intelligent systems can support and improve multi\-step enterprise processes while maintaining appropriate oversight and control. **What You'll Do** * Define and independently drive research questions across one or more of AIVista's science focus areas. * Develop novel algorithms, models, methods, prototypes, and system designs and evaluate their effectiveness through rigorous experimentation. * Design experiments and benchmarks that measure correctness, robustness, calibration, privacy, latency, cost, and process outcomes. * Work with scientists, engineers, and domain experts to translate enterprise data, policies, feedback, and operational constraints into research problems, research artifacts, and deployable systems. * Develop inspectable AI systems and analyses that connect model and agent decisions to evidence, rules, and outcomes. * Move promising research from early experimentation through simulation, controlled evaluation, and potential application in production\-scale AI systems. * Communicate research findings internally and externally and contribute high\-quality research to leading conferences, journals, and the broader scientific community. * Collaborate with and contribute to AIVista's broader research agenda while developing an independent body of research during the postdoctoral appointment. **Qualifications** * PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Electrical or Computer Engineering, Operations Research, or a closely related technical field. **The PhD must be completed prior to the start of the appointment.** * Demonstrated research record in machine learning, artificial intelligence, computer science, or a related technical discipline, evidenced through peer\-reviewed publications, significant research projects, or comparable scientific contributions. * Strong foundations in machine learning, algorithms, statistical methods, experimental design, and empirical research. * Deep research experience in one or more of the following areas: large language models, knowledge representation or knowledge graphs, formal methods, agentic systems, continual learning, multimodal learning, evaluation and interpretability, or process mining. * Ability to independently formulate research questions, design rigorous experiments, analyze results, and communicate scientific findings. * Proficiency in Python and experience implementing and evaluating machine learning or AI systems. * Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across research, engineering, and domain teams. **Areas of Additional Research Experience** Relevant research experience may include: * Neurosymbolic methods, autoformalization, formal verification, theorem proving, or constraint solving. * Ontology construction, knowledge graphs, entity resolution, graph learning, or graph\-based retrieval. * Mid\-training (continued pretraining), supervised fine\-tuning, preference optimization, or reinforcement learning for building domain\-specialized models. * Synthetic data and task generation, verifiable reward design, or scalable pipelines for training and evaluating domain models. * Agent memory, context engineering, model routing and orchestration, planning, tool use, or multi\-agent systems. * Continual, federated, or privacy\-preserving learning; uncertainty calibration; human\-in\-the\-loop systems; or regression\-safe adaptation. * Process mining, digital twins, simulation, workflow systems, or graduated\-autonomy deployments. * Robust and scalable benchmarking, agentic environment construction, and complex task metric design. * Research involving AI systems deployed in regulated, safety\-sensitive, or other high\-stakes environments. **Compensation \& Benefits** The estimated annual base salary for this role is **$150,000USD**. Individual compensation is determined based on job\-related factors including education, research experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, business needs, and market conditions. Eligible employees may participate in Company\-sponsored benefits in accordance with applicable Company policies. **Housing and relocation assistance may be available based on individual circumstances and business needs. Eligible postdoctoral researchers may also receive travel assistance associated with relocation to and from the Palo Alto area, in accordance with Company policy.** NTT DATA AIVista is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, reproductive health decisions, or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.

canonical data models and shared business entities across domains, enabling consistent definitions and reliable data exchange. * Drive architectural decisions that balance immediate business needs batch, streaming, and near\-real\-time data processing. * Establish patterns for data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, data quality, metadata management, lineage, and observability. * Enable platform reliability, performance, security, and cost optimization. **Healthcare \& Insurance Data** * Design data architectures that integrate complex, fragmented data across healthcare, health insurance, employee benefits, employer groups, claims, eligibility, provider networks, and financial systems, as applicable. * Develop a strong understanding of healthcare benefits and insurance business processes, data entities, and industry\-specific interoperability requirements. * Enable secure and governed access to sensitive healthcare and personally identifiable information, incorporating HIPAA and other applicable regulatory and privacy requirements. * Translate complex healthcare and insurance data into consistent, usable models that support business operations, business ownership, trusted metrics, reusability, and measurable business outcomes. **Technical Leader  payer/provider ecosystems. * Familiarity with healthcare data standards and interoperability jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description: **About Dockware** ------------------ Dockware is relentlessly driving toward the error free dock. Every day across the world, millions of freight handlers scan, count, inspect, measure, photograph, label, read, and transcribe shipment data tens of millions of times, and errors are the rule, not the exception. Every error on the dock ripples across the rest of the value chain, leading to inventory management discrepancies, misroutes, under/over pricing, disputes, sub\-optimal asset utilization, and many flavors of claims and chargebacks. As logistics underpins roughly 10% of global GDP, even marginal improvements at the dock translate into massive gains for businesses, workers, and consumers everywhere. Using computer vision, edge hardware, and real\-time ML systems, Dockware captures dimensions, condition, and identifiers for every shipment \- in seconds. That data becomes a verifiable digital twin: a continuously updated, shareable record that moves with the shipment from origin to destination.‍ Our platform integrates directly into existing workflows, eliminating manual data entry, barcode dependency, and costly delays \- while turning messy, real\-world freight into clean, actionable data. The result is a system that reduces disputes, improves operational accuracy, and unlocks better decisions across the supply chain. For the full company vision, read here. Dockware has deep Midwestern roots. Jerks, credit hogs, and elitists need not apply. We come to work and give everything because we know our teammates are doing the same. Similarly, the logistics professionals we serve make modern life possible – full stop. They deserve tech that works and real humans who answer the phone. **About the Role** ------------------ As a **Product Engineer** for our Scan Mobile app, you will bridge the gap between user research and technical implementation. The Scan Mobile app can be used by shippers or drivers, and allows either party to quickly and affordably capture all the accurate data required to originate, track, and/or validate a shipment (Demo of one version of app here). Dockware is also expanding mobile offerings in new customer segments where freight handlers and supervisors need phone or tablet based interaction on the dock. This role is designed for a technically inclined product manager, or an engineer with a talent for customer facing engagement and UX. * **Customer Feedback and Experience:** You'll engage directly with our customers through user interviews and ride\-alongs with drivers to gather insights, then use that feedback to shape the design and functionality of both our web and mobile applications. * **End\-to\-End Product Ownership:** Actively engage at every stage of the product’s lifecycle—from early development to warehouse integration and support. * **UI development**: You may also contribute directly to the UI, writing code for the frontend and mobile platforms. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- **Required:** Proficiency in at least two of the following areas, with a strong interest and enthusiasm for the rest: * Product Management: + Making decisions for the overall product strategy, roadmap, and feature prioritization based on customer impact. + Defining functional requirements and acceptance criteria for mobile and web features. + Balancing technical feasibility, user needs, and business goals to prioritize engineering deliverables. * User Data gathering: + Experience conducting user research, such as interviews or field observations. + Ability to translate user feedback into actionable product enhancements. + Strong communication skills to effectively bridge technical engineering teams and non\-technical stakeholders * UX and Design: + Understanding of user\-centered design principles to craft intuitive, user\-friendly experiences that align with customer expectations. + Experience producing clear design artifacts, including wireframes, user flow diagrams, and Product Requirements Documents (PRDs). * UI Development for Android and iOS + Ideally Kotlin Multi\-platform and Java, but not required. + Familiarity with Android and iOS testing frameworks **Preferred:** * Knowledge and/or experience in supply chain and logistics. **BonusL** * Hands on development experience in both iOS and Android development. * Track record of shipping production software systems * Experience with Machine Learning or Computer Vision products * You have refined your own AI\-augmented development workflow **What Makes You Successful Here** You don't get stuck in the weeds. You commit and follow through. You're comfortable with ambiguity and can make progress without complete specifications. You ask "why" before diving into "how," and you're not afraid to challenge assumptions when something doesn't make sense. This is a high\-ownership environment where your work directly impacts customers and revenue. You'll have autonomy, but you'll also be expected to take initiative and drive projects to completion. **Location** Striking distance of Tulsa, OK preferred, but we're open to exceptional candidates regardless of location. This role may require periodic travel to customer sites and our Tulsa headquarters. *Dockware is building the primary data capture layer for global logistics. If you're ready to tackle computer vision challenges at warehouse scale while keeping world\-class engineers aligned and shipping, we want to hear from you.*

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **About Faex Health** Faex Health turns stool images into gut\-health insights. Our platform combines proprietary computer\-vision models, color\-density analysis, and Felix, our retrieval\-grounded AI assistant, to help people track changes over time and to support clinicians and researchers. Faex runs on iPhone and Android in 13 languages across multiple regions. Live features include Faex MD for clinicians, women’s health with a period tracker, a GLP\-1 gut\-health journey, and partner APIs connecting to care and research ecosystems. **The Role** We are hiring a QA automation engineer to expand and formalize our existing test suite and CI. Today we run a Django test suite and browser regression tests, and an Azure DevOps pipeline runs tests and a secret scan on every pull request to our main and release branches. You will strengthen the frameworks, extend coverage across the web app, APIs, mobile apps, and image\-analysis pipeline, and make test results part of every release decision. You will work directly with our CTO and developers. **What You Will Do** * **Test frameworks.** Expand and formalize our automation frameworks for UI, API, integration, and regression testing, building on the existing Django test suite, with clear structure, reusable components, and reporting. * **Azure Pipelines integration.** Extend the Azure Pipelines YAML checks that already run tests and a secret scan on every pull request, publish results, and add quality gates that block failing builds. * **Azure DevOps test management.** Organize test plans, suites, and cases, using Azure Test Plans where it adds value; log and track defects in Azure Boards linked to stories and builds; keep tests in Azure Repos. * **Web UI automation.** Expand browser regression tests for the Django web app using tools such as Playwright or Selenium, covering our new Bootstrap 5 interface. * **API testing.** Test REST and partner APIs, including FHIR\-based integrations, authentication, and error handling. * **Mobile testing.** Test the iPhone and Android apps that wrap our web app, covering photo upload, deep links, sign\-in flows, and device differences, using tools such as Appium and cloud device testing. * **Image\-analysis pipeline testing.** Build regression checks that run labeled reference images through new model releases to confirm detection, color\-density, and scoring results stay within agreed limits. * **Release verification.** Run and extend smoke tests after Elastic Beanstalk deployments, building on the /health/ check in our deploy pipeline, and help decide whether to proceed or roll back. * **Performance testing.** Create load and performance tests for scan processing, queues, and peak traffic, using tools such as Locust, k6, or JMeter. * **Test data and compliance.** Build safe test data using synthetic or de\-identified records, never real patient information, and support SOC 2 and HIPAA audit evidence. * **Quality metrics.** Track coverage, flaky tests, and defect trends, and work with developers to improve testability. **Required Qualifications** * 5\+ years in software quality assurance, including 3\+ years building test automation. * Hands\-on experience designing and maintaining an automation framework, not just writing scripts within one. * Experience running and maintaining automated tests in CI/CD pipelines, triggered on pull requests and releases. * Strong Python testing skills (Django test framework / unittest; pytest also valuable); experience testing Django or other Python web apps. * Experience with browser automation using Playwright, Selenium, or Cypress. * Experience with API testing tools and frameworks, such as Django’s test client, Python HTTP clients, or Postman. * Solid understanding of CI/CD, Git branching, and test strategies such as unit, integration, end\-to\-end, and regression. * Clear defect reporting and communication with developers. * Comfortable working day to day with AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, Kiro) and quick to pick up new tools as they change. * Ability to work in the Denver office three days per week. **Preferred Qualifications** * Familiarity with the Faex app or experience testing health, wellness, or medical software. * Experience with Azure DevOps: Azure Pipelines YAML, Azure Test Plans, Azure Boards, and Azure Repos. * Experience with mobile automation using Appium or cloud device testing services. * Experience testing machine\-learning or computer\-vision outputs. * Experience with performance testing tools such as Locust, k6, or JMeter. * Experience testing on AWS, including Elastic Beanstalk deployments and environment management. * Experience with PostgreSQL and validating data in tests. * Experience working under HIPAA, SOC 2, or FDA software quality requirements. * ISTQB or a similar testing certification. **How We Work** * Small team, high ownership: you will set our testing standards, not just follow them. * Evidence\-led: every release decision should be backed by test results. * Privacy by default: test data must never expose real health information. Pay: $70,700\.00 \- $85,300\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Vision insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Greenwood Vlg, CO 80111

jobs.title: Senior Computational Chemist
jobs.description: **Adiabatic Materials \| Somerville, MA** ***Reinvent chemistry. Decarbonize industry. Electrify the future.*** Today, most chemicals are still made using heat from burning fossil fuels in energy\-intensive, polluting processes. Adiabatic Materials has developed a fundamentally new approach: an electrochemical synthesis platform that uses clean electricity instead of heat. The platform grew out of 15 years of Harvard research and has been demonstrated for a broad range of chemicals. Adiabatic recently spun out of Harvard and is scaling its operations in the Boston area. **Why Adiabatic might be great for you** We’re a small, early\-stage team working on hard, meaningful problems. If you get energy from making things actually work and want your contributions to directly shape a company’s trajectory, this could be a great fit. * You'll be our first dedicated computational chemist. You'll own the computational side of our chemistry, reporting to our CEO and working closely with our Chief Scientific Officer. * Direct strategic impact. Your data and ideas will help decide which products and targets we pursue, and they will feed directly into our conversations with partners and investors. * Computation close to the lab. You'll work side by side with the chemists who run the experiments, and see your proposals tested at the bench. * Chemistry that is genuinely new. Electrochemical reactions with high functional group tolerance, opening shorter routes to pharmaceutical and fine chemical targets. * Equity and upside. You'll share in the value you help create, alongside a mission\-driven team that cares about science and sustainability. **The Role** We're looking for a Senior Computational Chemist who provides well\-founded data and new ideas for our product strategy decisions, and builds out our ability to access new routes efficiently. A big part of the job is code for retrosynthetic analysis and Bayesian optimization: adapting open\-source tools such as ASKCOS, extending them with our own reactions, and developing new proprietary code, together with the data and parameters behind it. The goal is route planning and process optimization that is commercially useful, e.g. which targets benefit most from our reactions and what a product would cost along a proposed route at different scales. You're a cheminformatics and machine learning expert with a strong interest in chemistry. You enjoy a balance of chemistry discussions and time with your tools and code, and you understand enough chemistry to judge the output of your tools and to answer simple chemistry questions on your own. **What You'll Do** **Synthesis Planning:** Review the available open\-source tools, incl. ASKCOS and RetroAgent, recommend the best fit for our use cases and set it up. Then adapt its code, data and parameters so it proposes the new routes our reactions enable. **Target and Route Screening:** Screen promising pharmaceutical and fine chemical targets for places where our reactions shorten a route or solve a selectivity problem, estimate what a product would cost along a proposed route, and back each opportunity with data. The goal is a ranked shortlist of targets for experimental route validation. You'll also help judge which reactions in development are worth pursuing by their possible economic value. **Reaction Data and Experiment Design:** Set up structured capture of reaction and process data that fits the lab team's daily work, and apply design of experiments or Bayesian optimization to live optimization campaigns. **Working with the Lab:** Spend time with the chemists on site, hand them experiment designs for the most promising proposals, and feed the lab results back into the models. **New Materials:** Get up to speed on structure/property prediction for new materials we may develop, and rank novel structures for synthesis. **AI Tools and Code:** Lead our in\-house AI tools for route planning, optimization and cost prediction, built on third\-party or open\-weight LLMs, and be our go\-to\-person for AI tools more broadly. Write code quickly with AI coding tools, and keep it clean and documented so the team can use it. **What We're Looking For** Many strong candidates don’t fit a standard blueprint. If you bring relevant experience and are excited about what we’re building, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t check every box. **Required:** * PhD in cheminformatics, computational chemistry, chemical engineering, computer science or a closely related field, with a focus on cheminformatics or machine learning for chemistry, or a master's degree plus two years of relevant experience * Strong programming skills in Python and efficient use of AI coding tools, with a track record of code that others use, e.g. a tool, a package, a public repository or a publication with code * Hands\-on cheminformatics and machine learning for chemistry: RDKit or similar toolkits, molecular and reaction representations, and reaction and molecular databases * At least an undergraduate\-level understanding of organic chemistry, enough to judge whether a proposed route is plausible and what a reaction template represents * Hands\-on experience in at least one of: synthesis planning and retrosynthesis, reaction outcome or condition prediction, reaction data curation, Bayesian optimization or design of experiments, automated or high\-throughput experimentation **Nice to Have:** * Experience with a retrosynthesis planner such as ASKCOS or CAS SciFinder (a strong plus) * Hands\-on synthetic lab experience, e.g. a bachelor thesis in a synthetic lab * Pharmaceutical process chemistry, API supply chains, techno\-economic analysis or quantum chemistry (e.g. DFT) * Industry or startup experience is a plus, not a requirement * Electrochemistry experience is not required **Working Style \& Character:** * You like building tools people use: you ship a working first version within weeks and improve it step by step * You seek out the scientists and engineers, ask what they need, and enjoy working with them on site * You are clear about what a model or a dataset can and can't tell us, and you know when computation or AI is the right tool and when it isn't * You can explain a model's answer and its uncertainty to non\-specialists, e.g. for a partner or investor conversation * You pick up adjacent work when the company needs it, e.g. a techno\-economic check or a look at market data * You take high\-level direction, run with it and manage your own time against milestones, you're comfortable with less structure than in a big company, and you care about building a great team culture as we grow **Logistics** * **Location:** Greentown Labs, Somerville, MA. On site four days a week * **Work style:** Flexible, family\-friendly schedule * **Compensation:** $130K to $185K/year, plus meaningful equity and benefits (negotiable). The range is deliberately broad because it spans a strong recent PhD through to about five years of experience **How to Apply** Please submit your resume and include a few sentences about why you're excited about Adiabatic and how this role aligns with your experience. This is also an opportunity to highlight experiences that you feel are particularly relevant for the role. This doesn't need to be a formal cover letter; we just want to understand what motivates you. **The pay range for this role is:** 130,000 \- 185,000 USD per year(Somerville, MA)

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Applied AI
jobs.description: **About Ruxlo** LinkedIn is your professional network. Facebook and Instagram are your social networks. Ruxlo is your home's network. *Your**home**.**Your**neighborhood**.**Your**town**.* Ruxlo benefits everyone involved in real estate. Builders, architects, contractors and realtors do work that is quickly forgotten. A lawn sign stays up for a month or two, and after that no one knows who did the work. We're replacing that with one durable digital record attached to the parcel itself. Work is recorded by the professional who did it and confirmed by the owner who paid for it. When the house sells, the record stays. Think Carfax for homes. Around the property is your neighborhood, where you can comfortably connect and communicate with neighbors through the Ruxlo app, see other property profiles and ask about the contractors your neighbors used. Further out is your town, where you choose the notifications you want, such as recycling, bulk waste pickup, farmers markets or any other event the town sponsors. Underneath all of it, is our database of 150 million properties, users can leverage AI natural language search to get the information they are looking for quickly. We're backed by an experienced SaaS founder and CEO who bootstrapped and exited a GovTech SaaS company in early 2026\. We've assembled a fantastic team and have a unique opportunity to help define a category at the intersection of AI, data and real estate, the largest asset class in the country. **The Role** We're hiring a Staff Software Engineer, Applied AI. You'll set the technical strategy for how Ruxlo builds AI into the product, from a single well\-designed LLM call to long\-running autonomous agents, and you'll be the technical anchor for applied AI across teams. The range is the point. One week you're tuning natural language search over property records or extracting structured data from a scanned receipt. The next you're designing an agent that runs in the background for hours, calls dozens of tools, pauses for a human approval, and resumes exactly where it left off after a failure. Some of these agents act on a user's behalf. A homeowner might ask an agent to request quotes from contractors their neighbors used, file a receipt and warranty, or follow up until a contractor confirms a job. A contractor might hand an agent the import of their work history. These agents carry a user's authority, so they ask before anything consequential, stay inside what that user is allowed to do, and leave a record the user can review. You know when a prompt is enough, when retrieval is needed, and when only an agent will do. The engineer who succeeds here ships all three to production, measures them honestly, keeps their cost in check, and leaves behind a platform other engineers build on. **What's hard:** The patterns for production agents are still being invented, and you'll be setting direction without a playbook to lean on. If that sounds like the appeal rather than the warning, we should talk. What You'll Own * Own the architecture of Ruxlo's AI systems end to end: model access and routing, retrieval, prompt and tool layers, agent runtime, evaluation and cost * Ship LLM\-powered product features, including natural language search, summarization, structured extraction and classification over property, ownership and contractor records. * Ship autonomous background agents that verify, reconcile and enrich records and keep them fresh. * Ship agents that act on a user's behalf, such as requesting quotes, following up with contractors, importing work history and filing documents, with the user's consent at each consequential step. * Design durable, long\-running agent workflows on a durable\-execution engine such as Temporal, with retries, timeouts, idempotent tool calls and safe resume after failure. * Stand up evaluation for every AI feature: golden datasets, offline evaluation, regression gates in continuous integration and production sampling. * Set the standards for safe AI use, including prompt\-injection defense, least\-privilege tool access, delegated authority scoped to what the user could do themselves, and audit trails the user can review. * Make sound build\-versus\-buy calls across model providers, frameworks and vector stores, and treat cost and latency as first\-class constraints alongside * Build shared AI tooling, skills and Model Context Protocol servers, and mentor engineers on building with AI. **What You Bring** *Core Competencies* * Excellent verbal and written communication skills * Ability to work well independently or as part of a team * Adaptable and comfortable working in ambiguity * Strong ownership and follow\-through * Effective use of AI tools in daily work * Sound decision\-making and prioritization * Open to feedback, and able to give it well * Collaborative across functions **Position Specific Requirements** * 8\+ years of engineering experience, including a technical lead role on systems other engineers built on. * LLM\-powered features you shipped to real users, such as retrieval\-augmented search, extraction or classification. lifecycle activities. · Monitor network, server, and cloud environments for availability, performance, capacity, and security issues. · Diagnose infrastructure incidents, perform root\-cause analysis, security initiatives, and technology deployments. · Document configurations, procedures, technical standards, and troubleshooting knowledge. · Identify opportunities to automate repetitive administration and improve operational efficiency. · Collaborate with IT colleagues and business stakeholders to prioritize and resolve technical needs. · Mid to senior\-level experience in systems and network engineering. · Strong hands\-on experience with Microsoft 365, Microsoft Azure, Windows/Linux systems, and enterprise networking. · Solid knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, switching, VPNs, wireless networking, and firewalls. · Experience with identity and access management, backups, monitoring, patching, virtualization, and infrastructure security. · Strong troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis skills, with the ability to independently own issues through resolution. · Experience supporting infrastructure upgrades, migrations, automation, and technical projects. · Strong communication, documentation, and collaboration skills with technical and nontechnical stakeholders. · Comfortable working in a dynamic, startup\-style environment with changing
