jobs.description: **Job Description**: Develop sim2real reinforcement learning (RL) training pipelines for humanoid robots. Train and test robot policies via reinforcement learning for in\-home humanoid robots. Optimize training pipelines for improved performance and training speed. Modeling of physical systems (including robot dynamics, sensor modeling, contact parameter tuning) to close the gap between simulation and physical systems. Collecting, cleaning and retargeting human motion data for use in RL training pipelines. Supporting the test and debug of RL policies in simulation and on physical hardware. **Requirements**: Master’s degree or foreign degree equivalent in Robotics, AI/Machine Learning, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related field and one (1\) year of experience in a Robotics \& Machine Learning occupation or related in the job offered. **Skills:** Experience and/or education must include: * Rigid body dynamics and/or dynamical systems for training, deploying and testing reinforcement learned policies for humanoid robots. * Implement production\-grade Python code for reinforcement learning (RL) and other machine learning training pipelines. * Reinforcement learned algorithms, techniques, and sim2real approaches as they pertain to robotics to perform various human\-like capabilities, including whole\-body loco\-manipulation. * Implement and debug real\-time software in C\+\+ deployed on robots to satisfy various real\-time constraints. * Model physical systems, including multi\-body hybrid dynamic systems with contact, in a simulated environment to identify gaps between simulation and hardware and the ability to understand how to accurately model the hardware in simulation. * Root\-cause analysis as it pertains to robotic systems and the ability to quickly troubleshoot issues. * Forward and inverse kinematics as they pertain to humanoid system training using human motion data. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI-Augmented Development
jobs.description: **At ACT, Your Work Makes a Difference** Education has power – a power that changes lives forever. It creates opportunities that lift up individuals, their families, and sparks societal change that echoes through generations to come. From our grassroots we have fought the good fight for inclusivity in education, and we remain devoted to helping anyone who struggles to access that power. This is what matters to us and we must do better \- we’ve never been more sure of our purpose. ACT team members are part of an organization dedicated to a mission that has never been more important: Helping people achieve education and workplace success. Advancing that mission within our organization, by helping our team members achieve education and workplace success of their own, is core to our values. ACT values a diverse workplace and is committed to fostering an inclusive environment in which every team member has an equal opportunity to grow. We want our team members to have the well\-being and confidence they need to do their best work, in an environment where both they and ACT thrive. To support this, our total rewards include company paid life insurance, medical, dental, vision, flexible health and dependent spending accounts, 401(k) retirement savings with company match, paid holidays, paid time off, and so much more. You can find a comprehensive list of our benefits here. We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer, to help us fulfill that mission. The **Senior Software Engineer** applies advanced knowledge, skill, and expertise to software delivery. Work is both independent and collaborative in nature. This role emphasizes using AI coding tools to develop software efficiently, while owning the judgment calls AI can't make, including reviewing, testing, and correcting AI\-generated work, and taking end\-to\-end ownership of delivery from specification through production. Beyond using AI tools well, this role is expected to actively drive how the team adopts new AI\-assisted development practices by piloting new tools and techniques, and championing what actually works. This is primarily a hands\-on senior engineering role within the team, with the opportunity to grow into a cross\-team responsibility for advancing how the broader engineering organization uses AI\-assisted development tools as the role matures. The finalist will be hired at the salary and level commensurate with their qualifications. **For this position, we anticipate offering an annual salary between $110,000 and $135,000**. ACT manages salaries within this range based on relevant factors, including skills, experience, and internal equity. This position is not incentive eligible. **Location:** This is a remote position, based in the United States. **Visa:** Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for visa sponsorship. **What you will be working on:** * Technical Leadership \& Complex Problem\-Solving + Solve complex technical problems across the team's core systems, using AI\-assisted approaches to move faster, including integrations with related platforms. + Contribute senior\-level technical judgment to active modernization initiatives within the team, using AI tools to accelerate legacy\-to\-modern platform migrations. * AI Tooling Strategy \& Adoption + Pilot new AI\-assisted development tools, models, and techniques within the team (e.g., new agentic coding workflows, MCP integrations, updated model versions), evaluating them against real delivery work rather than vendor claims. + Propose and champion new use cases for AI in the team's engineering practice, backed by a measured before/after comparison — time saved, defect rate, or review burden. + Feed adoption learnings back into team practice, updating norms, playbooks, or tooling recommendations as new approaches prove out (or don't). * Deep Domain Knowledge + Apply deep familiarity with the team's platform architecture, history, and constraints to guide technical decisions, including where AI\-assisted approaches can speed modernization work. * AI\-Directed Development \& Delivery Ownership + Direct AI coding tools and agents to implement features from specs, tickets, or requirements, and own end\-to\-end delivery of the feature from specification through production. + Review, test, and correct AI\-generated code for correctness, security, and architectural fit; catch both subtle errors (a plausible\-but\-wrong calculation, an approach that won't scale) and obvious ones. + Act as a steward against AI\-specific security and supply\-chain risk, scrutinizing AI\-suggested dependencies, flagging unfamiliar or unverified packages before they're accepted, and treating AI\-generated code that touches auth, data access, or external integrations with elevated review. + Write specs detailed enough for an AI tool to implement correctly on the first or second pass; for ambiguous problems, exercise judgment on whether to escalate or proceed independently. + Maintain and extend I\-specific security risk, e.g., unverified or malicious dependencies suggested by AI tools, injected logic in auto\-accepted code; and habits for catching it before it reaches production. * Strong engineering fundamentals (programming, data modeling, API design, security, and distributed systems) that hold up independent of AI tooling; treats AI tools as an amplifier of skill. * Demonstrated ability to work from ambiguous specs, with sound judgment for when to escalate and when to proceed independently. * Experience working (or ability to work) across a mixed legacy and modern technology stack. * Experience owning delivery end to end, from specification through production, including writing specs clear enough for an AI tool to implement correctly. * Bachelor's degree in computer or data science, software engineering, artificial intelligence, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience from which comparable knowledge and abilities can be acquired. **It’s a plus if you have:** * Demonstrated ability to influence engineering practices and colleagues outside of a direct reporting relationship, or interest in growing into this scope. * Experience evaluating or comparing multiple AI coding tools or models for team fit. * Familiarity with test administration or assessment delivery systems, or a comparable domain is valued as a plus alongside strong engineering fundamentals and AI\-directed development skill. * Experience mentoring or setting technical standards across multiple teams. * Background in education technology or a similarly regulated, integration\-heavy domain. * Experience building or extending eval or guardrail frameworks for AI\-generated code. **About ACT** When ACT was founded in 1959, it disrupted the assessment industry with a new approach to helping students better understand their readiness so they could take steps to improve it. By leveraging our expertise and authority in assessment and research, we will again disrupt the industry—helping more people learn, better measure their progress, and improve their navigation through life’s transitions. More than ever before, ACT is fulfilling its mission of helping people achieve education and workplace success. We’re doing it by pushing the boundaries of learning innovation through the work of our people, who we call team members because we’re all in this together. We know transformation does not come without challenge. That’s why ACT invests in a variety of experiences for team members to strengthen their connections, explore ideas, learn from customers, and celebrate success. jobs.description: **Technology Engineer \- Decatur, IL** **Job Summary** The role of the E\&I Reliability Engineer has evolved into a highly specialized position bridging the gap between field expertise and data science. Acting as a data scientist on the shop floor, the primary goal is not to execute rapid emergency repairs, but rather to design and implement prescriptive strategies that ensure the asset never requires an emergency intervention in the first place. This role is responsible for the site’s Electrical, Instrumentation, and Packaging equipment reliability. The engineer will apply statistical reliability methods, and root cause analysis to guarantee the optimum availability of the plant's assets, aligning maintenance strategies and total business objectives. **Essential Job Functions** * Safety \& Electrical Compliance: Support electrical equipment reliability by ensuring the site stays 100% compliant with infrared (IR) scans, required switchgear maintenance and testing, and arc flash studies. Review arc flash studies and help the plant team create proactive hazard remediation plans. * Asset Criticality \& Strategy Development: Conduct criticality screening and risk analysis for E\&I assets. Utilize Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM) to develop Equipment Maintenance Strategies (EMS), optimizing Preventive Maintenance programs to ensure the right tasks are performed at the right intervals. * Defect Elimination \& RCA: Participate in and lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for Electrical, Instrumentation, and Packaging equipment failures using methodologies such as 5 Whys, Ishikawa, and Fault Tree Analysis to eliminate recurrence. * Condition Monitoring \& Industry. Help the site create, audit, and upgrade electrical preventative and predictive programs. Transition from basic monitoring to Predictive 4\.0 (telemetry, advanced IR, acoustic emission). Monitor and validate anomaly detection models (AI/ML concepts) and IIoT sensor data. * Capital Improvement \& Project Integration: Identify E\&I and packaging capital improvement projects through failure analysis and bad actor/threat list development. Work with site leadership to prioritize projects based on Life Cycle Costing (Capex vs. Opex). Write and manage AFEs for approved capital improvement projects. * Technical SME \& Standardization: Act as the Plant Subject Matter Expert (SME) to ensure Best Practices and the Most Effective Technologies (MET) are proposed during project scope development. Serve as the site Focal Point for high voltage contractors repair and inspections. * Data\-Driven Analytics: Review all preventative and predictive data collection reports to provide analytical recommendations for repair or replacement. * Craft Training \& Assessment: Help lead skill gap assessments for craftspeople. Build training materials, standards, and training plans for the site's E\&I craft technicians to foster a Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) culture. **Job Requirements** * Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation, Mechatronics, or a related field. Additional advanced certifications in Reliability Engineering or Data Analytics are highly desired. * Experience: Proven experience in an industrial manufacturing setting focusing on electrical systems, instrumentation, and automation. * Professional experience with RCM, FMEA/FMECA, and RCA methodologies is mandatory. * Technical Skills (Hard Skills): Proficiency in CMMS (Maximo). Knowledge of IIoT protocols, Big Data extraction. Familiarity with Digital Twins concepts and prescriptive maintenance architectures. * Competencies \& Soft Skills: * Systemic Vision: Understanding that maintenance is an integrated part of the supply chain and production, striving for optimal business availability. Bridge Communication: * Change Management: Resilience to foster a proactive reliability culture. * Data\-Driven Decision Making: The courage to halt a critical machine if data indicates imminent failure. A constructive skeptic who trusts trends over superficiality. **Working Conditions** * Environment: Industrial setting with potential exposure to dust, chemicals, and irritants. * Temperature: Ability to work in inside areas where temperatures may exceed 100°F. * Safety Hazards: Exposure to high\-voltage equipment and machinery; strict adherence to LOTO, Arc Flash, and safety protocols. * Physical Mobility: Walking 1–3 hours daily; ability to climb stairs/ladders and perform audits. * Stationary Work: Sit for 5–8 hours for computer\-based analysis and dashboard development. **Physical Requirements** * Lifting: Must be able to lift up to 25 lbs. from waist to shoulder on an occasional basis. * Mobility: Must be able to walk 1–3 hours daily, including walking long distances across the facility to perform equipment audits. * Postures: Must be able to squat, kneel, and climb stairs/ladders on an occasional basis. * Stationary Work: Must be able to sit for 5–8 hours for computer\-based analysis and keyboarding.  out this role but don’t think you meet every requirement listed? We encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this role or another one of our openings. ADM requires the successful completion of a background check. jobs.title: Solutions Architect
jobs.description: **About Us** At AEM, we're on a mission to help organizations unlock the power of their data. We build cutting edge data platforms that power AI and business critical decisions. We're looking for passionate innovators to join our team and help us build better solutions. **Position** As a Solutions Architect, you will be the key technical bridge between our customers' business goals and our world\-class engineering teams. You're an exceptional communicator and thrive on understanding a client's objectives and translating them into working systems. You will align client needs with effective solutions and champion secure, scalable, and cost\-effective data solutions hosted on Azure and AWS, guiding our customers and delivery teams from the initial workshop to a successful launch. **What We Offer*** Make a tangible impact through strategic client opportunities and grow professionally with dedicated support for your education and development. * Thrive in a collaborative, team\-first culture that genuinely cares for its members, reflected in our communication and generous benefits. * Enjoy a flexible environment and work can be performed at our Reston, Virginia office or remotely. * Connect with colleagues from across the country at our annual all\-company gathering to build relationships and celebrate our successes. * Advance your career on a clear path with defined opportunities for growth into senior and principal roles. **How We Work*** **Scrum\-Aligned Collaboration:** We believe in clear goals, user stories, acceptance criteria, and automated testing. We actively participate in planning, reviews, and retrospectives. * **Team\-First Culture:** We seek help early and offer help freely. We elevate our standards through design reviews, pair programming, and shared knowledge management. * **Outcome\-Driven Delivery:** We measure our impact (mission, performance, quality, cycle time), iterate on our processes, and stay focused on delivering customer value. **Key Responsibilities*** **Customer Engagement \& Solution Design:** Lead discovery workshops, clarify business goals, and elicit all functional/non\-functional requirements (security, cost, performance) to design and present a clear solution. * **Data Platform Architecture:** Design modern lakehouse and data platform topologies on Azure and AWS, defining patterns for ingestion, storage, processing (batch/streaming), and consumption (BI/AI/ML). Contribute to the continual evolution of AEM’s solution portfolio. * **Technical \& Business Advisory:** Advise clients on the best services (AWS, Azure, Databricks, Snowflake) to meet their needs. Clearly communicate tradeoffs between cost, complexity, and risk to secure stakeholder alignment. * **Modernization Strategy \& Execution:** Develop and implement modernization roadmaps that align mission priorities with target architectures and phased delivery plans. Assess legacy systems, prioritize initiatives, identify dependencies and risks, and guide implementation against agreed milestones and measurable outcomes. * **AI\-Enabled Solutions \& Processes:** Use approved AI tools to improve solution design and delivery, and identify, evaluate, and incorporate AI capabilities into new systems and business processes where they provide measurable value. Partner with stakeholders to validate results and establish appropriate data protection, cybersecurity, governance, and human oversight. * **Data Governance \& Quality:** Establish and champion data strategies and the value of business glossaries, data catalogs, lineage, master data management, and an organization that continually grows to realize the potential value of their data. * **Engineering \& Team Enablement:** Mentor engineers by improving and explaining our reference architectures, design artifacts, and best\-practice patterns. You'll review designs and PRs to ensure solutions are secure, scalable, and maintainable. **What We're Looking For (Must Have Qualifications):*** **10\+ years in data/analytics**, with at least 5\+ years in an architect role leading end\-to\-end solutions. * **Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree:** Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Software Engineering, Applied Math, Industrial Engineering or similar. * **Federal Sector Experience:** Required experience designing and delivering technology solutions for Federal Civilian agencies or the Department of War, with an understanding of federal mission needs, operating environments, and customer requirements. * **Secure Computing \& Cybersecurity:** Required experience designing and delivering solutions in secure computing environments and incorporating cybersecurity requirements into system architecture, development, and operations, including access controls, data protection, secure configuration, and applicable federal security and compliance requirements. * **Modernization Roadmaps:** Required experience developing and implementing modernization roadmaps that translate current\-state assessments and mission objectives into target architectures, prioritized initiatives, phased transition plans, dependencies, milestones, and measurable outcomes. * **Applied AI \& AI Tool Proficiency:** Required hands\-on experience using AI tools to support solution design, development, analysis, and workflow improvement, and incorporating AI capabilities into new systems and business processes. Experience must include evaluating use cases, integrating and validating AI\-enabled capabilities, and addressing data privacy, cybersecurity, human oversight, and applicable customer policies. * **Exceptional Communication:** Proven customer\-facing skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for business stakeholders, lead workshops, and present to executives. * **BD Experience.** Experience supporting Business Development activities including creating and delivering client presentations, developing solutions, and estimating levels of efforts and system costs. * **Cloud Expertise (Azure or AWS):** Hands\-on experience designing and delivering data platforms using services like Spark, ADLS Gen2, AWS S3, Databricks, Snowflake, Glue, Azure Synapse, CDC, Kafka, Lambda, Delta Lake, Iceberg, EMR, etc. * **Data Engineering Foundations:** Strong proficiency in Python (Pandas/PySpark) and SQL for reproducible, testable data transformations. * **Agile \& Collaborative:** Experience working in Scrum teams and partnering with product owners. * **Eligibility:** Ability to obtain a Public Trust or other security clearances as required by client contracts. **Nice\-to\-Haves (Bonus Points If You Have):*** Experience with commercial data platforms, e.g., Databricks, Snowflake. * Hands\-on experience with data governance tools (e.g., data catalogs, lineage). * Knowledge of MDM, reference data concepts, and data stewardship practice * Experience with multi\-cloud data integration patterns (Azure, AWS, GCP) * Understanding of FinOps, cost optimization strategies, and platform observability. * Relevant certifications from Microsoft Azure or AWS. jobs.title: Performance Engineer
jobs.description: Are you ready to be part of a company that's not just talking about the future, but actively shaping it? Join The AES Corporation, the largest US\-based global power company with a team of 8,300 employees across 12 countries. AES has been **ranked \#1 by BloombergNEF** in renewable energy sales to corporations in the US and Americas for five consecutive years, providing electricity for **millions of people worldwide.** We are proud to foster a strong workplace culture, earning prominent positions in Great Place to Work™ rankings across the markets where we operate. AES was also named one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies for the 13th consecutive year in 2026, highlighting our dedication to integrity, transparency, and responsible business practices. Our spirit of innovation continues to earn industry recognition. AES is the only seven\-time winner of the Edison Electric Institute’s Edison Awards in the twenty\-first century, a distinction honoring global leadership in advancing the electric power industry. If you're ready to be part of a company that's not just adapting to change, but driving it, AES is the place for you. We're not just building a more sustainable future, we're powering it. Apply now and energize your career with a true leader in global energy. AES Clean Energy (CE) is seeking a Performance Engineer to support the O\&M Engineering team by analyzing and optimizing the performance of our rapidly growing portfolio of photovoltaic and battery storage projects. This role is pivotal in ensuring our assets operate above industry standards for reliability, safety, and performance. The ideal candidate is a self\-starter with the experience and drive to implement programs and processes that ensure reliable, safe, and optimal generation. A day in the life of an AES CE Performance Engineer will include, but is not limited to: **Operations** * Analyze operational performance and trends of solar plus storage sites. * Lead execution of performance tests in accordance with production and capacity commitments. * Remotely investigate site performance and review system design to identify root causes of lost energy. * Configure and validate performance alerts in DAS. * Review third\-party reporting to inform performance analysis. * Support the transition from projects under construction to operating assets. * Troubleshoot systems in operation and review performance data to identify issues. * Perform or review capacity and performance ratio tests for projects in operation. * Review production estimates and meteorological data sources for accuracy. * Measure fleet performance against established KPIs and compare actual to forecasted results. * Produce monthly, quarterly, and annual performance reports with detailed variance analysis. * Seek and evaluate proposals for analysis services and consultants as needed. * Perform job safety assessments and safety walks to identify job\-site hazard. **Collaboration** * Coordinate with field service and asset management teams to improve site performance. * Collaborate with Operations and Engineering teams to identify underperformance and recommend improvements. * “Close the loop” between Operations and Engineering by recording and communicating issues that can be mitigated through better design. * Utilize technology such as drones, LiDAR, thermal imaging, and 3D modeling to reduce field labor and improve operational performance. * Lead operations engineering coordination with field service and asset management teams. **Growth and Leadership** * Participate in AES CE’s growth planning process by contributing to process improvement task forces and strategic planning activities. * Improve and develop processes for the execution of safe, quality, and high\-performance projects. * Educate the team on changing trends in technology, best practices, and safety. The Performance Engineer supports a larger operations team and serves as the subject matter expert for technical and engineering matters related to the overall performance of photovoltaic plants and grid\-scale battery storage systems. Excellent communication, task management, and planning skills are needed, in addition to technical breadth. While performance analysis is the primary qualification, the role will require the review of information related to all practical elements of photovoltaic and battery system design. The successful applicant, while not an expert, will be comfortable with high\-level review of all elements of practical system design. **The position may include up to 10\-15% travel to project locations and partner offices.** **Skills and Qualifications** **Primary Qualifications** * Undergraduate degree in Engineering or equivalent technical field. * Strong understanding of industry trends in production tools and processes. * Proficiency with advanced analysis and database tools for development of metrics and dashboards. * Ability to work effectively with Microsoft software programs, including but not limited to Excel, Outlook, Word, and PowerPoint. * Demonstrated ability to read and comprehend equipment/facility schematics. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * High degree of commitment to a quality safety culture and an incident\-free work environment. * Willingness to travel within the U.S. to support company’s portfolio of PV solar/BESS assets. * Personal values consistent with those of the AES Corporation: Safety, Integrity, Excellence, Agility, and Fun. **Plus Qualifications** * PE qualifications, or on track to become qualified. * Master’s degree in Engineering. * Experience with PV and Battery Energy Storage System design and interconnection. * Proficiency with PowerBI, machine learning, or advanced analysis tools. * Professional experience in engineering with focus on measuring and maintaining system performance. * Experience with Data Acquisition and SCADA systems. * Spanish language skills. AES is an Equal Opportunity Employer who is committed to building strength and delivering long\-term sustainability through diversity and inclusion. Respecting all backgrounds, differences and perspectives enables us to improve the lives of our people, customers, suppliers, contractors, and the communities in which we live and work. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity and/or expression, race, national origin, ethnicity, age, religion, marital status, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical condition, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. E\-Verify Notice: AES will provide the Social Security Administration (SSA) and if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) with information from each new employee's I\-9 to confirm work authorization. * Establish and maintain logging, monitoring, and alerting using CloudWatch, with dashboards and runbooks that support effective troubleshooting and incident response. * Work with developers to design and implement application capabilities that depend on platform or infrastructure changes. * Advise and support project teams building bespoke applications and tools for deployment in varied client environments. * Create and maintain clear infrastructure documentation, explain technical tradeoffs, and turn recurring work into repeatable processes. * Communication with varied stakeholders including engineering, product and other teams **WHAT YOU’LL BRING / QUALIFICATIONS** **Required:** * At least 4 yearsof relevant professional experience in platform, cloud, or DevOps engineering, identity, and Karpenter. * Hands\-on AWS expertise across multiple accounts and regions, including networking, S3, RDS, and Access Management (IAM). * Strong Terraform skills, including experience designing reusable modules and service blueprints. * Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, Docker and Kubernetes. * Experience with CloudWatch logging, metrics, and alert routing, plus a practical understanding of Prometheus and Grafana within a Kubernetes cluster. * Working knowledge of scripting and configuration tools, such as Bash and YAML with an understanding of the underlying logic and system behavior. * Strong organizational skills and an ownership mindset, with the ability to manage work independently, follow through on commitments, and stay aligned with team priorities. * The ability to learn unfamiliar systems, adapt to changing tools and priorities, and solve problems while recognizing when to seek input. * Clear written and verbal communication skills in English, including the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to non\-technical colleagues and create useful documentation. **Additional experience that would be helpful:** * 5 or more years of relevant professional experience * Familiarity with Terragrunt, including the use of modules, units, and stacks. * Experience with PostgreSQL/PostGIS or other geospatial data technologies. Experience with data orchestration tools such as MWAA or Airflow, and production\-grade extract, transform, and lod (ETL) workflows. * Experience with large\-scale or distributed batch computing using platforms such as AWS Batch, Glue, EMR, ECS/Fargate, EKS, or Databricks. * Familiarity with cloud cost\-management practices, including tagging, cost reporting, and budgets. * Experience with agentic workflows, Model Context Protocol (MCP) services, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), or other LLM application infrastructure. * A degree in information technology, computer science, engineering, or a related field is helpful but not required. **LOCATION \& WORKING ARRANGEMENTS** This role can be based out of one of our US Office locations (Boston, MA; New York, NY; Los Angeles, CA; San Francisco, CA) OR fully remote in select states. **COMPENSATION**: $120,000\-$160,000 (depending on location and experience) \+ performance bonus We offer a range of benefits to support your health, well\-being, and life outside of work, including paid time off, health, dental, and vision insurance, flexible spending accounts, fertility and family\-forming benefits, life insurance, short\- and long\-term disability coverage, and a 401(k) with company match. We believe that equal employment opportunity is a key principle for the successful operation of any business, and especially ours. We are committed to ensuring that all employees, at all levels, feel supported, feel a sense of belonging, and are equally invested in the success of our shared work. This starts with ensuring that we draw the most talented people from all backgrounds. Altman Solon is an Equal Opportunity Employer and E\-Verify user. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or other protected status. **Please note, we are unable to provide sponsorship for employment visa status for this role.** Please see below for additional information regarding sponsorship: * If your responses regarding your work authorization and/or sponsorship needs are inconsistent between your application and the information you provide us at any point thereafter, Altman Solon reserves the right to discontinue consideration for employment. jobs.title: Automation & Integration Engineer
jobs.description: **Automation \& Integration Engineer** **Remote position**, ideally located in New England Want to make a real difference in the world—and enjoy doing it? At Abode Energy Management (Abode), we care deeply about the work we do and the impact it has on our planet’s future. As proud members of 1% for the Planet, we back that care with action—donating at least 1% of our annual revenue to vetted environmental nonprofits. We’re a fast\-growing energy efficiency program implementer in the Northeast, leading the way in electrification and heat pump adoption. Our team is fun, kind, passionate, and progressive—and we offer a competitive benefits package to match. That includes Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, and Disability Insurance, a matching 401(k), and fully paid Parental Leave. We also believe you should be able to balance your work and personal life, so we offer generous paid time off (about 37 days a year!) and reasonable flexibility in when and where you work. If you’re looking for meaningful work, caring coworkers, and a great company culture, come join us. **Summary/Objective** Abode runs utility and government energy programs across New England, and much of that work depends on automations that move information between the tools our teams and customers use: Calendly, JotForm, SharePoint, Airtable, and Salesforce. We are consolidating these automations onto n8n and adding AI steps built on Claude, so program staff spend less time on data entry and more time helping customers and contractors. The Automation \& Integration Engineer will own Abode's automation platform as we standardize on n8n: designing new workflows, modernizing existing ones, and keeping everything reliable and well documented. **Responsibilities** The Automation \& Integration Engineer will report to the Senior Director of Product and work closely with our Salesforce administrator and program teams. This position will include some or all of the following responsibilities: * Designing, building, and maintaining n8n workflows for program intake, scheduling, surveys, contractor enrollment, quality assurance, and reporting * Modernizing existing automations onto n8n, consolidating where it makes sense, with test plans and rollback steps * Integrating Salesforce, JotForm, SharePoint and OneDrive (Microsoft Graph), Airtable, and Calendly through REST APIs, webhooks, and OAuth * Building AI\-assisted steps with Claude, such as document extraction, classification, and summarization, including structured outputs, validation, human review of low\-confidence results, and tracking usage costs * Setting and following standards for error handling, retries, scheduling, logging, and alerting, and resolving break\-fix issues * Serving as primary owner of Abode's automations, with documentation and runbooks that let teammates provide backup coverage * Gathering requirements with program staff and turning them into workflows that are simple to maintain * Managing credentials, service accounts, and access scopes securely, in line with Abode's data security and AI use policies * Supporting data flows into our reporting stack (BigQuery and Sigma) as needed * Identifying new automation opportunities and helping prioritize them with the technology team **Qualifications** Required * 3 to 5 years building production automations or integrations between SaaS systems * Strong working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, and OAuth 2\.0 * Scripting experience in JavaScript or Python (for example, in n8n Code nodes or custom API calls) * API integration experience with Salesforce or Microsoft Graph/SharePoint * Habits of good error handling, logging, and written documentation * Ability to work directly with non\-technical program staff and explain technical work clearly Preferred * Production n8n experience is strongly preferred, as we are actively standardizing our automations on n8n. Deep experience with a comparable platform (Make, Zapier, Power Automate, Workato) will be considered. * Building LLM steps into workflows, ideally with Claude or the Anthropic API * Experience with both Salesforce and Microsoft Graph, plus JotForm, Calendly, or Airtable * Experience moving workflows between platforms (for example, from Power Automate or Zapier to n8n) * SQL or BigQuery * Interest in clean energy, energy efficiency, or utility programs **Compensation and Benefits** This is a full\-time, exempt position with total compensation targeted between $100K and $120K, depending on relevant skills and experience. The Automation Engineer will work most of the time out of their own home, with some travel as needed to work with other staff in Abode’s Burlington office and/or to attend events or meetings. Abode offers its employees a competitive benefits package, including Medical, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability Insurance, a matching 401k, and fully paid Parental Leave. Employees have a flexible working schedule and generous paid time off (\~37 paid days off, or \~15% of all weekdays). **To Apply** To apply, please visit https://abodeenergy.com/about\-abode/careers\-and\-culture/ to submit a resume and cover letter. Please include a link to, or a short screen\-recorded walkthrough (10 minutes or less) of, an automation you've built in any platform. Applications will not be considered without a cover note clearly explaining why you would be a good fit for this position. We look forward to hearing from you! *Abode is focused on broadening opportunities for individuals from demographic groups that are historically underrepresented in the energy sector. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace culture where talented people of widely diverse backgrounds thrive. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, veteran status or disability.* uXU6YPNfXn

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer
jobs.description: AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation. At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD. We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived. ***We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD.*** AHEAD is on the hunt for an exceptional Senior Software Engineer to help build Hatch, our flagship platform. We’re a leading IT services provider, trusted by some of the world’s largest companies to design, build, run, and modernize their most important technology across cloud, data, AI, and security. Hatch is an advanced platform for IT lifecycle management, renewal, procurement, and logistics, giving enterprises real\-time visibility and control over their IT assets, orders, contracts, and inventory across thousands of sites. Unity, its sibling platform, extends those capabilities to streamline our own operations and service delivery. You’ll join a progressive engineering team that lives on the forefront of technology. We build real products, adopt new tools early, sweat the details, and trade ideas constantly. You will learn here, and you’ll have the autonomy to make a visible impact fast. We’re far less interested in the languages on your résumé than in how you think. You’ll own meaningful problems end to end, starting from the user and the business outcome. You’ll design, build, and ship full\-stack solutions, make sound architectural calls, and stay accountable for quality from first commit to production. Our stack today is Elixir and Phoenix, but we care far more that you can pick up whatever a problem demands and bring strong engineering judgment to it. ### **Building in the Age of AI** AI has changed what great engineering looks like, and we’ve leaned in. We expect engineers to use AI tools and coding agents fluently to prototype, explore, and accelerate the routine, so that human time goes to what matters: framing the right problem, designing the system, exercising judgment, and verifying that what ships is correct and secure. We’re not looking for people who fear the tools, or who trust them blindly. We’re looking for engineers who wield them with taste. * Reach for AI to move faster on scaffolding, refactors, tests, and research, then review every line like you own it, because you do. * Spend your judgment where it counts: architecture, product decisions, edge cases, security, and correctness. * Help push the practice forward with better tooling, prompts, and workflows that make the whole team more effective. ### **What will you be doing?** * Own features and problems end to end, from understanding the user’s need through design, delivery, and support. * Design and build full\-stack solutions for internal and public web applications, making pragmatic architectural decisions along the way. * Work at high leverage with AI tools and agents, then review, test, and harden everything you ship. * Engage across the full development life cycle: analysis, implementation, integration, testing, debugging, and support. * Lead code reviews and raise the bar on quality, mentoring other engineers as you go. * Work directly with end users and stakeholders to understand the business problem behind each request. * Help set estimates and milestones, balance technical risk against cost and deadlines, and keep work on track. * Help drive the future roadmap of the engineering team and AHEAD. ### **What does the ideal candidate look like?** * 5\+ years building and shipping software (7\+ preferred), with a track record of owning significant work end to end. * Strong engineering judgment. You know what “good” looks like and can tell solid solutions from shaky ones, including code an AI wrote. * A product mindset: you start from the user and the outcome, and you sweat the details that make software useful. * Fluency with modern AI development tools and coding agents, paired with the discipline to verify, test, and own everything you ship. * Stack\-agnostic adaptability, so you pick up new languages and frameworks quickly. (Our stack today is Elixir and Phoenix; prior experience is welcome but not required.) * A strong foundation in software design, architecture, and the practices that keep systems reliable, including testing, continuous integration, code review, and containerization. * Clear, direct communication, so you can express intent precisely to both teammates and the tools you work with. * The instincts of a senior engineer: you lead projects, mentor others, and raise the level of the people around you. * A drive to keep learning and to help shape how the team builds. ### **Why you'll love it here** * Join a progressive team that lives on the forefront of technology, where innovation and curiosity are the norm. * We invest seriously in modern tooling, including the best AI tools, and we’re always looking for the next approach that makes the team better. * Competitive salary, benefits, and an environment where work\-life balance is more than just a catchphrase. * You’ll play a crucial role in a platform that enterprises rely on to manage their IT, working alongside a talented and motivated team. ### **Make your voice heard** AHEAD recognizes the value of diverse perspectives. In our ever\-evolving tech landscape, the insights you bring from your own journey can reshape our collective experience. If you’ve had experiences, both good and challenging, with other platforms, technologies, or ways of working, they’ll become an asset here. Your voice will help refine our products and the way we build them, keeping both innovative, intuitive, and industry\-leading. *Please include links to anything that shows how you build, whether that’s repositories, projects you led, or pull requests that reflect the breadth of your work. If you’ve built something interesting with AI tools or agents, we’d love to see that too.* *The compensation range indicated in this posting reflects the On\-Target Earnings (“OTE”) for this role, which includes a base salary and any applicable target bonus amount. This OTE range may vary based on the candidate’s relevant experience, qualifications, and geographic location.* **Why AHEAD:** Through our daily work and internal groups like Moving Women AHEAD and RISE AHEAD, we value and benefit from diversity of people, ideas, experience, and everything in between. We fuel growth by stacking our office with top\-notch technologies in a multi\-million\-dollar lab, by encouraging cross department training and development, sponsoring certifications and credentials for continued learning. **USA Employment Benefits include:** * Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance * 401(k) * Paid company holidays * Paid time off * Paid parental and caregiver leave * Plus more! See benefits https://www.aheadbenefits.com/ for additional details. **Use of AI:** We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, assessing responses, or to capture recordings and create transcriptions or summaries during interviews. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. jobs.title: Engineering Manager (AI)
jobs.description: **About AiPrise** ----------------- AiPrise is a YC\-backed, Series A company building the global compliance infrastructure for financial services. We help banks, fintechs, cross\-border payment providers, stablecoin and crypto companies, and marketplaces gain a 360° view of every business they onboard, anywhere in the world. Through a single integration, we connect 800\+ data sources and 80\+ verification partners across 200\+ countries, powering KYB, KYC, AML, sanctions screening, and ongoing monitoring for companies like Meta, Airwallex, Fireblocks, and Bridge. Our AI Agents help compliance teams do more with less, resolving more cases, catching more fraud, and scaling operations without scaling headcount. We're \~60 people, Series A funded, and obsessed with a single problem: making compliance feel simple for the teams who live in it every day. Borders shouldn't be blockers. Compliance is hard. AiPrise shouldn't be. **About the role** ------------------ We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead and grow the team that builds AiPrise's AI agents. This is a player\-coach role: you will manage, hire and develop engineers, and you will also stay close enough to the code to design agent architectures, review prompts and tool definitions, and debug a failing eval yourself. You will own how our agents are built, measured and shipped: the skills and tools they call, how they remember context across a case, and the evals that tell us whether a change made them better or worse. In a regulated domain like KYC and KYB, an agent that is confidently wrong costs our customers real money and audit risk, so quality and observability matter as much as speed. **What you'll do** ------------------ **Lead the team** * Manage a team of 5\-6 AI and backend engineers: weekly 1:1s, clear goals, honest feedback and career growth plans. * Hire the next wave of AI engineers. You will own the interview loop for agent\-engineering roles and raise the bar on it. * Run planning and delivery for the AI roadmap with product, so the team ships on predictable cycles without burning out. * Build a culture where engineers write evals before they claim a win, and where incidents lead to fixes, not blame. **Build the agents, hands on** * Design and review our compliance agents, from single document checks to multi\-step investigations that hand off to human reviewers. * Build the reusable skills, tools and memory our agents rely on to call registries and data vendors and carry context across a case. * Own the eval stack: golden datasets built with compliance experts, regression tests in CI and production monitoring. * Write and review code about 50% of the time, and choose models based on accuracy, cost and latency. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- **People leadership** * 2\+ years managing engineers directly, including hiring, performance reviews and at least one hard conversation you handled well. * A track record of growing engineers: someone you managed got promoted or took on a bigger scope because of your support. * Experience running planning and delivery for a team in a fast\-moving startup or scale\-up. **Hands\-on agent engineering** * 6\+ years as a software engineer, with strong backend skills in Python or TypeScript. * You have built and shipped LLM agents to production, not just prototypes, and can explain what broke and how you fixed it. * Practical experience with each of these: designing tool and function\-calling interfaces; packaging reusable skills or prompt modules; implementing agent memory (short\-term context, long\-term stores, retrieval); and building evals that gate releases. * Comfort with at least one major model API (Anthropic, OpenAI or similar) and the trade\-offs between agent frameworks and plain code. * A habit of measuring: you can show an eval you built, the metric it tracked and a decision it changed. **How you work** * Clear written communication. You can explain an agent failure to a compliance lead and to an engineer. * Good judgment on when to build, when to buy and when to keep a human in the loop. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience in fintech, regtech, fraud, identity verification or another regulated domain where AI decisions need an audit trail. * Document AI experience: OCR, document classification or extraction across many languages and formats. * Experience with LLM observability and tracing tools, and with cost and latency optimization at scale. * Contributions to open\-source agent, eval or retrieval projects, or public writing on the topic. Compensation Range: $185K \- $230K

jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- The Investment Management System (IMS) is the system of record for Amazon's corporate investment and warrant portfolios — more than $200 billion in value across 700\+ positions, spanning minority investments, the four corporate funds, and commercial\-activity warrants. IMS serves teams across the Mergers \& Acquisitions (M\&A) ecosystem, including Corporate Development, Business Development, Accounting, Tax, Legal, and Treasury. When someone needs to know what a holding is worth today, how much of a warrant Amazon has earned through its commercial deals, or simply what Amazon owns and what it's worth, IMS is where they get the answer. IMS data feeds directly into Amazon's financial statements and supports real\-time investment decisions, so accuracy and timeliness are non\-negotiable. A core part of this role is keeping IMS accurate, trustworthy, and current — continuously ingesting new deals and milestones, and integrating and regularly reconciling with other internal and external systems (Amazon Lantern, Accounting, Tax, Legal, Treasury, Factset). We are a small, high\-ownership technical team with a unique organizational structure: we sit within a larger finance team. This is a deliberate decision to embed technical expertise directly alongside finance partners, enabling rapid collaboration, troubleshooting, and delivery. As a result, this role requires close, effective collaboration and communication with both technical colleagues and non\-technical stakeholders and team members. The role indexes high on visibility, ownership, and business acumen. You will manage a team of 2 to 4 software developers \- setting technical direction, unblocking the team, conducting code reviews, and raising the bar on engineering quality. You will design and build the services, data pipelines, and web application that power IMS, and you will own the programs that deliver them. That means working directly with stakeholders and leaders across the M\&A ecosystem, translating their needs into clear requirements, and driving the work through to reliable, compliant outcomes. You will drive the IMS roadmap end\-to\-end, prioritizing work, managing stakeholder expectations, and balancing near\-term operational needs with longer\-term platform investments. Tech stack: a serverless, event\-driven backend on AWS (Python), a PostgreSQL database, a React web application, and an AI assistant built on Amazon Bedrock — all deployed through infrastructure\-as\-code and Amazon's internal CI/CD, with AI\-assisted development tools used daily. Key job responsibilities * Own the architecture and the hardest technical problems in IMS, including the services and APIs that serve investment and warrant data, the quarterly data pipelines that carry positions from one quarter to the next, and the checks that catch when IMS and upstream finance systems disagree. * Own the data model and the financial calculations (such as internal rate of return, unrealized value, and warrant vesting progress), and write the code and tests that the rest of the team builds on. * Build the React web application that business users work in every day, and own the Amazon Bedrock–based AI assistant that lets them ask questions about the portfolio in plain language. * Work directly with leaders across the M\&A ecosystem to turn open\-ended requests into concrete requirements, sequence the work, manage dependencies, and deliver each program. You own the outcome, not just your part of it. * Run the deadline\-bound work the team cannot miss, including the quarterly close. * Lead integrations with partner data teams across multiple systems. * Define infrastructure as code with AWS CDK, raise the bar in code and design reviews, and keep stakeholders and engineers aligned as work progresses. jobs.title: WordPress/WooCommerce Developer — Existing Website Completion & Final QA
jobs.description: WordPress/WooCommerce Developer — Existing Website Completion ONE\-TIME PROJECT — $400 TOTAL FIXED PRICE — PAYMENT BY MILESTONES Seeking an experienced, detail\-oriented, independent U.S.\-based WordPress/WooCommerce developer to finish an existing wellness and lifestyle website. Target completion: within one week of the agreed start date. Confirm feasibility after inspecting the website. Desktop work must be completed and accepted before proceeding to mobile/tablet work. MILESTONE 2 — MOBILE AND TABLET COMPLETION: $200 * Independently review all existing pages and customer\-facing functions on mobile and tablet. * Correct agreed issues involving readability, text clipping, word wrapping, images, navigation, buttons, spacing, overflow, forms, and checkout. * Identify problems proactively without requiring the owner to direct every adjustment. * Preserve the approved desktop work while making responsive corrections. * Submit the completed mobile/tablet work for owner review. MILESTONE 3 — FINAL CORRECTIONS AND DELIVERY: $75 * Confirm that the completed desktop, mobile, and tablet website works correctly across the agreed scope. * Resolve outstanding defects in the agreed work. * Provide an updated desktop review ZIP if subsequent corrections affect desktop. * Provide a concise change summary and brief written instructions for independently managing blog posts. * Retain a final backup within GoDaddy. * Submit the completed website for final owner review and acceptance. WORKING AND SECURITY REQUIREMENTS * All inspection, development, and verification must remain within the existing GoDaddy hosting environment. No downloading or hosting website copies on local computers or external servers. * Staging requires prior written owner authorization and must remain within GoDaddy. * Preserve the owner’s hosting, website ownership, approved content, and existing working systems. * No new plugins or themes, hosting/DNS changes, migrations, payment\-gateway replacement, or major structural changes without prior written authorization. * Do not rewrite, shorten, expand, or replace approved content without written permission. * If another issue is discovered, explain it in writing and obtain approval before making changes outside the agreed scope. * No AI\-generated or AI\-modified code. Use existing WordPress/Elementor settings where appropriate; necessary custom code must be written by the developer. * All communication must be in writing. No voice or video calls. * Coming Soon must remain active. No public launch without explicit written owner approval. * Create a backup within GoDaddy before making changes. * Assessment access will be provided individually through a temporary WordPress account for a mutually scheduled two\-hour inspection window. Inspection does not authorize changes. DELIVERY AND ACCEPTANCE Provide an organized desktop review ZIP with clearly labeled, page\-by\-page visitor\-facing views in a format agreed before hiring. Videos or a collection of isolated screenshots are not the requested delivery format. Preparation of this owner\-requested review package does not authorize copying the WordPress installation or database outside GoDaddy. The completed website must also be available for direct desktop, mobile, and tablet review. Visual evidence alone does not establish that functionality works. The developer is responsible for confirming that the delivered work functions correctly before submitting each milestone. This is included in the $400 fixed project price. The owner will review submissions promptly and provide consolidated feedback. HONEST ASSESSMENT AND FOLLOW\-THROUGH We value a developer who gives small corrections the same care as larger tasks, works independently, and respects everyone’s time. Review the website and requirements before accepting. If you cannot complete the agreed work for $400 within these boundaries, please say so upfront. jobs.title: Principal Full-Stack AI Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: The Principal Full\-Stack AI Engineer (Level V) is the most senior individual\-contributor technical authority for AI\-enabled software engineering within AssistRx Engineering. This is an enterprise software engineering role with deep AI responsibility, not a narrowly specialized machine learning role. The Principal Engineer defines technical strategy while remaining hands\-on in the design and delivery of the company’s most complex systems. The role spans conventional and AI\-enabled architectures. Depending on the business problem, the Principal Engineer may lead a modern web application, REST and event\-driven services, enterprise integrations, data workflows, cloud platforms, generative AI, predictive models, intelligent document processing, agentic automation, or a combination of these. The Principal Engineer is expected to choose technologies and languages based on the problem, and to recognize when conventional software or deterministic logic is a better solution than AI. Reporting to the Vice President, Engineering, this role shapes enterprise technical direction, establishes reference architectures and engineering standards, advises executive and engineering leadership, represents AssistRx capabilities with clients, partners, and auditors, and develops the next generation of technical leaders. It is accountable for quality, security, reliability, performance, maintainability, cost efficiency, and the safe and compliant use of AI with protected health information across the enterprise. Responsibilities: **Enterprise Strategy and Architecture** ---------------------------------------- * Define the multi\-year technical strategy for AI\-enabled software in partnership with Engineering, Product, and Architecture, aligning investments to business value, feasibility, risk, and total cost of ownership. * Lead the architecture and delivery of the most complex enterprise\-scale solutions spanning multiple products, clients, platforms, and technology stacks. * Set the enterprise standard for when to use GenAI, predictive models, intelligent document processing, conventional application logic, workflow automation, or a hybrid approach. * Own reference architectures and engineering standards for web applications, APIs, distributed services, integrations, data flows, model access, retrieval services, prompt and version management, evaluation, observability, security, and resilience. * Identify emerging technologies and architectural patterns that create competitive advantage, and lead proofs of concept through production\-scale adoption when evidence supports the investment. **Full\-Stack Engineering and Delivery** ---------------------------------------- * Remain hands\-on in the design, implementation, review, troubleshooting, and production hardening of critical solutions across frontend, backend, cloud, integration, data, and AI layers. * Ensure AI capabilities are embedded in coherent, usable, secure, and supportable applications rather than delivered as isolated model or service components. * Lead the design of modern web experiences, REST APIs, event\-driven and distributed services, enterprise integrations, identity and access patterns, and cloud infrastructure where required by the initiative. * Resolve systemic technical constraints and cross\-team dependencies, and create platform capabilities that allow multiple teams to deliver safely and consistently. * Set standards for automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, observability, performance engineering, incident learning, and production readiness across AI\-enabled solutions. **Applied AI and Responsible AI** --------------------------------- * Architect enterprise LLM applications using retrieval\-augmented generation, structured outputs, prompt design, function and tool calling, agent\-based orchestration, and appropriate model\-selection strategies. * Set patterns for conversational AI, voice experiences, assistants, intelligent document workflows, and agentic systems, including state management, routing, human review, bounded autonomy, and safe fallbacks. * Define enterprise evaluation standards for quality, grounding, safety, bias, privacy, latency, reliability, and cost; ensure regression testing and monitoring are integrated into the delivery lifecycle. * Establish responsible AI practices appropriate for protected health information and high\-impact healthcare workflows in partnership with Security, Compliance, Legal, and business owners. * Set the standard for design documentation of AI features, covering intended behavior, context and retrieval design, prompt and agent structure, evaluation approach, and fallback behavior * Anticipate scaling, reliability, and cost challenges in AI systems, and lead architectural investments that address them before they affect clients * Evaluate models, platforms, and vendors; make build\-versus\-buy recommendations and guide commercial and technical decisions based on evidence. * Set th ith engineering peers * Conduct regular self\-guided study to stay current in a fast\-moving AI landscape, and bring relevant new techniques and tooling to the team’s attention Qualifications: * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience; Master’s degree preferred. * 10\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including substantial experience building and operating distributed production systems and delivering AI or machine learning capabilities in production. * Demonstrated principal\-level architecture and technical leadership across multiple products, teams, platforms, or business domains. * Deep full\-stack engineering experience covering modern web applications, REST and event\-driven services, data access, system integration, cloud infrastructure, automated testing, deployment, observability, and production operations. * Expert\-level capability in at least one general\-purpose application development language and strong production experience in additional languages, such as C\#, Java, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, or comparable technologies. * Experience with a modern frontend framework such as React, Angular, Vue, or a comparable framework, including the architectural concerns of production user\-facing applications. * Deep hands\-on expertise with LLM and GenAI patterns, including RAG, structured outputs, prompt and context design, tool/function calling, agents, evaluation, guardrails, monitoring, and cost management. * Experience evaluating model quality, cost, latency, security, privacy, and operational risk in production AI systems. * Expertise in cloud architecture, distributed systems, containers, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, application security, reliability, performance optimization, and technical risk management. * Demonstrated ability to make technology\-agnostic architectural decisions and to operate effectively outside a historical language or platform specialization. * Executive\-level communication skills and a record of influencing technical direction without relying on direct organizational authority. **Preferred Qualifications** ============================ * Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field. * Experience in healthcare technology, specialty medication access, protected health information, or another highly regulated environment. * Experience defining enterprise architecture or platform strategy for AI\-enabled software across multiple product teams. * Experience with conversational AI, voice applications, intelligent document processing, predictive models, or agentic workflows at enterprise scale. * Experience supporting client, partner, regulatory, compliance, or audit discussions involving production technology and AI risk. * Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or infrastructure\-as\-code * Experience with agent and orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, Strands, or Model Context Protocol * Experience with machine learning operations tooling, model registries, feature jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, ML Evaluation & Introspection Infrastructure
jobs.description: **Who we are** Aurora’s mission is to deliver the benefits of self\-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly. The Aurora Driver will create a new era in mobility and logistics, one that will bring a safer, more efficient, and more accessible future to everyone. At Aurora, you will tackle massively complex problems alongside other passionate, intelligent individuals, growing as an expert while expanding your knowledge. For the latest news from Aurora, visit aurora.tech or follow us on LinkedIn. **What we are looking for** We’re searching for a **Senior Software Engineer, ML Evaluation \& Introspection Infrastructure** to join our Behavior Analysis team, reporting to the team’s engineering manager. Aurora’s trucks already haul freight on Texas highways with no one on board, and every new version of the learned model that drives them has to prove, on real driving data, that it is better and safer than the one before. Behavior Analysis builds the systems that make that call: the evals that compare model versions, the embedding search that makes every driving scenario findable, and the introspection tools that show why a model did what it did. Engineers build more than 100 training and eval datasets a week through our tools. We’re a small team, so each engineer owns whole systems, and we work agent\-first: our tools are built for AI agents to drive as easily as engineers do. You’ll own core pieces of that loop and help lead what comes next: putting LLMs, VLMs and agents to work on analysis, so questions that take days to answer today take minutes. **In this role you will** * Build and scale evaluation pipelines that compare model versions on large driving datasets: offline evals, slice\-based metrics, regression detection, and model\-vs\-model reports. * Own embedding and vector\-search pipelines over driving data, versioned per model, so engineers can search, cluster and compare how any model represents the world. This is where you’d start: owning embedding generation and search end to end. * Build model introspection infrastructure (attention, attribution, ablations) that turns “why did the model do that?” from a research project into a query. * Help define how frontier LLMs, VLMs and agents change ML analysis here: triaging, labeling, clustering and summarizing driving scenarios and eval results. We already have a prototype using LLMs for data curation, and you’d help decide where it goes next. * Work side by side with the ML engineers training these models to decide what to measure, then make those measurements trustworthy, observable and cheap enough to run on every candidate model. * Build the web app and CLI that engineers and AI agents use to find datasets, training runs, evals and their costs, designed with agents as first\-class users. **Required qualifications** * Typically 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience building backend, data or ML infrastructure. * Strong Python, and proficiency with SQL. * Designed and operated large\-scale batch or data pipelines on cloud infrastructure, including backfills, retries and cost management. * Built systems that measure or evaluate something: metrics, experimentation, evaluation or analytics platforms. * Experience with distributed compute and container orchestration (e.g. Kubernetes, AWS Batch or similar). **Desirable qualifications** * ML evaluation infrastructure: eval harnesses, golden datasets, regression detection, A/B model comparison. * Embeddings and vector search, or model introspection and interpretability tooling. * Using LLMs, VLMs or agentic workflows to automate analysis, labeling or data curation. * Autonomous vehicles, robotics or other large\-scale sensor data. * Observability for data systems (metrics, alerting, SLOs), and everyday use of AI coding agents. * Coming from backend or data engineering and want to learn ML evaluation? Apply anyway: we’ll teach you the ML side. *For roles based in Mountain View, CA and Seattle, WA:* The salary range for this position is $162,000 \- $260,000 per year. Aurora’s pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, the successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on factors including job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, relevant education or training, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future. The successful candidate will also be eligible for an annual bonus, equity compensation, and benefits. *For roles based in Pittsburgh, PA:* The salary range for this position is $146,000 \- $234,000 per year. Aurora’s pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, the successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on factors including job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, relevant education or training, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future. The successful candidate will also be eligible for an annual bonus, equity compensation, and benefits. **Working at Aurora** At Aurora, we bring together extraordinarily talented and experienced people united by the strength of our values. We operate with integrity, set outrageous goals, and build a culture where we win together — all without any jerks. We believe in\-person work increases collaboration, empathy, and our ability to lead effectively. As a result, Aurorans are expected to work from the office at least 3 days per week, with some roles requiring more frequent in\-office presence, up to 5 days per week, based on operational needs. Our Careers page provides insight into what it is like to work at Aurora, and you can find all the latest updates in our Newsroom. **Our commitment to safety** At the core of everything we do is our commitment to safety. Building best\-in\-class self\-driving technology will take time, and we believe that each employee at Aurora has a role in contributing to safety, every step of the way. Aurora expects commitment to our safety policies from every employee, and seeks candidates who take an active responsibility, can contribute to building an atmosphere of trust, and invest in the organization’s long\-term success by prioritizing working safely, no matter what. **Our commitment to inclusion** Aurora considers candidates without regard to their race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy status, parent or caregiver status, ancestry, political affiliation, veteran and/or military status, physical or mental disability, or any other status protected by federal or state law. Aurora considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at careersiteaccommodations@aurora.tech. *For California applicants, information collected and processed as part of your application and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Aurora’s California Employment Privacy Policy.*

jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ============ Insurance is one of the largest industries in the world, and it still runs on manual work nobody wants to do. Claims is the clearest case: high\-volume, repetitive workflows handled over the phone, by email, and across 200\-page PDFs, most of it sitting in systems built in the early 2000s. Software has circled this problem for decades without touching the core of it, because nothing could make the calls or read the documents. AI finally can. Avallon builds agents that run the full claims lifecycle, from intake to settlement, so teams can move faster, eliminate busywork, and get more right. Out of YC we went from zero to seven figures of ARR in twelve months, and are now growing 3X quarter over quarter while working with some of the largest carriers in the world. Avallon is backed by top investors, and our founding team includes builders from MIT, Harvard, and Cornell. We aim to become the automation layer for the entire insurance industry, and we intend to get there with a talent\-dense team where everyone is enabled to do the best work of their careers. No one can predict the future of insurance, so we're building it. **The Role** ============ We're looking for an exceptional Product Engineer. You'll build the platform that lets insurance teams put AI to work on real operations, and trust it when it matters. Your job is to find what the platform needs next and build it. Our forward\-deployed engineers run customer deployments on top of the platform. You build the platform itself. Working closely with them, design, and customers, you'll spot the hard problems that keep coming up and turn them into product: the smallest version that creates value now and extends cleanly later. **What You'll Work On** ======================= * **Shape the product from the start.** You come in early, working with customers, design, and product strategy to decide what gets built and why, not picking up tickets after the decisions are made. * **Build the rails insurance will run on.** From public chat interfaces where claimants report and follow their claims, to branded portals our largest carrier customers host on Avallon, you build the surfaces the industry will soon run on. * **Help teams confidently automate more.** Build clear, auditable claim context and the experiences that let people review and approve agent work, giving teams control where it matters and letting them expand automation with confidence. * **Own it end to end, in production.** Build the whole flow yourself, from data model to backend to interface, then own how it performs: instrument it, watch how real users move through it in Datadog RUM, and keep pushing it as more teams rely on it. The work is broad, and your impact will grow wherever the platform needs you most. You will take on a meaningful challenge, ship it quickly, watch what changes in production, and go again. **You** ======= * You have 3\+ years building and owning meaningful software in production. You can point to a difficult challenge you solved or a system you built that changed what was possible, explain the judgment behind it, and answer for the outcome once it was live. * You are a full\-stack product engineer who builds whole flows yourself. TypeScript and SQL are your working tools; you design the data model and backend as readily as the interface on top of it. You work closely with design and product strategy, have opinions about what to build, and can explain them clearly. This is not a frontend\-only role. * You have built and operated LLM\- or agent\-powered products in production, and understand the challenges of making them reliable at scale. * You want to be in the room.
