jobs.title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Avenue Z, Inc.** Avenue Z is a digital marketing and PR agency engineered to move fast. Brands partner with us to drive revenue and reputation through high\-impact public relations, performance media, AI search optimization (AEO), and our creator network. Trusted by leaders in emerging tech, finance and consumer brands, we drive influence across all channels \- from AI Search to The Wall Street Journal, Shopify to TikTok, Meta to Google. **The role** ------------ We are hiring a Forward Deployed AI Engineer to build and ship the agent systems that run social commerce for our brands and for our own platform. You will embed with the teams doing the work, performance media, creator and influencer, ecommerce, and analytics, find the process where throughput is lost or money is left on the table, and build a production agent that owns it. Then you move to the next one. Concretely, this is work like: agents that detect and re\-authorize expiring TikTok Shop affiliate codes and Meta partnership permissions before spend stalls, systems that reallocate ad budget toward top\-performing creators automatically, pipelines that launch new creator content across every platform daily without a human touching it, and reporting infrastructure that tells a brand what actually drove GMV. You own the problem end to end: discovery, architecture, build, deploy, evals, adoption, and what breaks at 2am. If your instinct on a messy problem is to open an editor rather than schedule a working session, this is your role.**What you'll do** ------------------ * Embed with a business unit, diagnose where throughput or margin is lost, and ship a working agent against it inside the first few weeks. * Build production agent systems: tool use, planning loops, memory, retrieval, orchestration, and human\-in\-the\-loop approval gates where money or brand safety is on the line. * Integrate deeply against the commerce and ad platforms our revenue runs on: TikTok Shop and TikTok Ads, Meta and Instagram, Amazon, Shopify, Google, Snap, and affiliate and creator APIs. * Build data pipelines and analytics infrastructure that tie creator content, ad spend, and attributed GMV into one picture. * Build the evaluation harness alongside the agent. Nothing ships to production without a way to measure whether it is right. * Own the infrastructure: APIs, queues, auth and token refresh, observability, error handling, rate limits, and cost controls. * Instrument everything. Every system you ship gets tied to a number: hours returned, cycle time cut, spend efficiency, GMV or revenue supported. * Document it, drive adoption with the team that uses it, and keep improving it after launch. **Who you are** --------------- * Computer science or another technical background, or equivalent hands\-on experience as a developer or as a self\-taught AI\-native builder. We care about what you have shipped and whether it works, not where you learned it. * 3 to 5 years building and shipping software that other people depended on. * You can read, write, and debug Python or TypeScript. You have deployed and maintained real services and you understand what is happening underneath, whether you wrote every line yourself or built it alongside AI coding tools. * Hands\-on experience building LLM agent systems: function and tool calling, RAG, orchestration, prompt and context engineering, agent evals. * Real experience integrating third\-party marketing, ad, or commerce APIs. You know what OAuth token expiry, rate limiting, webhook replay, and undocumented API behavior actually cost you. * Comfortable with cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP), containers, CI/CD, and SQL. * You work fluently with AI coding tools such as Claude Code and Cursor. We expect you to build with them. We also expect you to be able to explain, debug, and defend what comes out of them. * You understand how performance marketing works: ROAS, CAC, attribution, creative testing, funnel mechanics, affiliate and creator economics. Or you can learn a domain fast and go deep, and you can prove it. * Entrepreneurial. You have built something of your own, a startup, a product, a side venture, an open source project, and can point to what you shipped and what it did. * High agency. You gather your own requirements, make the call, and ship. You do not wait for a spec, a committee, or a change management plan. * Able to sit with a senior executive or a brand's head of ecommerce, understand the business problem in their language, and translate it into a system without a translator in the room. **Nice to have:** direct experience with TikTok Shop, Meta Ads, or Amazon Seller/Ads APIs. Background at a DTC brand, an ecommerce platform, a creator or affiliate network, or a performance agency. Prior forward deployed, applied AI, or founding engineer experience. **Benefits*** Competitive salary \+ equity package * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans. * 401(k) plan with employer match. * Unlimited paid time off policy to support work\-life balance. * Professional development opportunities and budget. Please note that we do not offer Visa support of any type, and that the position is on\-site in Miami 4\-5 days per week.

jobs.title: Mission Engineer - Albany
jobs.description: #### **Join Axon and be a Force for Good.** At Axon, we're on a mission to Protect Life. We're explorers, pursuing society's most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other. Life at Axon is fast\-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you'll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter. ### **Your Impact** This isn't a relationship management role. It's an ownership role. Sharp. Adaptable. Unstoppable. You won't wait to be asked. You'll identify what's broken before it becomes a problem, build solutions that didn't exist yesterday, and earn the kind of trust that makes you indispensable to the agency — and to Axon. In this embedded role, you are the primary owner of customer outcomes within a strategic account — accountable for the full lifecycle of Axon's ecosystem. You combine deep technical expertise, builder instinct, operational leadership, and executive presence to help agencies transform how they operate, not just adopt software. You embed for the long haul: opening the laptop onsite, shipping on Axon's stack, holding the room when it matters, and iterating on what you build until it sticks in production. Success is measured by the agency's operational outcomes and working solutions in production — not product health, not activity, not slideware. ### **What You'll Do** This role is intentionally undefined in the day\-to\-day. Priorities shift with agency mission tempo, operational crises, and emerging opportunities. If you need a fixed playbook to succeed, this isn't the role for you. Building is the job. You will use Axon's platform — AI Era, agents, workflows, integrations, and data tools — to design, build, and ship new capabilities on site. You own outcomes end to end across deployment, adoption, optimization, and ongoing success — as the accountable owner, not a coordinator of other teams' work. #### **Onsite Building \& Platform Delivery** * Discover agency problems onsite and translate them into buildable, compliant solutions tied to mission outcomes * Design and ship working tools on Axon's platform: AI agents, workflows, automations, integrations, and data pipelines — built and tested with real users and real data * Build with Axon products, not around them — configure, integrate, and extend DEMS, Fusus, AI Era, Records, and related systems in the agency environment * Iterate in the field until adoption sticks, then document patterns for reuse across accounts * Apply responsible innovation guardrails — CJIS, evidence integrity, privacy — in every build. Ship working software, not slideware * Troubleshoot onsite and coordinate root\-cause resolution across Product, Engineering, Support, and Services when builds or integrations break #### **AI Build \& Adoption** * Build and deploy AI\-powered workflows (agents, prompts, RAG, evaluations) that solve defined agency problems — not generic experimentation * Drive hands\-on adoption with the people who use what you build daily * Measure whether changes stick — usage, workflow impact, mission outcomes — and iterate when they don't #### **Operational Transformation \& Leadership** * Assess workflows onsite, identify friction and mission impact, and define what to build before you build it * Move from reactive support to proactive outcome design — arrive with hypotheses, validate with command staff and operators, then build to match * Build trusted relationships with agency leadership and operational stakeholders; lead QBRs, mission reviews, and strategic planning * Define success metrics and capture baselines before major deployments so impact is proven, not assumed #### **Field Intelligence \& Growth** * Capture customer insights, workflow patterns, and adoption barriers; share field intelligence with Product and Engineering to influence roadmap decisions * Turn one\-off builds into reusable playbooks and operational frameworks * Identify expansion opportunities based on demonstrated impact; partner with Sales on long\-term account strategy #### **Onsite Engagement \& Outcomes** * Maintain consistent onsite presence (approximately 3\-4 days/week), closely connected to agency operations and evolving needs * Track customer success metrics: time\-to\-first\-production\-use, adoption depth by role and site, workflow improvements, and mission outcomes * Support Sales Post\-Sales onboarding and handoff, establishing goals and accountability from day one ### **What You Bring** #### **Required** * Experience in customer\-facing technical roles, program management, operational transformation, or complex deployment environments (typically 8\+ years; varied experience welcome) * Former law enforcement or military experience preferred, not required * Proven builder: you have shippe formation at scale #### **Additional Information** We recognize that candidates may bring strengths from different backgrounds and experiences. If your experience aligns closely with this role, we encourage you to apply. This role is for builders who earn trust in the room — not for those looking for a predictable schedule or narrowly defined responsibilities. Every week looks different. That's the job. **Benefits that Benefit You** * Competitive salary and 401(k) with employer match * Discretionary paid time off * Paid parental leave for all * Medical, dental, and vision plans * Fitness programs * Emotional and mental wellness support * Learning and development programs * And yes, we have snacks in our offices Don't meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long\-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve. Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you're excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. **Important Notes** *The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.* *Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment.* *We collect personal information from applicants to evaluate candidates for employment. You may request access, deletion, or exercise other CCPA rights at* ***axongreenhousesupport@axon.com*** *or via our* *Axon Privacy Web Form**. For more information, please see the Your California Privacy Rights section of our* *Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice.* *Axon's mission is to Protect Life and is committed to the well\-being and safety of its employees as well as Axon's impact on the environment. All Axon employees must be aware of and committed to the appropriate environmental, health, and safety regulations, policies, and procedures. Axon employees are empowered to report safety concerns as they arise and activities potentially impacting the environment.* *We are an equal opportunity employer that promotes justice, advances equity, values diversity and fosters inclusion. We're committed to hiring the best talent — regardless of race, creed, color, ancestry, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances — and empowering all of our employees so they can do their best work. If you have a disability or special need that requires assistance or accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email* *recruitingops@axon.com.* *Please note that this email address is for accommodation purposes only. Axon will not respond to inquiries for other purposes.* Phishing alert: Axon will never ask you to pay for any part of the hiring process, including training, equipment, or background checks. jobs.title: Portfolio Systems Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Implementation Department** The Investment Implementation department is a community of diverse investment professionals whose mission is to implement our investment strategies and client portfolios excellently. Our Department is responsible for ensuring the excellent implementation of our systematic investment approach, from raw data to executed trades, with processes and logic that reflect the full richness of our investment insight, executed with a near\-zero error rate, and engineered and orchestrated in a way that facilitates oversight and compounding. This is an investment department, owning the investment outcomes, and the mandate includes both the ‘run’ responsibility and the ‘transform’ responsibility, meaning daily operations as well as over time renovation of our systems. We fulfill our mission by applying four operating principles: * **Understand and deliver internal client needs.** Partner with our internal clients to understand, offer implementation designs, and deliver solutions, while proactively educating and communicating outcomes to ACLs (Asset Class Leads) and CIOs. * **Own our investment intent.** Own our investment intent in full, in letter and spirit. * **Continuously improve.** Have and evolve an investment pipeline to meet current and future internal client needs. * **Systematically and relentlessly deliver quality outcomes.** Apply our best logic systematically, discipline, expertise, and controls to every signal, position, and trade in every market. **About Your Role** We are an Engineering owned and led organization which strives to balance independence with incredible community support in an environment that is intellectually vibrant and driven to make a mark on the world as a collaborative force. As a Portfolio Systems Engineer on the Portfolio Implementation team, your mission is to design, build, and evolve the complex, large\-scale systems that manage money at the size and scale Bridgewater does — from Risk Controls through to Trade Generation. You will spend your time architecting and industrializing the investment systems that run our portfolios and investment strategies. The Portfolio Systems Engineer will be embedded within the Portfolio Implementation Team and gain a key understanding of our portfolio construction logic, process, and systems. You will drive the following responsibilities: * Design, build and evolve the investment system that manages our portfolios from risk controls through to trade generation. * Translate investment goals and understanding into elegant and robust systematic logic. * Dive deep into the systems and learn the contents to perceive issues in our logic and translate those problems into business solutions. * Visualize different ways to streamline and industrialize our Portfolio Construction through trade delivery process. * Own and develop tools to oversee and validate our Portfolio Construction process. * Set and enforce high engineering standards for building robust, maintainable, large\-scale systems across the Implementation team. The anticipated onsite requirement for this role is 4 days per week at our Westport, CT campus. **Minimum Qualifications** As a Portfolio Systems Engineer, you have a genuine passion for building complex software systems — you’re drawn to hard, interesting problems and enjoy designing systems that are robust, scalable, and built to last. * Have 2\+ years of professional experience in a relevant engineering field and a Bachelor’s degree in Finance or a related field. * Have strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues and develop innovative solutions. * Have hands\-on coding experience in any language — we care far more about how you build and your ability to learn than about any specific language. * Are eager to learn our investment concepts and language — e.g., security mechanics, portfolio construction, and how we model them — well enough to apply them in the systems you build. * Enjoy tinkering — you care not just about the work you produce but how you produce it, continually sharpening our tools and workflows (including leveraging AI) to work better and faster. * Are strong at prioritization and driving multiple workstreams in parallel. * Have excellent verbal and written communication skills and can translate technical concepts to different stakeholders. * Are practical and goal oriented so you can quickly interface with the various partners across the firm to perceive and solve problems. * Have a desire to use technology and engineering to solve real world business problems. **About Bridgewater** Bridgewater Associates is a global macro investment firm, founded in 1975, whose mission is to develop a fundamental, cause\-and\-effect understanding of how markets and economies work—and translate that understanding into insights, returns, and solutions that help the world’s leading institutional investors solve their most important investment challenges. Over five decades, we have codified our fundamental understanding into a systematic investment process—integrating human judgment with machine intelligence with the goal of applying our thinking consistently, testing it against reality, and continuously improving decision\-making over time. We believe this has created a unique platform for applying AI within our process, positioning us at the frontier of integrating technology with investment decision\-making. In financial markets—where reality is constantly evolving and outcomes are uncertain—sustained excellence requires continuous learning and improvement. Our culture—anchored in radical truth and transparency—helps us learn faster. Find more information about Bridgewater on our website. **Our Culture** Bridgewater’s culture is anchored in the pursuit of excellence—tied directly to our mission. In financial markets, where the base case is failure and reality is constantly evolving, winning requires continuous learning and improvement. Truth is our most essential tool for improvement, and transparency helps us get closer to truth because it places many eyes on our decisions, problems, and mistakes. By understanding reality clearly, we can identify the gap between where we are and where we want to be—and use that knowledge to learn and get better. Our system that supports this way of being is an idea meritocracy, where we commit to finding and rewarding the best ideas regardless of hierarchy. Operating in these ways is hard. Finding truth and learning through it is inherently a high\-friction cycle. It’s possible because we share a few core values: a commitment to honesty, high ownership, deeply meaningful work and relationships, and building Bridgewater as a big tent where vast differences are welcomed. These values create the common denominator that binds us together in good times and bad. Benefits One of our core priorities at Bridgewater is to enable our employees to build a great life and career, and we believe our benefits are an important extension of that philosophy. As such, currently Bridgewater offers a competitive suite of benefits, including health insurance, retirement benefits, paid leave, and other fringe benefits. Find more information about Bridgewater’s benefits on our website. *Bridgewater reserves the right to change its current benefits program at any time, in a manner that is consistent with applicable federal and state regulations.* **Sponsorship** The Portfolio Systems Engineer full time position requires the candidate to be eligible to work in the United States for a minimum of 3 years from the candidate’s start date. If visa sponsorship is required for any part of the three years, the successful candidate must demonstrate continuous, or eligibility to renew, work authorization in the United States for at least three years after the date of hire, without being subject to selection through a lottery process. **Compensation** The wage range for this role is $225,000 \- $450,000 inclusive of base salary and discretionary target bonus. The expected base salary for this role is between 60% \- 75% of this wage range. *This job description is not a contract and confers no contractual rights, privileges, or benefits on any applicant or potential applicant. Bridgewater has the right to change any and all terms of this job description, including, but not limited to, job responsibilities, qualifications and benefits. Nothing in this job description constitutes an offer or guarantee of employment.* *Bridgewater Associates, LP is an Equal Opportunity Employer*

Brown University Health employees are expected to successfully role model the organization's values of **Compassion**, **Accountability**, **Respect**, and **Excellence** as these values guide our everyday actions with patients, customers and one another. Writes detailed documentation for data processes, tools, and pipelines with data users in mind. Contributes, maintains, and grows a unified data catalog and data model. Manages the mapping of common or related terms in a single, unified location. Monitors and adjusts mapping in this centralized space to improve coordination with operational partners. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About Buildkite** Buildkite's CI platform is trusted by the world's leading engineering teams, helping ship software used by more than 1 billion people every day. Companies including Canva, Meta, Mistral AI, and NVIDIA rely on Buildkite to run builds, tests, and deployments on their infrastructure, ours, or both \- giving them the speed, reliability, and flexibility to ship with confidence. ### **About the Role** Our largest customers run CI/CD at frontier scale. AI is driving their build and test workloads up sharply, and more of these large, established companies want a partner to come in and build alongside them so they can grow and scale even faster. As one of Buildkite's first Forward Deployed Engineers, you'll take on scoped engagements with strategic customers from design through delivery. Customers pay for an outcome: you work out what they actually need, agree on a clear deliverable, build it as production code, and land it in the platform. It's hands\-on engineering with real customer access. You'll spend time on site with the platform teams behind some of the most demanding CI workloads in the world, in the room with their engineers and executives, and you'll stay accountable until what you built works and is handed off. You'll also shape how it runs (how we scope, value, and hand off work) by actually implementing the first engagements, not by writing the playbook first. You'll sit in our Revenue org alongside Solutions Architects and Technical Account Managers, close to customers and Sales, and work hand in hand with Product and our Engineering team in Australia. The role is based on the US West Coast, with regular travel to customer sites (around 25%). ### **What You'll Do** * Work through the customer's reality and scope engagements before the deal closes: partnering with Solution Architects and TAMs to dig into what stands between a customer and Buildkite, identifying true gaps. Spot patterns across customers and bring them back to Product so recurring workarounds become roadmap items. * Turn true gaps into defined engagements: a clear deliverable, an estimate, and exit criteria that the customer and Buildkite both sign off on, then keep the work inside that scope as new asks come up. * Build core platform features, held to the same bar (and using the same frontier tools) as our product engineers. Then hand off cleanly to Product and Engineering so what you build becomes a supported part of Buildkite, benefitting all customers. * Help Solutions Architects and Account Executives recognize FDE opportunities in their deals and explain what FDE is (and isn't) in plain terms, especially as we build the role together through iteration on engagements. ### **This Is You If...** * You've shipped production software end to end in the last few years: code you owned and were accountable for, not just contributed to. * You'd pass the same technical bar as our product engineers. * You can translate a business need into a technical spec and back again, and you stay composed when a customer's executive is frustrated. * You're at ease with large, established enterprises: structured evaluations, security reviews, and leaders who want to understand the why before they commit. * You can scope: take a vague ask, craft it into something defined and shippable, be clear about scope, and balance that line when new asks show up mid\-engagement. * You'd rather solve the customer's problem than either selling them more or building something shiny. * You have product judgment: you can tell a one\-off from something every customer needs. * You want to build *and* stay close to customers, and you don't want to give up either. * You're excited to help build a new function, and you know that means running the first engagements yourself and letting what you learn shape the playbook. ### **This Probably Isn't You If...** * You want to focus on code with little customer time, or on customers with little code. This role is both. * You prefer a well\-defined roadmap to working out what the problem is and taking initiative. * You're looking for hourly consulting, training, or migration work. Those matter, but they're a different role. * You'd rather not travel. Time on site with customers is a core part of this job. ### **Bonus Points If...** * You've led or supported a migration from another CI/CD system. * You've been an early engineer at a developer tools, infrastructure, or B2B SaaS company, or worked in a forward deployed role. * You've worked inside, or alongside, the engineering org of a growth\-oriented SaaS company or large enterprise. * You already use Buildkite. ### **Benefits** * **20 days paid annual leave plus 10 days sick \& carer's leave** — actively encouraged, we want you to be at your best and time off is a part of that. * **An ongoing remote\-work allowance to help you do your best work** — we want you to have everything you need, from great wifi to wellness options that are right for you. * **Retirement and health coverage (based on your region)** — build towards your future, your way. * **16 weeks paid parental leave for primary carers (6 weeks for secondary)** — becoming a parent is life changing and we're committed to supporting you and your family through it. * **Confidential EAP \& mental health support** — sometimes life gets hard. You should be able to access the resources and support you need. * **Support for learning and growth** — with time and budget for conferences, courses, and coaching so you have the opportunity to grow, improve your craft, and build mastery. * **Flexibility to work from anywhere in the world for up to 6 weeks a year** — great work doesn't have to happen from one desk. Exact benefits may vary slightly by country. We'll walk through the specifics for your location. ### **Compensation** This role sits on our engineering compensation bands: base salary plus equity. There's no commission: you're measured on outcomes delivered, not on what the customer spends. The base salary range is $223,000 \- $247,000 USD. Compensation is determined based on geographic location, relevant experience, and qualifications. ### **Equal Opportunity Employer** At Buildkite, we value diversity and celebrate all types of skills, backgrounds, and experiences. We’re dedicated to fostering an inclusive environment and providing reasonable accommodations throughout our recruitment process. If you need any accommodations or support during the application or interview process, please reach out to us at accommodations@buildkite.com.

Profibus, AS\-I, motor control systems, servo drives, frequency drives, and electrical distribution systems. * Acting as the first level of escalation support for equipment automation issues and appropriately escalating downtime situations to vendors and/or network support teams to restore equipment operation. * Applying subject matter expertise in material handling and electronic control systems to maximize building utilization of systems * Monitoring MHE metrics and partnering with mechatronics technicians to resolve equipment electrical problems that create performance deficiencies, and project management experience **Physical Demands:** * Ability to reach overhead, kneel, squat, climb steps/ladders, use an aerial lift, and frequently lift a maximum of 50 lbs. of equipment * environment with fluctuating temperatures * Regularly required to type on a computer for 1\-2 hours per day **Why C\&W Services?** We're a global company with over 400 offices in 60 countries. We're proud of our diverse family of employees and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace. Apply today and be part of a team that is making a difference! Cushman \& Wakefield also provides eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health, vision, and dental insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life, and disability insurance programs, and paid and unpaid time away from work. In addition to a comprehensive benefits package, Cushman and Wakefield provide eligible employees with competitive pay, which may vary depending on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, total hours worked, job type, business line, and applicability of collective bargaining agreements. The compensation that will be offered to the successful candidate will depend on factors such as whether the position is covered by a collective bargaining agreement, the geographic area in which the work will be performed, market pay rates in that area, and the candidate’s experience and qualifications. The company will not pay less than minimum wage for this role. Discrimination of any type will not be tolerated. jobs.title: Full-Stack Developer
jobs.description: At cabi, we're redefining what it means to build a fashion brand—one rooted in connection, confidence, and purpose. As a women's retail clothing company, we don't just design beautiful apparel; we create opportunities for women to express themselves, build community, and thrive both personally and professionally. Our culture is collaborative, entrepreneurial, and deeply people\-first, and every team member plays a role in creating meaningful experiences for our Stylists and clients. If you're energized by creativity, inspired by empowering others, and excited to contribute to a brand that blends style with substance, you'll feel right at home here. At Cabi, technology is at the heart of delivering an exceptional experience for our Stylists and clients. Every customer order flows through our fulfillment platform, connecting Shopify, warehouse operations, inventory management, shipping, and enterprise systems into a seamless experience. We're looking for a hands\-on Full\-Stack Developer to own and evolve this platform. You'll design, build, deploy, and support software that directly impacts thousands of customer orders while helping modernize one of the company's most critical business systems. While fulfillment is your primary focus, you'll be a full member of our engineering team and a full\-stack contributor to The Studio, Cabi's Shopify\-based platform that powers how our Stylists and clients shop. Like every developer on the team, you'll build features, integrations, and enhancements across The Studio alongside your fulfillment work. This role is based in Indiana to provide close partnership with our warehouse operations and local technology environment. **What You'll Do** As the primary developer responsible for our fulfillment platform, you will: * Design, build, and maintain Cabi's custom Fulfillment Service and related applications. * Provide mission\-critical technology support to Receiving, Inventory, Put\-away, Pick, Pack and Ship operations * Develop APIs, services, and integrations supporting inventory allocation, warehouse operations, order fulfillment, shipping, and returns. * Build and maintain integrations between Shopify, Oracle EBS, CRM, warehouse systems, shipping carriers, and other enterprise platforms, including through middleware and workflow automation platforms such as Pipedream. * Own software throughout its lifecycle—from solution design and development through deployment, monitoring, production support, and continuous improvement. * Troubleshoot production issues, identify root causes, and implement scalable long\-term solutions. * Improve platform performance, reliability, observability, and automation while reducing technical debt. * Partner with Product Management and Warehouse Operations to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions. * Collaborate with Infrastructure when software, AWS, networking, and warehouse technology intersect. * Participate in Agile planning, estimation, code reviews, testing, and production releases. * Leverage AI\-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity and software quality. * Work as a full\-stack developer on The Studio, Cabi's Shopify\-based platform, delivering front\-end and back\-end features, integrations, and enhancements alongside the broader engineering team, while maintaining primary ownership of the fulfillment platform. **What You'll Bring** **Required** * 4\+ years of professional software development experience, preferably in a backend or full\-stack role. * Experience building enterprise applications and backend services. * Strong API development experience in distributed applications environment using REST and GraphQL based webservices * Strong SQL and relational database experience, including writing and optimizing queries and working with object\-relational mapping (ORM) tools. * Full\-stack development experience across backend services and modern frontend frameworks such as React. * Proven ability to leverage AI to assist in development workflows. * Experience developing applications in AWS. * Experience with Git and CI/CD pipelines. * Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills. * Eagerness to learn new technologies and contribute across both backend and frontend as needed. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills. **Preferred** * Shopify development or Shopify integrations, including familiarity with Hydrogen and Remix. * Retail, ecommerce, fulfillment, warehouse, or supply chain experience. * Oracle EBS or ERP integrations. * Ruby on Rails, or experience with other server\-side frameworks such as Django or Spring. * Middleware and workflow automation platforms such as Pipedream. * Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) or Order Management Systems (OMS). * Docker, Kubernetes, or container technologies. * Event\-driven or distributed system architectures. **Technologies You'll Work With** * Shopify / The Studio (Cabi's Shopify\-based platform) * AWS * React, Node.js, Go, Ruby on Rails * REST \& GraphQL APIs * Pipedream (middleware \& workflow automation) * SQL / MySQL / PostgreSQL * Oracle EBS * Warehouse Systems * Shipping Carrier Integrations * Git \& CI/CD **What We Offer** At cabi, we believe our people should be recognized for the impact they make. jobs.title: Manager, Data Management & Operations
jobs.description: CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi\-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats. CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, Seattle, and London. For more information, please visit www.chaosinc.com. **Role Overview** Data is foundational to how CHAOS develops, tests, and improves complex sensing systems. As the company scales, we need a data operating model that makes information consistent, trusted, secure, and usable across Engineering, AI, Test, and business teams. As Manager of Data Management and Operations, you'll own the end\-to\-end data lifecycle: how data is defined, collected, transported, governed, transformed, secured, and delivered for analysis. You'll lead our data management and field data operations functions, partnering closely with the Foundry engineering team to ensure the platform meets company needs. This isn't an analytics\-only role. It's a technical and operational leadership role spanning data governance, data\-platform coordination, and test operations. You'll build durable systems and teams while remaining close enough to field execution to understand where data quality and collection break down. Success means teams use the same definitions, analysts can trust the datasets they receive, test data is captured and available quickly, and access to sensitive data is controlled and auditable without becoming a barrier to execution. **Responsibilities** * Establish company\-wide governance for data definitions, ownership, quality, lineage, retention, and calculation change management. * Create authoritative, documented analytical datasets and shared definitions so teams can work from consistent data and metrics. * Work with the Foundry engineering team to ensure that data ingestion, ETL, modeling, transformation, validation, and monitoring align with stakeholder needs. * Own permissions management and partner with Security and Compliance to implement least\-privilege access, auditability, retention, and handling controls for sensitive data. * Build a repeatable process for planning data capture at test events, including required sensor data, metadata, truth data, labels, logging, storage, and validation. * Coordinate across teams to translate test objectives into clear data requirements and ensure collection systems are ready before testing begins. * Establish pre\-test readiness and post\-test reconciliation processes so required data is captured, validated, transferred, cataloged, and available for analysis. * Use test outcomes and data gaps to continuously improve collection methods, retention strategy, data quality controls, and the underlying data architecture. * Build and manage teams responsible for data governance and field data operations, while establishing an effective partnership with the Foundry engineering team. * Sustain data operations at CHAOS test sites, including contributing to test schedule strategy, extraction technology and logistics, , and data labeling. * Create clear operating procedures, ownership, service levels, and metrics for pipeline reliability, test data capture, and data availability. * Partner with Foundry engineering to balance immediate test and program needs with long\-term investments in scalable architecture, automation, , and team capability. * Work full\-time on\-site at our El Segundo, CA headquarters * Travel to CHAOS test sites and other company locations on a regular basis. * Support critical test events and field operations outside standard business hours when needed. **Minimum Requirements** * 8\+ years of experience across data engineering, data platforms, data governance, analytics infrastructure, test data, or similarly complex technical environments, including significant team leadership. * 1\+ years of management experience, ideally with prior experience managing teams incorporating non\-exempt or contract employees. * You see data as both a technical platform and an operating discipline, not simply a reporting or analytics function. * You can move comfortably between data engineers, radar and test teams, security stakeholders, analysts, and senior leadership. * You build governance creating clarity and trust without unnecessary bureaucracy. * You are willing to get close to field operations and understand the practical realities of collecting, moving, and validating data. * You thrive in high\-execution environments where requirements evolve quickly and ownership is expected. * You combine strong technical judgment with practical prioritization and can make sound tradeoffs across platform, operations, and compliance. * You enjoy building teams, systems, and operating rhythms from the ground up. * Demonstrated ownership of production data pipelines from source ingestion through transformation, quality assurance, publication, and consumption. * Strong knowledge of ETL, data modeling, metadata, lineage, data quality, observability, and modern data engineering practices. * Strong cross\-functional leadership and communication skills, with the ability to turn ambiguous needs into clear standards, systems, and operating processes. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related technical field. **Preferred Requirements** * Experience with Palantir Foundry or a comparable enterprise data platform; deep Foundry experience is strongly preferred. * Radar or defense systems experience * Experience planning or supporting test events and coordinating the operational logistics required to reliably collect and transport data. * Experience designing permissions and access\-control processes in environments with significant security, compliance, audit, or data\-handling requirements. * Experience supporting data collection from physical systems, sensors, laboratories, manufacturing, or field testing. **Why CHAOS?** * **Health Benefits:** Medical, dental, and vision benefits 100% paid for by the company * **Additional benefits**: 401k (\+ 50% company match up to 6% of pay), FSA, HSA, life insurance, and more * **Our Perks:** Free daily lunch, 'No meeting Fridays', unlimited PTO, casual dress code * **Compensation Components:** Competitive base salaries, generous pre\-IPO stock option grants, relocation assistance, and (coming soon!) annual bonuses * **Team Growth:** 350 employees and counting across 5 global offices ***Salary Range: $246,000 \- $339,000*** *The stated compensation range reflects only the targeted base compensation range and excludes additional earnings such as bonus, equity, and benefits. If your compensation requirements fall outside of the range, we still encourage you to apply. The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations.* ### **Recruiting Agencies: CHAOS Industries does not accept unsolicited resumes or outreach. Unsolicited submissions will not be reviewed or compensated.** *\#LI\-onsite*

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - AI Systems and Backend
jobs.description: ***This role is full\-time, in\-office at our Long Beach, CA headquarters. We're not able to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so please only apply if you're able to work onsite full\-time.*****ABOUT US** We are a fast\-growing technology company building products used by hundreds of thousands of customers, backed by a supply chain spanning multiple distribution centers and a data platform processing millions of events daily. Engineering is not a support function here — it is a core driver of every major business outcome. We move fast, hold ourselves to a high bar, and believe the best engineering decisions are made by people who are close to the business. We are embracing AI not as a trend, but as a genuine multiplier — using it to ship better software, faster, while never losing sight of the craftsmanship that makes software great. **THE ROLE** This is a forward\-deployed engineering role with AI at its core. You will architect systems, write production\-grade code, design databases, and own your projects end to end — with a primary focus on deploying AI capabilities directly into the business and products that serve real users. What defines this role is the expectation that you bring strong engineering fundamentals together with a hands\-on, deployment\-first mindset for AI\-powered tools and workflows. You are not required to be an AI researcher or an ML specialist. You are expected to be an excellent engineer who deploys AI where it creates real value — using it to accelerate delivery, build intelligent features, and solve hard problems, while applying your own judgment to validate, refine, and own the outcome. **Strong Engineering Core*** Design robust, scalable systems from the ground up * Write clean, well\-tested, maintainable code * Optimize database performance and data models * Debug complex issues across the full stack * Own code quality through rigorous peer review * Deliver reliable software with measurable outcomes **AI as a Force Multiplier*** Use AI coding assistants to accelerate development * Leverage LLMs to generate boilerplate, tests, and docs * Build AI\-powered features where they add real user value * Apply AI to improve code review, debugging, and analysis * Evaluate AI outputs critically — judgment still wins * Stay current and bring new AI tools to the team **OUR CULTURE****What We Believe*** Outcomes over activity — we measure what ships and what works. * Speed is a feature — long approval chains kill great products. * Radical candor — honest feedback is a form of respect. * Learning is non\-negotiable — every sprint is a chance to improve. * No politics, no silos — collaborate openly across every team. **How We Work*** Fast\-paced sprints with a strong bias toward shipping. * Engineers own requirements, architecture, and roadmap input. * AI tools are standard kit — we share what works. * Blameless post\-mortems — failure is a learning event. * Async\-first with intentional synchronous collaboration. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES****Core Software Engineering (50%)*** Design, build, and maintain scalable, high\-quality software systems and APIs that serve real users in production. * Write clean, well\-structured code with appropriate test coverage — unit, integration, and end\-to\-end. * Architect and optimize relational and non\-relational database schemas, queries, and data models for performance and reliability. * Conduct meaningful code reviews that improve team quality and share knowledge, not just catch syntax errors. * Debug, profile, and resolve performance bottlenecks and production issues with urgency and rigor. * Contribute to technical architecture decisions — propose solutions, evaluate tradeoffs, and document outcomes. * Participate actively in Agile ceremonies: sprint planning, standups, retrospectives, and backlog refinement. **AI\-Forward Deployment (35%)*** Deploy AI solutions end\-to\-end — from identifying the right use case, to building and shipping LLM\-powered features directly into products and internal workflows. * Incorporate LLM APIs and AI frameworks into product features where they create genuine user value: search, summarization, recommendations, intelligent automation, and decision support. * Apply critical engineering judgment to evaluate, refine, and validate all AI\-generated outputs before they reach production — you own the result, not just the prompt. * Use AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) as a daily accelerator — and champion effective AI tool patterns and prompt strategies across the team. * Stay at the front edge of the AI tooling landscape — evaluate new models, frameworks, and techniques and bring back deployment\-ready recommendations that move the business forward. **Cross\-Team Collaboration \& Communication (15%)*** Partner with Marketing, Customer Experience, Data Science, Merchandising, Warehouse Ops, and Finance to understand requirements and deliver technical solutions. * Translate technical concepts clearly ode. * **Cloud \& DevOps:** Familiar with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, Azure), Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and basic infrastructure practices. * **Version Control:** Strong Git workflow: branching strategies, pull requests, and code review culture. **AI Literacy — Expected \& Growing*** **AI Tool Adoption:** Actively uses AI coding assistants in day\-to\-day development and can demonstrate concrete productivity or quality improvements as a result. * **LLM Integration:** Has built or integrated at least one LLM\-powered feature or workflow in a real project — even if exploratory or side\-project experience counts. * **Prompt Awareness:** Understands the basics of prompt design, few\-shot examples, and how to get reliable, structured outputs from LLM APIs. * **Critical Evaluation:** Applies engineering discipline to AI outputs — tests them, validates them, and knows when not to trust them. * **Curiosity:** Genuinely interested in how AI tooling is evolving and proactively experiments with new approaches. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS*** Experience building RAG pipelines or working with vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Weaviate, etc.). * Familiarity with AI frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar orchestration tools. * Exposure to ML concepts: embeddings, model evaluation, fine\-tuning, and working with data science teams. * Experience with observability and monitoring tooling (Datadog, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or equivalent). * Background in microservices architecture and event\-driven systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.). * Knowledge of security best practices: OWASP Top 10, authentication/authorization, input validation. * Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and tools like Jira or Linear. * Open\-source contributions or public portfolio demonstrating your engineering work. **CORE COMPETENCIES*** **Engineering Craft:** Clean, tested, maintainable code * **Database Acumen:** SQL, NoSQL, schema \& performance * **AI Fluency:** Tools \+ LLMs as force multipliers * **Performance Mindset:** Measures, optimizes, validates * **Quality Discipline:** Tests like production depends on it * **Cross\-Team Voice:** Fluent in code AND in business * **Sound Judgment:** Knows when — and when NOT — to use AI * **Ownership Drive:** Ships end\-to\-end, measures impact **TECHNOLOGY LANDSCAPE****Languages:** Python, TypeScript, Java, Go, SQL**Databases:** PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, DynamoDB, pgvector**Cloud \& Infra:** AWS / GCP / Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform**APIs:** REST, GraphQL, gRPC, OpenAPI / Swagger**AI \& LLM:** OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini — integrated as features, not the foundation**AI Dev Tools:** GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code — used daily to accelerate engineering**Observability:** Datadog, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana**Data:** PostgreSQL, dbt, Airflow, Spark, Kafka**CI/CD:** GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, Jenkins, CircleCI **Equal Opportunity Employer** *CarParts.com is an equal\-opportunity employer. We enthusiastically accept our responsibility to make employment decisions without regard to race, religious creed, color, age, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, religion, marital status, medical condition, physical or mental disability, military service, pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions, or any other classification protected by federal, state, and local laws and ordinances. Our management is dedicated to ensuring that we fulfill this policy with respect to hiring, placement, promotion, transfer, demotion, layoff, termination, recruitment advertising, pay, and other forms of compensation, training, and general treatment during employment.* *The above\-noted job description is not intended to describe, in detail, the multitude of tasks that may be assigned but rather to give the incumbent a general sense of the responsibilities and expectations of his/her position. As the nature of business demands change so, too, may the essential functions of this position.*

jobs.title: SENIOR PROGRAMMER
jobs.description: **Job Type:** Full Time, Exempt **Location:** Monterey Park, CA Job Summary We are seeking an experienced Senior Programmer to join the Information Systems \& Technology department at Carmichael International Service. In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining IBM iSeries applications, designing system integrations, and supporting Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) transactions between clients, third\-party logistics providers, and other business partners. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in IBM iSeries programming, RPG development, SQL, and EDI transaction processing. This position requires strong technical expertise, analytical skills, and the ability to troubleshoot complex system issues while ensuring reliable data exchange and system performance. The Senior Programmer will work closely with internal teams, clients, vendors, and external technical resources to implement system enhancements, resolve production issues, and support the company's technology operations. What You’ll Do * Design and implement EDI integrations with clients, third\-party logistics providers, and other business partners. * Monitor daily EDI transactions, system processes, and performance to ensure reliable operations. * Provide production support for EDI systems and partner integrations, collaborating with internal and external resources to resolve issues. * Extract data from databases and convert RPG data into XML, Excel, and CSV formats. * Work with file transfer protocols, including HTTPS, FTP, SFTP, and AS2\. * Test system changes and enhancements before moving them into production. * Document system changes, updates, enhancements, and technical processes. * Troubleshoot software issues, identify root causes of processing failures, and implement appropriate solutions. * Collaborate with vendors and technical specialists to investigate and resolve system faults. * Provide technical guidance and IT Help Desk support to employees and clients as needed. * Support system reliability and participate in on\-call support, including occasional overtime as required. Experience \& Skills You'll Bring Education * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering or related field preferred. * Equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree. Experience * 10\+ years of current experience developing applications using RPG LE, RPG Free, SQL, and CLLE. * Extensive experience with IBM iSeries programming and application development. * Experience with EDI transactions and ANSI X12 standards. * Experience working with IBM iSeries architecture, system security, and technical operating standards. Skills \& Abilities * Proficiency in RPG, RPG IV, ILE, RPG LE, RPG Free, SQL, and CLLE. * Technical experience with OS/400, CL, Java, MQ, and web services. * Knowledge of IBM iSeries architecture, security, development best practices, and modern development technologies. * Ability to analyze business requirements and translate user needs into effective and efficient applications. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to identify root causes of system failures and resolve technical issues. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams, clients, vendors, and external technical resources. * Ability to manage competing priorities and provide technical support as needed. Why Carmichael? Join Carmichael International Service, a trusted leader in customs brokerage and global logistics. Be part of a team that supports the technology and systems that keep our operations connected and running efficiently. We offer a collaborative work environment, opportunities for career growth, and the chance to contribute your technical expertise to our continued success. **Benefits:** * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Tuition reimbursement * Vision insurance Equal Employment Opportunity Statement Carmichael International Service is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other protected status.

jobs.title: Engineer II - Energy Efficiency/RCx
jobs.description: About This Opportunity We are seeking an Engineer II with Energy Efficiency and Retro\-commissioning (RCx) experience. In this role, you will work directly with our clients to assess their operations and identify opportunities for maximizing energy efficiency and performance in industrial and/or commercial facilities. The Engineer II takes a consultative role, gathers data, creates optimization models of industrial and/or commercial systems and writes feasibility reports for energy efficiency projects, while leading overall management of projects. The Engineer II will also contribute to peer support and quality control review. Future\-Focused AI\-Ready Culture At Cascade Energy, we’re actively shaping how AI gets deployed in the real world, in our tools, our client engagements, and our daily work. Our approach has always been relationship\-driven and expertise\-led, and AI is how we multiply the impact of both. Successful Cascadians are curious and resilient. They embrace change, seek smarter ways to create impact, and take ownership of their own growth. We embed AI into our work in ways that are responsible and human\-centered, and we actively develop our people to deploy it creatively and confidently. We believe the future belongs to organizations that pair emerging technology with genuine human expertise. That future is being built here. . . .come be a part of it! What You Will Be Doing * Project leadership \& peer support: Lead projects with overall management, direction, and accountability, and support peers through technical discussions and work review. * Energy\-savings analysis: Calculate energy savings for system/equipment changes using established tools, spreadsheets, and accepted methodologies. * On\-site client engagement \& efficiency opportunities: Work with clients at industrial sites to understand equipment/operations and identify energy\-efficiency opportunities. * Client relationship growth \& business development: Strengthen client relationships and identify opportunities to generate additional work with current clients. * Technical communication, documentation \& compliance: Explain complex technical topics to diverse audiences, produce energy\-efficiency reports, collect/document performance data (including data loggers), and maintain strong knowledge of utility programs and compliance requirements. This is a full\-time, exempt position, with no office requirement, but candidate must live in one of the following states: NY, NJ, CT, PA, RI, MA, VT, or southern ME. Travel for this role is anticipated to be about 20% and candidates must be open to traveling to work sites and have an easy commute to an airport. Qualifications **Applicants for this role are required to have:** * Bachelor’s Degree (or higher) in Mechanical or Chemical Engineering, or a related field of study * 1 – 5 years of engineering experience, preferably in energy or energy related fields * Technical knowledge of refrigeration, compressed air systems, steam systems, custom computer modeling of systems, electrical distribution system design, industrial control and data\-logging of system results * Experience in energy efficiency in commercial and/or industrial facilities * Experience doing retro\-commissioning (RCx) * Experience with Strategic Energy Management (SEM) A successful candidate should also demonstrate these preferred characteristics and/or skills: * Critical thinking, problem solving, and decision\-making skills * Ability to work independently and as part of a team * Proactive, resourceful, and highly motivated to achieve project results For candidates whose experience may not align perfectly with all these preferred skills but can see themselves adding value in this role, we encourage you to still apply. Cascade is dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace and places strong importance on learning and development. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions. Compensation \& Benefits The salary range for this full\-time, exempt position as a National Average for an Engineer II is: $77,400 \- $108,900\. At Cascade, transparency and fairness are core to how we work. We post the full salary range for every role because we value clarity and equity. Our offers are thoughtfully determined based on factors such as location, experience, qualifications, and internal equity, to ensure fairness. We aim to ensure consistency and integrity in every decision. Our total rewards include competitive pay and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your wellbeing and financial security. We provide health, dental, and vision coverage, along with flexible spending and health savings account options that include employer contributions. Additional benefits include life insurance, short\- and long\-term disability coverage, paid parental leave, and a 401(k)\-retirement plan with a guaranteed 3% employer contribution. jobs.description: Citrin Cooperman's Applied AI Practice puts AI to work inside clients' businesses: their people, their processes and their systems. Forward Deployed Engineers build what you design, and you lead the client through rollout and adoption. You measure the result and report it to the client's executives. When an engagement lands, you find the next one. You are technical enough to prototype a workflow, write and test prompts, and query the client's data yourself. The engineer will work on real banking use cases involving financial document analysis, credit writing, enterprise knowledge retrieval, risk and fraud prevention, and employee productivity. The ideal candidate combines strong Python software engineering skills with practical experience building, testing, and deploying LLM\-powered applications. This is a development\-focused role, not a pure research or experimentation position. **What You'll Do:*** Design, develop, test, and maintain production\-quality Python applications for generative AI and applied machine learning. * Build RAG pipelines using document ingestion, parsing, chunking, embeddings, metadata filtering, hybrid search, reranking, and grounded response generation. * Develop AI agents and workflow components using LangChain v1 and LangGraph. * Integrate Azure OpenAI models and Azure AI Search into enterprise AI applications. * Implement structured outputs using Pydantic, schema validation, deterministic business rules, and robust error handling. * Build document validation, financial data extraction, summarization, classification, and analysis components. * Implement automated evaluation datasets and tests to measure retrieval quality, answer correctness, grounding, and regression. * Develop REST APIs and backend services using FastAPI or an equivalent Python framework. * Write unit tests, integration tests, and mock\-based tests; participate in code reviews and continuous integration. * Implement secure handling of sensitive banking information, prompt\-injection defenses, input validation, and appropriate AI guardrails. * Deploy containerized applications and contribute to Azure monitoring, logging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization. * Collaborate with senior engineers, AI leadership, business stakeholders, and risk and compliance teams. Qualifications: **Programming and software engineering*** 4–5 years of professional software development experience, with strong hands\-on Python proficiency. * Strong knowledge of object\-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, modular design, and clean\-code principles. * Experience with FastAPI, REST APIs, Pydantic, SQL, Git, pytest, and debugging. **Generative AI and machine learning*** Practical experience building LLM\-powered applications using OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, or comparable model APIs. * Understanding of transformers, embeddings, tokenization, semantic search, and model inference. * Hands\-on experience with RAG, including document ingestion, chunking strategies, retrieval, grounding, and evaluation. * Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or comparable orchestration frameworks. Direct LangGraph experience is strongly preferred. * Experience with prompt design, structured generation, function/tool calling, and output validation. * Ability to measure and improve AI quality rather than relying solely on subjective demonstrations. **Cloud and engineering practices*** Experience with Azure or another major cloud platform; Azure experience is preferred. * Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD, application logging, monitoring, and automated testing. * Ability to troubleshoot API failures, retrieval defects, latency, token usage, and model\-related errors. **Preferred qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience with Azure AI Search, hybrid search, reranking, or vector databases. * Experience building AI agents that call enterprise APIs and tools. * Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP). * Experience with PostgreSQL, Azure Blob Storage, or document\-processing pipelines. * Experience in banking, financial services, lending, fraud, or another regulated industry. * Familiarity with responsible AI, data privacy, and auditability. course feedback to implement course improvements and propose curriculum changes that ensure KPIs are met * Participate in check\-ins with instructors during the course, optionally shadowing some of * Experience working through shifting priorities and learning, while maintaining organization and control * A passion for training the next generation of developers and some experience teaching in an educational, volunteer or work setting, for online learning environments * ***(Preferred)*** 1\+ years of instructional experience with a demonstrated track record of educational excellence jobs.description: Awarded 'Great Place to Work' ™ Certification Once Again! Behind every award is a story, and ours is written every day by more than 900 dedicated employees and hundreds of compassionate volunteers who walk alongside patients and families when they need us most. At Community Hospice \& Palliative Care, we’re honored to bring clinical excellence and compassion to every bedside, every home, every conversation. Every day, we serve approximately 1,500 patients living with advanced illness, wherever they call home, be it a private residence, a long\-term care or assisted living facility, a hospital, or in one of our nine inpatient care centers. We’re here to improve quality of life, to ease pain and lift burdens, and to be the Compassionate Guide that families need when time matters most. And most importantly, as the only non\-profit hospice provider in the region, we never turn anyone away due to an inability to pay. Position Summary The Director of Enterprise Data \& Analytics leads Alivia Care's enterprise data, business intelligence, and decision support function. Reporting to the Chief Information Officer, this role develops and executes the analytics roadmap, guides the enterprise data platform and analytical architecture in partnership with Information Technology, and establishes trusted, accessible information to support clinical, operational, financial, and strategic decisions across the organization. Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.” Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. Come deliver this transformation. **About the Role** At Commure, our Air AI team is building the intelligence layer that lives inside the clinical workflow — one that listens, documents, reasons, and acts so clinicians don't have to. The Provider Pod turns that intelligence into the daily clinician experience. The team works across AI\-powered documentation that transcribes patient visits and structures them into clinical notes in real time, a conversational clinical assistant grounded in live patient context and medical literature, and an extensible AI Skills Library of reusable agents and workflows that automates clinical work across the platform. We also own the core provider surfaces around charting, clinical coding, treatments and flowsheets, orders, labs, prescriptions, and the signed encounter that powers downstream billing. As the Engineering Manager for the Provider Pod, you'll lead a full\-stack team responsible for building AI that clinicians trust with their most critical work. You'll own people leadership, technical direction, roadmap execution, and operational excellence across Python backend services, TypeScript/React product surfaces, and AI/LLM workflows. You'll partner closely with Product, Design, Clinical, AI/ML, Data, Platform, and RCM to turn ambitious ideas into intuitive, scalable, and reliable features that work in real clinical environments. This is a hands\-on leadership role on a fast\-moving team that celebrates large ambition, ships daily, and makes decisions quickly. **What You'll Do** * Lead and grow the Provider Pod: Recruit, coach, and develop a high\-performing team of full\-stack engineers. * Own product and engineering outcomes: Drive the roadmap and execution across scribe documentation, the clinical assistant, reusable AI skills, and core provider workflows. * Set the technical direction: Guide architecture across Python services, TypeScript/React experiences, data systems, and AI/LLM workflows. * Partner cross\-functionally: Work with Product, Design, clinical experts, AI/ML, Data, Platform, and Air Billing to ship intuitive solutions for real clinical environments. * Raise the engineering bar: are reliable, secure, performant, and supported by effective on\-call and incident response. * Build a high\-ownership culture: Mentor technical leaders and foster strong judgment, customer empathy, healthy debate, and a bias toward action. **What You Have** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, required * 6\+ years of software engineering experience, including 2\+ years managing or formally leading engineers * Proven success hiring, coaching, and developing high\-performing engineering teams * Strong full\-stack technical depth across Python, TypeScript/React, APIs, data systems, containers, and cloud infrastructure * Hands\-on experience integrating LLM APIs or shipping AI\-powered features in production * Track record of driving complex, user\-facing products from early ideation through successful production deployment * Strong product judgment, communication, and cross\-functional leadership in fast\-moving environments * Bonus: experience with EHRs, clinical software, healthcare interoperability, or regulated environments such as HIPAA and SOC 2 Please be aware that all official communication from us will come jobs.description: **ABOUT** **SYLUX** SYLUX is an innovative company bringing lifesaving systems to the transportation market. We specialize in infrared sensing and AI\-driven perception technologies for automotive safety. The company is committed to improving vehicle awareness and recognition capabilities in darkness, fog, glare, and other low\-visibility environments. By combining infrared cameras, AI algorithms, and advanced perception platforms, SYLUX helps next\-generation ADAS and intelligent vehicles go beyond the limits of conventional sensors, enabling more consistent and reliable detection of pedestrians, cyclists, and other vulnerable road users, while setting a higher benchmark for future road safety. This infrared heritage also serves as the foundation for SYLUX’s expansion into broader ADAS perception and intelligent sensing solutions. security initiatives, and technology deployments. * Document configurations, procedures, technical standards, and troubleshooting knowledge. * Identify opportunities to automate repetitive administration and improve operational efficiency. * Collaborate with IT colleagues and business stakeholders to prioritize and resolve technical needs. **DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Mid to senior\-level experience in systems and network engineering. * Strong hands\-on experience with Microsoft 365, Microsoft Azure, Windows/Linux systems, and enterprise networking. * Solid knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, switching, VPNs, wireless networking, and firewalls. * Experience with identity and access management, backups, monitoring, patching, virtualization, and infrastructure security. * Strong troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis skills, with the ability to independently own issues through resolution. * Experience supporting infrastructure upgrades, migrations, automation, and technical projects. * Strong communication, documentation, and collaboration skills with technical and nontechnical stakeholders. * Comfortable working in a dynamic, startup\-style environment with changing priorities. * Relevant Microsoft, Cisco, or CompTIA certifications are a plus but not required. **TRAVEL** Occasionally
