As a senior engineer, you will lead solution design, establish engineering standards, and guide other data engineers in building reliable, governed, and production\-ready data pipelines that support analytics, reporting, and AI/ML use cases. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Design, develop, and maintain robust batch and streaming data pipelines for extracting, transforming, and loading data from multiple sources into the Databricks lakehouse on Azure. * Automate and streamline data ingestion using Auto Loader, Lakeflow Connect, and Azure services such as Azure Data Factory and Event Hubs. * Build and manage pipelines with Lakeflow Spark Declarative Pipelines, formerly Delta Live Tables, including data quality expectations and change data capture. * Perform complex data manipulation and transformation using PySpark and Spark SQL to prepare data for advanced analytics, reporting, and AI/ML use cases. * Design and implement workflow orchestration and scheduling using Lakeflow Jobs, formerly Databricks Workflows, to support reliable and efficient data operations. * Create scalable lakehouse data models using medallion architecture — bronze, silver, and gold — and dimensional modeling, including SCD Type 1 and Type 2\. * Implement data governance and security in Unity Catalog, including access controls, lineage, row filters, and column masks for sensitive data. * Optimize performance and cost across Delta tables, Spark workloads, serverless and classic compute, and SQL warehouses. * Establish CI/CD and testing practices for data pipelines using Git folders, Declarative Automation Bundles, formerly Databricks Asset Bundles, and Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions. * Monitor pipeline health and data quality using system tables and data quality monitoring; lead root\-cause analysis and resolution of production issues. * Lead design and code reviews, define engineering standards, and mentor data engineers across the team. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including business stakeholders and IT, to ensure data solutions meet business, performance, and project requirements. **Qualifications** ------------------ * 10\+ years of professional experience in data engineering, data and analytics, or data warehousing. * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience working with Databricks in a data engineering capacity, including production workloads. * 5\+ years of experience with Python, including manipulating large datasets using PySpark DataFrames, Spark SQL, and/or the pandas API on Spark. * 3\+ years of data engineering experience on Microsoft Azure, including services such as ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory, Key Vault, and Microsoft Entra ID. * Strong experience designing and developing ETL/ELT pipelines for batch and streaming data workloads. * Experience with Databricks lakehouse architecture, Delta tables, Unity Catalog, Lakeflow Jobs, and Lakeflow Spark Declarative Pipelines. * Experience implementing scalable data models using medallion architecture, dimensional modeling, and slowly changing dimensions. * Experience with CI/CD and testing practices for data pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions. * Ability to lead technical design discussions, conduct code reviews, define engineering standards, and mentor other engineers. * Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work across business, IT, and technical stakeholder groups. * Preferred certification: **Databricks Data Engineer Professional**. The base salary for this position is $106,087 – $151,554 plus incentives that align with individual and company performance. Actual salaries will vary based on work location, qualifications, skills, education, experience, and competencies. Benefits available to eligible employees in this role include medical, dental, and vision insurance, comprehensive employee assistance program, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off and holidays and paid learning days. The deadline to apply for this position is: 11/01/2026\. This position is for an existing, immediate vacancy. We are currently seeking to fill this role with an individual who can start as soon as possible. **\#LI\-Remote** **Physical and Mental Requirements:** The employee is regularly required to operate a computer, keyboard, telephone/headset, and/or other office equipment as essential functions of this position. jobs.title: Associate, IT Support
jobs.description: Overview: **Being on medication is tough enough.** **We want to make getting it the easy part**. Getting prescriptions to patients has become increasingly complex. When things get messy along the prescription journey, pharmaceutical manufacturers rely on us to untangle the process and create a clear path—allowing patients to build trusting relationships with their medication brands. We’re not only committed to taking the pain out of the prescription process, but we’re also devoted to bringing the brightest minds together under one roof. We bring together diverse voices—engineers, pharmacists, customer service veterans, developers, program strategists and more—all with one vision. Each perspective and experience makes ConnectiveRx better than the sum of its parts. The IT Support Associate works on the Infrastructure Operations team within IT Infrastructure. This position is primarily a hands\-on role that will install, troubleshoot, and repair computer systems, hardware, off\-the\-shelf (OTS) software, and computer peripherals. This person’s primary responsibilities include user on\-boarding and off\-boarding, resolving general technology problems, and ensuring the correct operation of company workstations. This person will maintain proper documentation of all equipment and procedures and log all work within the company’s incident and problem management system. This position must work closely with business users, Application Development personnel, and peers in IT Infrastructure to support ConnectiveRx business operations. Responsibilities: * Perform desktop support, i.e., hardware, software, network, printers, scanners, and audio\-visual (A/V) equipment, for all internal users, both on\-site and remote. * Perform On\-Boarding \& Off\-Boarding of all personnel concerning deploying \& recovering laptops and supporting IT peripheral equipment. * Image, configure, and deploy Windows 11 workstations. * Troubleshoot Microsoft Office 365, Adobe Acrobat, Call Center software Five9, and other proprietary software as needed. * Proactively troubleshoot production issues as needed and identify and capture root causes, action items, and lessons learned after all incidents and infrastructure events. * Enforce company security procedures and policies by ensuring all workstations meet security guidelines. * Work to meet all Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for production systems. * Assist the extended IT Infrastructure Team as needed. Qualifications: * 0 to 2 years supporting IT Infrastructure functions. * Windows 11 workstations, printers, and basic networking. * Healthcare IT Infrastructure and HIPAA compliance experience a plus * Solid understanding of desktop systems and OTS applications. * Excellent hardware skills with an understanding of Dell \& Lenovo laptops, peripheral equipment, printers, basic networking, and other competencies to resolve issues promptly. * Support of Apple Macs and mobile devices in a corporate environment is a plus. * Excellent customer service skills. * Ability to troubleshoot and fix Tier 1 \& 2 IT\-related issues. * Excellent knowledge of Windows 11, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, and DHCP. * Good knowledge of cloud\-based infrastructure support tools and technology. * Strong written \& verbal communication; attention to detail; strong organization skills; ability to manage multiple priorities well; calm under pressure; ability to provide support outside of regular business hours as needed. **Education*** Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science or Engineering. MCSA, A\+, Net\+ certifications preferred. Compensation \& Benefits: Compensation for this role varies based on factors such as location, relevant skills, experience, and capabilities. Employees at ConnectiveRx can enroll in comprehensive benefit plans, including medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance. The company retains the right to update or modify health, welfare, and other fringe benefit policies. Employees may also participate in the company's 401(k) plan. Time\-Off \& Holidays: ConnectiveRx provides paid time off (PTO) to non\-exempt employees for vacations and personal leave. For sick leave, eligible non\-exempt employees receive Sick Time Off (STO) in accordance with company policy. PTO and STO are prorated during the first year of service. Employees also receive eight standard company holidays and three floating holidays annually, with floating holidays prorated in the first year. The company is committed to maintaining competitive benefits and reserves the right to adjust employee offerings, including PTO, STO, and holiday policies, in compliance with applicable laws and regulations. Posted Salary Range: USD $23\.50 \- USD $28\.95 /Hr.

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description: **Data Scientist \- Energy (Oil \& Gas)** Houston, TX (Hybrid) **About this position:** Context Labs is seeking an early\-career Data Scientist to support the deployment of Context Labs’ Decarbonization as a Service™ platform, built on our Immutably™ Data Fabric technology. This role sits at the intersection of data science, engineering, scientific computing, product development and real\-world emissions domain application. You will work with complex, real\-world energy and emissions data and collaborate with application engineers, data engineers, and product teams to translate engineering methodologies and research ideas into robust, scalable analytical capabilities. We do not expect you to arrive knowing every technology, emissions methodology, or aspect of the energy industry. We seek strong quantitative reasoning, Python and SQL proficiency, and a self\-driven curiosity to learn new technologies and own complex challenges. This position reports to the Data Science Architect. **In this role you will****:** * Work with domain experts to understand engineering and emissions methodologies, assumptions, and requirements and translate them into computational solutions. * Develop, implement, validate, and document robust and reproducible emissions calculations and analytical methodologies. * Explore complex customer datasets, understand their structure and meaning, identify data\-quality issues, and investigate discrepancies. * Implement scalable analytical workflows using Python, SQL, and PySpark, working with data engineers to move solutions into repeatable production workflows * Help generalize customer\-specific calculations, research ideas, and analytical prototypes into reusable software and product capabilities. * Apply statistical methods to validate results, quantify uncertainty, and understand the limitations of available data and methodologies. * Work within an ontology\- and knowledge\-graph\-based framework to connect data to the entities, relationships, and concepts they represent. * Write maintainable, modular Python code and contribute through Git, code review, testing, and documentation. * Apply machine learning methods, including regression, classification, time\-series analysis, and anomaly detection, when appropriate to the problem. * Collaborate across Data Science, Data Engineering, Application Engineering, Product, R\&D, and Customer Experience teams. **What we’re looking for****:** * Relevant professional experience in data science, scientific computing, engineering analytics, or related quantitative work. Candidates with an advanced degree and substantial applied research or project experience will also be considered. * Strong Python and SQL skills, including experience developing maintainable, modular code beyond exploratory notebooks and working with complex, real\-world datasets. * Strong quantitative and analytical problem\-solving skills, including comfort reasoning about equations, assumptions, data relationships, and statistical results. * Working knowledge of statistics, including distributions, descriptive statistics, regression, and statistical validation. * Experience investigating messy or heterogeneous datasets, identifying data\-quality issues, and developing defensible analytical approaches. * Familiarity with collaborative software\-development practices such as Git, code review, testing, and documentation. * Strong initiative and demonstrated ability to learn unfamiliar technical subjects, ask effective questions, seek out relevant expertise, and progressively take ownership of new problems. * Ability to communicate analytical approaches, assumptions, and results clearly to technical and non\-technical colleagues. * BS or MS degree in Engineering, Physics, Applied Mathematics, Data Science, or another related quantitative scientific or technical discipline. **Bonus if you have****:** * Experience working with energy, utilities, industrial, environmental, or emissions\-related data, including greenhouse\-gas or methane analytics. * Familiarity with engineering or physical\-system concepts such as mass and energy balances, thermodynamics, or process modeling. * Experience with PySpark, Spark, Delta Lake, or other distributed data\-processing technologies. * Experience with uncertainty quantification, Monte Carlo methods or implementing scientific, engineering, or regulatory calculation methodologies in software. * Knowledge of ontologies, knowledge graphs, or semantic modeling. **Why you’ll like it here:** * Context Labs is collaborative at its core. You’ll work within your team and across the organization allowing for continuous learning and discovery. * We set goals that matter and provide value in all that we do, from building meaningful products to positively impacting carbon reduction and climate change. * Context Labs’ mission is to transform complex data into continuously proven information. Powered by Immutably™, an innovative, trusted data fabric platform, our integrated solutions deliver context\-driven insights that enable human networks to spot patterns, correlate trends \- and reveal the ground truth hidden inside the world’s most complicated, persistent problems. We understand that applying for a job can be intimidating. Applicants rarely meet every single job requirement, and we know there are many skills and backgrounds that will contribute to success in this role. If you’re interested in applying, please do so. If you come from an engineering or scientific background and have developed strong programming and data\-analysis skills, we encourage you to apply even if your previous title has not been “Data Scientist.” Context Labs embraces diversity and equal opportunity. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We believe the more inclusive we are, the better our products will be. Context Labs will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you require accommodation, please contact Human Resources at HR@contextlabs.com. **Who we are:** Context Labs builds industrial AI data infrastructure for global markets, giving energy and industrial companies trusted data and AI outputs they can defend. Its platform turns fragmented operational and emissions data into continuously proven information, while sensitive data stays within each company’s own environment. Because the data is verified and the workflows validated, one platform can support any output, from carbon management and compliance to commercial use. The company grew out of research at MIT and is led by a team that helped build the internet at scale through earlier companies. Context Labs has offices in Amsterdam, Cambridge, Mass., and Houston, TX. Learn more at www.contextlabs.com.

jobs.title: Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: Convene Hospitality Group (CHG) operates a global portfolio of lifestyle brands focused on creating places and experiences that bring people together. The company designs, develops, and operates hospitality\-driven destinations to host gatherings of all kinds, ranging from small corporate meetings to immersive brand activations and beyond. We love bringing people together in person, and that passion for great experiences extends to our employees as well. If you're interested in creating inspiring moments of connection, consider joining our team. **Analytics Engineer** We're hiring Analytics Engineers to join Convene Hospitality Group's (CHG) Technology organization. We're building out the foundational platform to democratize data at CHG so that a venue GM, a finance lead, and an AI agent are all able to ask a question and get the same trusted answer. Analytics engineers own the full path from ingestion to visualization, including governance and observability. You'll bring data in from source systems, model it through bronze, silver, and gold, define the semantic layer, and breathe life into the visualizations, conversational analytics, and business agents that teams rely on to make decisions. You'll join the Data Platform team, reporting to its Engineering Manager, and work closely with other analytics engineers and business partners across the company. You'll build on Snowflake, dbt, and Fivetran, using Snowflake\-native capabilities like semantic views and Cortex to power ThoughtSpot and beyond. **What You'll Do:** * **Partner with the business.** Work with Finance, Sales, Operations, and venue teams to understand their needs and turn them into models and metrics they trust. * **Own ingestion for your domains.** Set up and maintain Fivetran connectors, land data in bronze, and handle schema drift and load failures. * **Model the business.** Build dbt models that move data through bronze, silver, and gold, and shape gold around how CHG runs so people outside the data team can understand and use it. * **Own the semantic layer.** Set metrics, dimensions, and relationships so a number means the same thing in a dashboard, a search, or an agent's answer. Tune synonyms and descriptions so a model picks the right measure, trace wrong answers to the root cause, and help us decide where each definition lives. * **Power self\-service in ThoughtSpot.** Build the models and Liveboards that let teams explore data on their own, and turn the questions people actually ask into new test cases. * **Own the quality of conversational analytics.** Test answers the way you'd test code. Build and maintain a golden question set of real business questions paired with certified answers as your test cases, run them as a regression suite on every model or semantic change, and block releases that fail. Back your models with dbt tests and clear documentation. * **Apply governance day to day.** Tag sensitive data at ingestion, apply access controls such as tag\-based masking and row access policies, and follow the standards the team sets, so an agent only returns what the person asking is allowed to see. * **Keep it fast and fresh.** Monitor freshness, data quality, and pipeline health so problems surface to you before they reach a dashboard or an agent's answer. Tune query and model performance, from incremental dbt models to warehouse sizing, so answers come back fast and Snowflake costs stay in check. * **Work AI\-native.** Lead with specs, then hand agents end\-to\-end tasks, from exploring source data to building models, tests, and documentation. Let agents run loose in the wild (with some guardrails in place). You hold agent and human work to the same review bar, so code from Claude and code from a teammate get the same scrutiny. Share what you learn, and help set the playbook for agentic data work. **What We Look For:** * You have 3\+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or BI development, building data products people rely on. * You write strong SQL and have built and maintained dbt models in production. * You've worked in a cloud data warehouse, ideally Snowflake. * You've worked with ELT ingestion tools like Fivetran and can troubleshoot source\-data issues such as schema changes, late\-arriving data, and API limits. * You understand data modeling: dimensional models, medallion layering, and clear reasoning about grain, slowly changing dimensions, and event lifecycles. * You've built dashboards or self\-service data products that people use to make decisions. * You test and document your work as a habit. * You're curious about the business. You ask what decision a request supports before you start building. * You use AI agents for real multi\-step work, like writing SQL and dbt models, generating tests, and drafting documentation, and you verify what they produce. * You explain your work clearly to technical and non\-technical partners. * You take ownership. You see work through, ask for help when you're stuck, and look for ways to make things better. Bonus Points * You've evaluated LLM or natural\-language analytics output, for example with golden sets or regression testing. * You've worked in hospitality, events, real estate, or another customer\-centric, multi\-location business. **Compensation:** The above job definition information has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job. Job duties and responsibilities are subject to change based on changing business needs and conditions. Salary Min: $120,000 Salary Max: $160,000 This role is also eligible for Convene's annual incentive performance bonus plan. This information reflects the anticipated base salary range for this position based on current national data. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. Individual pay is based on skills, experience and other relevant factors. **We're Here For You:** At Convene Hospitality Group, we want you to feel supported in every part of your life. Here's what you can expect: * **Health \& Wellness:** Day\-one health coverage for you and your family, 24/7 virtual care, emotional well\-being support, and fertility \& family planning benefits. Because your well\-being matters, inside and outside of work. * **Time Off \& Balance:** Generous PTO, your birthday off (because, of course!), paid parental leave, and a year\-end holiday closure to recharge. * **Financial Growth:** 401K with company match and support for education, courses, and certifications. We invest in you so you can grow personally and professionally. * **Development \& Recognition:** Ongoing career growth opportunities plus recognition programs to celebrate milestones. * **Community \& Impact:** Volunteer and give\-back opportunities, and the chance to make a real impact in the work you do. At Convene Hospitality Group, we believe great teams are built by bringing together people with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. Our values of GRIT (Genuine, Relentless, Integrity, and Teamwork) shape how we show up for each other every day. We want everyone here to feel welcome, supported, and free to be themselves. If you're excited to grow, learn, and make an impact, we'd love to have you on the team. Convene Hospitality Group is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. \#LI\-DK1

jobs.title: Data Platform Lead
jobs.description: Convene Hospitality Group (CHG) operates a global portfolio of lifestyle brands focused on creating places and experiences that bring people together. The company designs, develops, and operates hospitality\-driven destinations to host gatherings of all kinds, ranging from small corporate meetings to immersive brand activations and beyond. We love bringing people together in person, and that passion for great experiences extends to our employees as well. If you're interested in creating inspiring moments of connection, consider joining our team. **Data Platform Lead** We're hiring a hands\-on Data Platform Lead, to join Convene Hospitality Group's (CHG) Technology organization.You'll own our data platform end to end, from architecture to how we model the business, and you'll manage the analytics engineers who build on it. Data platform modernization and AI\-first development are top priorities, and this role sits at the center of both, working hand in hand with the product engineers whose systems create much of our data. Today, our marts mostly mirror the systems they come from. Salesforce data looks like Salesforce, NetSuite data looks like NetSuite. You'll reshape our models around how the business runs, organized by domain, and layer governed dashboards and conversational analytics on top. In one year, a finance lead, a venue GM, and an AI agent should all be able to ask a question in plain language and get the same trusted answer. Today we run Snowflake, dbt, and Fivetran. You'll help us rearchitect for where CHG is headed: building on Snowflake's native capabilities (semantic views, Cortex, and its agent tooling), rolling out ThoughtSpot, and filling gaps like observability. This is a hands\-on management role, open to first\-time managers. If you've led as a tech lead, mentored engineers, or directed contractors, you'll get direct coaching from a VP of Engineering who develops first\-time leaders. Experienced managers who still want to build are welcome too. **What You'll Do:** * **Own the data platform end to end.** Architecture, reliability, and roadmap from source to decision across Snowflake, dbt, and Fivetran. Move platform configuration from the UI into Terraform, in coordination with Cloud Infrastructure, so warehouses, roles, grants and connectors are versioned, reviewed and reproducible. * **Rethink how we model the business.** Move us from source\-shaped marts to domain\-oriented models built around how CHG runs. Set the modeling standards, naming conventions and review practices the team builds on. * **Work backward from the business question.** Partner with Finance, Sales, Operations and venue leadership to turn the questions they need answered into models, metrics and definitions they trust. * **Partner closely with product engineering.** Work with product squads on schema design, data contracts, and upstream changes, so the platform and products evolve together. * **Own data quality and observability.** Set the testing standards, contracts, and reconciliation checks that make our numbers trustworthy, and alert an owner before a stakeholder finds a broken dashboard. * **Own the metrics and BI layer.** Roll out our BI tool and build the semantic layer behind governed dashboards in Snowflake semantic views, with certified metrics and shared definitions, so a number means the same thing everywhere it shows up. * **Bring conversational analytics online, safely.** Stand up natural\-language querying and agents on Snowflake's native tools, with the evals and guardrails that keep agent, dashboard, and human answers in sync. * **Govern the data.** Access control, PII handling and accessible documentation across analytics and AI. * **Lead and grow analytics engineering.** Manage and hire our analytics engineers, and direct the contractors we work with today. Coach through code review, pairing, and clear expectations. * **Keep your hands on the keyboard.** Write dbt models, review PRs, debug pipelines and prototype new approaches. Expect to build a lot, especially early on. **What We Look For:** * You have 7\+ years in data engineering, analytics engineering or data architecture, including building a modern data platform that people rely on in production. * You use AI agents for real multi\-step work: building models, writing tests, debugging pipelines and documenting what exists. You write clear specs, give agents the right context, and verify what they produce against the real system. * You're deep on dbt and Snowflake. You've designed project structure, testing strategy and warehouse performance at scale, and you manage the platform as code with Terraform or similar. * You're fluent in data modeling and have moved a team from source\-shaped models to business\-shaped, domain\-oriented marts, then seen the change through to adoption. * You've built data quality and observability practices: tests, contracts, freshness monitoring and alerting that people trust. * You've built a semantic layer and governed metrics that people trust, and you understand what it takes to make natural\-language and agent\-driven analytics accurate. * You've worked with managed ingestion like Fivetran and know where it fits and where it breaks. * You've led beyond your own work: as a tech lead on a multi\-person project, mentoring engineers, running interview loops, or directing contractors or vendors. * You explain clearly to engineers and non\-engineers. You can walk an analyst through a modeling decision and a CFO through a metric definition. * You're high agency. jobs.title: Sr. Automation/Controls Engineer
jobs.description: It's exciting to work for a company that makes the world measurably better. We're committed to bringing safety, quality, and customer focus to the business of advanced ceramics manufacturing. **Job Title** Sr. Automation/Controls Engineer As the Sr Automation/Controls Engineer, you will serve as a senior technical expert in industrial automation and controls and executes against the function’s manufacturing and engineering strategy. You will be responsible for understanding, defining, implementing, and supporting automation and controls systems across manufacturing operations. Responsibilities include identifying process and equipment improvements, performing technical and cost\-benefit analyses, developing equipment and controls specifications, evaluating equipment suppliers and system integrators, supporting project proposals, and leading equipment installation, programming, integration, commissioning, and technology transfer activities. You will also be accountable for improving manufacturing capability, yield, productivity, reliability, safety, and equipment effectiveness through development and application of automation technologies. You will support development and standardization of automation architectures, controls practices, and manufacturing data connectivity that can be effectively maintained and deployed across multiple manufacturing sites.**Role \& Responsibilities:** * Serve as a senior engineering subject matter expert in industrial automation, controls, and related manufacturing technologies. * Provide hands\-on engineering support for the design, programming, integration, commissioning, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of automated manufacturing equipment. * Lead complex troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis involving PLCs, HMIs, electrical controls, instrumentation, motion systems, networks, sensors, and associated manufacturing equipment. * Develop and maintain PLC and HMI programming standards, controls specifications, electrical/control system documentation, program backups, version control practices, and other automation standards to improve equipment maintainability and consistency. * Design, program, commission, and troubleshoot Rockwell Automation control systems, including ControlLogix/CompactLogix and FactoryTalk platforms. Support legacy PLC platforms where required. * Apply industrial networking and communication technologies such as EtherNet/IP and other applicable industrial communication protocols to connect machines, controls, and manufacturing systems. * Support machine data collection and integration between automation systems and higher\-level manufacturing, historian, database, or MES systems where applicable. * Apply appropriate OT cybersecurity principles when designing, modifying, connecting, and remotely supporting industrial control systems. * Specify, integrate, and troubleshoot automation technologies such as VFDs, servo/motion control, sensors, instrumentation, machine vision, robotics, and automated material handling where applicable. * Apply machine safety principles, including safety circuits, interlocks, guarding interfaces, safety PLCs, and risk\-reduction requirements in equipment design and modification. * Review and develop electrical schematics, control panel designs, I/O requirements, P\&IDs, and equipment interface requirements. * Serve as a key technical interface with machine manufacturers, automation suppliers, system integrators, and other external engineering resources. * Develop equipment and automation specifications and participate in supplier selection, design reviews, Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), installation, startup, and commissioning. * Execute capital equipment projects and technology transfers to meet manufacturing requirements, including training and technical support for plant engineering, maintenance, and manufacturing personnel. * Collaborate with manufacturing, maintenance, engineering, quality, EHS, IT/OT, and business leadership to improve equipment performance, reliability, process capability, and productivity. * Develop technical and business justification for automation and process improvement projects, including cost\-benefit and risk analysis. * Identify opportunities to standardize and replicate successful automation technologies and equipment solutions across manufacturing operations. * Maintain awareness of developments in industrial automation, controls, robotics, machine vision, manufacturing data systems, and related technologies and help evaluate their application within the company. * Prepare technical analyses, project updates, recommendations, and presentations for engineering, plant, and executive leadership. **Job Requirements** **Required Education \& Experience:** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Automation Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. * Minimum of 5 years of controls, automation, or manufacturing engineering experience, with significant hands\-on responsibility for industrial automation systems. **Required Experience and Skills:** * Demonstrated experience designing, programming, commissioning, troubleshooting, and improving PLC/HMI\-based manufacturing equipment. * Strong experience with Rockwell Automation platforms, including Studio 5000/ControlLogix and FactoryTalk, or equivalent industrial control platforms. * Experience commissioning automated equipment for small and large capital projects. * Strong understanding of industrial electrical controls, electrical schematics, instrumentation, jobs.title: Machine Learning Wildfire Scientist
jobs.description: **About EmberWorks** -------------------- EmberWorks Sensing is the remote sensing arm of the R\&D division of Coulson Aviation. Our flagship product, ORBIT, is a persistent aerial thermal sensing system flown on Coulson air attack aircraft. ORBIT automatically captures and delivers near\-real\-time fire intelligence straight into the tools incident teams already use. **The Role \- Remote Job** -------------------------- Operational fire behavior models have been built and calibrated on limited observations, and their predictions often diverge from what crews see on the ground. EmberWorks is positioned to help close that gap: our aircraft already fly over active fires as part of routine operations, collecting thermal observations as they go. -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- You will own EmberWorks' fire behavior modeling effort, from first integration to new methods. This is a new function for us and a founding position, so you will shape which approaches we pursue, how results are validated, and how outputs reach the people who use them. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- You will join a small, hands\-on team of geospatial and platform engineers who build our data pipeline and cloud infrastructure, and who will work closely with you to get the right data to your models. You will be the team's modeling expert, and we expect you to tell us what we're getting wrong. -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Evaluate existing fire behavior modeling approaches and select the right fit for our data. * Build and implement models in an automated production pipeline using airborne thermal observations plus external fuel, weather, and terrain data. * Research and develop new modeling approaches, drawing on empirical, physical, and machine learning methods as appropriate. * Own model validation and interpretation: define what "good" looks like, detect bad outputs, and determine whether a problem lies in the model or upstream in the data. * Define compute requirements for training and inference and work with our platform engineer to set up GPU and distributed computing resources and an efficient remote workflow. * Maintain connections with the academic fire science community and help EmberWorks engage with research partners. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- **Required** * Deep understanding of fire behavior models (e.g. ELMFIRE, WRF\-SITE, FSIM, etc), including the underlying physics and math, not just experience running existing models. * Hands\-on experience building and training machine learning or data\-driven models on spatiotemporal data. * Strong remote sensing background, including working with raster imagery (thermal experience a strong plus). * Proficiency in scientific geospatial programming stack (for example, python xarray, GDAL, rasterio, PyTorch or similar). Familiarity with Git based version control. * Experience running model training on cloud compute, including GPU resources. * Ability to work independently in a small R\&D team and explain modeling decisions to engineers and operations staff. * Bachelor's degree in fire science, atmospheric science, remote sensing, computer science, environmental science or a related field. **Preferred** * Proven experience delivering at least one wildfire project end to end, or sustained, in\-depth support of an established wildfire product suite. Active ties to academic or government fire research groups. * Experience with data assimilation or physics\-informed ML. * Knowledge of optics and radiometry, including thermal sensor calibration. * Familiarity with wildland fire operations and the agencies and tools that support them. * Advanced degree and research in fire science, atmospheric science, remote sensing, computer science, environmental science or a related field, or equivalent applied experience. **How we Hire: \-** ------------------- * + **We actually read your resumes and don't rely on automated filtering methods** + **We don’t care about ATS optimized resumes.** + **There is no gating system for which ones we receive.** + **We value honesty and authenticity.** + **If you submit a cover letter, we will read it.** **Why Join** ------------ This is a founding position on a small team doing new work with unique airborne fire observation data. Your work gets tested on active fires, not just benchmark datasets, so you see quickly how it holds up in the field. You will also have direct access to leadership and room to set technical direction. We are looking for someone who finds that more compelling than a well\-defined role at an established organization.

The core product is already built, and each client is served by a small pod made up of a product lead and two engineers working alongside the firm’s consultants. As one of the two engineers in the pod, you will work on site with a client based in Waltham, MA, Cincinnati, OH, or Dallas, TX, turning business questions into reliable data feeds. Expect messy, undocumented systems and a fast feedback loop with the people using what you build. **Tasks and Deliverables** * Integrate client data sources, including warehouses, ERP, CRM, operational systems, and APIs, into the product. * Write and tune SQL queries and data pipelines that turn raw client data into reliable metrics. * Extend the product’s frontend and backend to meet client\-specific needs. * Use the product’s agent and SDK tooling to configure and extend client workflows. * Debug data quality issues on site with client IT teams and data owners. * Collaborate closely with the product manager and consultants to deliver client customizations. **Requirements** * 4\+ years of full\-stack engineering experience with React and Node.js in production. * Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and Redux. * Strong SQL skills and hands\-on data integration experience (ETL/ELT, APIs, data warehouses). * Experience building with LLMs or agent frameworks, including prompting, tool use, and evaluation. * Experience working directly with customers or end users, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to non\-technical stakeholders. * Ability to join an unfamiliar codebase and ship within the first week. **Nice to Have** * Previous experience in a forward\-deployed, solutions, or consulting engineering role. * Experience with Snowflake, dbt, or a similar modern data stack. * Experience with healthcare or medical services data, such as EHR, claims, scheduling, or revenue cycle, is a strong plus. * Familiarity with HIPAA\-aware data handling. **Engagement Highlights** * 3 to 6 month engagement. * Start date beginning November. * On\-site work Monday through Thursday, with remote work on Fridays. * Location restricted: candidates must live in the Greater Boston area (Waltham, MA), Cincinnati, OH, or Dallas, TX. * Must be authorized to work in the US.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Platform
jobs.description: **Senior Software Engineer, Platform** -------------------------------------- **Team:** Platform Engineering **Location:** Portland, Oregon. Full time (hybrid) **Salary range:** $132,300–$161,700 *Unfortunately, we are not able to provide visa sponsorship for this role at this time.* ### **About CreativeX** CreativeX is building the system of creative control for an AI\-first marketing world. As AI rewrites how content is made, evaluated, and distributed, marketers need a foundation they can trust and a way to bring consistency, intelligence, and governance to creative at scale. For over a decade, we've powered smarter creative decisions for the world's biggest brands, including Google, Unilever, Pepsi, Bayer, Mondelez, Heineken, shipped category\-defining products, and proven that creative is the single biggest driver of marketing performance We use computer vision and other machine learning techniques to extract creative data from our client's digital advertising copy and transform those previously dark signals into a standardised data model at industrial scale. This creates a new, unique and powerful first party data set that represents the last and most impactful untapped reservoir of advertising performance. This is the problem CreativeX is focussed on solving. We're an end\-to\-end solution to ingest, process, and analyse content at scale. We help brands isolate creative elements so they can be analysed against downstream ad impact metrics, from clickthrough rates to brand lift. Our objective is to help marketing organisations power every creative decision with data. ### **Platform Engineering Team** As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll own the reliability, performance and scalability of the production infrastructure behind every CreativeX product. You'll be a part of the Platform Engineering team, which builds the infrastructure, shared services and self\-service tools our engineers rely on, and runs the systems that collect, process and serve the ad data and creative scoring our customers depend on. We're investing in our core architecture: evolving our data layer, scaling our processing pipelines for higher throughput and automating more of how we process creative assets. You'll lead the database migrations and rearchitecture work that make this possible, and build the tooling that lets other engineers deploy, test and debug. This is a systems\-level role so you'll write code, but most of your impact will come from how our systems are designed, run, observed and scaled. You enjoy taking a system that works and making it faster, more reliable and easier to run, and this role is an opportunity to shape the platform that CreativeX's next stage of growth is built on. ### **What you will do:** * Be the owner and go\-to expert for the reliability and performance of our production systems * Lead database migrations and rearchitecture projects across teams, from planning and risk assessment through cutover, with minimal disruption to customers * Scale our infrastructure and data processing pipelines to keep pace with growing data volumes and throughput * Build self\-service tools and automation that let engineers deploy, test and debug on their own * Maintain and improve staging and development environments, deployment automation and testing infrastructure * Improve observability across our systems, using AI\-assisted workflows to cut manual investigation and repetitive operational work * Respond to production incidents and lead post\-incident reviews that result in lasting fixes * Collaborate with Information Security, Product and the wider engineering team to keep our systems secure and flag feasibility and scalability risks early * Set and meet reliability and performance targets for the platform ### **Who you are:** * Experience leading a database migration or significant architectural change on a live production system * Deep, hands\-on experience with cloud data platforms in production, including performance tuning and query optimisation * A track record of scaling existing web applications and the infrastructure behind them, with a strong grounding in observability, monitoring and alerting * Comfort reading and writing production code, ideally in Ruby on Rails * Day\-to\-day use of AI tools such as Claude to build workflows and automation, not only as a search engine * Clear communication: you explain technical trade\-offs to engineers and non\-engineers, and write documentation others can follow * Experience with a major cloud platform like AWS or DigitalOcean; infrastructure as code (e.g. Ansible); Datadog or similar monitoring * *Nice to have:* High\-volume data or media pipelines; internal developer platforms or self\-service tooling; working within a formal information security programme ### **What success looks like** **In your first 90 days** * You know our production architecture, data layer and deployment pipeline well enough to make changes safely, and you have shipped improvements to production. * You have assessed our current database setup and agreed a plan with engineering leadership for the first major migration or rearchitecture, including risks, sequencing and rollback. * You have delivered at least one reliability or observability improvement that other teams notice, such as fixing a noisy alert or replacing a recurring manual request with a self\-service tool. **After one year** * You have led at least one major database migration or rearchitecture to completion without unplanned customer\-facing downtime. * Our systems handle higher data volumes and pipeline throughput, and reliability and performance are tracked against agreed targets. * Engineers across CreativeX use self\-service tooling you built to deploy, test or debug, and wait less on the platform team. At CreativeX, we encourage applicants of all backgrounds and identities to apply for roles that align with their own interests and career trajectory. If you fit the description above and see yourself in this role, we would love to see your application! ### **What we Offer:** Fully paid medical, dental, and vision (US) and Private Medical Insurance and Health Cash Plan (UK) ✈️ Generous time off \+ bank holidays Education budget to be used for individual learning experiences or grouped with your team for joint learning Annual subscription to Calm and Headspace for your mental wellbeing Monthly coaching to talk to a trained professional about career goals, relationships, and personal development Competitive salary and commission plan including stock options, as we believe that everyone should have a stake in the business 4\-month full pay parenting leave for all employees who have been with the company for one (1\) year Employee contributions to a 401(k) once they have completed their eligibility period ***CreativeX provides equal employment opportunities for all applicants and employees.*** As part of our commitment to maintaining a safe and secure workplace, CreativeX conducts standard right to work and background checks on all potential employees. This process is designed to verify the accuracy of information provided by candidates and to ensure a safe environment for all employees. Background checks are conducted via a secure third party application and in compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.

jobs.title: Sr. Automation and Controls Engineer
jobs.description: **COMPANY OVERVIEW** -------------------- Cresco Labs is one of the largest public, vertically integrated, multistate operators in the cannabis industry. Our portfolio of in\-house cultivated and manufactured brands features some of the highest quality, most awarded and most popular cannabis products in America. With dozens of locations nationwide, our owned and operated Sunnyside® dispensaries provide a welcoming, positive, judgement\-free place to shop for anyone at any point on their cannabis journey. Founded in 2013, Cresco Labs' mission is to normalize and professionalize cannabis through our passionate employees. As stewards of the cannabis industry, our teams are constantly focused on supporting the needs of our fellow colleagues, consumers, customers, and communities alike. With a focus on Social Equity and Educational Development, our SEEDTM initiative ensures that our company reflects the communities in which we serve, ensuring equal opportunity for all to have the knowledge and resources to work in and own businesses in cannabis. At Cresco Labs, we aim to revolutionize and lead the nation's cannabis industry with a focus on quality and consistency of product, and to bring legitimacy to the industry with the highest level of integrity and professionalism. If you're interested in joining our mission, click the below links to join our team today! **MISSION STATEMENT** --------------------- At Cresco, we aim to lead the nation's cannabis industry with a focus on regulatory compliance, product consistency, and customer satisfaction. Our operations bring legitimacy to the cannabis industry by acting with the highest level of integrity, strictly adhering to regulations, and promoting the clinical efficacy of cannabis. As Cresco grows, we will operate with the same level of professionalism and precision in each new market we move in to. **JOB SUMMARY** The Automation \& Controls Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting automation and control systems across Cresco Labs' manufacturing, packaging and other areas. This role focuses on improving equipment reliability, throughput, and data visibility across lab and production environments, while ensuring compliance with regulatory and quality standards. This position plays a key role in scaling operations by integrating new equipment, standardizing control systems across sites, and driving automation initiatives that enhance efficiency, consistency, and traceability. This is a technical, people\-leadership role with multiple direct and indirect reporting relationships. **CORE JOB DUTIES** * Design, program, and maintain PLC, HMI, and SCADA systems * Develop and support control systems for: * Extraction and post\-processing equipment (hydrocarbon, ethanol, solventless) * Distillation, refinement, and formulation systems * Automated packaging lines (filling, capping, labeling, cartoning) * BAS and Environmental control systems. * Troubleshoot controls, instrumentation, and system integration issues to minimize downtime * Lead integration of new manufacturing and lab equipment into site\-wide control architectures * Partner with Operations, Engineering, and Quality teams to ensure equipment meets performance and compliance requirements * Drive standardization of controls platforms, architectures, and naming conventions across multiple Cresco facilities * Support FAT, SAT, commissioning, and startup activities * Implement and maintain data collection systems for production metrics (OEE, OOE, throughput, downtime, yield) * Support development of dashboards and reporting tools for real\-time operational visibility * Analyze system data to identify bottlenecks and drive continuous improvement initiatives * Develop and maintain technical documentation (control narratives, IO lists, P\&IDs, SOPs) * Support validation activities (IQ/OQ/PQ where applicable) in regulated environments * Lead or support automation scope for capital projects, expansions, and line upgrades * Develop technical specifications and coordinate with OEMs, system integrators, and vendors * Manage controls\-related timelines, budgets, and deliverables * Support multi\-site rollout of standardized automation solutions * Ability to travel as needed to sites across the U.S. (50% or more). **REQUIRED EXPERIENCE, EDUCATION AND SKILLS** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Mechatronics, or related field * 7\+ years of experience in industrial automation within manufacturing or process environments * Hands\-on PLC programming experience (Allen\-Bradley, Rockwell Automation and/or other) * Experience with HMI/SCADA systems (FactoryTalk, Ignition, or similar) * Knowledge of industrial communication protocols (EtherNet/IP, Modbus, OPC) * Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills * Experience with automated packaging systems (filling, labeling, vision inspection) * Experience developing, reviewing, redlining, and approving electrical, mechanical, and pneumatic schematics. * Advanced MS Office skills. * CAD Modeling (e.g., AutoCAD / SolidWorks) preferred. * Knowledge of pharmaceutical guidelines (GMP, GDP, ASTM). * Excellent organizational, interpersonal, quantitative, writing, and communication skills. **BENEFITS** Cresco Labs is proud to offer eligible employees a robust offering of benefits including, major medical, dental and vision insurance, a 401(K)\-match program, FSA/HSA programs, LTD/STD options, life insurance and AD\&D. We also offer eligible employees paid holidays and paid time off. Other rewards may include annual discretionary bonuses, stock options as well as participation in our employee discount program. Benefits eligibility for permanent positions may vary by full\-time or part\-time roles, location, or position. **ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS** * Must be 21 years of age or older to apply * Must comply with all legal or company regulations for working in the industry * The company does not offer employment\-based visa sponsorship for this role or any other position, now or in the future. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis without the need for current or future sponsorship at any time. *Cresco Labs is an Equal Opportunity Employer and all applicants will be considered without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.* ##### **California Consumer Privacy Act ("CCPA") Notice to Applicants:** ##### **Please read the** **California Employee Privacy Notice****("CA Privacy Notice") regarding Sunnyside\* and its affiliate Cresco Labs' policies pertaining to the collection, use, and disclosure of personal information. This CA Privacy Notice supplements the information contained in the** **Sunnyside\* Privacy Policy** **and applies to California resident employees and job applicants. Applicants with disabilities may access this notice in an alternative format by contacting** **CCPAnotice@crescolabs.com** ##### **Reporting a Scam:** **Cresco Labs is aware of fictitious employment offers being circulated from various sources. Many of these schemes consist of an alleged offer of employment with Cresco Labs with the intention of gaining personal information, including payment and/or banking information. Be aware that fraudulent job offers and correspondence may appear legitimate: they may feature a Cresco Labs logo, they may appear to originate from an official\-looking email address or web site, or they may be sent by individuals purporting to represent Cresco Labs or an entity which includes the word Cresco Labs in its name.** **Please note that Cresco Labs** **does not** **ask for payment or personal banking information as a condition of employment. Any personal information is requested for payroll or state badging purposes only. Applications can be securely submitted through our career's pages.** ##### **We are working diligently to block this from happening. Beware if an offer of employment looks too good to be true. Never divulge personal and banking information or send money if you are unsure of the authenticity of an email or other communication in the name of Cresco Labs.** ##### **If you are in doubt, please contact us at** **Report\-a\-spam@crescolabs.com****with questions.**

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: At Crisis Text Line, Engineering, Product, and Design work together to create a trusted, innovative, and deeply human\-centered Crisis Care Platform. Our technology supports millions of people in moments of need and enables global partners to deliver crisis support at scale. We’re looking for a mid\-level full\-stack software engineer to join our Conversational Application Team. This is a backend\-leaning role for an engineer who can independently deliver well\-defined work across the software development lifecycle—from technical design and implementation through testing, deployment, and production support. You’ll contribute to APIs, data models, caching, background processing, and user\-facing or internal tools. Your work will help improve the resilience, stability, and scalability of systems used by people during some of their most vulnerable moments. ### **Role:** As a Mid\-Level Full\-Stack Software Engineer, you will design, build, test, deploy, and operate core platform features. After completing your initial onboarding and becoming familiar with our environments, you’ll be trusted to take ownership of assigned work with support available from technical leads, architects, and other members of the team. You’ll work primarily on backend systems while contributing across the stack as needed. This includes implementing approved technical designs, developing and maintaining APIs, working with relational databases and caching technologies, and supporting systems that use queues, schedulers, and other asynchronous processes. You’ll also help address technical debt, improve production reliability, and strengthen the tools and practices that allow us to deliver software safely. **Our Stack** You’ll work across a modern, cloud\-based environment, including: * **Backend:** PHP with Symfony, Golang, Node.js, services, and APIs * **Frontend:** React and Redux * **APIs:** REST and GraphQL * **Data:** MySQL, PostgreSQL, and Redis * **Cloud:** AWS * **Infrastructure as code:** Terraform * **Observability:** Datadog and Grafana * **Delivery:** Automated CI/CD pipelines and shared ownership of production reliability ### **Responsibilities** * Own features end\-to\-end: Design, build, test, ship, and maintain full\-stack features in production. * Solve hard problems: Break down ambiguous technical challenges and deliver scalable, secure solutions. * Champion security: Contribute to authentication, authorization, and platform security practices. * Build for scale: Improve service architecture, APIs, and system reliability as we grow globally. * Collaborate deeply: Partner with product, design, and engineering peers to deliver high\-impact solutions. * Raise engineering quality: Improve testing, CI/CD, observability, and developer workflows. * Support production: Participate in on\-call rotation to ensure platform reliability. ### **Required Qualifications:** * Approximately three to five years of professional software engineering experience, including meaningful backend or full\-stack responsibilities. * Professional experience programming in at least one high\-level language. * Experience developing and maintaining production APIs. * Experience working with SQL and relational databases such as MySQL or PostgreSQL. * Experience testing, debugging, and supporting production software. * Familiarity with cloud\-based environments such as AWS. * Experience working with automated CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows. * The ability to independently complete well\-defined engineering work while asking questions and seeking Full alignment when needed. * The ability to explain technical analysis, decisions, risks, and tradeoffs clearly. * A collaborative approach to working with engineering and cross\-functional partners. * A commitment to building secure, reliable, and accessible technology for people with diverse needs and experiences. **Preferred Qualifications** The following experience would be useful, but we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every item: * PHP or the Symfony framework. * Golang or an interest in developing Golang proficiency. * Node.js, React, or Redux. * REST and GraphQL APIs. * Redis or another caching technology. * Queues, schedulers, background processing, or event\-driven systems. * AWS services and cloud\-based application architecture. * Terraform or another infrastructure\-as\-code tool. * Datadog, Grafana, or comparable telemetry and observability tools. * Improving CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, or release processes. * Designing for availability, performance, security, and observability. * Contributing to service\-oriented or API\-first architectures. * Participating in technical design reviews or architectural discussions. * Working in a mission\-driven, regulated, safety\-sensitive, or high\-trust environment. ***Reliable High\-Speed Internet Required:*** Must have a stable high\-speed internet connection to support seamless remote collaboration, virtual meetings, online job tasks, etc. The full salary range for this position, across all United States geographies, is $99,704 to $116,990\. The upper portion of the salary range is typically reserved for existing employees who demonstrate strong performance over time. Starting salary will vary by location, qualifications, and prior experience; during the interview process, candidates will learn the starting salary range applicable for their location. We pay competitively in the tech\-forward nonprofit space and offer a robust benefits package. This is a remote position within the United States. At the time of hire and throughout employment, the employee’s primary residence and regular home work location must be in one of the following approved hiring states: California, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Indiana, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, New Jersey, New Mexico, New York, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, or Washington state. **Benefits \& Well\-Being** Crisis Text Line offers thoughtfully designed, equity\-centered benefits that support holistic wellness, financial security, and flexibility. Our benefits are built to meet people where they are and reduce barriers to care and sustainability. **Highlights include:** * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision options that prioritize accessibility and financial peace of mind * Employer\-funded HSA contributions * Generous PTO, sick time, and 19 paid holidays with a winter break * 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave after 26 consecutive weeks of service * Monthly wellness and mental health stipends * Home office and professional development stipends * 403(b) retirement plan with employer contribution * Sabbatical after 3 years of service Benefits are for U.S.\-based employees; international benefits may vary. #### \#LI\-KR1 **This is a remote\-only position** sm862QnkoB

jobs.title: Distinguished Engineer, AI Security Systems (Remote)
jobs.description: As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI\-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission\-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI\-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you. **About the Lab:** ------------------ AI is changing cyber offense and defense simultaneously. Adversaries use models to inspect code, hunt vulnerabilities, adapt tooling, and conduct longer operations. CrowdStrike built the Cybersecurity Superintelligence Lab to ensure defenders stay ahead. The Lab is CrowdStrike’s frontier AI research organization for cyber defense. Its work spans frontier and open\-weight models, CrowdStrike\-trained models, specialized agents, reinforcement learning, evaluation, and secure deployment. The Lab combines trillions of Falcon events each day, more than a decade of adversary intelligence, expert\-validated outcomes, and high\-fidelity environments where offensive and defensive AI can attack, defend, learn, and prove what works in real enterprise environments. **About the Role:** ------------------- We are seeking a Distinguished Engineer who has built AI and security systems that operate in the real world and stop real adversaries. You may have worked on the endpoint, where every millisecond, megabyte, and CPU cycle matters, or at cloud scale, where systems reason over trillions of events and design decisions affect cost, latency, and efficacy across millions of protected assets. Ideally, you understand both. As one of the Lab’s most senior technical leaders, you will architect systems that turn frontier AI into autonomous, trustworthy cyber defense—from the sensor to the cloud. You will write code, design experiments, set technical direction across research and engineering teams, and carry breakthroughs into the Falcon platform. If you have shipped AI that stops adversaries in production and want to build what comes next, we want to talk. **What You’ll Do:** ------------------- * Architect the Lab’s AI security systems end to end, including models, agents, security telemetry, tools, execution environments, on\-sensor inference, and cloud\-scale reasoning. * Bring frontier AI to the endpoint using distillation, quantization, compact and specialized models, and integration with kernel\- and user\-mode telemetry. * Build cloud\-scale streaming detection and inference systems across trillions of events per day, with GPU\-efficient serving, intelligent model routing, and disciplined control of cost, latency, and reliability. * Build autonomous defenders that investigate, hunt, write and validate detections, and drive response and remediation. * Create systems that learn from investigations, adversary emulation, simulations, expert feedback, reinforcement learning, post\-training, reward modeling, and synthetic data. * Engineer for adversarial conditions, including evasion, poisoning, prompt injection, tool abuse, sandboxed execution, and autonomous action in customer environments. * Establish benchmarks, cyber ranges, and evaluation harnesses measuring efficacy, false\-positive cost, reliability, latency, and spend. * Lead through technical depth by working on the hardest problems, mentoring principal\-level engineers and research scientists, and aligning cross\-functional teams. * Carry research into production in the Falcon platform, solving the scale, safety, and operability challenges required for customer\-grade capabilities. * Represent CrowdStrike through publications, open\-source work, standards, and collaboration with frontier AI labs, universities, and the security research community. **What You’ll Need:** --------------------- * BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related technical field; PhD preferred. * 15\+ years of industry experience in software engineering, machine learning, or security engineering; 12\+ years with a PhD. * 8\+ s:** ----------------- * Cybersecurity industry experience across endpoint, cloud, identity, SIEM, or threat intelligence. * Experience at a frontier AI lab in pre\-training, post\-training, reinforcement learning, inference, evaluation, or safety. * Experience with adversarial machine learning, AI red teaming, autonomous cyber reasoning systems, or AI\-driven offensive security. * Experience building extensible AI or agentic platforms that enable teams to safely develop, evaluate, optimize, and deploy AI applications at scale. * Recognized technical contributions, including publications, patents, influential open\-source projects, or conference talks spanning AI and security. **Why Join the Lab:** --------------------- * Work on frontier technology with real\-world consequences, protecting organizations that keep economies, hospitals, and critical infrastructure running. * Access trillions of daily Falcon events, deep adversary intelligence, and high\-fidelity cyber environments. * Help define the technical culture, architecture, and standards of a new frontier lab. * Collaborate with AI researchers, offensive operators, threat hunters, and incident responders who understand how real attacks happen and how they are stopped. \#LI\-Remote \#LI\-CS1 **Benefits of Working at CrowdStrike:** * Market leader in compensation and equity awards * Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs * Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge * Paid parental and adoption leaves * Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role * Employee Networks, geographic neighborhood groups, and volunteer opportunities to build connections * Vibrant office culture with world class amenities * Great Place to Work Certified™ across the globe CrowdStrike is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a culture of belonging where everyone is valued for who they are and empowered to succeed. We support veterans and individuals with disabilities through our affirmative action program. CrowdStrike is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants for employment. The Company does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, creed, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy or pregnancy\-related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, marital or family status, veteran status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical disability (including HIV and AIDS), mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, membership or activity in a local human rights commission, status with regard to public assistance, or any other characteristic protected by law. We base all employment decisions\-including recruitment, selection, training, compensation, benefits, discipline, promotions, transfers, lay\-offs, return from lay\-off, terminations and social/recreational programs\-on valid job requirements. If you need assistance accessing or reviewing the information on this website or need help submitting an application for employment or requesting an accommodation, please contact us at recruiting@crowdstrike.com for further assistance. Find out more about your rights as an applicant. CrowdStrike participates in the E\-Verify program. Notice of E\-Verify Participation Right to Work CrowdStrike, Inc. is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Placement within the pay range is dependent on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, certifications, job level, supervisory status, and location. The base salary range for this position for all U.S. candidates is $235,000 \- $350,000 per year, with eligibility for bonuses, equity grants and a comprehensive benefits package that includes health insurance, 401k and paid time off. For detailed information about the U.S. benefits package, please click here. Expected Close Date of Job Posting is:12\-22\-2026

jobs.title: Research Engineer
jobs.description: **About David AI** ------------------ David AI is the first audio data research company. We bring an R\&D approach to data–developing datasets with the same rigor AI labs bring to models. Our mission is to bring AI into the real world, and we believe audio is the gateway. Speech is versatile, accessible, and human—it fits naturally into everyday life. As audio AI advances and new use cases emerge, high\-quality training data is the bottleneck. In less than a year, we’ve brought on most FAANG companies and AI labs as customers. Our team is sharp, humble, ambitious, and tight\-knit. We’re looking for the best research, engineering, product, and operations minds to join us on our mission to push the frontier of audio AI. **About our Research team** --------------------------- Our Research team sits at the intersection of cutting\-edge research and production systems, transforming raw audio into high\-signal data for leading AI labs and enterprises. We own the full ML lifecycle \- from researching novel speech processing algorithms to deploying models processing terabytes of audio daily. **About this role** ------------------- As a **Research Engineer** at David AI, you'll build algorithms and systems that turn large\-scale speech and audio collections into high\-quality datasets. You'll tackle questions like: What makes a recording useful? How do we measure and improve dataset quality? **In this role, you will** -------------------------- * Design algorithms and metrics using advanced signal processing algorithms and cutting edge ML models with to derive insights from thousands of hours of audio data. * Build scalable data processing pipelines for analyzing, filtering, deduplicating, and curating large speech and audio datasets. * Develop production\-grade inference algorithms, pipelines, and APIs with cross\-functional teams that unlock key insights into our data for our customers. * Collaborating with our Operations team to gather useful training and evaluation datasets to improve the quality of our models. * Architect systems that enable resilient, durable inference and evaluations. **Your background looks like** * Strong Python skills and experience building maintainable, production\-quality software. * End\-to\-end ownership of ML pipelines, from proof\-of\-concept to production deployment. * Ability to translate research papers and ideas into high\-quality, production\-ready code. * Experience deploying ML systems for production inference with cloud technologies. * Ability to assess model quality in the context of user experience and business value. **Bonus points if you have** ---------------------------- * Experience with speech, audio, or digital signal processing. * Experience with data curation, search and retrieval, embeddings, clustering, deduplication, or sampling. * Experience building model inference systems or integrating pretrained models into production workflows. * Experience in publishing in top conferences such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, etc. * Experience in releasing, maintaining, contributing to open\-source softwares. * PhD or Masters in Computer Science or a related field. **Benefits** ------------ * Unlimited PTO. * Top\-notch health, dental, and vision coverage with 100% coverage for most plans. * FSA \& HSA access. * 401k access. * Meals 2x daily through DoorDash \+ snacks and beverages available at the office. * Unlimited company\-sponsored Barry’s classes. You should be equally comfortable setting multi\-year strategy, negotiating trade\-offs with peer executives, and going deep with engineering and product leaders on execution. If you're a self\-starter with an analytical mindset, excellent executive communication skills, and a track record of building and scaling high\-performing product and engineering organizations, we'd love to hear from you. Join us in shaping the future of cloud computing, cybersecurity, and platform services at DigitalOcean. **What You'll Be Doing:** ------------------------- * Own the vision, strategy, and business outcomes for Security Products, Security Engineering, Customer Identity, Billing, Secrets Management, Security Observability, and other Core Platform Account Services, acting as the general manager of this combined portfolio. * Build, lead, and grow a multi\-disciplinary organization of product management and engineering directors, managers, and individual contributors;
