communicate strategy, progress, and risk in a way that builds confidence and drives alignment. * Coordinate with support, training, sales, and marketing teams to ensure customers and internal stakeholders have the materials, documentation, and enablement they need. **What We'll Expect from You:** ------------------------------- * Proven experience as a general manager or senior business leader owning both product management and engineering functions for a significant product area, platform, or business unit. * A track record of building, scaling, and leading multi\-team, multi\-discipline organizations through dire  regulatory and compliance landscape relevant to identity, billing, and security data. * Experience operating in public\-company or high\-governance environments, including board\-level and executive reporting. * Familiarity with cloud hosting and virtualization technologies. * Past success shaping highly scalable, secure products and platforms with an eye toward ease of use and customer trust. **Compensation Range:** ----------------------- * $279,200 \- $349,000 * + *Non\-sales roles*: In addition to base salary, this role is eligible to participate in DigitalOcean's annual bonus plan and may be eligible for a new hire equity grant, subject to plan terms and local eligibility. jobs.title: Expert Programmer (Java)
jobs.description: About the Role Diverse Agile Solutions is seeking an Expert Programmer (Java) to provide technical leadership for the UI Job Assist Tool (JAT), an initiative that connects New York State's Unemployment Insurance (UI) system of record with an AI\-enabled job assistance tool through secure APIs and Model Context Protocol (MCP) services. This hybrid position is based in Albany, New York. The Expert Programmer will lead backend development and API architecture, vendor integration, security, data integrity, performance, and knowledge transfer across the solution. Key Responsibilities * Build REST endpoints, optimize database queries in collaboration with the Data Architect, and implement business logic and validation. * Design and review Java microservices and APIs connecting the core UI system and the AI Job Assist Tool. * Review vendor API specifications, data schemas, and integration designs, and recommend approval before ITS development begins. * Serve as a technical liaison among the vendor AI team, NYSDOL business subject matter experts, and ITS security and infrastructure teams. * Establish coding standards and branching strategies; conduct code reviews focused on security, performance, and maintainability. * Design end\-to\-end integration across REST APIs, the MCP server, and the UI system of record. * Collaborate with GCP Cloud Engineering on secure egress proxies, VPC Service Controls, GKE, Pub/Sub, IAM, and related cloud\-native architecture. * Design validation controls to prevent corrupt or unapproved AI\-generated data from being written back to the UI system. * Anticipate and mitigate API instability, dependency, and database\-change risks; develop technical workarounds as needed. * Develop and execute load\-testing strategies for approximately 1,500 concurrent users and document\-heavy workloads. * Integrate AI capabilities and MCP services with enterprise Java and microservice solutions. * Maintain technical documentation and provide knowledge transfer and mentoring to State staff. Required Qualifications * 84\+ months of experience. The candidate can guide large teams and/or has extensive industry experience and is considered at the top of their field. Preferred Qualifications * 96 months of enterprise backend software development and API architecture using Java and microservices, including REST API design and implementation. * 36 months in a technical leadership or architecture role on enterprise systems, including code review, technical standards, and cross\-functional or vendor coordination. * 24 months integrating enterprise applications with AI\-enabled services or AI platforms, including validation of data exchanged between AI services and systems of record. * 12 months designing, implementing, or validating MCP servers, clients, tools, or integrations. * 24 months with GCP cloud\-native architectures and services, including one or more of GKE, Pub/Sub, IAM, VPC Service Controls, or secure egress patterns. * 24 months delivering solutions in high\-compliance environments such as IRS Publication 1075, CJIS, HIPAA, or comparable regulated environments. * 24 months designing data\-integrity, write\-back validation, or API security controls for transactional enterprise systems.

jobs.title: Controls Engineer 3
jobs.description: Position summary: Electrical controls PLC programmer responsible for aiding in developing, creating, testing, implementing, and commissioning PLC program required to control conveyor systems and/or related equipment used in the Material Handling Industry (Freight/Parcel, Baggage Handling, Warehouse Distribution, \& Manufacturing). This includes assisting in initial code development, conforming to established in\-house programming and field commissioning, complying with customer specifications on each project, for system control and monitoring, testing, completing field testing documentation, and field commissioning and start\-up activities. Experience with Rockwell RSLogix and ControlLogix platforms is required along with knowledge of Ethernet/IP communications, ControlNet, DeviceNet, and other industrial control networks. Prefer experience with Proface and/or Panelview software. HMI experience is preferred but not required. Tasks: * Confer with project managers, customers, and others to discuss and understand project specifications, scope and design requirements. * Prepare detailed and complete PLC programs that are fully annotated, and comply with the system design drawings required to implement the project scope as per project specifications and ensure compliance with specifications, codes, and customer requirements. * Fully test and document testing procedures for all programs \& software developed that comply with customer and in\-house testing documentation requirements. Fill all commissioning documents for L1 and L2 commissioning.. * Field commissioning and testing of assigned projects working within a team to deploy and turn\-over completed, tested systems to customers. * Travel to job sites as required for commissioning and start\-up activities for assigned projects. Participate in customer training and instruction sessions. Travel percentage (65%\-75%). Skills: * Active Listening \- Giving full attention to what other people are saying, taking time to understand the points being made, asking questions as appropriate, and not interrupting at inappropriate times. * Troubleshooting \- Determining causes of operating errors and deciding what to do about it. * Critical Thinking \- Using logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions or approaches to problems. * Reading Comprehension \- Understanding written sentences and paragraphs in work related documents. * Technology Design \- Generating or adapting equipment and technology to serve user needs. * Complex Problem Solving \- Identifying complex problems and reviewing related information to develop and evaluate options and implement solutions. * Sound and efficient design abilities. * Ability to work within and function well with project teams and other programmers who may be assigned to the same or similar projects. Required Experience and Education: Bachelor's Degree \- Electrical or related Engineering degree. Able to travel 65%\-75% Able to travel on some weekends

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: **OUR COMPANY:** EOS IT Solutions is a Global Technology and Logistics company, providing Collaboration and Business IT Support services to some of the world's largest industry leaders, delivering forward\-thinking solutions based on multi\-domain architecture. Customer satisfaction and commitment to superior quality of service are our top business priorities, along with investing in and supporting our partners and employees. We are a true International IT provider and are proud to deliver our services through global simplicity with trusted transparency. **WHAT YOU WILL DO:** As a Senior Data Engineer, you will lead data engineering initiatives and build end\-to\-end scalable, stable, and secure analytical solutions. You are passionate about working with huge datasets and have experience with the organization and curation of data for analytics. You have a strategic and long term view on architecting advanced data eco systems. You are experienced in building efficient and scalable data services and have the ability to integrate data systems. In this assignment you will support the RL Data Engineering team (Burlingame, CA \+ vendor office as applicable), backfilling production ownership of demo, yield/funnel, and asset\-tracking pipelines — onboarding new datasets, keeping recurring batch jobs and dashboards healthy, and making onboarding repeatable through documentation and automation. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Design, implement and operate large\-scale, centralized high\-volume, high\-performance data structures for analytics and data science. * Implement data ingestion routines both real time and batch using best practices in data modeling, ETL/ELT processes. * Work with Project Manager to understand business and functional requirements and translate these requirements into robust, scalable, operable solutions with a flexible and adaptable data architecture. * Assist SWE team with identifying in code key events and data to be logged to populate the data structures used for dashboarding. * Help continually improve ongoing reporting and analysis processes, automating or simplifying self\-service modeling and production support for customers. * Onboard new datasets end to end: requirements, access provisioning, packaging and CI/CD configuration, partition/snapshot validation, go\-live checks. * Own recurring batch jobs — monitoring, triage, test plans, and partition recovery — including backfills via notebooks and SQL. * Build and maintain flow/funnel, quality\-check, and operations\-health dashboards in the team's BI platform; maintain internal web tools (bug fixes, duplicate\-record cleanup, prod/test tagging). * Author and maintain runbooks, end\-to\-end documentation, release notes, and user guides; keep them current with a scheduled audit cadence. **ESSENTIAL CRITERIA:** * Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field or 7\+ years industry experience. * Demonstrated strength in data modelling, ETL development, and data warehousing experience with Oracle, Redshift, PostgreSQL, etc. * Advanced SQL and query performance tuning skills. * Experience building data products incrementally and integrating and managing data sets from multiple sources. * Coding proficiency in Python programming language. * Experience with scheduled batch orchestration (e.g. Airflow or equivalent) and partitioned lake/warehouse tables. * Experience with CI/CD, version control, and task tracking; ability to own production issues and write clear runbooks. * Experience building operational dashboards and reporting on delivery KPIs (freshness, completeness, on\-time delivery, accuracy). * Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills; self\-motivated in an autonomous, fast\-paced environment. * Ability to work on\-site in Burlingame, CA per assignment **DESIRABLE CRITERIA:** * Hardware / field data collection, demographic data, or yield/funnel analytics. * Flow/funnel visualizations, asset\-tracking DAGs, or lineage tooling. * Internal tooling, form builders, or AI\-assistant guides for onboarding automation. * Capture\-management systems, search APIs, or permission models. *The EOS pay range for this job is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, experience, education, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, market data, or other laws.* *EOS is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We invite you to consider opportunities at EOS regardless of your gender; gender identity; gender reassignment; age; religious or similar philosophical belief; race; national origin; political opinion; sexual orientation; disability; marital or civil partnership status or other non\-merit factor.* \#INDNAMER

jobs.title: Agentic AI Engineer - Manager
jobs.description: Location: New York Other locations: Anywhere in Country Salary: Competitive Date: Oct 21, 2026 **Job description** ------------------- Requisition ID: 1754575 Location: Anywhere in Country At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world. **The opportunity** Build AI agents that carry meaningful work from intent to a verified outcome, not merely produce an impressive response. You will engineer the execution loops, tools, context, permissions, evaluations, and runtime controls that let agents operate across complex workflows while remaining understandable, steerable, and safe when systems or assumptions fail. This role sits where applied AI, distributed systems, and product engineering meet. You will work on long\-running behavior, real enterprise integrations, and difficult production failures, deciding when a deterministic workflow is enough, when autonomy adds value, and whether each added degree of freedom earns its operational and user\-experience cost. **About Challenger** Challenger is a new EY program focused on building the firm’s next generation of services. It pursues opportunities where AI enables a fundamentally different service and way of delivering it, including rethinking existing offerings and developing new ones. Small, dedicated teams build and test ideas in real conditions. Solutions that demonstrate clear business value and operational readiness transition to the business for adoption and scale. Challenger Core develops and maintains the shared technology, methods, and risk and quality guardrails that support this work. Each team contributes reusable tools and practices, helping make the next service faster and less costly to build. **Your key responsibilities** * **Choose the right execution model.** Design agent architectures that use deterministic steps, a single\-agent loop, or coordinated agents only when measured performance justifies the complexity. * **Build dependable tools.** Create connectors and interfaces with clear contracts, validated outcomes, narrow authorization, and errors that help the agent recover or escalate. * **Engineer agent behavior.** Shape planning, routing, delegation, stopping, retry, and handoff behavior across complete workflows. * **Create durable context.** Combine instructions, user state, retrieval, memory, and environment feedback while preserving relevance, provenance, freshness, and permitted access. * **Bound agent authority.** Implement scoped identities, credentials, budgets, approval points, and emergency containment so agents act within explicit limits. * **Evaluate complete trajectories.** Build representative tests that measure verified task success, tool use, recovery, human takeover, and prohibited actions rather than isolated responses. * **Operate long\-running execution.** Use durable state, checkpointing, safe retries, versioned releases, rollback, and graceful degradation to keep work recoverable. * **Make behavior observable.** Instrument end\-to\-end traces and replay so teams can understand failures, diagnose patterns, and turn production evidence into improvements. * **Protect user control.** Design clear intervention points so people can inspect, interrupt, redirect, and safely resume agent work. * **Build shared capability.** Partner across product, platform, knowledge, security, and evaluation teams and publish reusable agent patterns and operational lessons. **Skills and attributes for success** * **Production engineering:** Strong software engineering and distributed\-systems judgment, with practical experience building services that remain dependable under failure. * **Agent architecture:** Ability to reason about planning, tools, state, handoffs, and coordination while choosing a simpler workflow when it performs better. * **AI application depth:** Practical knowledge of model APIs, structured outputs, context, retrieval, memory, experimentation, and tool use. * **Evaluation discipline:** Experience measuring complete trajectories and verified outcomes for systems whose behavior is variable. * **Security and operability:** Strong instincts for least privilege, tool boundaries, observability, resilience, recovery, and accountable human intervention. * **Product judgment:** Ability to balance quality, latency, cost, and user control and explain technical trade\-offs clearly across disciplines. **To qualify you must have** * Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant field of study. * **Relevant experience:** 7\-9 years of experience in software or applied machine\-learning engineering, with ownership of production systems and their live behavior. * **Agent delivery:** Hands\-on evidence of shipping large\-language\-model applications, agents, or complex model\-driven workflows used for real work. * **Programming depth:** Strong capability in Python, TypeSc ontrol. * **Ecosystem contribution:** Practical contributions to agent, evaluation, developer tooling, applied AI, or open\-source communities We welcome exceptional candidates from product, service design, operations, transformation, policy, domain, and entrepreneurial backgrounds; no particular degree or certification is required. **What we offer you** At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers. * We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job is: * + New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $150,700 to $251,200 + Bay Area California offices – $157,100 to $261,600 + All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $125,500 to $230,200 * Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options. * Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well\-being. **Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.** * To make the most of your application experience, please limit yourself to two applications within a six\-month period. * EY accepts applications for this position on an on\-going basis. * For those living in California, please click here for additional information. * At EY, our values set the foundation for how we work and the behaviors we expect of our people. Any misrepresentation or falsification of information or lack of integrity at any point in the recruiting process may result in withdrawal of your candidacy, revocation of an offer or immediate termination of employment. **EY \| Building a better working world** EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets. Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow. EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories. All in to shape the future with confidence. EY provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, genetic information, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other legally protected basis, including arrest and conviction records, in accordance with applicable law. EY is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities including veterans with disabilities. If you have a disability and either need assistance applying online or need to request an accommodation during any part of the application process, please call 1\-800\-EY\-HELP3, select Option 2 for candidate related inquiries, then select Option 1 for candidate queries and finally select Option 2 for candidates with an inquiry which will route you to EY’s Talent Shared Services Team (TSS) or email the TSS at ssc.customersupport@ey.com.

jobs.title: Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description: Every meter read, work order, and utility bill in the Vail Valley runs on data. We are looking for a **Data Platform Engineer** to join our Digital Intelligence \& Automation team and own the databases, pipelines, and integrations behind our Microsoft and Azure data platform. It’s an exciting time to join: the District is replacing its customer information system (CIS), finance system, and other core platforms, and this role will be the data lead on those migrations. This role is a fit for a hands\-on engineer who has moved data out of a legacy system into a new one, knows what can go wrong, and builds pipelines that others can understand and support. Why work for us? The data you move supports reliable water and wastewater service and accurate billing for our community. Not to mention our excellent health benefits, housing program, and ample opportunities for training and development. **Day to Day:** * **DATA PIPELINES:** Design, build, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines on SQL Server, SSIS, and Azure Data Factory that feed the District’s central data environment. Build the schemas, views, stored procedures, and incremental extract patterns that keep large datasets current without full reloads. Monitor load jobs, troubleshoot failures to root cause, and set up alerting, data quality checks, and documentation so problems are caught before users notice and others can support the pipelines. * **INTEGRATIONS:** Engineer and maintain data interfaces between our CIS and vendors such as payment processing, meter data management, and bank file exchange, including file formats, schedules, validation, and exception handling. Build and support connections among the CIS, Cityworks, Esri ArcGIS, operational historian data, and financial systems. Evaluate API, file, and database options with vendors, recommend the durable approach, and design integrations that limit exposure of customer data. * **SYSTEM REPLACEMENTS:** Serve as data lead on upcoming replacements, starting with CIS and finance. Profile source data, define mappings, build and run conversion pipelines, and reconcile results. Build the staging environments and validation reporting that prove a migration before go\-live, support cutover, and rebuild downstream pipelines as source systems change. * **PLATFORM OPERATIONS:** Automate data tasks with Python, PowerShell, and Power Automate, and manage pipeline code and database objects in GitLab under the team’s change practices. Administer the Azure data services the platform runs on. Deliver curated, well\-documented datasets to the analytics team: you own the pipelines, and they own the semantic models and reports. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related technical field, or two (2\) additional years of relevant professional experience. * Five (5\) or more years building and operating production data pipelines (seven (7\) years without a degree), including T\-SQL and SQL Server database design and performance tuning, SSIS and/or Azure Data Factory, Python (pandas or similar), and Azure data services. * Hands\-on system\-to\-system integration experience (file exchange, APIs, or database\-to\-database) * At least one major system replacement or data migration, including profiling, mapping, conversion, and reconciliation * Git\-based version control * Ability to document and explain technical trade\-offs clearly. **Preferred Qualifications** * Utility, municipal, or public\-sector experience, especially with a customer information or billing system, Cityworks, or Esri ArcGIS. * Experience with SCADA historian data (iHistorian or similar) or AMI meter data. * PowerShell, Power BI semantic models, and CI/CD for data pipelines. * PowerShell scripting. * Power BI and an understanding of how semantic models consume data. * SSAS Tabular, data lake, or other Microsoft data platform experience beyond SQL Server and Data Factory. * CI/CD for data pipelines or database projects. **The Schedule** This role can be entirely remote but should be able to come to our Eagle County, CO office locations occasionally for team events, training and development, and meetings. **Pay Range** The overall pay range for this role is $108,804\.80 to $163,196\.80\. The starting range depends on qualifications but generally falls within the minimum and midpoint of the pay range. **Benefits** At ERWSD, we value life\-work balance and are leaders in the industry with our holistic benefits package, which includes but is not limited to: * Comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage * Employee housing or $559 monthly housing stipend * Wellness program * Retirement savings plans (414h and 457\) \- *We are a social security exempt organization* * 13\.5 Paid Holidays * Paid Time Off (PTO) * Paid Parental Leave * $800 Annual Recreation Benefit * Tuition Reimbursement * Loan programs for: Ski Passes, Electric Vehicles, and Computers * Relocation Assistance (if applicable) Click this link to learn more and view our full Benefits Guide. All District employees must submit to a pre\-employment drug screen and extensive background check including an educational verification and reference check. For a full position description including work environment and physical demands, email erwsdjobs@erwsd.org. All applicants must apply online at www.erwsd.org by November 13, 2026\. **We are an Equal Opportunity Employer** We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, genetic information or any other status protected by law or regulation. It is our intention that all qualified applicants be given equal opportunity and that selection decisions are based on job\-related factors.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: Join EarthOptics as a Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack)! At EarthOptics, we are combining cutting\-edge genomic analysis, data science, microbiology, and remote sensing to revolutionize agriculture. We are creating a future where traditional sampling methods are obsolete. Our mission is to be the leading soil information company, delivering maps that growers, farmers, ranchers, and other stakeholders use to cost\-effectively increase yields, improve soil health and the climate and feed the growing world through all things soil. We are a growing company with a passion for soil health, innovative technologies, and supporting all within the food value chain. We currently have \~100 individuals spread across 20 states and 2 countries, and they come from all walks of life, industries, and experiences. We are deeply focused on building the future of AgTech and sustainability and helping the world *see soil differently.* Our **Senior Software Engineer** will join our **Software Engineering** team to impact our mission through individual contributor responsibilities to design, build and maintain the technology that powers EarthOptics’ products and operations. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role requiring strong full\-stack engineering capabilities, experience with modern cloud infrastructure, and the ability to independently own complex software systems. You'll work across frontend applications, backend services, APIs, and cloud infrastructure while helping shape technical decisions and improve engineering practices. **The digs:** * **Job Type:** Full\-time, salaried, exempt (not eligible for overtime) * **Work Location:** This remote position is open to candidates authorized to work in the United States who reside in the contiguous 48 states, with a preference for those who can consistently align their working hours with US Central Time. * **Travel:** 5% of the time * **Target Start Date:** December 2026 * **Application Deadline:** Applications will be accepted through November 30, 2026\. * **Compensation:** $125,000 to $165,000 annual base salary, plus eligibility for our bonus program and an equity option grant (see below). + - This range covers all US locations where this remote role can be performed. Your offer will reflect the pay zone for your location and your job\-related skills and experience, assessed consistently for every candidate. We do not ask about current or past pay. **What you’ll cultivate as a** **Senior Software Engineer****:** *(Your responsibilities)* * Own the end\-to\-end design, development, deployment, and maintenance of full\-stack applications, spanning user interfaces, backend services, APIs, and data integrations. * Design, build, and maintain scalable, reliable cloud\-based systems, including infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, observability, security, and production operations. * Take technical ownership of existing applications and services, developing a deep understanding of their architecture, identifying risks, addressing technical debt, and improving long\-term maintainability. * Provide hands\-on technical leadership through architectural decisions, code reviews, mentorship, and close collaboration with Product and other engineering teams. * Evaluate, develop, and integrate AI\-powered solutions across engineering workflows, internal applications, and customer\-facing products, identifying opportunities to improve productivity and deliver new capabilities while maintaining strong standards for security, correctness, and maintainability. * Collaborate directly with internal stakeholders and external customers to understand their needs, translate requirements into effective technical solutions, and support the successful delivery and adoption of software capabilities. **What you can expect to accomplish within your first 60\-120 days** * **System Ownership \& Knowledge Transfer:** Develop a strong understanding of EarthOptics' applications, architecture, and cloud infrastructure. Successfully transition ownership of critical systems and identify key technical risks. * **Full\-Stack Feature Delivery:** Independently design, implement, and deploy a meaningful full\-stack feature or enhancement, demonstrating proficiency across frontend, backend, and cloud services. * **Technical Debt \& Reliability:** Identify and begin addressing high\-priority technical debt, performance bottlenecks, or reliability issues, with actionable recommendations for improving system maintainability. * **AI\-Assisted Engineering:** Evaluate AI development tools, demonstrate practical applications, and recommend approaches that improve engineering productivity without compromising quality. **Are you our soil\-mate? You’ll bloom in this role if you have experience in:** *(Your qualifications)* * 7\+ years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated experience building and maintaining production software. * Strong full\-stack engineering experience, including mode g, and maintaining applications using modern cloud infrastructure, including cloud\-native architecture, deployment automation, and production operations. * Proficiency with modern frontend and backend programming languages, with the ability to quickly learn and contribute to new technologies. * Experience designing and working with relational databases, SQL, REST APIs, and common application integration patterns. * Practical experience with infrastructure\-as\-code tools, containerization, and modern deployment technologies such as Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, or equivalent solutions. * Strong engineering practices, including automated testing, code reviews, observability, secure software development, debugging, and production incident response. * Experience making architectural decisions, independently owning complex systems, and helping other engineers improve through technical guidance and mentorship. * Familiarity with AI\-assisted software development tools and the ability to use them effectively while critically evaluating generated code for accuracy, security, and maintainability. * Strong problem\-solving and communication skills, with experience collaborating across engineering, product, and other business functions. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. *\*\*We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we are not able to sponsor or transfer visas at this time.* **Although not required, we’d love to see roots in:** * Production experience with **Python and TypeScript**, ideally including frameworks such as FastAPI, React, or similar technologies. * Experience developing geospatial or data\-intensive applications, including GIS, spatial databases such as PostGIS, mapping technologies, or large\-scale scientific data pipelines. * Experience integrating AI/ML capabilities, large language models, or agentic workflows into production software applications. * Experience thriving in a small, fast\-moving engineering team where individuals take broad ownership, adapt to changing priorities, and work closely with stakeholders to solve technical and business challenges. **Aside from “the green”, we can offer you:** * Medical, Dental \& Vision Insurance \- 90% funded by EarthOptics for benefit\-eligible employees and 55% for dependents * Company\-paid LTD, STD, and Life Insurance * Meaningful equity option grants * 401k Plan \+ Employer Match up to 4% * Tenured PTO Accrual Policy starting with 17 days of paid time off per year, * 11 Paid Company Holidays **Equal Opportunity and Inclusion at EarthOptics:** EarthOptics is an equal opportunity employer, and we stand against any form of discrimination or harassment. We base all hiring and promotion decisions on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, marital or family status, physical or mental disability, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We are deeply committed to welcoming and including every qualified individual. As part of this commitment, we provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities, for pregnancy, childbirth, and related conditions, and for sincerely held religious beliefs. If you require assistance during the job application or interview process, need support to perform essential job functions, or seek other benefits and privileges of employment, please reach out to us at accommodations@earthoptics.com. We will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records for employment in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state, and local fair chance laws.

solutions for intricate imaging, data acquisition, and analysis challenges. * Oversee end\-to\-end optical engineering projects, from initial ideation and design to prototyping, testing, and validation. * Foster seamless collaboration across cross\-functional teams, including software, data analysis, biology, chemistry, and other disciplines, to integrate optical systems into jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior Full Stack Engineer** **Era Supports · Engineering** Full\-time · Individual contributor · *\[Remote — TBC]* *Own the platform that decides which patient in recovery gets a call today, helps shape what is said to them, and makes sure the clinic gets paid for making it.* **About Era Supports** Era Supports exists to change how people recover from substance use disorder. We deliver evidence\-based collaborative care inside community health centers, embedding behavioral health care managers alongside primary care teams so that physical, emotional and social needs are treated together rather than in separate silos. The software is not a side project — it *is* the operating model. Our platform runs the clinical registry, the daily patient outreach engine, assessment scoring and acuity tiering, the billing pipeline for collaborative care, and the integrations with our partners' electronic health records. When a care manager knows who to reach today, or a health center gets reimbursed correctly for collaborative care minutes, that is our code doing its job. **The role** You would be our senior engineer, and you would be building. **This is deliberately an individual contributor role.** The platform is currently maintained by a very small team, and what we need first is someone who ships — who can own significant parts of the system end to end, from schema design through to the deploy and whatever happens afterwards. As the team grows you would have the first claim on shaping how we hire and how we work, if that is something you want. But that is later. Today the job is to build. The surface area is wide and we are not going to pretend otherwise: a NestJS backend with a domain\-driven core, three React applications, a Python scheduling service, an SFTP\-based ETL pipeline, a GraphQL integration with an external EHR, and a growing body of AI\-assisted clinical tooling. You will not be handed a narrow slice of this. **What you would actually work on** Not hypotheticals — these are live on the roadmap right now. * **AI inside the clinical workflow.** Help develop responsible AI used in a clinical setting using evaluation, guardrails, human review, and real limits on what data may inform a model. These are some of the most consequential engineering projects we have. * **Multi\-region architecture.** Improving our systems and care platform to have full support for partners and billing in multiple regions. * **Deeper EHR interoperability.** We integrate with EHRs via API today. Partners increasingly want ADT feeds, FHIR endpoints and health information exchange connectivity. This is protocol work with immediate clinical consequences. * **The outreach engine.** A Python service scores every enrolled patient daily against a set of clinical rules to decide who the care team should contact and in what order. Extending and tuning that logic is one of the most direct levers we have on patient outcomes. * **Billing correctness.** Collaborative care, behavioral health integration and chronic care management billing all depend on cumulative time tracking, documentation state and payer\-specific rules. Mistakes here are expensive and slow to surface. * **Hardening what we have.** We are a small team that has moved quickly, and it shows in places — test coverage, authorization edge cases, observability. You would have a mandate to fix that, not merely permission. **Our stack** **Backend** TypeScript and NestJS, domain\-driven design with CQRS and an event bus, PostgreSQL, Redis and BullMQ for queues and scheduled work **Frontend** React 18, TypeScript, MUI, Zustand, SCSS **Services** Python 3\.12 and FastAPI, running on AWS Lambda **AI / ML** LLM\-backed clinical tooling — patient messaging, risk stratification and population health focused **Integrations** Multiple EHRs via API and HL7 standard interfaces, Auth0 for identity, SFTP\-based ETL for partner data, Metabase for analytics **Infrastructure** Docker, AWS, Aptible, GitHub Actions, Sentry You do not need to have used all of this. You do need to be genuinely fluent in TypeScript on both sides of the wire, and untroubled by picking up the rest. **What we are looking for** * **Substantial production experience** building and running web applications, with real depth in TypeScript, Node and React — not a passing familiarity with each. * **Genuine end\-to\-end ownership.** You have designed the schema, written the API, built the interface, and then debugged the whole thing in production when it mattered. * **Judgement about pace.** Knowing when to build carefully and when to build fast, and the honesty to say out loud which one you just did. * **Early\-stage temperament.** You have worked somewhere without a platform team, a QA team or a dedicated SRE, and you treated that as the conditions rather than a grievance. * **You have shipped AI features, not just tried them.** You have taken LLM\-backed functionality to production and dealt with what that actually involves: evaluation, failure modes, guardrails, cost, latency, and a clear view of where a human has to stay in the loop. This matters to us considerably more than model\-training experience. * **Care about correctness where it counts.** Some of our bugs are cosmetic. Some of them mean a patient in recovery does not get a phone call, or that a generated message reaches someone it should never have reached. Knowing the difference is most of the job. **Valuable, but not required** * Healthcare experience — particularly behavioral health, collaborative care, or revenue cycle * Deeper ML or data science background: predictive modelling, feature engineering, or working with claims and clinical data at population scale * Exposure to value\-based care, risk contracts, or population health analytics * Healthcare data standards: FHIR, HL7v2, ADT, X12 * Working knowledge of HIPAA and 42 CFR Part 2 in practice rather than in principle * Python, for the scheduling service **What this role is not** * **Not a management role, for now.** This role is not responsible for managing a team, there may be opportunities to take on team management as we grow. * **Not greenfield.** You would be working in a real codebase with real history, some of it considered and some of it the product of a startup moving fast. * **Not ticket\-taking.** You will play a role in defining the technical implementation and system architecture based upon product specifications in requirements docs and tickets. **How we work** Small team, direct communication, and a short path from problem to production. We work with clinicians every day, which means feedback arrives fast and specific — you will hear about it when a workflow does not fit the way care actually happens. We take privacy and security seriously because we hold some of the most sensitive health data there is. Substance use records carry protections beyond HIPAA under 42 CFR Part 2, and that genuinely shapes how we design systems rather than being a compliance box at the end. It also makes applying AI here harder, and a good deal more interesting, than in most domains. What data may inform a model, what a model may be permitted to draft to a patient, and who signs off before it is sent are design inputs from the first line of code — not questions to answer after the demo works. **What we offer** * Meaningful equity and competitive cash compensation * Ownership of the technical direction of a platform that measurably affects whether people stay in recovery * Direct access to leadership and to the clinicians using what you build * Health, dental and vision benefits; paid time off Pay: $101,000\.00 \- $123,000\.00 per year Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: Location: Berkeley Heights, New Jersey, United States of America Job ID: R\-10404848 Category: Technology Onsite Posting Start Date: Posting Start Date: 22\-October\-2026 Posting End Date: Posting End Date: 04\-December\-2026 **Calling all innovators \- find your future at Fiserv.** We're Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants and consumers to one another millions of times a day \- quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we're involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv. **Job Title** Senior Software Engineer**About your role:** At Fiserv, we are dedicated to transforming financial services technology to benefit our clients. As a Senior Software Engineer you will play a critical role in designing, developing, and maintaining high\-quality software applications. You will work with cross\-functional teams to deliver solutions that align with our business goals and client needs. You will design, build, and support highly scalable distributed applications and event\-driven systems. You will ideally have strong hands\-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, AWS, Apache Kafka/Amazon MSK, MySQL, microservices, APIs, and system design. This role requires someone who can understand complex business requirements, translate them into scalable technical designs, and take ownership of solutions from design through production. **What you'll do:** * Design, develop, and maintain highly scalable Java and Spring Boot applications and microservices. * Design and implement distributed and event\-driven architectures using Apache Kafka and Amazon MSK. * Build reliable asynchronous workflows, event producers/consumers, and service\-to\-service integrations. * Design robust REST APIs and integration services for enterprise applications. * Participate in system design and architecture discussions, including scalability, availability, resiliency, fault tolerance, and performance. * Develop and support cloud\-native solutions using AWS services. * Design and optimize data access using MySQL, including queries, indexes, transactions, and overall database performance. * Troubleshoot complex issues across applications, APIs, databases, messaging platforms, and distributed systems. * Implement appropriate error handling, retry mechanisms, monitoring, logging, and operational resiliency. * Conduct code reviews and promote strong engineering practices around code quality, testing, security, and maintainability. * Collaborate with product, architecture, QA, DevOps, and other engineering teams throughout the software development lifecycle. * Provide technical guidance and mentorship to other engineers. * Take ownership of applications and services from design and development through deployment and production support. **Experience you'll need to have:** * 8\+ years of professional software development experience. * Strong hands\-on development experience with Java. * Strong experience with Spring Boot and microservices architecture. * Strong understanding of distributed systems and event\-driven architecture. * Hands\-on experience with Apache Kafka and/or Amazon MSK. * Strong experience with AWS and cloud\-native application development. * Strong experience with MySQL or similar relational databases. * Strong understanding of system design, including scalability, high availability, resiliency, performance, and fault tolerance. * Experience designing and integrating RESTful APIs and backend services. * Solid understanding of concurrency, asynchronous processing, caching, messaging, and distributed application patterns. * Experience troubleshooting and supporting applications in production environments. * Strong understanding of software engineering best practices, including automated testing, code reviews, CI/CD, observability, and secure development. * Strong communication, analytical, and problem\-solving skills. * Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related field (or foreign equivalent degree) or equivalent work experience **Experience that would be great to have:** * Experience in the financial services industry * Experience working with CRM platforms or CRM\-integrated applications is preferred **Important information about this role:** * You must currently possess valid and unrestricted U.S. work authorization to be considered for this role. Individuals with temporary visas including, but not limited to, F\-1 (OPT, CPT, STEM), H\-1B, H\-2, or TN, or any candidate requiring sponsorship, now or in the future, will not be considered for this role * This is a full\-time, direct\-hire position, and no contract options for unsolicited agency submissions will be considered * All offers of employment are contingent on standard background checks. jobs.title: IT Systems Technician
jobs.description: The IT Systems Technician is the second\-level technical resource for IT at our operating mine and works alongside the IT Systems Engineer. You will resolve support issues, maintain site network, server and end user systems, and provide backup coverage for the IT Systems Engineer, keeping a 24/7 operation productive and secure. You will also help deploy and administer new IT tools, such as ticketing and asset management, as they are introduced, and take part in site infrastructure improvement projects such as network upgrades. This is a hands\-on role for someone who enjoys solving technical problems and providing excellent customer service in a mining environment. RESPONSIBILITIES: The key responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to the following: * Resolve hardware, software, network and account issues * Provide end user support in person, by phone, email, chat and remote session * Log, prioritize, track and close requests and incidents, and keep users informed of progress * Support Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint) and line\-of\-business applications * Escalate issues beyond the role’s scope to the IT Systems Engineer or the appropriate vendor or IT service partner, with complete documentation * Administer and maintain Windows servers, Active Directory, Microsoft 365 and endpoint management tools * Configure, monitor and troubleshoot network equipment, including switches, wireless access points, firewalls and VPN connections * Perform scheduled maintenance, patching and backup checks, following approved change procedures * Assist with network cabling, fibre and site infrastructure projects * Provide backup coverage for the IT Systems Engineer during absences, including on\-call duties * Create, modify and disable user accounts, and assign security group and license permissions, following approved request and approval procedures * Image, configure, deploy and retire computers, mobile devices and peripherals * Write and maintain technical documentation, procedures and how\-to guides * Follow cybersecurity policies, report suspicious activity or phishing and support security improvements * Train users on tools and IT best practices * Participate in the on\-call rotation and perform other duties as assigned QUALIFICATIONS: * High school diploma or GED required; associate or bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, or a related field, **preferred.** * 4\+ years of IT support or systems administration experience (or an equivalent combination of education and experience), **required**. * Strong working knowledge of Windows 10/11, Windows Server, Microsoft 365 and Active Directory, **required**. * Working knowledge of networking: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, Wi\-Fi and VPN, including managed switches, **required**. * Experience resolving escalated technical issues independently, **required**. * Experience with a ticketing / ITSM system (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, Freshservice), **required**. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues to non\-technical users, **required**. * Valid Nevada driver’s license **required**. * CompTIA A\+, Network\+ or Security\+; Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator or Modern Desktop Administrator Associate, **preferred**. * Experience with Intune / Endpoint Manager, SCCM or other device management tools, **preferred**. * Experience setting up or administering a ticketing or asset management tool, **preferred**. * Scripting or automation experience (e.g., PowerShell), **preferred**. * ITIL 4 Foundation certification or familiarity with ITIL practices, **preferred**. * Experience supporting mining, industrial, manufacturing or other 24/7 operations, **preferred**. * Familiarity with VoIP phones, two\-way radios, CCTV or access control systems, **preferred**. * Ability to work a Monday–Thursday 4x10 schedule with occasional early morning, evening, or weekend flexibility; lift up to 50 pounds; stand, walk, bend, kneel and climb ladders or stairs; and wear required PPE for work area, **required.** Florida Canyon is an equal opportunity employer, values diversity in its workforce, and encourages applications from qualified candidates. Wherever possible, accommodations are made for qualified applicants with self\-declared disabilities.

jobs.title: Validation Engineer
jobs.description: Description: Since 1948, Follett Products, LLC, has led the industry in designing and manufacturing high\-quality, innovative ice storage bins, ice storage and transport systems, ice machines, ice and water dispensers, ice and beverage dispensers, and medical\-grade refrigerators and freezers for the food service and healthcare industries. Follett currently has an opportunity for a **Validation Engineer** to join our team! Follett’s robust benefits package includes medical, dental, and vision insurance; paid time off; paid holidays; retirement plan with company match, bonus opportunity, and much more. The Validation Engineer establishes and sustains technical standards for defining products and verifying that product designs and manufacturing processes meet these requirements. This is a senior individual contributor role that leads through technical authority, methodology ownership, and coaching rather than through direct supervision. The position works cross\-functionally, partnering with the Product Design, Industrial Engineering, and Technical Service teams to define methods for establishing product requirements, developing and qualifying test methods, and validating manufacturing equipment and processes. This role also involves warranty data analysis, using the results to improve product requirements planning and test methods. **Essential Functions:** **Requirements Definition \& Design Verification** -------------------------------------------------- * Develop methods to establish clear, comprehensive, and measurable product requirements. * Define and maintain the Design Verification Plan \& Report (DVP\&R) standard to document traceability of requirements to evidence. * Champion, partner, and collaborate with Product Design and Industrial engineers in authoring program\-level DVP\&Rs. Review and approve plans for high\-risk programs. * Proactively define verification and validation exit criteria for product development stage gates. **Test Method Development \& Qualification** -------------------------------------------- * Develop and maintain a test method library containing cross\-functional contributions. * Develop new test methods where no qualified method exists. Consider instrumentation strategy, fixture requirements, environmental chamber profiles, data acquisition approach, and measurement uncertainty. * Partner with the Product Design team, which manages laboratory and environmental chamber facilities, to schedule and prioritize validation activity. **Process \& Equipment Validation** ----------------------------------- * Define standards for installation, operational, and performance qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ) of manufacturing equipment and processes. * Provide protocols, templates, and technical review for validation activities executed by Industrial Engineering. Establish criteria and triggers for requalification following process, tooling, supplier, or location changes. * Establish and govern the measurement systems analysis (MSA) standard including gage repeatability and reproducibility, bias, and linearity. Place particular emphasis on leak test and functional test systems where the measurement system constitutes the acceptance decision. * Set the statistical standard for process capability studies and sampling plans. Ensure validation results are reflected in control plans owned by Industrial Engineering. * Apply design of experiments (DOE) to optimize product and process performance. **Reliability \& Warranty Analysis Support** -------------------------------------------- * Support the cross\-functional warranty team with reliability analysis of field data. Use tools such as Weibull analysis to evaluate product lifespans, predict equipment failures, and optimize maintenance schedules. * Develop test plans that reproduce field failure modes in a laboratory environment and establish correlation between accelerated laboratory testing and observed field life. * Design accelerated life tests appropriate to refrigeration systems product portfolios, including compressor and control cycling, door and hardware cycle life, joint thermal fatigue, corrosion and condensation exposure, and cleaning chemical compatibility. * Contribute technical analysis and experimental design to structured problem\-solving efforts such as CAPA and 8D investigations, which are facilitated by the Quality function. * Ensure that recurring and high\-cost field failure modes result in a documented change to the product requirements, the test method library, or the process validation standard. **Capability Building** ----------------------- * Train and mentor engineers across Product Design, Industrial Engineering, and Quality in requirements definition, validation planning, applied statistics, and reliability methods. * Develop and maintain templates, work instructions, and the validation and verification elements of the Quality Management System. Requirements:**Education \& Experience** --------------------------- * Bach e in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. Advanced degree preferred. * Minimum of ten (10\) years of progressive engineering experience in product verification and validation, reliability engineering, test engineering, or advanced quality engineering within a design and manufacturing environment. * Demonstrated hands\-on ownership of design verification plans and process validation protocols. Experience must reflect direct technical execution, not solely oversight of a validation team. * Experience in commercial food service equipment, appliance, HVAC/R, automotive, or a comparable industry involving thermal, refrigeration, or electromechanical systems is strongly preferred. **Technical Knowledge \& Skills** --------------------------------- * Design Verification Plan \& Report (DVP\&R) * Product Development Stage Gate Process * Equipment and Process Validation Protocols * Physics of Failure Modes (e.g., thermal and mechanical fatigue, electrical and control failure, refrigeration system degradation) * Applied Statistics Tools (e.g., design of experiments, sample size determination, hypothesis testing, process capability analysis, measurement systems analysis) * Reliability Engineering Tools (e.g., Weibull and life data analysis, B10/L10 life estimation, accelerated life test design) * Statistical and Reliability Analysis Software (e.g., Minitab, JMP, Weibull\+\+, MATLAB) * Standards and Compliance (e.g., UL, NSF) **Professional Competencies** ----------------------------- * Ability to establish credibility and drive adoption of technical standards across departments without formal authority. * Effective teaching and coaching skills, with a demonstrated record of raising the technical capability of peers outside the direct reporting structure. * Clear technical writing, with the ability to produce protocols, reports, and standards that withstand internal and third\-party scrutiny. * Sound judgment in balancing process discipline with program schedule and business risk. * Ability to protect long\-term process development projects against the pull of urgent reactive demands. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office products. * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. * Self\-motivated with excellent organizational and time management skills. * Detail\-oriented with excellent critical thinking and problem\-solving skills. **Working Conditions/Physical Requirements:** * Regular presence on the manufacturing floor. Compliance with all personal protective equipment requirements is mandatory. * Regular work in laboratory environments, including environmental chambers. * Extended periods of computer\-based work including data analysis, technical writing, and documentation review. * Frequent standing, walking, bending, kneeling, and reaching while conducting equipment observation, test setup, instrumentation, and failure analysis. * Ability to lift and carry up to 40 pounds occasionally. * Visual acuity sufficient to read instrumentation, inspect components and joints, and evaluate detailed technical documentation. * Occasional work outside standard business hours to support extended\-duration testing, production trials, and time\-sensitive investigations. **Travel Requirements:** * Travel is estimated at 10\-20% annually. * Travel between Follett business locations. * Travel to attend meetings or training outside the company as requested. * Supplier facility visits to support purchased part qualification, process validation, and supplier\-based failure investigation. * Customer and field site visits to support investigation of significant or recurring warranty failure modes. If you meet the position’s qualifications and are looking for an exciting and challenging career with growth opportunities, then Follett is the place for you. Follett Products, LLC is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EOE/M/F/Vets/Disabled) employer and welcomes all qualified applicants.

jobs.title: Staff AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description: Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost\-effective, multi\-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form! In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by *TIME* as a “Best Invention”, *MIT Technology Review* as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and *Fast Company* as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron\-air batteries is underway at our first high\-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia. Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now \- right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing \- might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better. **Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading \- you’ve come to the right place.** **Role Description** -------------------- Form Energy is hiring a Staff AI Platform Engineer to build the shared platform that lets people across the company build and run AI\-powered tools safely and quickly. As a hands\-on senior individual contributor, you will help design the application runtime, knowledge systems, agent infrastructure, and governance tooling that teams would otherwise build separately, and you will help set the patterns other engineers follow. Your work spans product R\&D, design, manufacturing process engineering, product costing, and root cause analysis. It draws on data from our battery test stands, factory manufacturing robots, and deployed projects in the field, along with the documents, slide decks, transcripts, and conversations our teams produce every day. You will sit on the AI \& Data Platform team, working with data engineers, software engineers, Information Security, and the scientists, engineers, and operators who use what you build. This is an exciting opportunity to shape how a fast\-moving company with breakthrough technology and an incredible mission puts AI to work. *This is a hybrid role, which will require working onsite from our office in Berkeley, CA, Somerville, MA or Weirton, WV 3\+ days per week.* *Relocation assistance is available.* ### **What you'll do:** * Build and operate the internal application platform that lets employees create and deploy AI\-generated applications on curated backend and frontend frameworks, with starter templates, design guidance, authentication, and secure deployment built in, so app authors own only business logic, user flows, and UI. * Give those applications governed access to data, including connectivity to our data warehouse and a shared Postgres cluster for application state that is automatically integrated into our data platform. * Build and operate a central knowledge platform over unstructured content (documents, slide decks, meeting transcripts, Slack) and structured data from battery test stands, manufacturing robots, and deployed systems, pairing document retrieval with query access to structured data through semantic models and text\-to\-SQL. Own its retrieval quality through semantic and hybrid search, re\-ranking, chunking, and classification, with source\-level permissions and evaluation sets that show whether a change helps. * Design and deploy the shared MCP infrastructure, including a gateway layer (such as agentgateway) for authentication, authorization, rate limiting, and audit logging, and build MCP servers for applications and services across the software org and for selected external tools. * Own model selection and cost: evaluate open\-source and open\-weight models against frontier models on our own tasks, decide where each fits, and reduce token usage through context management, caching, and model routing. * Build the agent orchestration layer, including multi\-agent workflows and long\-running loops with checkpoints, human review gates, and automated evaluation. Work with data engineers to decide when work should run as a deterministic, scheduled workflow and when it needs a graph or state machine in which an agent chooses among bounded steps. * Partner with product R\&D, battery design, manufacturing process engineering, product costing, and root cause analysis teams to find repeatable work and automate it, including nd up the AWS infrastructure and infrastructure\-as\-code (Pulumi and/or Terraform) it runs on. * Help stand up a company\-wide skills and plugin marketplace that vets contributions against AI policy and scans them for security vulnerabilities with open\-source and commercial tools. Advise on AI governance, recommending changes that make the policy specific to platform needs and automating its execution, such as approvals for new tools. * Raise the engineering bar through design docs and RFCs, code review, mentorship, and technical influence that reaches beyond the immediate team. ### **What you'll bring:** * *Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, computer engineering, or a related field plus 7\+ years of software or data engineering experience, including building and operating production platforms or services that other engineers depend on.* * *Strong production programming in Python and Go, with experience building APIs and backend services.* * *Hands\-on experience building LLM\-powered systems in production, including retrieval\-augmented generation, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, re\-ranking, and structured\-data access through text\-to\-SQL or semantic layers.* * *Experience with agent frameworks, tool calling, and the Model Context Protocol, and with workflow orchestration or state\-machine frameworks such as LangGraph, Temporal, or Dagster.* * *Experience building evaluation sets and harnesses for LLM systems and measuring quality, latency, and cost across model providers, including open\-weight models.* * *Experience with PostgreSQL and a cloud data warehouse, plus AWS, containers, CI/CD, and infrastructure\-as\-code with Pulumi and/or Terraform.* * *Working knowledge of platform and AI security: authentication and authorization (OAuth/OIDC), secrets management, sandboxed execution, tenant isolation, supply\-chain scanning, and risks specific to LLM tools such as prompt injection and data exfiltration.* * *A track record of building internal platforms that other teams adopt, and of independently leading the design of novel solutions through technical design docs and RFCs.* * *Excellent communication and organizational skills, including with scientists, engineers, and operators who aren't software developers, and comfort participating in an on\-call rotation.* * ***Nice to have:*** *React and design\-system experience; Snowflake or Databricks; serving open\-weight models (for example with vLLM); API or AI gateway experience; AI governance or compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001\); background in battery, energy, manufacturing, or other physical\-systems data.* *\#LI\-Hybrid* *Humanity is a cornerstone of Form Energy’s culture, and we make sure our compensation and benefits reflect that. Form Energy offers competitive salaries, stock options, and a holistic benefits package to ensure all employees have what they need to thrive while working here.* *When it comes to you and your family’s health, we cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for full\-time employees \- and 80% of healthcare premiums for dependents. This starts from day one. We also offer at least 12 weeks of paid leave for new parents (up to 20 weeks for birthing parents), and generous vacation policies to give employees time to recharge when needed.* *To build America’s energy future, we need everyone at the table. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply to our open jobs.* *If you may require reasonable accommodations to participate in our interview process, please contact accommodations@formenergy.com. Requests for accommodations will be treated with discretion.* *Form Energy is committed to maintaining the privacy of our applicants. Please be aware that we will* ***never*** *solicit sensitive personal information such as Social Security numbers or bank account details during the recruiting or hiring process.* Compensation Range: $128,660 \- $184,966
