jobs.title: AI Automation Engineer
jobs.description: ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a highly motivated AI Automation Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will be the primary engineer building and maintaining our technical interview pipeline \- from the question bank to AI\-assisted scoring to full workflow automation \- working alongside the team to grow this role into a broader automation function over time. This isn't a "call an API and ship it" job: you'll be designing the systems that add/calibrate interview questions and evaluate candidate answers, which means understanding how to prompt and structure AI models for consistency, how to measure and validate output quality against ground truth, and how to catch and correct the ways these systems get things wrong. This is a role we expect to grow \- the shape of that growth is still being defined. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** Assessment Repository Management \- Add, revise, and retire technical interview questions across roles/levels/skill areas \- Maintain question metadata (difficulty, topic tags, expected answer criteria, role relevance) \- Create variant/randomized versions of questions to reduce answer\-sharing risk \- Build validation checks (automated and manual) to catch incorrect, ambiguous, or miscalibrated questions before they enter the repository \- Build automation to update problem sets and recalculate average difficulty ratings as new results come in \- Review and update questions periodically to prevent leakage/staleness and keep content aligned with actual job requirements **Scoring \& Answer Evaluation** \- Architect scoring workflows that evaluate and compare candidate answers against reference answers/rubrics, grounded in a clear methodology for what "correct" and "well\-scored" mean \- Calibrate and benchmark scoring prompts/models against human\-graded samples, measuring accuracy and identifying systematic errors or bias \- Understand and account for model failure modes (inconsistency, hallucination, prompt sensitivity) and design safeguards around them \- Flag edge cases or low\-confidence scores for human review rather than fully automating high\-stakes decisions **Process Automation** \- Automate the end\-to\-end workflow: question selection \-\> test delivery \-\> answer collection \-\> scoring \-\> reporting \- Help transition our source code and repositories to an internal Git platform \- Track test results to help establish scoring benchmarks over time **Quality \& Fairness** \- Track scoring consistency and accuracy over time; report on pipeline health \- Watch for and mitigate AI evaluation bias across candidate demographics or answer styles \- Document the process, prompts, and scoring logic for auditability **Growth \& Scope** \- Apply the same automation and AI\-integration skills developed here to other internal workflows as the role expands \- Partner with engineering teams to identify manual, repetitive processes that are good candidates for automation \- Take on additional internal tooling and infrastructure projects as capacity and scope grow **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** \- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience \- Solid programming fundamentals (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar) \- Comfort working with APIs, including LLM/AI APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) \- Demonstrated experience designing and evaluating prompts/pipelines for LLM\-based tools (not just using AI products, but building with them) \- Proficient with Git and a hosted platform (GitHub or GitLab) \- branching, PRs/MRs, code review, CI basics \- Basic understanding of databases (SQL or similar) \- Strong attention to detail and technical writing ability \- Ability to work independently on processes that are still being defined, and adapt as scope evolves **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** \- Familiarity with test/assessment platforms or ATS integrations \- Exposure to scripting automation (e.g., workflow tools, cron jobs, CI\-style pipelines) \- Interest or coursework in fairness/bias in ML systems \- Prior experience conducting or coordinating technical interviews (not required, but a plus) Fortinet offers employees a variety of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, 401(k), 11 paid holidays, vacation time, and sick time as well as a comprehensive leave program. Wage ranges are based on various factors including the labor market, job type, and job level. Earnings for this position are expected to be $110,000 \- $170,000Exact salary offers will be determined by factors such as the candidate's subject knowledge, skill level, qualifications, experience, and geographic location. All roles are eligible to participate in the Fortinet equity program, Bonus eligibility is reviewed at time of hire and annually at the Company’s discretion

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: **A NOTE ON HOW TO REACH US** We're truly grateful that so many people have Foundant on their radar — it means a lot that our work resonates with others. That said, due to the high volume of direct messages and emails we receive, cold outreach isn't the preferred way to be considered for a role, and we're not able to prioritize applications submitted this way. To apply for open positions, please visit our careers page, which is the fastest and most effective route to being considered. #### **About Foundant** At Foundant, we build mission\-critical software for the social good ecosystem — helping foundations, grantmakers, nonprofits, and community organizations streamline their work, strengthen relationships, and maximize their impact. We serve the giving community worldwide with a comprehensive suite of solutions spanning grant management, community foundation software, and giving analytics. We're a unified company shaped by strong roots across our product portfolio, and we operate with intention and purpose. Our team of \~350 people across six countries is connected by a shared North Star: to be the trusted partner and strategic advisor to the communities we serve. #### **Where You’ll Work:** * As a remote\-first workplace, we believe in offering flexibility and the freedom to work where it suits you best, while staying connected through technology. Our global network of talent is supported by physical office hubs and virtual collaboration, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation and growth thrive. * With office locations in Bozeman, MT, Toronto, Canada, and Dublin, Ireland, you'll be part of a globally connected team. Whether you're working remotely or from one of our office locations, you'll be contributing to a vibrant, collaborative culture focused on driving meaningful impact across the world. ##### ***What******You’ll******Do:*** * You'll be part of Foundant’s product engineering team responsible for development activities along with their ongoing production environments care and feeding to take on their hardest technical problems, and you’ll deliver high\-quality working code — not just direction. This is a hands\-on role at every level of seniority it carries. * You'll own architectural decisions at both the application and service level, making calls that hold up under real production load and remain understandable to the engineers who inherit them. * You'll diagnose systemic and architectural issues that cross component and service boundaries, including the ambiguous ones where the cause isn't in any single team code. * You’ll see the big picture and work proactively to resolve integration issues or coordinate across team boundaries. * You’ll put AI\-assisted development and agentic tooling to work in your daily engineering, shortening the path from idea to production\-ready code and getting valuable improvements into clients’ hands sooner. * Other duties as assigned. ##### ***What******You’ll******Need:*** * 12\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant time at a principal, staff, or equivalent senior individual contributor level as a hands\-on developer. * Demonstrated mastery of architectural patterns and the judgment to know which apply in a given context, at both the application and service level. * Proven expertise in Java, Spring Boot, TypeScript, Node.js, and React, with a track record of building and shipping production software. * Extensive full\-stack development experience building scalable RESTful applications with React and Java/Spring Boot backend. * Advanced proficiency working with large scale relational database management systems (RDBMS). * Experience working with analytical systems and databases processing large volume of data. * Proficient with AI assisted development practices and tooling. * Proven experience developing cloud\-based SaaS applications; experience working with AWS is highly desirable. * Proven experience owning production services, including reliability, performance, and incident response. * Professional experience using AI\-assisted development tools in production work. Foundant uses Claude Code; deep expertise with a comparable tool is acceptable. * Extensive experience diagnosing and debugging complex technical issues across multiple components and services, including the use of debugging and profiling tools. * Must be legally eligible to work in the United States. ##### ***What******You’ll******Bring to our Team Dynamics:*** * **Adaptive Achievement:** Moves between unfamiliar codebases, domains, and problem spaces without losing momentum, and delivers high\-quality solutions under shifting priorities and incomplete context. * **Productive Collaboration:** Leads engineers through complex initiatives by influence rather than authority — entering a team as a guest, earning trust quickly, and articulating direction clearly enough that the team can carry it forward without you. * **Service Orientation:** Treats internal engineering teams as clients, and understands that the reliability of a shared service is ultimately felt by the foundations and nonprofits depending on our software to do their work. * **Business Insight:** Weighs the blast radius of shared\-service decisions across every product and client, balancing technical elegance against what actually advances the business and the communities we serve. * **Active Learning:** Builds working depth in unfamiliar stacks quickly, and applies rigorous judgment to AI\-generated code — knowing when to lean on it, when to scrutinize it, and how to help colleagues do the same. ##### ***Why You’ll Love Working at Foundant:*** * At the heart of everything we do is a commitment to innovation and making a positive impact. Whether you’re working on projects that empower not\-for\-profits, community foundations, or corporations, your contributions will help drive real\-world change. * We offer competitive salary and benefits, including tuition, and lifestyle reimbursements, and bespoke mindfulness and fitness initiatives. * With our Flexible PTO policy, you’ll have the freedom to manage your time in a way that supports your personal well\-being and professional success. * We’re committed to your professional and personal development. With our merger, you'll have the chance to collaborate across teams, giving you exposure to diverse ideas, expertise, and projects that span multiple industries. * As part of a larger organization, you’ll have even more opportunities to grow your career. Whether it’s exploring new roles, leadership opportunities, or shifting to a different department, we support internal mobility to help you achieve your career goals * You’ll enjoy autonomy and responsibility, empowering you to approach your work creatively and independently, fostering innovation and independent thought. * Employee recognition is a core part of our culture. When you do a great job, we make sure everyone knows about it! Foundant is an equal opportunity employer, committed to building a diverse workforce that represents the communities we serve. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified candidates, and will consider all applicants without regard to race, color, citizenship, religion, sex, marital/family status, sexual orientation, gender identity, Indigenous status, age, disability, or individuals who may require accommodation. Foundant is also committed to providing accommodations throughout the interview and employment process. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in all aspects of the selection process. If you have accessibility requirements during the recruitment process and require accommodation, please contact hr@smartsimple.com.

jobs.title: Associate AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Fuel Cycle**: Fuel Cycle empowers leading organizations with agile research solutions that deliver decision\-ready insights — fast, flexible, and fully integrated. As a market research disruptor, our AI\-powered Insights Platform is built for speed, precision, and scale. With cutting\-edge tools and seamless audience connectivity, we help brands ditch the guesswork and make smarter, customer\-led decisions at lightning speed. **Why work at Fuel Cycle?** Join a high\-growth team where curiosity is valued, ownership is encouraged, and your work drives real\-world impact. Whether you’re based at our Los Angeles HQ, New York City hub, working remotely across the U.S., or part of our global team in India, you’ll help shape the future of decision intelligence for some of the world’s most iconic brands. **Overview:** Build real AI agents on a production platform, with senior engineers working alongside you. You will work in Python and FastAPI, build tool\-calling agents on AWS Bedrock and AgentCore using the Strands Agents framework, and own technical decisions within the problems you take on, with your scope growing as you do. This role is fully in\-office in Los Angeles because our mentorship model depends on it: pair programming, in\-person code review, and a mentor a few desks away. We hire for fundamentals, curiosity, and initiative. This is an early\-career role. Engineers new to the field are welcome, and so are engineers with a year or two of experience who want to go deeper into AI and agentic systems. You do not need to know our stack on day one. **What You’ll Work On:** * Design, build, and improve AI agents, deciding how tool\-calling loops, model configuration, and multi\-step workflows are structured using Strands Agents and AWS Bedrock * Build and integrate MCP tools and servers, and learn how tool names and descriptions shape what an LLM does * Deploy and run agents on Bedrock AgentCore, working with the platform team and your mentor * Build RAG pipelines over pgvector or FAISS, choosing chunking, embedding, and retrieval approaches based on what the results show * Design, test, and iterate on prompts; evaluate answer quality, latency, and token cost, and decide which tradeoffs to make; learn how guardrails are applied in production paths * Evaluate models, tools, and approaches, and recommend which to use, with your reasoning documented * Ship features and bug fixes in FastAPI services (REST and WebSocket APIs backed by PostgreSQL and Redis), deciding how to design, implement, and test them * Contribute to background jobs and queue consumers so agent work runs outside the API request path * Apply our architectural standards, use your judgment on design choices within them, help keep design documents current, and flag where the standards should change * Submit pull requests, respond to review feedback, and review teammates’ code as you grow **What You Bring:** * Solid Python from coursework, internships, or work: functions, classes, type hints, error handling, testing basics * Data structures and algorithms, with awareness of time and space complexity * SQL fundamentals (joins, aggregations, indexes, schema design); PostgreSQL exposure preferred * REST and HTTP concepts, and how a web API is structured * Git and pull\-request workflow * Clear communication, comfort asking questions, and a habit of picking up new tools and asking for help when you’re stuck **Preferred:** * An agent project built with Strands Agents, LangChain, the OpenAI SDK, or a similar framework (coursework, personal, or professional), including how an LLM chooses and calls tools * Model Context Protocol (MCP): building or using MCP tools and servers * AWS Bedrock or Bedrock AgentCore, or AWS basics such as S3 and SQS * RAG: chunking, embeddings, and vector stores * Prompt engineering: writing, testing, and iterating on prompts * FastAPI or a similar framework such as Flask or Django, SQLAlchemy or another ORM, and a willingness to learn async Python **Experience:** * Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience (bootcamp, self\-taught, or on\-the\-job) * Roughly 0–2 years of software engineering experience; internships, research, and substantial projects count * A track record of learning quickly, shown through coursework, projects, work, open\-source contributions, or community involvement **Benefits \& Perks:** Fuel Cycle is committed to supporting the well\-being, flexibility, and growth of our team. We offer a competitive and inclusive benefits package that includes: * **Comprehensive Health Coverage**: Medical, dental, and vision insurance plans * **401(k) with Company Match**: Plan for your future with our retirement savings program * **Equity Purchase Option**: Participate in Fuel Cycle’s long\-term success * **Flexible Work Schedule**: Empowering you to balance life and work * **Generous Time Off**: + 15 vacation days and 7 sick days per year + 12 company holidays + 4 floating holidays/recharge days to rest or celebrate what matters to you * **Paid Parental Leave**: Time to bond with your growing family * **Monthly Internet \& Phone Stipend**: Support for remote work setup * **Wellness \& Lifestyle Perks**: Access to tools like **Rightway (healthcare navigation), Headspace (mental wellness), Peloton (fitness)**, and more * **Team Connection Perks**: + **Weekly community lunches**, refreshments, and snacks at our LA \& NY headquarters **Compensation Overview:** The expected starting salary range for this position is **$90,000 \- $110,000\.** This range represents the typical starting compensation offered to candidates hired into this role. Final base salary will be determined based on a variety of factors, including location, work experience, skills, knowledge, education, and certifications. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for variable bonus, and may include an equity grant or purchase option. These components make up your total compensation package, which will be reviewed in greater detail during your initial recruiter conversation. **Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Equal Opportunity:** At Fuel Cycle, we embrace the values of diversity, equity, and inclusion and are committed to fostering an inclusive company culture. We believe that everyone, regardless of their background or identity, should have equal access to opportunities for growth and advancement. Our selection processes and career pathways are designed to be fair, transparent, and free from bias. We value the unique perspectives and contributions of each team member, knowing that this diverse range of experiences strengthens our team. Fuel Cycle stands firmly against discrimination based on disability, sex, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, veteran status, or any other protected status under the law. Fuel Cycle is an equal opportunity employer and fully comply with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). We will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified applicants and employees with disabilities, as needed, to enable them to perform the essential functions of their job and participate in the application and interview process. If you require accommodations during any part of the application process, please contact us at hr@fuelcycle.com to discuss your needs. Compensation Range: $90K \- $110K

jobs.title: Staff AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description** **Staff AI Engineer** ===================== **Mission** Design and deliver trustworthy AI systems, machine\-learning solutions, data products, and applications that improve decisions, automate work, and create measurable business impact across Sales, Service, Marketing, and Global Markets. This is a hands\-on Staff AI Engineer role for an experienced individual contributor who can move from business problem framing and analytical discovery through data engineering, model and AI\-system development, application delivery, and production operation. The role combines practical data science with strong software and platform\-engineering skills to build reusable, secure, maintainable, and adopted AI capabilities at scale. **Key Responsibilities** **Applied AI and Machine Learning** Translate ambiguous business problems into clear AI objectives, solution strategies, evaluation plans, and measurable success criteria. Develop, validate, and improve predictive, forecasting, classification, segmentation, optimization, natural\-language, generative\-AI, and decision\-support solutions. Select practical statistical, machine\-learning, and AI techniques based on the business decision, available data, operational constraints, risk, and expected value. Apply methods such as experimentation, time\-series forecasting, causal analysis, retrieval\-augmented generation, agentic workflows, or other modern AI patterns when they are fit for purpose. Partner with stakeholders to identify when AI is appropriate—and when simpler analytics, rules, or workflow automation will create better outcomes. **Data and Feature Engineering** Define data requirements and partner with data engineering, platform, and business teams to establish reliable, documented data sources. Build scalable ingestion, transformation, aggregation, feature, embedding, and knowledge pipelines using batch or streaming patterns as appropriate. Create reusable data products, analytical datasets, semantic models, feature assets, and retrieval indexes that support multiple use cases. Perform exploratory analysis, data\-quality assessment, schema validation, feature selection, leakage detection, and data\-availability analysis. Work across structured and unstructured data, including customer, vehicle, dealer, sales, service, warranty, incentive, document, conversation, and operational datasets. **AI Application and Platform Engineering** Build production\-grade AI applications, services, APIs, assistants, dashboards, and workflow tools that make AI capabilities accessible to end users. Translate models and AI systems into intuitive user experiences, decision\-support tools, automation workflows, and self\-service capabilities. Design clean interfaces between data pipelines, models, foundation models, tools, backend services, and front\-end or workflow applications. Implement retrieval, grounding, tool use, orchestration, prompt management, evaluation, and human\-in\-the\-loop patterns where appropriate. Develop secure, testable, observable, and maintainable software using sound engineering practices, code review, version control, and automated testing. Partner with architects and software engineers on application structure, integration patterns, authentication, authorization, deployment, and operational support. **Evaluation, Reliability, and Production AI** Establish evaluation frameworks that reflect real\-world business outcomes, not only offline technical metrics. Assess model and AI\-system quality, calibration, bias, interpretability, robustness, factuality, groundedness, safety, usability, latency, and operational fit. Design and analyze experiments, pilots, red\-team exercises, and champion/challenger approaches to validate value and manage risk before broad adoption. Deploy solutions as APIs, batch processes, scheduled workflows, applications, assistants, or decision\-support capabilities. Establish practices for dependency management, versioning, data lineage, prompt and model tracking, release management, rollback, and reproducibility. Design monitoring for data quality, drift, model performance, response quality, safety signals, application health, latency, availability, usage, and business outcomes. Investigate production issues, identify root causes, and improve models, pipelines, services, prompts, and user experiences through structured iteration. **Responsible AI, Security, and Governance** Apply responsible\-AI, privacy, security, and data\-governance principles throughout solution design and operation. Define appropriate controls for access, data handling, auditability, explainability, human oversight, model and prompt risk, and use of external or third\-party services. Document assumptions, limitations, intended use, prohibited use, evaluation results, and operational ownership for AI solutions. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, GC Events
jobs.description: GiveCampus is the world's leading fundraising platform for non\-profit educational institutions. Trusted by millions of donors and 1,300\+ colleges, universities, and K\-12 schools, our mission is to help advance the quality, the affordability, and the accessibility of education. At our current pace, we will facilitate $100 billion in charitable giving over the next decade–enough money to send more than 1 million students to college, tuition\-free. GiveCampus is backed by leading investors including Y Combinator, but we're also practitioners of Sustainable Growth: we've made the Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest\-growing private companies each of the last five years and we've been profitable nine of the last 10\. In 2025, we celebrated a $140 million growth investment that included a major liquidity event for GiveCampus employees–the second in less than three years. Our purpose\-driven team of 130\+ is located in 30\+ states across the US: team members work from anywhere they choose. We have a beautiful 12,000sf office in Washington, DC that is available for people to use whenever they want, and we regularly organize team meet\-ups, visit partner institutions, and host retreats in various locations. While we operate at meaningful scale, we're still small relative to the commercial and social good opportunities in front of us. Every GiveCampus employee plays a meaningful role in shaping what comes next, and we're growing the team in support of our ambitious plans–including a $100 million investment in AI product development. If you believe in the transformative power of education and want to join a fast\-growing, mission\-driven company, you'll fit right in. **Location:** This is a remote\-first role based in the U.S. While we embrace flexible, distributed work, we also value in\-person connection. Team members are expected to attend multiple company\-wide and team\-specific onsites throughout the year. GC Events is our answer to the question *"Can I run my homecoming, reunion, gala, or auction on GiveCampus, too?"* The product is revenue\-generating, well on its way to product\-market fit, and serving a real, repeat need across our 1,500\+ Partner schools. It's also one of the biggest growth levers in front of us. We're hiring a **Senior Product Manager** to own GC Events end\-to\-end—not just the roadmap, but the commercial outcome. You'll be accountable for whether the number moves, and you'll drive everything required to move it on the product side: strategy, discovery, execution, shipping quality and velocity, launch readiness, adoption, operations, and any third\-party vendors and integrations that sit in the flow. Engineering is one big input, and a critical one—but it isn't the whole job. The whole job is making GC Events the undisputed first choice for schools looking for best\-in\-class software to power event registration, ticketing, and auctions, and delivering 10x revenue growth by the end of 2027 while we do it. You won't do that alone. GC Events has a dedicated GTM Lead who is your commercial counterpart—co\-accountable for the number and responsible for messaging, positioning, pricing and packaging, launches, campaigns, sales enablement, demos, and RFPs. The two of you are joined at the hip. They bring the market and the buyer; you bring the product and the build. Together you make sure GC Events is built, shipped, positioned, sold, adopted, loved, and driving commercial results. This is a PM role for someone who wants to operate like a GM of the product, ship like a builder, and go deeper with users than anyone else at the company, including in person at their events! It's also a PM role for the AI\-native era. You reach for AI across your entire workflow—research synthesis, data analysis, drafting, prototyping, experimentation, shipping—and you think about AI as a core capability of the product itself, not a feature you bolt on. You'll report to the Head of Product and work in close partnership with your GTM Lead counterpart, Engineering, Design, Data Science, Partner Operations, Partner Success, Marketing, Business Development, and Business Operations. **Successful Outcomes** * **Commercial results, co\-owned—whatever it takes:** You and your GTM Lead co\-own the GC Events commercial KR. Not a backlog. Not a velocity number. Not a feature list. If we ship the right thing but the number doesn't move, that's on both of you. If we ship nametag printing but the printers never arrived on time, it doesn't matter that we shipped it. You're accountable for the product half of the equation and whatever else it takes across functions, vendors, and external partners to actually move the number. * **Insanely close to users:** You know GC Events better than anyone else on the planet, and you know our Partners the same way. You're on a text\-message basis with the fundraisers running events at our schools—swapping voice notes with them on a Tuesday morning, showing up in person to watch them run regis  own analyses and don't wait on someone else to pull the query. * **AI\-native operator.** You've integrated AI across your full PM workflow—research synthesis, data analysis, drafting, prototyping, experimentation. You've used AI\-powered tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Lovable, v0, Figma Make, or similar) to go from idea to working prototype—and, ideally, to a shipped fix, experiment, or companion app that solved a real problem. Just as importantly, you have a point of view on how AI shows up as a capability of the product itself: which problems it's best suited to solve, where it earns a spot in the core flow, and how human\-in\-the\-loop should work. You're actively exploring what's possible and excited about this shift in what a PM can do. You don't confuse "I can build it" with "I should build everything"—you have judgment about where your hands\-on contribution multiplies the team versus where it distracts. * **Technical fluency with engineers.** You hold your own in discussions on software architecture, security, data modeling, and integrations. You participate in technical decisions because you understand the tradeoffs, not because you're performing depth. * **Execution and cross\-functional leadership.** You've led and continuously improved the full execution loop—sprint planning, standups, refinement, retrospectives, resource allocation, roadmap execution—and you treat velocity as a first\-class metric. You've partnered closely with GTM, sales, customer success, and marketing counterparts to move a commercial outcome, and you know the difference between driving their work yourself and amplifying the person whose job it is. **Cultural Characteristics** * Dynamic, emerging leader who is better at listening than speaking * Thrives in ambiguity, creates order in chaos, and consistently thinks two steps ahead * Hands\-on builder excited to go deep into technical requirements, user flows, and data—and to reach for AI or open a PR when that's the fastest path * Operates AI\-first by default—AI is in the flow across research, drafting, analysis, prototyping, and shipping; not bolted on as an afterthought * Strong collaborator who will naturally work cross\-functionally but is also comfortable operating independently * Intensely curious, always pushing to understand why things are the way they are and how they got that way * Operates with a sense of urgency, maintains a fast pace, always pushing for faster * Holds themself and others to high standards; always pursues excellence * Deep sense of ownership and accountability; low maintenance, low drama * Comfortable with strong opinions, loosely held—advocates passionately, then commits fully once a decision is made * Runs towards big, ambitious goals rather than away from them * Passionate about advancing the quality, the affordability, and the accessibility of education * Radical empathy for our Partner schools, the fundraisers doing the hard work, and the donors who want to make a difference **Ready to apply?** ------------------- Be sure to keep an eye on your spam and promotions boxes in case our emails end up there! *At GiveCampus, we value diversity and we pledge to foster an environment of support, inclusivity, and learning, both on the job and throughout the application process. In this spirit, we encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.* *GiveCampus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Applicants and employees are not discriminated against because of race, color, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, citizenship status, disability, ancestry, marital status, veteran status, medical condition or any protected category prohibited by local, state or federal laws.* *If you feel like you don't meet all of the requirements for this role, please apply anyways. We know confidence gaps and imposter syndrome often get in the way of connecting with incredible people, and we don't want them to prevent us from meeting you.*

jobs.title: AI Engineer - Data and Evals
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, US
jobs.description: **About Glean:** Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full\-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business \- without vendor lock\-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context\-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities \- AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real\-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025\), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026\), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50\+ industries and 1,000\+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI\-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. **About the Role:** The bottleneck in building reliable, useful AI is no longer writing code. It's defining what good looks like and measuring how well our products deliver it. That takes high\-quality data and evals that teams can trust. Our team owns data and evaluation science for Glean's AI products. We build evalsets, agentic LLM\-judges, and benchmarks that capture what good looks like, along with the platform and infrastructure that run evals reliably at scale, and enterprise simulation environments where we test how our assistants and agents actually perform. Starting from real production usage, you'll turn what we learn into evals that guide improvements across the entire stack, from agent harnesses to tool use, skill iteration, model routing, and post\-training of task specific models. You'll bring new research into production and partner with R\&D, product, and GTM to turn findings from evals into better products and customer outcomes. If you care about quality and want to build the systems that measure it, this role is for you. **You will:** * Build evalsets and benchmarks from expert\-curated examples, production data, synthetic data, and past failures, covering edge cases and key user slices. * Build and scale the eval platform and agent observability: experiment pipelines, trace capture and replay, and dashboards, with reproducible, affordable runs. * Build agentic LLM verifiers for correctness, groundedness, citation quality, and task success, and calibrate them against human labels using clear rubrics. * Run evals at every stage, from CI and pre\-release suites to sampled production traffic, and report results with confidence intervals. * Build enterprise simulation environments with simulated users and realistic company data to test multi\-step agent tasks. * Diagnose failures by slice and trace, and turn eval results into concrete fixes, weighing quality against latency and cost. **About you:** * 5\+ years of software engineering experience with strong Go and/or Python and backend fundamentals: APIs, data modeling, testing, and distributed pipelines. TypeScript is a plus. * Experience building datasets and benchmarks for LLM use\-cases, RAG, or agents, including evalset curation and synthetic data generation. * Familiarity with eval methodologies and their tradeoffs: deterministic metrics, LLM\-as\-a\-judge, pointwise vs pairwise grading, human labeling, and judge calibration. * Experience building eval or experiment infrastructure that runs reliably at scale, including CI/CD integrations and observability tooling like OpenTelemetry. * Strong analytical skills: you dig into traces and failure cases, write SQL, and use data and metrics to explain why quality moved. * Nice to have: experience with simulation environments and/or model post\-training techniques. **Location:** * This role is hybrid (4 days a week in our Mountain View or San Francisco office) **Compensation \& Benefits:** The standard base salary range for this position is $200,000 \- $280,000 annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time\-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long\-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused. jobs.title: Transformation Engineer
jobs.description: Description: **About the role** Global Data Systems is moving from Managed Services Provider to Managed Intelligence Provider, and we are proving it on ourselves first. Our Customer Zero program turns twenty years of operational data (tickets, SLA clocks, devices, contracts) into managed intelligence that we run our own business on, then package and deliver to our customers. The motion is simple: See the truth, Steer the levers, Shift the metric. The Transformation Engineer is a hands\-on builder who will take on the Microsoft Fabric, AI, Copilot, and Power Automate work that the VP of Customer Operations has been leading, and help turn it from promising builds into tools GDS relies on every day. You do not need to be a Fabric expert on day one. We need someone who builds, learns fast, and is shipping useful work within the first few weeks. As capabilities prove themselves internally, you will help package and deploy them for customers and support the program and go\-to\-market around them. This is a builder\-first role with real room to grow into an architect role. **What you will own** Build and run it on ourselves (Customer Zero) * Get hands\-on in our Microsoft Fabric environment quickly: build and maintain semantic models, reports, and data pipelines, and help bring more operational sources into one trusted Lakehouse. * Help move AI capabilities from pilot to daily use, including agents, Copilot skills, and pipelines for commitment intelligence, contract extraction, and executive pre\-reads. * Build and support Power Automate flows, Power Apps, and API connections that remove manual work from service delivery, reporting, and account management. * Help instrument the metrics that matter so our numbers are honest and complete, with the same data reaching our teams and our customers. * Work with the Service Desk, NOC, PMO, Finance, and account teams to understand their problems and get what you build into how they actually work. Help package and deploy for customers * Help turn proven internal capabilities into repeatable customer offerings by documenting how they work, what they need, and how to deploy them. * Take a hands\-on build role in early customer deployments, from data readiness through build, rollout, and adoption. * Build reusable pieces (templates, model patterns, flow and agent libraries, checklists) so each deployment is faster than the last. * Bring lessons from customer work back into the Customer Zero platform so internal and customer tools improve together. Support the program and go\-to\-market * Contribute to the Managed Intelligence offering with the VP of Customer Operations, Sales, and the Microsoft practice, bringing the builder's view of what is realistic to deliver. * Demo what you have built in customer briefings, workshops, and QBRs, showing what GDS runs on itself. * Help deliver Microsoft\-funded engagements, such as Copilot and agent workshops, internally first and then for customers. * Earn relevant Microsoft certifications and contribute to customer references that support the Microsoft Copilot Specialization. Build it the right way * Keep a simple, current inventory of the AI and automation tools you build: who owns them, what data they use, and whether they are being used. * Follow and help shape our governance practices around data sensitivity, security, and consumption cost. * Build so things are easy to support, hand off, and move as the platforms change. * Take an active part in the AI Center of Excellence, including office hours and "I Built This" sessions that help others across GDS build too. Requirements: **Required** ------------ * Three or more years of hands\-on experience building business solutions, automation, or data products, ideally with Microsoft tools. * Working experience with Power BI (data modeling, DAX, or report building). Fabric experience is a plus, not a requirement. * A track record of things you have built and shipped, such as Power Automate flows, Power Apps, Copilot Studio agents, scripts, or integrations, that people actually use. * Real curiosity about generative AI and a habit of trying new tools, with good judgment about data security and cost. * Comfort working with business users and customers to understand a problem and turn it into a working solution. * Clear communication: able to demo your work and write simple documentation others can follow. **Preferred** ------------- * Microsoft certifications such as Power BI Data Analyst (PL\-300\), Power Platform (PL\-200 or PL\-400\), or Fabric Analytics Engineer (DP\-600\), or a willingness to earn them in the first year. * Experience with ConnectWise or other PSA and service desk data. Experience in a managed services, IT services, or consulting environment.

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Analyst - AI & Firewalls
jobs.description: . **Title:** Cybersecurity Analyst **Company:** Global Power Components – www.globalpowercomponents.com **Location:** Milwaukee, WI (onsite 5\-days/week) **Hire Type:** Direct Hire **Position Summary** GPC is seeking a hands\-on Cybersecurity Analyst whose primary focus is AI and firewall security. You will secure and govern the AI tools the business adopts including Microsoft 365 Copilot, AI agents, and third\-party generative AI services while owning the day\-to\-day administration of our Ubiquiti UniFi firewall and network security controls across our sites. The focus is securing AI, not building it; however, hands\-on experience implementing AI solutions is required so you understand how these tools are deployed and where their risks lie. You will also support security operations, incident response, and governance, working closely with the IT team, engineering, and operations to keep a modern manufacturing environment secure, resilient, and productive. **Essential Duties \& Responsibilities** **AI Security \& Governance (\~40%)** * Review proposed AI tools, agents, and use cases for security, privacy, and data\-protection risk; define the security requirements they must meet; and verify those controls are in place before go\-live. * Help develop and enforce GPC’s AI acceptable\-use policy and standards, and maintain an inventory of approved AI tools, agents, and integrations. * Secure Microsoft 365 Copilot and other AI assistants by reviewing data permissions and oversharing and applying sensitivity labels, data loss prevention (DLP), and audit controls (e.g., Microsoft Purview), so AI tools surface only data users are authorized to see, and engineering drawings, designs, and customer information stay protected. * Detect and manage unsanctioned “shadow AI” use through firewall application control and content filtering, cloud app discovery (e.g., Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps), and endpoint and browser policies. * Assess AI agents, plugins, connectors, API integrations (e.g., Microsoft Foundry / Azure OpenAI), and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers for excessive permissions, credential and secrets exposure, logging gaps, and supply\-chain risk, and enforce least privilege for agent identities. * Threat\-model and test AI\-enabled applications against the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications, and MITRE ATLAS including prompt injection, sensitive information disclosure, data poisoning, and excessive agency. * Evaluate AI vendors’ data handling, retention, use of customer data for model training, and security controls as part of third\-party risk reviews. * Monitor AI usage and AI\-related security events and investigate misuse or data exposure. * Create user guidance and training on safe AI use, including how to recognize AI\-generated phishing and deepfake voice or video impersonation. **Firewall \& Network Security (\~35%)** * Administer, configure, and maintain GPC’s Ubiquiti UniFi firewall platform, including zone\-based firewall policies, application\-aware (Layer 7\) rules, NAT, intrusion detection and prevention (IDS/IPS), content and URL filtering, SSL/TLS inspection, region and domain blocking, and threat\-signature subscriptions (e.g., UniFi CyberSecure). * Design and enforce least\-privilege segmentation between GPC’s separate network environments including corporate, guest, production/shop\-floor (OT), and IoT across multiple sites and buildings, using VLANs, firewall zones, and identity\-aware policies (e.g., Microsoft Entra integration). * Configure and secure site\-to\-site connectivity (IPsec VPN, Site Magic SD\-WAN) and remote access (e.g., WireGuard, Teleport), including hybrid connectivity to Microsoft Azure. * Maintain firewall high availability and resilience (e.g., Shadow Mode failover, multi\-WAN), firmware and UniFi OS updates, and configuration backups through UniFi Site Manager. * Own firewall change management: evaluate rule and exception requests for business justification, implement approved changes, and keep rule and exception documentation current. * Conduct scheduled firewall rule\-base reviews to remove unused, shadowed, or overly permissive rules. * Forward firewall, IDS/IPS, and network logs to the SIEM, and investigate anomalous traffic and threat alerts. * Manage host\-based firewall policies for servers and workstations (e.g., Windows Firewall through Microsoft Intune) to complement network controls. * Support network security projects — such as new buildings, gateway deployments and upgrades, and network redesigns including testing, cutover, and documentation. **Security Operations \& Incident Response (\~15%)** * Monitor, triage, and investigate security alerts across endpoints, identities, email, and cloud using SIEM/XDR tools (e.g., Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel), including threat hunting informed by MITRE ATT\&CK. * Use AI\-assisted security tools (e.g., Microsoft Security Copilot) to accelerate investigat ologies for example, applying data\-protection and access controls for generative AI tools, governing AI usage, or assessing LLM\-based applications for security risks. * 2\+ years of hands\-on experience administering firewalls and network security, ideally on Ubiquiti UniFi gateways; experience with other enterprise platforms (e.g., Fortinet, Palo Alto Networks, Cisco, or Sophos) also applies. * Strong networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, routing and switching, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, NAT, and VPN (IPsec, WireGuard, SSL). * Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 and Azure security, including Entra ID, Intune, Defender, and Purview. * Familiarity with security and AI frameworks: NIST CSF 2\.0, NIST AI RMF, CIS Controls, MITRE ATT\&CK, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, and MITRE ATLAS. * Experience with SIEM, EDR/XDR, and vulnerability management tools. * Scripting or query skills in PowerShell, Python, and/or KQL, including working with REST APIs. * At least one recognized security certification (e.g., CompTIA Security\+, CompTIA CySA\+, or ISC2 SSCP), or the ability to obtain one within six months of hire. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and documentation skills, with the ability to explain technical risk to non\-technical audiences. * Ability to handle confidential information with integrity and discretion. * Willingness to participate in an on\-call rotation and respond to after\-hours incidents. * Ability to pass a pre\-employment background check. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience building AI solutions with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Platform, or Microsoft Foundry (formerly Azure AI Foundry), including grounding AI in business data (e.g., retrieval\-augmented generation). * Experience governing AI agents with Microsoft Agent 365 and Microsoft Entra Agent ID, Microsoft Purview AI data\-security capabilities, or Microsoft Security Copilot. * AI certifications such as CompTIA SecAI\+, IAPP Artificial Intelligence Governance Professional (AIGP), a GIAC AI security certification, or Microsoft exam AI\-103 (Developing AI Apps and Agents on Azure). * Hands\-on experience with the UniFi Network application, UniFi Site Manager, CyberSecure, and Site Magic SD\-WAN. * Ubiquiti certifications such as UniFi Routing, Switching \& Cybersecurity Admin (URSCA) or UniFi Network Professional, or other networking and firewall certifications (e.g., CompTIA Network\+, Cisco CCNA, Fortinet NSE 4 or higher, or Palo Alto Networks Next\-Generation Firewall Engineer). * Advanced security certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Cloud and AI Security Engineer Associate (SC\-500\), Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC\-200\), GIAC GCIH or GCIA, or ISC2 CISSP. * Experience with AI red\-teaming tools such as Microsoft PyRIT or NVIDIA garak. * Experience securing manufacturing or operational technology (OT) environments, including shop\-floor equipment, and familiarity with ISA/IEC 62443\. * Experience protecting engineering/CAD environments and intellectual property. * Familiarity with compliance frameworks common to manufacturers and their customers (e.g., NIST SP 800\-171/CMMC, ISO/IEC 27001\) and with AI management standards such as ISO/IEC 42001\. * Experience designing or deploying segmented, multi\-site networks, including firewall deployments and migrations. **What Success Looks Like in the First Year** * Approved AI tools and agents are inventoried, governed by policy, and protected by data\-loss and access controls. * New AI tools and integrations receive a security review before approval, with required controls verified before go\-live. * Firewall policies are documented, reviewed on a regular schedule, and aligned to least privilege across all sites and network environments. * Security alerts are triaged within defined service levels, and critical and known\-exploited vulnerabilities are remediated within target timeframes. * Employees recognize and report AI\-enabled phishing and impersonation attempts.

jobs.description: Company Statement: Graham Packaging is a people, planet and values\-based company and a leader in sustainable packaging manufacturing. From the kitchen to the laundry room, Graham Packaging is part of your everyday life. For employees at Graham, our Blue Culture is part of their everyday lives, too. In other words, Blue is how we do things here. At Graham, we are united by a clear vision. We know our part and help those around us know theirs, encouraging one another to continuously improve. Working at Graham means you lead constructively with clear goals, use diverse thinking to drive excellence, accountability, innovation, as well as demonstrating collaboration, embracing learning, and taking action for continuous improvement and growth. Overview: Graham Packaging is seeking an Intelligent Factory Program (IFP) Integration Engineer to connect manufacturing equipment across our North American plants to our real\-time data platform. IFP is a multi\-year program focused on reducing scrap, downtime, and labor cost through line\-level data connectivity, digital Standard Operating Conditions (SOC) management, and analytics. This role is responsible for getting reliable data from plant equipment into our systems and making sure each connection is documented and repeatable. Our equipment includes blow molders, injection molders, trimmers, leak testers, vision systems, and conveyors from many manufacturers, ranging from modern network\-ready machines to older controllers. The right candidate enjoys hands\-on troubleshooting, learns new equipment quickly, and works well with plant teams. The position is remote and requires 35 to 50% travel to plant facilities. Responsibilities: **Essential Duties and Responsibilities*** Connect production equipment to the IFP data platform (Kepware, AVEVA PI) using industrial protocols such as OPC UA, EtherNet/IP, Modbus TCP, and MQTT * Read and interpret PLC programs (Allen\-Bradley, Siemens, and others) to identify and map the data points needed for each line * Set up and support industrial PCs, network hardware, and sensors in coordination with plant IT, controls, and maintenance * Add sensors where machine data is not available from the controller * Validate data after each connection to confirm values, units, and update rates match actual machine behavior * Follow and help improve connectivity standards and documentation so connections can be repeated across plants * Provide remote and onsite troubleshooting for connectivity issues at operating plants * Track connection progress and report status against line targets Qualifications: **Required Qualifications** * 3\+ years of experience in controls, automation, or industrial integration in a manufacturing environment * Hands\-on experience with PLCs, preferably Rockwell Studio 5000/RSLogix or Siemens TIA Portal/Step 7 * Working knowledge of industrial networking (EtherNet/IP, Profinet, Modbus TCP, basic VLAN concepts) * Exposure to OPC UA, Kepware, or similar industrial connectivity tools * Strong troubleshooting skills and jobs.title: Robotics Software Engineer - Construction
jobs.description: *Every day, our team members do amazing things in pursuit of our shared purpose to build trust with our clients, partners, subcontractors, and teammates. No matter your background, education, or career path, if you share our vision to create extraordinary experiences, you belong* ***at HITT****.* Robotics Software Engineer \- Construction**Job Description:** ==================== The Robotics Software Engineer is responsible for developing and deploying autonomous robotics solutions that must operate in some of the most challenging real\-world environments. This role will own work across the development lifecycle: creating proof\-of\-concept prototypes, maturing promising concepts into feature\-complete systems, and hardening those systems for reliable deployment on jobsites. This team member reports to the Robotics Software Lead and is part of HITT’s Robotics Team, which leads research and development, pilot programs, and full\-time field deployments. The Robotics Team’s mission is to support our project teams, transform our industry, and bring robots to every jobsite. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on engineer who has a deep system\-level understanding of what it takes for robots to operate in unstructured environments, handle dynamic obstacles, safely work around people, and work reliably with limited networking and power infrastructure. Although they may specialize in autonomy, perception, or manipulation, they are comfortable contributing across the robotics stack and addressing issues that span software, sensors, compute, networking, and mechanical hardware. They can move quickly when building an early proof\-of\-concept while applying the engineering discipline needed to mature it into a field\-ready solution. We encourage strong candidates excited by this role to apply even if they do not match every technical qualification listed. **RESPONSIBILITIES** Robotics Software \& Systems Integration * Design, develop, integrate, and test software for complex field robotics applications. * Support the development and maturation of the HITT robotics software stack. * Integrate robot platforms, sensors, actuators, embedded computers, networks, and operator interfaces into cohesive systems. * Develop field\-ready autonomy capabilities, including localization, mapping, navigation, state estimation, and mission planning. * Integrate perception pipelines using cameras, LiDAR, depth sensors, inertial sensors, and other sensing modalities. * Develop manipulation applications involving motion planning, controls, end effectors, calibration, and task execution. * Use simulation, synthetic data, hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing, and repeatable test environments to accelerate development and reduce field risk. * Configure and troubleshoot network connectivity on robots, sensors, operator interfaces, and cloud services using wired and wireless networks. * Serve as a strong technical contributor across the stack while bringing depth in one or more of these areas; expertise in every discipline is not expected. Collaboration \& Partnerships * Collaborate with software engineers, hardware engineers, field testing engineers, vendors, partners, end users, and other stakeholders. * Integrate and extend third\-party technologies using APIs, SDKs, middleware, and other software interfaces. * Contribute to co\-development efforts with vendors and technology partners to establish technical requirements, resolve integration challenges, and evaluate solutions. Field Testing \& Deployment * Plan and execute structured testing in the lab, at test sites, and on active construction projects. * Deploy alongside field teams, observe real workflows, collect data, diagnose issues, and convert field feedback into engineering priorities. * Design for difficult real\-world conditions, including dust, changing lighting, uneven terrain, vibration, intermittent connectivity, dynamic obstacles, and frequent environmental change. * Support deployed systems through remote and on\-site troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, and corrective actions. * Document architectures, interfaces, test results, deployment procedures, and lessons learned so solutions can be supported and scaled. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Bachelor’s degree (BA/BS) in robotics, computer science, software engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or a related field. * Master’s degree or 2\+ years of experience in developing, integrating, and testing field robotics systems. * Proficiency in C\+\+, Python, and Linux\-based robotics development. * Proficiency in modern software\-engineering practices, including version control (e.g., Git), automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and containerization (e.g., Docker). * Experience working with APIs/SDKs, open\-source software packages, and technical standards to bring together disparate technology components into a reliable solution. * Fluency with AI\-assisted and agentic software development (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor). * Strong system\-level troubleshooting skills across software, hardware, networking, and field operations. * Ability to work effectively in uncertain, fast\-moving environments and take ownership of open\-ended technical problems. * Ability to effectively communicate complex technical topics in written and verbal formats to various audiences. * Detail\-oriented, organized, and able to prioritize tasks across multiple projects. * Willingness to travel to active construction sites and participate directly in testing and deployment. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Experience developing robotic systems for construction, manufacturing, logistics, agriculture, mining, defense, or other demanding real\-world environments. * Experience developing robotic systems using Robot Operating System 2 (ROS 2\) or comparable robotics middleware. * Experience in mobile robot perception, SLAM, and navigation for ground and/or aerial robots. * Experience developing or integrating mobile manipulation systems, including perception, motion planning, controls, end\-effector integration, and task execution. * Experience integrating robotic sensing and compute such as cameras, LiDAR, GNSS, IMUs, embedded computers, and GPU\-accelerated perception. * Experience writing and working with software drivers to interface with sensors, actuators, and embedded systems, including familiarity with communications protocols and peripherals (e.g., RS232/422/485, CAN, TCP/IP). * Experience developing low\-latency teleoperation systems for real\-time video, command, and telemetry streams, with graceful degradation amid intermittent connectivity. * Experience developing cloud\-connected robotics software workflows (e.g., Azure, Azure DevOps, AWS), web\-based operator interfaces (e.g., React, JavaScript/TypeScript), and real\-time video\-streaming pipelines (e.g., GStreamer). * Experience with robotics simulation environments (e.g., Gazebo, NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Unity) and/or developing software for NVIDIA Jetson devices. * Familiarity with IP networking (e.g., subnetting, routing, DNS, DHCP) and mesh\-network radios, including diagnosing latency, packet loss, and connectivity issues in RF\-constrained field environments. In accordance with Virginia Senate Bill 215 (SB 215\), the base salary range for this position is: $82,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 Compensation in other cities and states may vary. jobs.description: Presales Solution Engineer \- Edge AI **Description \-** **Role Summary** ---------------- The Presales Solution Engineer – Edge AI is a customer\-facing technical leader responsible for transforming Edge AI opportunities into measurable business outcomes and production\-ready solutions. This role works across the complete customer journey—from discovery and solution architecture through Proof of Concept (POC), validation, deployment, and production scale. The Solution Engineer serves as the technical bridge between customer requirements, HP's Edge AI capabilities, Advanced Compute platforms, partners, and delivery organizations. Success is measured not simply by successful demonstrations or POCs, but by the ability to move customers from concept to production and deliver measurable business value. **Customer Discovery \& Technical Strategy** -------------------------------------------- Partner with customers, account teams, Enterprise Architects, and business stakeholders to understand business challenges, technical requirements, workloads, infrastructure, data environments, and desired outcomes. Translate customer requirements into actionable Edge AI and Advanced Compute architectures and implementation strategies. Define clear POC objectives, technical success criteria, business outcomes, architecture, timelines, responsibilities, and exit criteria before execution begins. Develop a clear productionization plan covering architecture, infrastructure, security, integration, operational readiness, support, monitoring, deployment, and scaling requirements. Identify technical and organizational barriers that could prevent a successful POC from reaching production and proactively develop mitigation plans. Partner with HP Services, engineering, partners, ISVs, Enterprise Architecture, and customer teams to create a smooth transition from presales validation into implementation. **Maintain technical continuity throughout the lifecycle: Discover Architect Validate POC Production Scale** **Edge AI Technical Leadership** -------------------------------- Serve as a subject matter expert within HP's Edge AI and Advanced Compute Practice. Maintain deep knowledge of emerging Edge AI technologies, architectures, AI models, inference frameworks, accelerators, compute platforms, and industry use cases. Build reusable architectures, technical patterns, reference designs, demos, POC frameworks, and deployment methodologies that accelerate future customer engagements. Capture lessons learned from customer engagements and feed those insights back into HP product, engineering, services, and practice development teams. **Sales \& Business Development Support** ----------------------------------------- Partner with sales and technical account teams to identify, qualify, and advance Edge AI opportunities. Develop solution bills of materials, architecture documentation, technical proposals, deployment assumptions, and supporting technical content. Help differentiate HP by demonstrating how HP's Edge AI and Advanced Compute capabilities can solve real customer problems and deliver measurable outcomes. **Required Qualifications** =========================== * 3–5 years of experience in technical presales, forward deployment engineering, solution engineering or architecture, AI infrastructure, advanc PUs, accelerators, containers, networking, storage, and hybrid\-cloud technologies. * Experience taking technical solutions from POC or pilot into production environments. * Ability to troubleshoot complex hardware, software, networking, application, and integration challenges. * Strong understanding of enterprise architecture, security, scalability, manageability, and production operational requirements. * Ability to translate business requirements into technical architectures and technical capabilities into business outcomes. * Strong customer\-facing presentation, communication, and technical storytelling skills. * Ability to collaborate across sales, engineering, product management, services, partners, and customer organizations. **Preferred Qualifications** ============================ * Experience with AI inference and Edge AI frameworks. * Experience with NVIDIA and other accelerated\-compute ecosystems. * Knowledge of computer vision, video analytics, generative AI, and AI inference workloads. * Experience with Kubernetes, containers, Linux, APIs, and modern application architectures. * Experience working with ISVs and technology ecosystem partners. * Experience supporting enterprise customers across retail, manufacturing, industrial, healthcare, public sector, or other Edge AI\-intensive industries. * Experience developing production reference architectures and repeatable solution patterns. **What Great Looks Like** ========================= A successful Presales Solution Engineer does not stop when the demo works. They understand the customer's business challenge, architect the right solution, prove it works, set measurable success criteria, remove deployment barriers, and stay technically engaged until the solution runs successfully in production. **Turn Edge AI possibilities into production outcomes.** **Salary** The on\-target earnings (OTE) range for this role is $192,550\.00 \- $284,000\.00 USD annually with a 80%/20% (salary/incentive) mix. jobs.title: Manufacturing Industrial Engineer
jobs.description: **SUMMARY** The Manufacturing Industrial Engineer will play a key role in redesigning HARLO’s manufacturing plant and developing the systems, layouts, and processes needed to support continued business growth. This is a new, hands\-on, on\-site position requiring someone who is comfortable spending significant time on the production floor, learning how work is currently performed, and turning observations into practical, sustainable refinements, and developing a robust process for continuous improvement plant\-wide through Kaizen events and other methods process enhancements. The successful candidate will independently assess operations, identify opportunities, establish priorities, and lead improvements from concept through implementation. This position will help develop a phased plant\-growth and operational\-improvement roadmap and will evaluate people, equipment, materials, methods, information, and facility constraints to create a scalable manufacturing operation that safely increases capacity, improves throughput, controls costs, and maintains product quality. The Manufacturing Industrial Engineer will partner with Production, Quality, Supply Chain, Engineering, Maintenance, and Management to translate business growth objectives into practical facility, equipment, labor, and process plans. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** **Essential duties and responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.** * Evaluate HARLO’s current plant configuration and recommend practical layouts, capacity plans, equipment strategies, material\-flow methods, and operating systems to support increased production volume and product complexity. Coordinate and implement approved changes. * Create and maintain an operational\-improvement roadmap that identifies and prioritizes opportunities based on impact, effort, cost, and implementation timing. * Spend 50\-70% of the time on the production floor observing how HARLO products and major subassemblies are built, engaging with employees, identifying constraints, and translating and turning front\-line knowledge into practical improvements into tangible implementations. * Design and implement approved assembly\-line concepts, subassembly cells, workstations, and material\-flow routes for HARLO product families, with emphasis on safety, ergonomics, quality, line balance, visual management, production continuity, and effective use of floor space. * Incorporate new product launch processes and procedures as defined between Engineering and Production to ensure seamless transition of new products coming into manufacturing flow are not disruptors to current product and gain production efficiencies expeditiously. * Ensure the 4M principles — Man, Machine, Material, and Method — are implemented across HARLO’s production / assembly plant to analyze, improve, and troubleshoot all processes. * Establish and maintain reliable production standards through process flows, value\-stream maps, time studies, takt and cycle\-time data, labor standards, workstation layouts, standard work, digital work instructions, and process\-control documentation. * Evaluate fixtures, tooling, equipment, and automation alternatives based on labor requirements, capacity, quality, implementation risk, and cost. * Lead approved manufacturing and process\-improvement projects from planning through implementation, working with appropriate departments to support successful adoption and sustained results. **SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES** This position does not initially have direct reports. During onboarding, the employee will develop an understanding of how production leadership manages labor, material flow, and daily operations. perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily and demonstrate the following:** * Self\-directed and comfortable helping build a new function, identifying opportunities, prioritizing work based on operational impact, and driving projects to completion with limited supervision. * Hands\-on approach with a willingness to work directly on the production floor, engage employees, observe processes, test solutions, and support implementation until improvements are successfully adopted. * Proficiency with CAD or facility\-layout software, process\-mapping tools, and Microsoft Excel. * Experience with ERP/MRP systems and data visualization tools. * Ability to analyze manufacturing processes, identify root causes of inefficiencies, and develop practical solutions. * Working knowledge of lean manufacturing methods, including 5S, standard work, value\-stream mapping, line balancing, visual management, root\-cause analysis, and mistake\-proofing. * Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across production and support functions. * Six Sigma training or certification is preferred. **EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE** **Qualified candidates must possess:** * Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related field. * At least three (3\) years of relevant professional engineering experience, including demonstrated experience independently implementing manufacturing or process improvements. * Approximately five (5\) years of relevant experience is preferred for candidates whose background includes significant responsibility for plant\-layout changes, production expansion, or operational transformation. **PHYSICAL DEMANDS** This position requires regular interaction with manufacturing operations and time spent on the production floor.
