jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: Hayward Holdings Inc. (NYSE "HAYW") is one of the leading manufacturers of residential swimming pool equipment in the world, with a significant presence in the commercial pool market that is continuously growing. Hayward designs, manufactures, and markets a full line of residential and commercial pool and spa equipment including pumps, filters, heating, cleaners, salt chlorinators, automation, lighting, safety, flow control and energy solutions at our company owned facilities. Headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, Hayward also has facilities in Tennessee, Arizona, and Rhode Island, Georgia, as well as Canada, Spain, France, Australia, and China. **Overview:** We're looking for a self\-directed engineer who thrives with ownership — someone who can take a project from concept through manufacturing release with minimal oversight, while collaborating closely with cross\-functional teams to deliver industry\-leading pool controls, electronics, and assemblies. Join us to lead, grow, and make an impact as part of a company that values care, respect, and innovation. **This position is based in North Kingstown, RI and is onsite 5 days a week.** **Major Tasks and Responsibilities** **1\. Design Ownership** * Analyze system and subsystem level requirements and evaluate technical solutions for new platforms. * Generate electrical architecture solutions, topologies, and configurations to optimize the electrical design for new project needs. * Design, model, simulate, implement, and verify circuits. * Lead design reviews, optimize PCB layouts, and specify components for robust designs. **2\. Analysis and Verification** * Support electronic circuit verification activities per industry accepted practices. * Support DFMEA and other analyses to develop a robust product that meets market and safety requirements. **3\. Test, Validate, and Launch** * Build and analyze bench level prototypes for proof\-of\-concept designs. * Create and execute test plans to validate designs and ensure industry compliance (HALT, EMC/EMI, UL, CE). * Partner with manufacturing teams for smooth production launches. **4\. Stakeholder Collaboration** * Work with product, firmware, mechanical, and system architects to create cohesive product architectures. * Maintain detailed technical documentation and communicate design strategies effectively. **5\. Continuous Learning** * Stay up to date on industry trends and emerging technologies through conferences, research, and side projects. * Champion and role model best practices within the electrical engineering team. **Requirements** Experience: 8–10\+ years in electrical design and product development. **Who You Are** * Self\-driven and independent — comfortable owning projects end\-to\-end with minimal oversight and a strong commitment to meeting deadlines. **Required Experience** * Proficiency with schematic capture tools (Altium, Xpedition, Zuken, OrCAD or Eagle) and knowledge of PCB layout and PCB construction. * Experience with IoT\-connected embedded systems, including wireless communication protocols (e.g., Wi\-Fi, BLE, Zigbee) and cloud\-connected device architectures. * Knowledge of 3\-phase BLDC motor drives, embedded systems, microcontrollers, and analog/digital circuitry. * Familiarity with safety standards, EMC, and environmental compliance. * Understanding of mechanical/thermal/packaging design for embedded systems in commercial and industrial markets. * Experience with oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, power analyzers, and timing analyzers to support product verification. * Technical knowledge of reliability testing including environmental, safety, and EMI/EMC verification procedures. * Working knowledge of display controller and touch\-controller interfaces (e.g., RGB, MIPI DSI, SPI, I2C), including backlight drive and power sequencing, touch tuning for wet, gloved, and high\-glare conditions, ESD/EMC protection of the display and touch subsystem. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience using simulation and analysis tools such as LTSpice, Saber, Mathcad, or Maple. * Experience with electrical product design in a regulated environment such as automotive, aerospace, or medical. * Design For Six Sigma, DMAIC, Lean Six Sigma, or Shainin Red X certification. * Hands\-on experience designing and integrating user\-interface displays and touchscreens for harsh, outdoor\-exposed products, including full\-color TFT LCD touchscreens (resistive and projected\-capacitive) as well as simpler segmented, character, and LED displays and keypads. * Proven track record translating customer and market requirements into product requirements, system architectures, and technical specifications. * Experience leading or contributing to architecture trade studies, make/buy decisions, and platform selection (MCU/SoC, connectivity modules, sensors). **Education** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering (BSEE) required; Master's degree in Electrical Engineering (MSEE) preferred. **Why Join Hayward** * **Impact at Scale:** Build the connected, IoT\-enabled hardware inside smart pool products used in millions of homes worldwide. * **Our Mission:** Transforming water experiences with innovation and sustainability. * **Growth Opportunities:** A supportive environment for career advancement and professional development. * **Inclusive Culture:** We value diversity and foster a collaborative workplace. * **Comprehensive Benefits:** Competitive pay, health coverage, retirement plan matching, and paid time off. \#LI\-LS1

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Product Security
jobs.description: **Why work at Higgsfield AI?** Higgsfield AI is the fastest\-scaling generative AI company in history, hitting $1B in annual revenue run rate, 30M\+ users worldwide, 6M\+ generations per day, and powering 390 of Fortune 500 brands. We're building at the absolute frontier of AI\-powered video creation and next\-generation creative tools. Joining Higgsfield means becoming part of a high\-impact team shaping the future of AI\-native experiences, at a company that isn't just moving fast, but rewriting what fast looks like. **About the role:** Higgsfield AI is looking for a hands\-on **Member of Technical Staff, Product Security** to identify and eliminate security vulnerabilities across our rapidly evolving AI products and platforms. secure products. **What You'll Do** ------------------ ### **Offensive Security \& Vulnerability Research** * Conduct hands\-on penetration testing of new products and features, including web applications, APIs, and administrative interfaces. * Identify security risks across agentic systems, MCP servers, code\-generating agents, and AI\-powered applications. * Independently map attack surfaces and uncover authorization, authentication, and multi\-tenant isolation vulnerabilities. * Develop proof\-of\-concept exploits, validate findings, and retest remediation efforts. ### **Secure security\-focused code reviews. * Analyze complex codebases to trace vulnerabilities to their root cause and recommend effective fixes. * Assess security risks across generative AI products, user\-deployed applications, and enterprise features such as SSO and role\-based access controls. ### **Security Engineering \& Automation** * Translate recurring vulnerabilities into secure development standards, reusable controls, and automated security checks. * Build security tooling and integrate preventive controls into development and CI/CD workflows. * Identify systemic weaknesses and implement solutions that prevent entire classes of vulnerabilities. * Apply cloud, container, and infrastructure security knowledge to investigate vulnerabilities across the application stack. ### **Technical Ownership \& Collaboration** * Own security findings from discovery through remediation, working directly with engineers to implement lasting fixes. * Prioritize vulnerabilities based on exploitability, business impact, and real\-world risk. * Establish practical security standards that enable rapid product development without compromising security. * Help define security practices for emerging AI technologies and new product architectures. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in product security, application security, penetration testing, or vulnerability research. * Proven track record of independently discovering and exploiting real vulnerabilities through application security work, bug bounty programs, or security research. * Deep understanding of web application and API security, including authentication, authorization, and multi\-tenant isolation. * Strong ability to read and analyze modern codebases, identify root causes, and collaborate with engineers on remediation. * Experience conducting threat modeling, secure design reviews, and hands\-on penetration testing. * Proficiency in scripting or programming languages such as Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, or Go. * Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, containers, and modern application architectures. * Ability to translate security findings into scalable engineering controls and automated checks. * Strong technical judgment, independent problem\-solving skills, and a proactive approach to identifying security risks. **Compensation \& Benefits** * We offer a competitive and thoughtfully structured compensation package designed to align with impact, experience, and long\-term growth. * **Base Salary:** The anticipated salary range for this role is **$200,000 \- $300,000**, depending on experience, skills, scope, and location. * **Bonus:** This role is Bonus eligible and may participate in the Company's discretionary annual bonus program. * **Equity:** In addition to cash compensation, employees are eligible to participate in the company’s stock option program and share in Higgsfield’s long\-term growth. * **Benefits:** We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employees professionally and personally, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a competitive 401(k) retirement plan with company matching, and additional benefits and perks. * The opportunity to work on ambitious AI products alongside a highly experienced, fast\-moving, and international team. * Significant ownership, direct impact, and opportunities for professional growth as the company scales. This is a **hybrid role based in the San Francisco Bay Area**. Team members are expected to work from our San Francisco office **three full days per week**, with the remaining days worked remotely and are expected to be available during agreed working hours and to maintain sufficient overlap with the relevant team’s time zone. We value in\-person collaboration, active communication, responsiveness, and close partnership across teams. *Higgsfield AI is an equal opportunity employer. To succeed long\-term, healthcare organizations must empower leaders, clinicians, employees, affiliates and communities to build cultures that foster innovation to achieve the best outcomes for patients. Joining the Huron team means you’ll help our clients evolve and adapt to the rapidly changing healthcare environment and optimize existing business operations, improve clinical outcomes, create a more consumer\-centric healthcare experience, and drive physician, patient and employee engagement across the enterprise. Join our team as the expert you are now and create your future. We are looking for a Lead Data Engineer to provide technical leadership for our engineering team and take on one of our most strategically important challenges: unifying a diverse ecosystem of analytics applications under a coherent, scalable technology platform. Our analytics landscape has grown organically across multiple teams and products. The result is a collection of powerful but siloed tools, each with its own technology stack, data contracts, and deployment patterns. You'll join a team that acts as the connective tissue bringing these applications together, making pragmatic decisions about when to consolidate and when to preserve the right tool for the right job. This role is for an engineer who is energized by ambiguity, skilled at reading distributed systems, and opinionated (but flexible) about platform design. You will work directly with engineering leads and data teams. identify unification opportunities but defer to domain expertise on data semantics and processing logic **Cloud Infrastructure** * Deploy and manage platform services on cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred; Azure/GCP experience a plus) * Contribute to infrastructure\-as\-code practices using tools such as Terraform or CDK * Collaborate with the IT platform team to define deployment pipelines and reliability standards for integration services * Construct evidence\-based business cases for cloud feature adoption, translating technical requirements into business value, risk reduction, and compliance language that resonates with IT governance and procurement stakeholders **What We're Looking For** **Required Qualifications** * 7\+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 3 years focused on data engineering, integration, platform, or infrastructure work * 2\+ years in a technical lead role: setting direction for shared work, mentoring engineers, and reviewing code and designs * Proficiency in Python; comfortable reading and writing production\-quality code, not just scripts * Strong SQL skills, including working with large or complex datasets * Hands\-on experience with AWS (compute, storage, and at least one managed data service) * Experience with AI\-assisted development tools or coding agents in a professional context, and a genuine curiosity about how AI is changing engineering work * Demonstrated ability to learn unfamiliar systems quickly: you can walk into an existing pipeline, tool, or codebase you didn't build and figure out how it works * Strong written communication skills **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with dbt and Snowflake * Experience with Apache Iceberg * Additional language proficiency, especially Spark or Java * Experience leading or coordinating engineering work across distributed or multi\-location teams * Experience with data pipelines (ETL/ELT), including schema management or data quality monitoring * Exposure to structured (SQL) and semi\-structured (JSON, Parquet, Avro) data at scale * Familiarity with analytics or ML platform tooling (Airflow, MLflow, or SaaS equivalents) **How You Work** We care as much about how you think as what you've built. The ideal candidate for this role: * Is pragmatic over dogmatic: comfortable making a clear recommendation and defending it, but changes course when someone presents a genuinely better argument, not just a louder one * Treats AI\-assisted tools as a normal part of how you work, not a novelty, and stays curious about how they change what's possible * Communicates tradeoffs clearly to both technical peers and non\-technical stakeholders * Moves quickly from “I don't know this system” to “here's how it works,” and can produce a clear map of an unfamiliar codebase or pipeline * Understands that “don't touch what works” and “build it right” are often both correct answers, depending on context * Takes ownership of quality and reliability: you care about what happens after you ship * Multiplies the team's impact: shares context, unblocks others, and delegates real ownership rather than becoming the bottleneck **The estimated base salary for this job is $140,000 \- $190,000 USD. jobs.title: Cybersecurity, Architect
jobs.description: **ABOUT THE ROLE** Hut 8 is seeking a Cybersecurity Architect to lead security design and build the technical capabilities that protect the enterprise. This role translates the technology and cybersecurity strategy into practical architecture, reusable design patterns, technical standards, and implemented security capabilities across corporate IT, mining operations, data centers, cloud platforms, SaaS applications, enterprise data, and AI/compute environments. The Cybersecurity Architect is the lead security designer and builder: a senior technical individual contributor who turns strategy into architecture, guides implementation, and builds durable security capabilities. The role partners closely with Software, Networking, Data Engineering, Business Intelligence, Applied AI, Technology Operations, Data Center Operations, Mining Operations, and other arm of the business to embed security into technology decisions without creating unnecessary delivery friction. This role reports to the Cybersecurity Partner and works closely with technology leadership, and external security partners. **What You'll Do** * Lead the design of Hut 8's security architecture principles, reference architectures, technical standards, and security\-by\-default patterns, then build the capabilities needed to apply them consistently. * Translate cybersecurity strategy, risk priorities, and business requirements into executable architecture decisions and implementation roadmaps. * Lead security architecture reviews for new platforms, applications, integrations, cloud services, infrastructure changes, AI/compute workloads, and operational technology environments. * Design defense\-in\-depth architectures across identity and access management, privileged access, network segmentation, endpoint security, cloud, SaaS, application security, data security, APIs, CI/CD pipelines, and OT or industrial control environments. * Define practical security requirements for systems and services, including authentication, authorization, encryption, logging, monitoring, resiliency, secrets management, vulnerability management, and incident response readiness. * Partner with engineering and technology teams to secure integrations, APIs, production platforms, data pipelines, and software delivery processes throughout the technology lifecycle. * Develop reusable security patterns and guardrails that enable teams to deliver securely and consistently at scale. * Identify material technology risks, evaluate alternatives, document decisions, and recommend risk\-based treatment options to technology and business leaders. * Guide the design and evolution of security capabilities such as SIEM and security monitoring, EDR, vulnerability management, IAM, privileged access, cloud security, and security testing. * Review third\-party products, vendors, and managed services for architectural fit, security risk, control coverage, and operational accountability. * Support threat modeling, attack\-surface analysis, technical risk assessments, incident preparedness, and post\-incident architectural remediation. * Establish architecture documentation, diagrams, standards, decision records, and operating procedures that make the security program repeatable and auditable. * Partner with GRC and audit stakeholders to ensure that security architecture and control decisions are documented, testable, and supported by evidence. * Mentor cybersecurity engineers and technical stakeholders on secure design, risk\-based decision\-making, operational discipline, and incident readiness. * Provide clear technical recommendations, tradeoffs, and status updates to the Cybersecurity Partner and technology leadership. **ABOUT YOU** * 5\+ years of progressive experience in cybersecurity, information security, security architecture, security engineering, or a comparable technical discipline. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent practical experience will be considered. * Strong knowledge of security architecture across identity, network, endpoint, cloud, SaaS, application, data, and infrastructure environments. * Experience designing security controls and reference patterns for cloud platforms, enterprise applications, APIs, CI/CD pipelines, production systems, and data environments. * Familiarity with OT, industrial control, data center, or other operational technology environments, with the ability to adapt enterprise security principles to operational realities. * Experience with security architecture methods, threat modeling, risk assessments, zero trust principles, defense\-in\-depth design, and secure systems development practices. * Working knowledge of security frameworks and control environments, including NIST CSF, NIST SP 800\-53, ISO 27001, SOC 2, SOX ITGC, PCI, or comparable standards. * Demonstrated ability to turn ambiguous requirements into practical architecture decisions and drive adoption through implementation. * Strong technical writing and communication skills, including the ability to explain complex security decisions to engineers, operators, executives, and non\-technical stakeholders. * Experience working with security vendors, MSSPs, auditors, and third parties, with the judgment to hold partners accountable for measurable outcomes. * Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, SABSA, TOGAF, GIAC, or cloud security certifications are preferred. * Pragmatic, collaborative, and comfortable operating hands\-on in a fast\-moving environment where the security program is continuing to mature. **ABOUT THE WORK ENVIRONMENT** This role is in office at our corporate headquarters in the Brickell area of Miami, Florida. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

experience as a Data Engineer, including designing, implementing, and validating production\-grade data pipelines. * Hands\-on experience with Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and core Azure cloud services. * Strong proficiency in SQL and PySpark for data transformation and pipeline development. * Experience implementing data quality checks, reconciliations, and jobs.title: Channel Sales Engineer
jobs.description: **Hypori, Inc.** is a high\-growth cybersecurity SaaS company transforming how organizations think about secure mobility. Our virtual workspace platform enables users to access enterprise apps and data from any mobile device—with zero data on the endpoint and total personal privacy. Backed by $55M in funding from investors including UBS, AE Industrial Partners, Hale Capital Partners, and GreatPoint Ventures, Hypori is expanding into new commercial and regulated markets. Learn more at hypori.com. Hypori is looking for a hands\-on Channel Sales Engineer to join our growing commercial sales team. You will be the technical engine behind our channel program, enabling engineers at MSSPs, MSPs, RPOs, and C3PAOs to sell, scope, and deploy Hypori on their own. You will work alongside the Channel Account Manager and report to the VP of Commercial Sales. Most of the 100,000\+ companies in the Defense Industrial Base buy security through the partner that runs their IT, and those partners only sell what their own engineers trust. Hypori is proven at scale, with more than 95,000 Department of War users and IL5, FedRAMP High, NIAP Common Criteria, NSA CSfC, CMMC 2\.0 Level 2, and SOC 2 Type II. The channel program is new, and the person in this seat builds its technical foundation. Success is measured by partner\-sourced pipeline, technical win rate, and partners who can run a deal without you. **Responsibilities** * Build the partner technical certification path with the Channel Account Manager * Enable partner engineers to demo, scope, and deploy Hypori without us in the room, taking every new partner from signature to first deployment * Maintain reference architectures, deployment guides, and partner lab environments * Equip partner sellers and compliance leads to defend the CMMC scope reduction argument * Understand the why first: why the partner's or client's current setup isn't enough, why now, why Hypori, and why not the status quo * Lead discovery, demos, and proof\-of\-value engagements on partner\-led deals against agreed success criteria * Use MEDDPICC to validate technical decision criteria, build technical champions, and flag unqualified deals early * Scope deployments across identity, multi\-tenant design, app delivery, licensing, and the assessment boundary * Answer security questionnaires, RFIs, and shared responsibility requests * Help partners package Hypori into managed service offerings with multi\-tenant administration and RMM, PSA, and SIEM integrations * Bring partner and field requirements to Product and Engineering * Support channel campaigns, webinars, and events, including CMMC CON * Over time, help stand up the technical foundation for a broader security reseller and solution provider channel **Qualifications** * 3–5 years as a sales engineer, solutions engineer, or solutions architect at a SaaS cybersecurity vendor, MSP, or MSSP * A track record supporting cybersecurity sales, with measurable technical win rates * Hands\-on experience enabling MSP or MSSP partners, including building your own certification and enablement content * CMMC 2\.0 and NIST SP 800\-171 depth. Be ready to scope an assessment boundary and defend scope reduction in the interview * Endpoint security architecture expertise across mobile, identity, and data protection * MEDDPICC fluency and strong Salesforce hygiene * Location: Remote, United States, with travel up to 40 percent to partner sites and industry events **Who You Are** * **Speed:** You move with urgency and get things done today, not next week * **Focus:** You spend your time on the partners and deals that will actually move * **Extreme ownership:** Partner readiness and technical wins are yours. No excuses * **Accountability:** You do what you say, when you say. You flag slips early * **Coachability:** You ask for feedback, act on it, and get better * **Humility:** You know what you don't know, and you say so * **Creativity:** You find new ways to make partner engineers self\-sufficient **Preferred Attributes** * **Technical credibility:** The bar is high. You need credibility with a partner's lead engineer and compliance lead, on your own * **CMMC and 800\-171:** CUI vs. FCI, the 5 asset categories, how an unmanaged device moves from CUI Asset to out of scope, the External Service Provider question, FedRAMP Moderate equivalency under DFARS 7012, and SPRS scoring * **Microsoft 365 GCC High:** Commercial vs. GCC vs. GCC High, enclave vs. full\-tenant migration, and where Hypori shrinks the GCC High footprint * **Endpoint and mobile security:** MDM, UEM, MAM, mobile threat defense, EDR, enterprise browser, VDI, and DaaS. You know where the data rests in each * **Identity and networking:** SSO, SAML, SCIM, conditional access, Entra ID, Okta, derived credentials for CAC and PIV, and cloud networking in AWS and Azure * Prior time at an MSP, MSSP, RPO, or C3PAO serving defense contractors * CMMC CCP or CCA, CISSP, Security\+, or Microsoft security certifications * Experience in an early\-stage channel program * Military service or Department of War civilian experience **About Us** Compensation: $200,000 – $225,000 on\-target earnings, split 80/20 between base salary and variable compensation ($160,000 – $180,000 base salary, commensurate with experience), plus equity. Targets are based on partner\-sourced channel bookings, partner technical certifications, and technical win rate. **About Us** Hypori Inc. provides a generous benefits package for full\-time employees that includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, parental leave, and life and disability packages. We also invest in our employees' futures by providing a 401(k) plan with employer\-matching contributions that vest starting from your first day of employment. **In addition to the base compensation, Hypori also offers a performance bonus, which is primarily contingent upon company\-wide performance.** We are dedicated to investing in the tools and skills required to be strong, collaborative colleagues and people managers to help build and retain a strong workforce. Hypori is an Equal Employment and Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. At Hypori, we are committed to creating and promoting an inclusive workplace that embraces differences and perspectives – making us a stronger, more successful company. In doing so, we are committed to providing reasonable accommodation to applicants with disabilities where appropriate. Applicants requiring reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or hiring process should contact people@hypori.com for assistance. \#Hypori

jobs.title: Data Quality Engineer

In this role, you will design and automate validation, testing, profiling, and monitoring frameworks that ensure the accuracy, consistency, completeness, and reliability of multi\-source data as it is ingested, conditioned, curated, and delivered as consumable enterprise data products. Working with Azure Synapse, Databricks, Collibra Data Quality, Profisee, SQL, Python, and related tools, you will detect anomalies, enforce governance standards, and improve trust in data across interoperating ATLAS platforms. jobs.description: Posted Date 7/19/2026 Description **About Accenture:** Accenture helps the world's leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client\-focused, AI\-enabled, great place to work in the world. We bring together the talent of our approximately 814,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep process and industry expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships to deliver end\-to\-end solutions and measurable outcomes at scale. Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $74 billion in FY26 revenue. Visit us at accenture.com. **We Are:** Accenture is recognized as a global leader in AI and cloud transformation, helping businesses across industries reimagine the digital core for an AI\-native operating model. Through partnerships with frontier AI labs such as Anthropic and OpenAI, and the leading cloud providers, Accenture delivers end\-to\-end services that drive innovation and business agility. The Digital Core Reinvention practice builds the enterprise ontology — the semantic layer that turns raw data into contextualized enterprise knowledge, and the knowledge agents that maintain, evolve, and query it. Where our problem\-scoped ontology work wields meaning against a single problem, this discipline builds the meaning the whole enterprise stands on. **You Are:** A senior knowledge engineer ready to own the discipline: scaled ontology creation, the semantic layer, and the public technical argument for why AI without engineered meaning is guesswork. This is the senior technical track at Accenture: we hire people here who would rather own a methodology than carry a number. **The Work:** As an Associate Director in this family you are the technical owner of our enterprise knowledge engineering services. Concretely, that means three things at once: #### **You own the methodology.** * Scaled ontology creation, semantic\-layer design, knowledge\-agent patterns — yours to defend, evolve, and sign off on, including the boundary with problem\-scoped ontology work (build the ontology here; wield it there). #### **You own the asset portfolio.** * Ontology templates, entity\-resolution patterns, semantic serving reference architectures — every engagement consumes or produces one. #### **You own the technical point of view.** * You can explain the value of the semantic layer to a CFO and defend an OWL modeling decision to an architect in the same meeting — and the market hears the argument from you. Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements. #### **Here's what you need:** * Minimum of 10 years in knowledge engineering, semantic web, ontology design, or adjacent data disciplines, with at least 2 years specifically on AI/LLM\-based work. * Minimum of 6 years with knowledge\-graph technologies (RDF, SPARQL, SHACL, property graphs) and enterprise graph databases. * Minimum of 6 years of managerial or discipline\-leadership experience, able to explain the value of the semantic layer to senior stakeholders (per the W16 scaffold for this family). * Minimum of 2 years of publishing or speaking publicly in the discipline. * Minimum of 3 years owning a productized offering, platform, or methodology — not just consulting within one. * Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate's Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience). **Professional Skills Required:** * Demonstrated ability to walk into a client executive's office and earn the room on technical depth alone. * A clear, defensible point of view on the current AI frontier — what's real, what's hype, what matters in 18 months — that you can articulate publicly. **Bonus Points if You Have:** * Retrieval\-augmented generation and agent context engineering at enterprise scale. * Experience running ontology governance — versioning meaning the way engineers version code. * Multi\-tenant or federated semantic\-layer architectures. * Comfort being outranked on pipeline conversations and outvoting on technical ones. * A track record of editing methodology the way engineers edit code. * Frontier\-partner relationships (Anthropic, OpenAI, hyperscaler AI orgs, or equivalent). jobs.description: **Job Details:** ================ **Job Description:** -------------------- The Foundry Capacity Optimization (FCO) and Strategic Planning organization is seeking a visionary, high\-impact Grade 10 Strategic / Development Industrial Engineer to lead the next era of operational transformation across our planning and capacity ecosystems. As a senior individual contributor reporting directly to the VP/GM of Foundry Capacity Optimization, you will partner closely with Staff Area Managers (AMs), Principal Engineers, and senior FCSP stakeholders to architect and execute a multi\-year digital and operational transformation roadmap. Your charter is clear: radically increase the strategic impact, velocity, and analytical depth of the organization without expanding headcount. You will eliminate manual data manipulation, disparate spreadsheet modeling, and repetitive reconciliation, enabling FCO engineers to focus on solving high\-value, complex semiconductor capacity and customer delivery challenges. **Core Responsibilities** **1\. Transformation Roadmap and Systems Architecture** * Define, architect, and deliver the end\-to\-end Foundry Capacity Optimization (FCO) Digital Transformation Roadmap, aligning long\-range planning (LRP), capacity modeling, tool allocation, and operational execution systems. * Translate complex foundry operational workflows into automated, scalable, and resilient enterprise system requirements. * Establish quantifiable efficiency and productivity metrics to track manual labor reduction, cycle\-time compression, and decision\-velocity improvements across planning cycles. **2\. AI, Machine Learning, and Automation Implementation** * Spearhead the adoption of modern Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), and Generative AI technologies to automate complex decision\-support pipelines, including automated tool mismatch identification, capacity balancing, and yield/mix scenario modeling. * Partner directly with Foundry Automation, Enterprise IT, software development groups, and specialized third\-party technology consultants to rapidly prototype, validate, and deploy production\-grade solutions. * Drive the transition from fragmented desktop spreadsheets and static databases to unified, low\-latency, automated enterprise planning engines. **3\. Data Integration and Elimination of Manual Reconciliation** * Eliminate the time engineers spend manually mapping, transforming, stitching, and reconciling disparate fab, demand, and tool datasets. * Partner with data engineering and business intelligence teams to establish a robust single source of truth for fab capacity, equipment lines, capital planning, and customer allocations. * Institutionalize automated exception handling, data anomaly detection, and self\-healing data pipelines across critical planning feeds. **4\. Industry Benchmarking and External Innovation** * Actively benchmark peer semiconductor foundries and adjacent hyper\-capital\-intensive industries, including advanced aerospace, automotive, display, and energy, for state\-of\-the\-art planning systems, algorithmic optimization, and operational efficiency methodologies. * Evaluate commercial off\-the\-shelf (COTS) platforms versus proprietary internal builds and develop disciplined business cases, ROI models, and technology roadmaps for executive review. * Bring external best practices into Foundry Capacity Optimization (FCO), fostering a culture of continuous modernization, technological curiosity, and systems thinking. **5\. Stakeholder Alignment and Change Leadership** * Function as a trusted technical advisor and thought partner to Staff AMs, Principal Engineers, and executive management. * Drive operational change management across diverse engineering disciplines, ensuring seamless adoption of new digital tools, automated interfaces, and standardized workflows. * Mentor and upskill the broader engineering cohort in modern analytical tools, automation scripts, and systems\-level problem solving. **Required Skills and Experience** * Proficiency with data analysis and automation tools such as SQL, Python, Excel, business intelligence platforms, or similar technologies. * Experience developing capacity models, facility layouts, or manufacturing systems. * Knowledge of supply chain processes, production systems, or factory operations. * Familiarity with forecasting methodologies and statistical techniques. **Preferred Skills and Experience** * Experience within high\-volume semiconductor manufacturing, semiconductor foundry operations, or complex wafer fab supply chains, including familiarity with fab toolsets, lithography/etch/thin\-film constraints, cycle\-time dynamics, and capacity models. * Familiarity with commercial supply chain/capacity planning suites such as Kinaxis, Anaplan, SAP IBP, and Blue Yonder, as well as modern business intelligence architectures. * Experience engaging with and directing external technology vendors, systems integrators, and management consultants to execute technology pilots and full\-scale rollouts. * Demonstrated expertise in Lean, Six Sigma, Design for Excellence, or formal Business Process Re\-engineering (BPR). **Qualifications:** ------------------- * Bachelor's/BS degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Operations Research, or a related field. * 12\+ years of experience with a Bachelor's degree, 8\+ years with a Master's degree, or 6\+ years with a PhD in a relevant domain. We invite you to bring your expertise, vision, and creativity to make a meaningful impact on Intel's manufacturing future. Join us in shaping the next generation of technology solutions. **Job Type:** ------------- Experienced Hire **Shift:** ---------- Shift 1 (United States of America) **Primary Location:** --------------------- US, Oregon, Hillsboro **Additional Locations:** ------------------------- US, Arizona, Phoenix, US, California, Santa Clara **Posting Statement:** ---------------------- All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military and veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender, gender expression, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by local law, regulation, or ordinance. **Position of Trust** --------------------- This role is a Position of Trust. Should you accept this position, you must consent to and pass an extended Background Investigation, which includes (subject to country law), extended education, SEC sanctions, and additional criminal and civil checks. For internals, this investigation may or may not be completed prior to starting the position. For additional questions, please contact your Recruiter. **Benefits** ------------ We offer a total compensation package that ranks among the best in the industry. It consists of competitive pay, stock bonuses, and benefit programs which include health, retirement, and vacation. Find out more about the benefits of working at Intel . Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific compensation range for your preferred location during the hiring process. **Work Model for this Role** This role will be eligible for our hybrid work model which allows employees to split their time between working on\-site at their assigned Intel site and off\-site. \* Job posting details (such as work model, location or time type) are subject to change. * ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: Intel is committed to Responsible Business Alliance (RBA) compliance and ethical hiring practices. jobs.title: AI Data Engineer
jobs.description: **SUMMARY:** The AI Data Engineer is a hands\-on technical expert who builds the data foundation and AI\-driven applications that help InterMed automate work and make better decisions. The role develops custom applications and AI agents that automate business and clinical workflows end to end, creatively leverages EMR and other healthcare data, and helps the Business Intelligence (BI) team grow its Python and AI\-assisted development skills. It also builds and optimizes InterMed’s cloud data platform on Microsoft Fabric and Power BI, including the semantic models that power AI\-assisted reporting and self\-service, while supporting the existing SQL environment as workloads move to Fabric. The ideal candidate combines strong data engineering fundamentals with hands\-on experience in LLM and AI tooling and is excited to leverage AI capabilities to reshape data strategy **CORE RESPONSIBILITIES:** * **Data Platform** + Assist with the migration of BI workloads from the on\-premises SQL and SSIS environment to Microsoft Fabric; assess which legacy packages to retire, rebuild, or re\-architect, and maintain existing SQL Server, SSMS\-based workflows, and SSIS packages to ensure continuity of reporting during the transition + Design and build data pipelines into Fabric OneLake from source systems (for example, eClinicalWorks, payer and ACO files etc.), including orchestration, scheduling, dependency management, alerting, and failure recovery + Complete the data warehouse build\-out across priority subject areas, applying a SQL\-based transformation framework (for example, dbt) for modular, tested, version\-controlled, and documented data models + Build and publish certified Power BI semantic models with governed measures, definitions, and business\-friendly descriptions that power Copilot report building and self\-service data agents, and support the transition of reporting from Tableau to Power BI + Build and maintain Python automation scripts and APIs that support data pipelines, applications, and agents + Ensure strong data quality, integrity, and security controls across the platform, including HIPAA and PHI safeguards and automated monitoring and alerting on key data quality metrics * **AI Use \& Development** + Evaluate and integrate LLM\-powered tooling (for example, Claude, Copilot, or equivalent) to accelerate data workflows and enable natural\-language data access + Establish team standards for responsible AI\-assisted development, including use of AI tools to write, review, test, and document code and queries, with human review of generated output + Use AI to optimize dashboard builds and capabilities for end user agents and self\-service analytics + Design, build, and deploy purpose\-built applications and AI agents that automate BI, IT, other administrative and clinical workflows end to end, from data intake through action and audit trail + Develop custom apps and agents using low\-code tools within the Microsoft ecosystem (for example, Power Apps, Power Automate, and Fabric data agents) and Python\- and LLM\-based custom agents for multi\-step workflows where low\-code tools fall short + Creatively leverage EMR and other data sources, including structured fields, clinical documentation, and other unstructured sources, to support new analytics, automation, and clinical and operational use cases, in compliance with HIPAA and PHI safeguards + Partner with IT on the integration, deployment, and ongoing operation of applications and agents + Serve as an advisor to IT and business partners on AI vendor point solutions: assessing fit, overlap with in\-house capabilities, data access and integration requirements, and build\-versus\-buy tradeoffs + Develop analyst capability in Python, flexible coding, unstructured data techniques, and AI\-assisted development through coaching, code review, and shared patterns and templates + Maintains strict confidentiality in alignment with HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability) guidelines and InterMed policies. + Perform other duties to support the mission, vision and values of InterMed. **MISSION AND VALUES:** * Follows InterMed’s mission to provide patient\-centered primary care, putting the patient first to deliver high quality, high value care. * Provide the highest quality care to our patients with a level of service that exceeds their expectations. * Maintain a positive attitude and always treat our patients and each other with dignity and respect. * Insist on honesty and integrity from each other and our business partners. * Make teamwork a core component of our relationships between physicians, colleagues, and patients. * Embrace change to better serve our patients. * Use business practices that feature individual accountability and group responsibility to ensure delivery of high value healthcare. * Have fun as we carry out our mission to serve. **SKILLS \& COMPETENCIES:** * Python or equivalent for data engineering: writing modular, testable pipeline code, custom operators, and data quality scripts * Proficient SQL and strong data modeling expertise, including dimensional modeling, star schema design, and performance optimization — with hands\-on experience in SQL Server environments * Uses AI coding assistants and LLM\-powered tools as part of everyday work to accelerate data engineering, analysis, and documentation; applies judgment, reviews AI\-generated output, and understands AI’s limitations * Experience designing Power BI semantic models, including relationships, governed measures, and descriptions that support accurate AI\-generated reports and answers * Deep knowledge of modern data architecture patterns (for example, lakehouse, medallion, or cloud ELT) and the ability to map a path from legacy on\-premises environments to those patterns * Hands\-on experience with a SQL\-based transformation framework (for example, dbt) and a pipeline orchestration tool * Experience building applications or AI agents that automate multi\-step workflows, using low\-code platforms (for example, Power Apps and Power Automate) and/or Python with LLM APIs and agent frameworks * Ability to work with unstructured and semi\-structured data (for example, clinical notes, documents, and JSON) in addition to relational data * Ability to coach analysts with varied technical backgrounds and raise team coding standards * Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric and Power BI and how they fit within a broader Microsoft environment (Azure, M365, Microsoft Entra ID) preferred * Experience in healthcare, health tech, or regulated environments; HIPAA/PHI familiarity a plus * Strong analytical reasoning and problem\-solving skills; able to operate effectively in ambiguous environments and lead through uncertainty * Clear communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts, architecture tradeoffs, and migration plans to non\-technical audiences and leadership **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:** * **Education:** + Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience * **Experience**: + 3\-5 years of hands\-on experience with AI, data engineering, BI development, or data architecture, with demonstrated ownership of production pipelines and infrastructure + Proficiency in Python for data engineering: transformation, automation, pipeline development and data quality scripts + Advanced SQL skills with hands\-on experience in SQL Server and SSMS\-based environments preferred + Hands\-on, daily experience using AI coding assistants and AI tools (for example, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar) to write, test, debug, and document code and queries + Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric, Azure data services, Snowflake or a comparable cloud data platform, and how it integrates within a broader Microsoft technology environment + Deep understanding of data engineering, analytics, and end\-to\-end data workflows from source system to consumption layer + Demonstrated experience delivering at least one production application, automation, or AI agent that replaced a manual business process + Experience with version control, CI/CD workflows, and code review practices for data assets + Demonstrated ability to design, document, and govern enterprise data models and architecture Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. jobs.title: Senior AI Systems Engineer / Architect
jobs.description: Overview: CSG AI is building advanced AI systems for Keysight CSG that bring together agentic reasoning, machine learning, reinforcement learning, engineering software, simulation, emulation, measurement, and product integration to transform how complex engineering designs are explored, evaluated, and improved. Our ambition is to move beyond isolated AI assistants and point solutions. We are building systems that can understand engineering intent, reason across tools and data, coordinate specialized capabilities, act on virtual and physical engineering environments, and learn from the results. The goal is a foundation for AI\-driven engineering at scale, where intelligent systems can connect design intent to simulation, emulation, instruments, measurements, and product workflows, helping engineers explore larger design spaces and turn complex workflows into repeatable, adaptive, and increasingly autonomous capabilities. Responsibilities: **Role Overview** ================= As a Senior AI Systems Engineer / Architect, you will define and build the architectural backbone that connects AI reasoning with Keysight engineering tools, data, models, services, and products. You will design how agents represent state and context, coordinate work, invoke tools, exchange structured information, and interact with engineering environments. Your systems will span the full fidelity spectrum, from software simulators and digital models, through real\-time and hardware\-in\-the\-loop emulators, to instruments, measurement systems, lab automation, and physical test workflows. You will create the integration patterns that allow AI capabilities to operate coherently across these environments rather than as isolated prototypes. This is a hands\-on architecture and systems engineering role. You will shape core agentic abstractions while also building production\-quality software, APIs, orchestration services, tool interfaces, and backend integrations. You will work closely with ML, RL, Agentic DevSecOps, product, and domain teams to turn advanced AI capabilities into engineering systems that are powerful, extensible, reliable, and ready to become part of Keysight products and workflows. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== * Architect and implement the core agentic systems that connect LLMs and other reasoning models with engineering tools, APIs, data services, learned models, policies, and product workflows. * Design orchestration and multi\-agent reasoning flows using graph\-based, tool\-calling, or equivalent architectures, including clear semantics for state, context, memory, coordination, and execution. * Build backend services, APIs, SDKs, and integration layers that allow intelligent systems to invoke engineering capabilities, retrieve context, execute multi\-step workflows, and return structured, verifiable results. * Integrate AI systems with Keysight CSG engineering environments across design, simulation, emulation, physical measurement, test automation, laboratory systems, and product software. * Define robust agent and tool contracts, structured schemas, validation interfaces, state models, and error handling patterns that support predictable and extensible execution. * Design context, retrieval, memory, and persistence mechanisms that allow AI systems to reason over engineering intent, product knowledge, design artifacts, simulation and emulation results, measurement data, and workflow history. * Build production\-quality orchestration services with modular architecture, versioning, observability, tracing, auditability, and clear failure and recovery behavior. * Create reusable integration patterns for connecting AI systems with existing engineering platforms, enterprise services, data pipelines, compute environments, and product software. * Collaborate with product, UX, and application teams to turn agentic capabilities into compelling engineering experiences through product features, operator workflows, APIs, and intelligent assistants. * Partner with Agentic DevSecOps and runtime teams so agent workflows can be validated, monitored, governed, replayed, and operated reliably in production environments. * Work with ML and RL engineers to integrate learned models, representations, policies, evaluations, and feedback loops into larger agentic systems. * Prototype new agentic concepts rapidly, then harden the successful ones into maintainable, testable, documented, and production\-quality software components. * Define technical standards and architectural patterns for agent interfaces, tool integration, orchestration, APIs, context management, and product quality across CSG AI. Qualifications: **Required Qualifications** =========================== * BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent industry experience. * Typically 5\+ years of relevant experience building production software systems, AI platforms, distributed applications, engineering tools, or intelligent systems, with demonstrated ownership of system architecture or complex integrations. * Strong software engineering skills in Python and C\+\+ or another production systems language, with the ability to move between high\-level AI frameworks and lower\-level engineering integrations. * Experience architecting and building backend services, REST or gRPC APIs, SDKs, service integrations, and production software components. * Hands\-on experience with LLM application development, tool\-calling, agentic workflows, RAG, context management, or orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, or equivalent systems. * Strong understanding of distributed systems, asynchronous execution, state management, concurrency, reliability patterns, and integration architecture. * Experience integrating software systems with external engineering tools, data sources, compute systems, workflow engines, or enterprise platforms. * Ability to design clean, structured interfaces for agents, tools, data exchange, validation, authorization, and error recovery. * Experience building maintainable production software with automated testing, version control, CI/CD practices, observability, profiling, and clear technical documentation. * Ability to translate emerging AI techniques into practical system architectures and collaborate across AI research, systems engineering, product engineering, and technical domain teams. **Preferred Qualifications** ============================ * Experience integrating AI systems with engineering design, simulation, emulation, measurement, test automation, lab instrumentation, or other physical engineering workflows. * Experience with Keysight or similar electronic design, validation, measurement, test, lab automation, wireless, semiconductor, or telecom engineering environments. * Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), Agent\-to\-Agent communication, structured tool protocols, or custom agent runtime interfaces and interoperability standards. * Experience with vector databases, knowledge graphs, semantic retrieval, multimodal context, document processing, or engineering knowledge systems. * Experience designing product\-facing AI features, copilots, autonomous engineering workflows, operator experiences, or AI\-enabled engineering applications. * Experience with GPU\-backed inference, model serving, prompt and model versioning, evaluation pipelines, and performance optimization for AI workloads. * Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, cloud\-native or on\-premises distributed services, observability tools, and production deployment patterns. * Familiarity with hardware\-in\-the\-loop systems, digital twins, emulator control, instrument control, SCPI, VISA, measurement automation, or real\-time engineering systems. * Experience with security, authorization, policy enforcement, audit trails, validation, or governance mechanisms for AI\-enabled workflows. * Background in high\-performance computing, scientific computing, EDA, wireless systems, semiconductor workflows, electronic measurement, or other complex engineering domains. Santa Rosa, CA Pay Range: MIN $156,740\.00 \- MAX $261,230\.00 Careers Privacy Statement\*\*\*Keysight is an Equal Opportunity Employer.\*\*\*

distributed systems. * Demonstrated experience designing and launching AI/ML systems in production at scale * Strong proficiency in Python (or a similar backend language such as Go, Java, or Scala). * Experience with cloud infrastructure and platform fundamentals (AWS, kubernetes): * Familiarity with data\-intensive systems: streaming or batch processing, data modeling, and designing systems with large\-scale data in mind (spark, ray\-data). * Comfortable collaborating with cross\-functional technical partners (ML, product, infra, security). * Strong communication skills and a track record of driving technical excellence across teams. **What to Expect in Your First 90 Days** **30 Days** * Complete Klaviyo boot camp and onboarding for the AI \& Analytics organization. * Build strong context on our AI/ML stack, platform components, and roadmap. * Meet your team, engineering peers, and key stakeholders across product, ML, infra, and security. * Onboard to existing technical workstreams and gain familiarity with production ML deployment pipelines. **60 Days** * Deliver high\-impact architectural enhancements or core features across the ML Platform end\-to\-end. * Conduct deep technical dives into platform architecture and mentor peers through detailed code and design reviews. * Partner with staff/principal engineers and product leaders to establish technical standards and design patterns for feature platform components. * Partner with product and technical leaders to shape the next 2–3 quarters of roadmap at a high level. **90 Days** * Own accountability for delivery, reliability, and operational health of key ML Platform systems in your area. * Have multiple features or platform capabilities shipped that are in active use by ML/AI product teams. * Participate fully in on\-call and incident management for your team's services. * Contribute to broader AI/ML strategy and platform direction, influencing how Klaviyo builds and operates models at scale. *This role may require up to 10% travel for purposes such as new hire onboarding, client or partner work if applicable, team meetings, and industry events. Travel is coordinated in advance.* **Get to Know Klaviyo** We're Klaviyo (pronounced clay\-vee\-oh). We empower creators to own their destiny by making first\-party data accessible and actionable like never before. We see limitless potential for the technology we're developing to nurture personalized experiences in ecommerce and beyond. To reach our goals, we need our own crew of remarkable creators—ambitious and collaborative teammates who stay focused on our north star: delighting our customers. jobs.title: Financial Operations Engineer (REMOTE)
jobs.description: Applications for this position will be accepted through 11/13/26\. Koniag IT Systems, LLC a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking a Financial Operations Engineer to support KITS and our government customer. The position is remote. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, flexible spending accounts, commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement. Koniag IT Systems, LLC a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking a skilled AWS FinOps Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will leverage AWS advanced analytics and analysis techniques to extract valuable insights from complex datasets. This position offers the opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technologies and contribute to mission\-critical projects while solving challenging analytical problems. The FinOps Engineer will be responsible for analyzing, forecasting, and optimizing AWS cloud spend, developing cost visibility tools, and collaborating with team members and customers to drive cost\-effective cloud use. This is a hands\-on role. You will build the dashboards, automation, and governance that let teams move fast on AWS while spending wisely. **Key Responsibilities include:** * Analyze and monitor spend: Track AWS usage and cost using Cost Explorer, Cost and Usage Reports (CUR), Cost Optimization Hub, Budgets, and Trusted Advisor, plus third\-party platforms such as CloudHealth, Cloudability, or CloudZero. * Find and eliminate waste: Identify idle, orphaned, and overprovisioned resources across compute, storage, networking, databases, and managed services, and quantify the savings of each opportunity. * Manage commitments: Recommend and manage Savings Plans, Reserved Instances, and Spot usage, tracking coverage and utilization to maximize discount without overcommitting. * Build visibility: Create and maintain dashboards, executive summaries, and show back/chargeback reporting (QuickSight, Tableau, Power BI) for engineering, finance, and leadership. * Forecast and budget: Deliver forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis, partnering with Finance on planning cycles and explaining month\-over\-month changes in plain business terms. * Detect anomalies: Configure cost anomaly detection and alerting and lead rapid investigation and remediation of unexpected spend. * Drive cost allocation: Design and enforce tagging standards and account structure (AWS Organizations, Service Control Policies, tag policies) so every dollar maps to a team, product, or customer. * Automate controls: Use Terraform or CloudFormation and scripting (Python, Bash) to automate rightsizing, scheduling, tag compliance, and budget guardrails, and integrate cost checks into CI/CD pipelines. * Partner with engineering: Advise on cost\-efficient architecture (including Kubernetes/EKS, containers, and serverless) without compromising performance, reliability, or security. * Mature the FinOps practice: Define KPIs such as cost per unit, savings realized, and commitment coverage; run regular stakeholder reviews; and deliver training and documentation that spread FinOps best practices. **Education and Experience:** * Proven experience with machine learning and statistical modeling. * Bachelor's degree (Master's degree in a quantitative or technical field preferred) in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, Engineering, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years of experience in cloud cost optimization, FinOps, or cloud engineering, with a strong focus on AWS. * Deep understanding of AWS pricing and billing models and the cost drivers of core services (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, EKS, data transfer). * Hands\-on experience with AWS cost tooling (Cost Explorer, CUR, Budgets) and at least one FinOps platform or BI tool. * Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform or CloudFormation) and scripting for automation (Python, Bash, or PowerShell). * Proven ability to translate technical usage into financial insight and to communicate with both engineers and finance leaders. * Working knowledge of FinOps principles and the Inform, Optimize, Operate lifecycle. **Required Skills and Competencies:** * Strong understanding of AWS pricing models, services, and cost management tools. * FinOps Certified Practitioner (or higher) and/or AWS certifications such as Cloud Practitioner, Solutions Architect, or DevOps Engineer. * Familiarity with the FinOps Open Cost and Usage Specification (FOCUS). * Experience with Kubernetes cost allocation and optimization (EKS, Kubecost) and with serverless and container architectures. * Experience with multi\-account governance at scale and multi\-cloud cost management (Azure, GCP). * SQL and data\-analysis skills (for example Athena over CUR data) and experience building financial or forecasting models. * Experience building cost awareness into DevOps or CI/CD workflows and working in Agile/Scrum teams. * Background establishing or maturing a FinOps practice, including executive reporting and unit\-economics metrics. * Analytical and data\-driven, with strong financial modeling instincts. * Influences without authority; builds trust with engineering and finance alike. * Clear written and verbal communicator who can tell the story behind the numbers. * Balances cost efficiency with reliability, performance, and speed of delivery. * Curious, self\-directed, and comfortable operating in ambiguity. Our Equal Employment Opportunity Policy The company is an equal opportunity employer. The company shall not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, color, religion, creed, ethnicity, sex, sexual orientation, gender or gender identity (except where gender is a bona fide occupational qualification), national origin or ancestry, age, disability, citizenship, military/veteran status, marital status, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We are committed to equal employment opportunity in all decisions related to employment, promotion, wages, benefits, and all other privileges, terms, and conditions of employment. The company is dedicated to seeking all qualified applicants. If you require an accommodation to navigate or apply for a position on our website, please get in touch with Heaven Wood via e\-mail at accommodations@koniag\-gs.com or by calling 703\-488\-9377 to request accommodations. Koniag Government Services (KGS) is an Alaska Native Owned corporation supporting the values and traditions of our native communities through an agile employee and corporate culture that delivers Enterprise Solutions, Professional Services and Operational Management to Federal Government Agencies. As a wholly owned subsidiary of Koniag, we apply our proven commercial solutions to a deep knowledge of Defense and Civilian missions to provide forward leaning technical, professional, and operational solutions. KGS enables successful mission outcomes for our customers through solution\-oriented business partnerships and a commitment to exceptional service delivery. We ensure long\-term success with a continuous improvement approach while balancing the collective interests of our customers, employees, and native communities. For more information, please visit www.koniag\-gs.com. Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled. Shareholder Preference in accordance with Public Law 88\-352

jobs.description: Full\-Time In Person Hybrid (2\-4 days/week): Boston, MA Headquarters *Set the technical direction for the engine behind grid intelligence, from raw sensor data to the ratings that utilities act on.* We are seeking a **Staff Software Engineer** to join our LineRate team and set the architecture and technical strategy for the systems that turn massive time\-series sensor data into the ratings our utility customers rely on. If you want to own technical problems across teams and help shape how utilities get affordable, reliable power onto the grid, join us at **LineVision**, *Built In Boston Best Places to Work*! ### **What will you do?** **Core Responsibilities and Key Performance Objectives** * Develop the technical architecture for the ratings generation library and its microservice, the slimmed\-down customer\-deployable product, weather modeling tools, and front end visualizations, and keep those codebases coherent as they grow. * Partner with data scientists to set the path from research code to reliable, scalable production services, and develop reusable frameworks that make that path faster for the whole team. * Work with UI/UX and Product to design the APIs and data contracts that surface the right data at the right time. * Design storage and retrieval strategies for massive time\-series data sets, and own the tradeoffs on cost, latency and accuracy. * Lead complex, multi\-team technical initiatives from scoping through delivery, and guide teams through execution. * Influence roadmap priorities with Product and Engineering leadership, weighing customer benefit against time to implement and long\-term technical cost. * Coach engineers through design reviews, code review and pairing, and build programs that grow the team’s technical capability. * This role requires participation in a compensated rotational on\-call schedule. On\-call responsibilities are a condition of employment for this position. **Within the first 3 months:** * Learn how the ratings library, customer product, weather modeling and front end connect, and ship a meaningful contribution to at least one of them. * Build working relationships with Data Science, UI/UX, Product and engineering peers. * Deliver a written assessment of current architecture, with the top technical risks and opportunities ranked by customer impact. **Within the first 6 months:** * Lead the design and delivery of an initiative that spans multiple codebases or teams. * Propose and drive a concrete improvement to how we store or retrieve time\-series data at scale. * Bring a clear technical point of view to roadmap discussions and influence the decisions that come out of them. **Within the first year:** * Be the recognized technical authority for at least one core codebase and make the architectural decisions that others build on. * Lead a cross\-functional initiative with Data Science, UI/UX or Product from scoping through delivery, and answer for its outcome. * Coach multiple engineers, and put in place at least one practice or program (design review process, onboarding guide, shared frameworks) that raises how the whole team works. ### **How to succeed in this role** **Key Competencies** * **Critical Thinking:** Develop frameworks for solving complex problems in ratings generation, weather modeling and time\-series storage, and mentor others in applying them. Approach new problems with curiosity. * **Delivering Innovative Solutions:** Develop innovative technical strategies and guide teams in executing them. Embrace ambiguity and iterate with a growth mindset. * **Taking Ownership:** Coach others to take ownership and drive accountability across teams. Communicate proactively when scope or technical constraints shift. * **Follow Through \- Execution:** Deliver quality work on time across teams and projects. Resolve open questions with stakeholders and hold yourself and others accountable to commitments. * **Empowering Others:** Develop programs and initiatives that grow other engineers. Share knowledge freely and foster a supportive team environment where outcomes matter more than individual output. * **Stakeholder Management:** Develop strategies for working with Data Science, UI/UX, Product and customer\-facing teams, and influence decision\-making on priorities and tradeoffs. **Essential Skills** * Expert proficiency in Python and JavaScript/TypeScript, with strong experience in React. * Proven experience designing and evolving systems with at least one relational database and one NoSQL database. * Experience deploying and operating production systems on a major cloud platform. * Track record of setting architecture across the stack, from data storage through APIs to UI. * Experience leading technical initiatives across multiple engineers or teams, and mentoring other engineers. **What Sets the Best Candidates Apart** * Experience with Kubernetes. * Experience with Rust. * Experience designing large\-scale time\-series data systems. * Background working closely with data science or applied science teams to productionize research code. * Experience building engineering practices or programs that scaled beyond your own team. **Reporting \& Team Structure** * Reports to the **Senior Software Engineering Manager** * Collaborates closely with Data Science, UI/UX, and Product teams, and acts as a technical lead and mentor for engineers on the LineRate team. **Interview Process** * Apply Online. * Round 1: Phone screen (Recruiter) * Round 2: Hiring Manager Interview * Round 3: Panel Interviews + Panel 1: Technical competency, architecture and system design + Panel 2: Technical leadership, collaboration and communication * Final Round: Leadership Team \& Hiring Manager Sign\-Off (onsite) ### **What does joining LineVision mean for you?** * **Impact.** Your talent, time, and energy will critically impact our success in accelerating our mission of providing utilities with grid intelligence to enable affordable, reliable power. * **Ownership.** You will hold broad responsibilities with high autonomy and trust in a communicative, collaborative, and fast\-paced environment. * **Flexibility.** You will be empowered to maintain jobs.title: Scrum Master
jobs.description: Overview: LMI is seeking a **Scrum Master** to support Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) digital modernization and technology delivery initiatives. This full\-time role provides hands\-on Agile delivery leadership across multiple concurrent Scrum teams, helping multidisciplinary teams plan, execute, inspect, and improve work while maintaining clear visibility into commitments, dependencies, risks, and outcomes. The Scrum Master IV will manage multiple Jira boards, facilitate core Scrum ceremonies, support backlog readiness, coordinate cross\-team dependencies, remove impediments, and use delivery metrics to improve predictability and flow. The role partners closely with Product Owners, technical leads, designers, analysts, engineers, QA resources, and program leadership while preserving clear ownership of product, technical, and delivery decisions. The successful candidate must operate beyond a single\-team Scrum Master model. This individual should be comfortable balancing several teams, facilitating Scrum\-of\-Scrums and other cross\-team coordination, improving Jira and Agile discipline, coaching teams toward greater self\-management, and distinguishing team\-level impediments from program\-level dependencies. Strong facilitation, judgment, and data\-informed delivery management are essential. LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial\-grade platforms and mission\-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed. Leveraging our mission\-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value. Responsibilities: * Serve as Scrum Master for multiple concurrent Scrum teams, adapting facilitation and coaching to each team's maturity, work type, composition, and mission priorities. * Plan and facilitate sprint planning, daily Scrums, backlog refinement, sprint reviews/demos, retrospectives, and other Agile ceremonies; keep sessions focused, decision\-oriented, and appropriately time\-boxed. * Own the day\-to\-day health of multiple Jira boards, including workflows, issue hygiene, sprint setup, statuses, dependencies, labels/components, dashboards, filters, and reporting views. * Partner with Product Owners to maintain prioritized, actionable backlogs with clear acceptance criteria, dependencies, sequencing, and readiness for upcoming sprints. * Track commitments, sprint progress, blockers, carryover, scope movement, defects, and delivery risks; surface material issues early and facilitate resolution or escalation. * Coordinate dependencies across Scrum teams and shared resources such as engineering, data, architecture, UX/HCD, QA, security, platform, and other delivery functions. * Facilitate Scrum\-of\-Scrums, cross\-team planning, dependency reviews, and release\-readiness discussions when work spans several teams or shared milestones. * Use delivery measures such as velocity, throughput, cycle time, lead time, work in progress, burndown/burnup, aging work, and carryover to identify trends and support continuous improvement. * Coach teams on Scrum values, self\-management, estimation, work decomposition, sustainable delivery, definition of ready/done, and effective retrospectives without becoming the team's task manager. * Coach Product Owners and stakeholders on backlog quality, prioritization, acceptance criteria, sprint goals, scope tradeoffs, and appropriate engagement with delivery teams. * Remove impediments within the Scrum Master's control and work with program leadership to resolve organizational, resource, approval, environment, access, and cross\-team barriers. * Connect sprint\-level execution to broader milestones and release objectives while maintaining transparency about capacity, constraints, dependencies, and forecast confidence. * Prepare concise, Jira\-based delivery views for program leadership that emphasize progress, risks, dependencies, decisions needed, and forecast confidence rather than activity counts alone. * Mentor less\-experienced Scrum Masters or Agile practitioners and contribute reusable ceremony guides, Jira standards, metrics definitions, and team\-health practices across the program.
