jobs.title: Engineer Lead
jobs.description: Overview: LSAC’s mission is to advance law and justice by promoting access, equity, and fairness in law school admission, to broaden the pathway into legal education, and to support law schools, law students, and the legal education community. ***Pay rate: $125,000 to $133,000, depending on experience \- This is a remote position.*** We are seeking an **Engineer Lead with Generative AI experience**. You will work as part of an autonomous agile team to develop features and applications to meet the needs of the Technology Solutions and Platforms department. We are looking for a candidate with a deep understanding of engineering best practices and a strong agile mindset. As lead, you are responsible for ensuring the team's alignment with best practices, enterprise architecture, and stakeholder satisfaction. In addition, this position is responsible for operational maintenance, troubleshooting, and support of applicable back\-end systems. We rely heavily on web\-based services, and you will have the opportunity to work with new and interesting technology. This role carries an expanded mandate to **design, prototype, and deliver Generative AI solutions** that directly enhance LSAC products and internal tooling. LSAC currently uses **GitHub Copilot** as its primary AI\-assisted development tool; this role will own that practice and *grow it*—expanding our AI capabilities into large language models (LLMs), retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), agentic workflows, and responsible AI practices. You will partner with the Software Development Manager (SDM), data engineers, and stakeholders to identify high\-value AI opportunities and bring them to production. Equally critical is the **human side of this transformation****.** This person will be a hands\-on change agent for Generative AI adoption across the engineering organization—translating emerging AI capabilities into practical, day\-to\-day habits for developers, testers, and product teams. You will design and run enablement programs, lead by example in code, and build the organization's confidence and fluency with AI tooling from the ground up. Responsibilities: **Essential Job Functions** Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position. The individual employed in this position will be required to: * Collaborate with partners within the company to design, configure, maintain, and promote a variety of internally\- and externally facing applications. * Collaborate across areas to ensure application reliability and coding to architectural standards. * Support product teams by advocating for their needs and providing constructive guidance. * Provide the glue across dependent teams to ensure technical dependencies are planned for and addressed in a fast\-paced environment. * Connect with developers within your team to coach, inspire, and foster a continuous learning environment. * Build and maintain scalable full\-stack applications. * Continuously monitor, test, and optimize software. * Collaborate with software engineers, the Software Development Manager (SDM), analysts, and stakeholders to deliver solutions that meet or exceed customer expectations. * Contribute as part of the team by leveraging continuous delivery methods and test\-driven development to frequently deliver new functionality. * Deliver high\-quality code and hold the team to the same standard through code review and mentoring. * Work to scale software to support dynamic teams in a fast\-paced environment. * Be a contributor of knowledge to the team by reviewing code, sharing experience, and listening. * Champion and govern team\-wide use of GitHub Copilot – establish prompting standards, review AI\-generated code for security and quality, track productivity metrics, and coach developers on effective, responsible use of AI\-assisted development. * Drive organizational Gen\-AI adoption: build and execute a structured enablement roadmap that moves the engineering organization from awareness to competency, delivering workshops lunch\-and\-learns, hands\-on labs, and reference implementations that make AI tooling tangible and accessible for developers at all levels. * Coach and mentor engineers on Gen\-AI practices, provide 1:1 and team\-level guidance on integrating AI into daily workflows including AI\-assisted coding, AI\-augmented code review, AI\-accelerated test generation (unit, integration, regression), and effective use of AI in debugging and documentation. Help engineers build critical evaluation skills for vetting AI\-generated output. * Act as internal AI change agent. Identify adoption blockers, measure team AI maturity over time, gather feedback from engineers and stakeholders, and continuously iterate on enablement programs; evangelize Gen\-AI success stories across the broader Technology Solutions and Platforms organization. * Architect and implement Generative AI features using Azure OpenAI Service, OpenAI  Copilot Chat, and enforcing code review standards for AI\-generated output. Ability to configure and manage Copilot at the organization/repository level via GitHub Enterprise settings. * Prompt engineering \& evaluation – ability to design structured prompts, implement few\-shot and chain\-of\-thought patterns, and use evaluation frameworks (Azure AI Evaluation, Promptflow, Ragas, or similar) to measure quality and regression. * Responsible AI \& AI governance – understanding of content safety controls, PII handling in LLM contexts, model fairness, explainability, and Microsoft Responsible AI principles. * Experience with agentic AI patterns (AutoGen, Azure AI Agent Search, tool\-calling, multi\-agent orchestration) preferred. * Familiarity with MLOps/LLMOps practices, fine\-tuning pipelines, model versioning, deployment monitoring, and drift detection preferred. Qualifications: **Education and Experience** * 5–10 years of experience in full stack software engineering. * B.A. or B.S. degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field. * Master's degree preferred. * Azure certifications (e.g., AZ\-204, AZ\-400, AZ\-305\) preferred. * Azure AI certifications – AI\-102 (Azure AI Engineer Associate) and/or Microsoft certified, Azure OpenAI certification or equivalent demonstrated proficiency preferred. * Coursework, certifications, or verifiable project experience in machine learning fundamentals, natural language processing, or applied AI/ML (e.g., DeepLearning.AI, fast.ai, Coursera ML Specialization) preferred. Supervisory Responsibilities This role does not have people management responsibilities. This is an individual contributor lead role without direct people management responsibilities. The engineer lead provides technical guidance, code review, and mentorship to team members but does not carry formal HR or performance\-evaluation authority. Position Type The LSAC standard business hours are Monday\-Friday, 8:30 a.m. \- 4:45 p.m. ET. While these are the standard office hours for LSAC, as an exempt employee, the employee will be expected to work the hours necessary to satisfactorily complete their assignments in a responsible and professional manner. Work Environment This job operates in a remote and professional office environment. jobs.description: The Accelerator Physics Group (APG) of the Advanced Light Source (ALS), part of the Accelerator Technology \& Applied Physics (ATAP) Division at Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory (LBNL), is seeking a **Postdoctoral Researcher** to develop agentic artificial intelligence (AI) methods and software for accelerator operations. The research will address how agents can reliably perform operational tasks within defined permissions and physical constraints, with appropriate human oversight. The position is part of MOAT\-Core, a multi\-laboratory DOE Genesis Mission program focused on AI\-driven accelerator facilities. In collaboration with accelerator physicists and partner laboratories, you will develop and validate shared capabilities for use across the consortium. **We're here for the same mission, to bring science solutions to the world. (e.g., EPICS, Bluesky, ophyd). * Contributions to open\-source scientific software. **Additional information:** * **Application date:** Priority consideration will be given to candidates who apply by November 16, 2026\. You must have less than 3 years of paid postdoctoral experience. jobs.title: AI Automation & Enablement Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar. Our AI\-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end\-to\-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes. 2,100\+ customers across 80\+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White \& Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to **$200M\+ in ARR**, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler. We partner with world\-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law. Joining Legora means three things. * We **lean in:** ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions. * We **fight for excellence:** high standards, direct, ego\-free feedback. * We **grow together:** as a team and with our customers. Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts. If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place. **About the role** ------------------ We want every employee at Legora to get more from AI. As an AI Automation \& Enablement Engineer, your mission is to raise the baseline of AI fluency across the company and help colleagues have their own aha moments with AI and automation. You’ll work as an embedded engineering partner to internal teams: understand how people work, build useful solutions alongside them and help them develop the confidence and skills to use AI independently. You’ll combine hands\-on building with practical teaching, turning promising experiments into reliable workflows that people use every day. You’ll work with tools such as Claude and Claude Code, OpenAI’s ChatGPT and Codex, Cursor, and other AI and automation platforms. You’ll choose the right approach for the problem, from a better way to use an existing tool to an integration or internal application. **What you’ll be doing** ------------------------ * **Find work worth improving:** Spend time with employees across functions to understand their tasks and identify opportunities to improve quality, reduce manual effort or remove delays. * **Create practical "aha" moments:** Work alongside colleagues on their real tasks. Help them provide useful context, break down problems, evaluate outputs and see where AI can meaningfully improve their work. * **Build automations and internal tools:** Use AI coding tools, scripts, APIs, agents and workflow platforms to take useful ideas through testing, rollout and ongoing use. * **Raise AI fluency:** Run hands\-on sessions and office hours, create clear examples and reusable workflows, and help employees build skills they can apply independently. * **Turn individual wins into shared practice:** Identify approaches that work, make them easy to reuse and help teams develop their own confident AI practitioners. * **Choose tools thoughtfully:** Evaluate new capabilities and explain the tradeoffs in usefulness, reliability, cost and ease of adoption. Simplify the process before automating it. * **Optimize model selection and spend:** Match models to the task, comparing quality, speed and cost to improve employee productivity and reduce unnecessary AI spend. Help teams understand when a faster, lower\-cost model is sufficient and when a more capable model justifies the additional cost. * **Make workflows dependable:** Test outputs and verify actions in connected systems. Work with IT, Security and system owners on appropriate permissions, human review, monitoring and recovery steps. * **Own adoption and improvement:** Follow up after launch, resolve failures and improve what you build based on how people actually use it. * **Measure the results:** Track changes in manual effort, turnaround time, errors, output quality and sustained adoption. Success means better work and more capable employees. **Who you are** --------------- * **A practical builder:** You’ve built automations, integrations or internal tools that other people use. You can explain the problem, your decisions and the resulting impact. * **An active AI power\-user:** You use tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Codex or Cursor for substantive work. You understand their limitations and can judge when AI, conventional automation or a simpler process is appropriate. You can match models to the task, balancing quality, speed and cost to improve productivity and reduce unnecessary spend. * **A clear, patient teacher:** You enjoy working with people at different levels of confidence, explain technical ideas simply and help others solve problems themselves. * **Curious about how work gets done:** You ask useful questions, find the underlying problem and translate a vague request into a practical next step. * **Thoughtful about reliability and access:** You verify results, handle sensitive information carefully and know when an action needs human review or a system owner’s input. * **Accountable after launch:** You follow through on documentation, maintenance and adoption, and stay focused on whether the work is delivering value. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience building internal AI tools or delivering practical AI enablement programs. * Experience connecting agents to business applications, APIs and knowledge sources. * Experience evaluating AI outputs, testing workflows or monitoring integrations. * Examples of tools, guides or workshops that helped colleagues adopt a better way of working. **What’s in it for you** ------------------------ * **Visible impact:** Help employees across Legora do better work and build lasting confidence with AI. * **Room to build:** Work directly with the people using your solutions and see their feedback shape what you deliver. * **Global collaboration:** Partner with colleagues across Europe, APAC and North America. * **Competitive package:** Comprehensive salary, benefits and tools for success. * **In\-person environment:** Union Square office and company provided lunch daily. ### **Benefits \& perks** We invest in our people with a comprehensive, thoughtfully designed benefits package: **Medical, dental \& vision** * Multiple medical plan options through Aetna and Kaiser Permanente * HSA or Healthcare FSA (based on plan selection) * Dental plans via MetLife * Vision plans via Vision Care **Family support** * Generous parental leave * Free access to Maven Clinic * Dependent Care FSA * Free One Medical membership for employees and dependents **Additional perks** * Pre\-tax commuter benefits * Life Insurance \+ STD/LTD * 401(K) with generous company match * Unlimited PTO * Robust voluntary benefits, including identity protection (via Aura), legal coverage via MetLife, pet savings programs, and more **Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer** At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high\-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Compensation Range: $172,550 \- $233,450

jobs.title: Lead Data Engineer
jobs.description: Lead Data Engineer Are you an experienced data engineer who thrives on solving complex technical challenges, leading talented engineers, and pushing the boundaries of what modern data platforms and AI can accomplish? Are you looking for an opportunity to put those skills to work in a Christian ministry whose mission aligns with your faith? Ligonier Ministries is seeking a Lead Data Engineer to provide hands\-on technical leadership for our enterprise data engineering practice. This is an opportunity to shape the next generation of our data infrastructure—leading a major transition from Microsoft Fabric to Databricks while pioneering the responsible use of agentic AI to transform how data engineering gets done. At Ligonier, reliable data enables sound stewardship, informed decisions, and effective ministry operations. Your work will support everything from financial accountability and constituent engagement to advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI—all in service of our mission to proclaim, teach, and defend the holiness of God in all its fullness to as many people as possible. What You'll Do * Lead and mentor a team of data engineers, establishing technical standards, guiding architecture, and ensuring high\-quality delivery. * Drive platform modernization by leading the phased migration of data engineering workloads from Microsoft Fabric to Databricks, leveraging Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Apache Spark, and Lakeflow. * Pioneer AI\-accelerated engineering by integrating agentic AI development tools into engineering workflows to improve productivity, automate repetitive work, and accelerate delivery while maintaining rigorous quality controls. * Own enterprise data reliability, ensuring our data warehouse, pipelines, and integrations deliver accurate, timely, and trustworthy information. * Engineer scalable data solutions using SQL, Python/PySpark, dimensional modeling, and modern lakehouse architectures. * Collaborate across the ministry to turn complex business requirements into dependable data products that enable reporting, analytics, and AI. What You Bring * 10\+ years of progressive data engineering experience, including at least 3 years providing technical leadership for a data warehouse or data platform team. * Expert\-level SQL/T\-SQL and Python/PySpark skills, with proven ability to optimize complex data transformations and pipelines. * Strong Microsoft Fabric and Azure data platform experience, with the ability to assess existing architectures, migrate production workloads to Databricks, and maintain data reliability throughout the transition. * Expert\-level Databricks proficiency, with deep, hands\-on production experience in Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Apache Spark/PySpark, and Lakeflow. Experience leading an enterprise data platform migration to Databricks is strongly preferred. * Demonstrated proficiency with AI\-assisted and agentic development tools, such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or Databricks Genie Code, with a track record of measurable productivity improvements. * Deep knowledge of data architecture, engineering quality, and DevOps, including dimensional modeling, medallion architecture, CI/CD, automated testing, and data governance. * Proven technical leadership and communication skills, with the ability to mentor engineers, coordinate complex projects, and translate technical concepts for diverse stakeholders. * A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related quantitative field (master's preferred). * Agreement with Ligonier Ministries' General Statement of Faith. Experience with nonprofit fundraising, donor management, and financial reconciliation data is highly desirable. Relevant Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, and Azure certifications are also valued. If you're ready to lead meaningful technical innovation, help shape the future of AI\-enabled data engineering, and apply your expertise in service of a mission that matters, we encourage you to apply. Join Ligonier Ministries and lead the next evolution of our data engineering practice—modernizing our platform with Databricks, harnessing agentic AI, and accelerating the impact of data across the ministry. The pay range for this position is $103,000 \- $120,000 annually. Pay ranges represent the lowest to highest salary we reasonably believe we would pay for this role at the time of posting. We may ultimately offer more or less than the posted range, and the ranges may be modified in the future. An employee's position within the salary range will be based on several factors, including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, geographic location, and organizational needs.

jobs.description: Knowledge Engineering Associate Director \| Senior Level \| Full time Job No. R00365647 \| Multiple Locations **About Accenture:** Accenture helps the world's leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Through partnerships with frontier AI labs such as Anthropic and OpenAI, and the leading cloud providers, Accenture delivers end\-to\-end services that drive innovation and business agility. The Digital Core Reinvention practice builds the enterprise ontology — the semantic layer that turns raw data into contextualized enterprise knowledge, and the knowledge agents that maintain, evolve, and query it. Where our problem\-scoped ontology work wields meaning against a single problem, this discipline builds the meaning the whole enterprise stands on. **You Are:** A senior knowledge engineer ready to own the discipline: scaled ontology creation, the semantic layer, and the public technical argument for why AI without engineered meaning is guesswork. This is the senior technical track at Accenture: we hire people here who would rather own a methodology than carry a number. **The Work:** As an Associate Director in this family you are the technical owner of our enterprise knowledge engineering services. Concretely, that means three things at once: **You own the methodology.** ---------------------------- * Scaled ontology creation, semantic\-layer design, knowledge\-agent patterns — yours to defend, evolve, and sign off on, including the boundary with problem\-scoped ontology work (build the ontology here; wield it there). **You own the asset portfolio.** -------------------------------- * Ontology templates, entity\-resolution patterns, semantic serving reference architectures — every engagement consumes or produces one. **You own the technical point of view.** ---------------------------------------- * You can explain the value of the semantic layer to a CFO and defend an OWL modeling decision to an architect in the same meeting — and the market hears the argument from you. Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements. **Here's what you need:** ------------------------- * Minimum of 10 years in knowledge engineering, semantic web, ontology design, or adjacent data disciplines, with at least 2 years specifically on AI/LLM\-based work. * Minimum of 6 years with knowledge\-graph technologies (RDF, SPARQL, SHACL, property graphs) and enterprise graph databases. * Minimum of 6 years of managerial or discipline\-leadership experience, able to explain the value of the semantic layer to senior stakeholders (per the W16 scaffold for this family). * Minimum of 2 years of publishing or speaking publicly in the discipline. * Minimum of 3 years owning a productized offering, platform, or methodology — not just consulting within one. * Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate's Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience). **Professional Skills Required:** * Demonstrated ability to walk into a client executive's office and earn the room on technical depth alone. * A clear, defensible point of view on the current AI frontier — what's real, what's hype, what matters in 18 months — that you can articulate publicly. **Bonus Points if You Have:** * Retrieval\-augmented generation and agent context engineering at enterprise scale. * Experience running ontology governance — versioning meaning the way engineers version code. * Multi\-tenant or federated semantic\-layer architectures. * Comfort being outranked on pipeline conversations and outvoting on technical ones. * A track record of editing methodology the way engineers edit code. * Frontier\-partner relationships (Anthropic, OpenAI, hyperscaler AI orgs, or equivalent). jobs.description: About Lucid At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid's proprietary technology and software\-defined vehicle architecture, our award\-winning vehicles bring our "Compromise Nothing™" approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience. We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in\-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what's possible and shape the future of mobility. The GeoAI team is building next\-generation AI\-powered data automation platforms for ADAS and autonomous driving. We are seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to develop scalable auto\-labeling technologies that transform fleet\-collected sensor data into high\-quality training datasets with minimal human intervention. This role sits at the intersection of machine learning, computer vision, spatial AI, and large\-scale data infrastructure. You will work on perception models, 3D scene reconstruction, foundation models, and automated data\-generation systems that accelerate autonomous\-driving development. **The Role:** **Build Next\-Generation Auto\-Labeling Systems** * Design and deploy production\-scale auto\-labeling solutions for 2D and 3D object detection, semantic and panoptic segmentation, lane and road\-structure extraction, multi\-object tracking, occupancy, scene understanding, and traffic\-participant behavior. * Develop automated label validation, confidence scoring, consistency checks, and quality\-monitoring frameworks. * Build active\-learning and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows that improve label quality while reducing manual annotation effort and turnaround time. * Create teacher\-student and model\-assisted labeling workflows for large\-scale camera and LiDAR datasets. **Develop Advanced Perception and Fusion Models** * Research, train, and evaluate camera\-based and LiDAR\-based detection, segmentation, tracking, depth\-estimation, and occupancy models. * Develop multimodal fusion models combining camera, LiDAR, radar, GNSS/IMU, and map context. * Improve operations. **Responsibilities:** * **Lead critical system debugging as the technical authority**, conducting root\-cause analysis of complex failures involving physical mechanisms, embedded devices, features** to improve the health monitoring, diagnostics, and remote intervention capabilities of the deployed fleet * **Drive improvement in Mytra’s issue capture, analytics, and reporting pipeline**, to maintain a deep understanding of how issues impact and inform engineering priority * **Ensure the operational health of early\-stage prototype fleets**, working side\-by\-side with test The CTO will continue to lead enterprise technical vision and architectural direction; the Vice President of Software Engineering will ensure that direction is translated into effective team structures, sound execution, and measurable results. This is a remote position within the United States. This is a remote position within the United States. The Vice President of Software Engineering must be able to travel to Magna’s Philadelphia\-area offices approximately 10% of the time. Travel may occasionally be scheduled on short notice or occur in consecutive weeks based on business needs. Candidates with convenient access to Philadelphia are preferred. ### **Primary Responsibilities** #### **Engineering Leadership and Organization Development** * Lead Magna's software engineering organization across multiple products and lines of business. * Develop and coach engineering managers, senior technical leaders, and individual contributors, establishing clear accountability and high performance at every level. * Assess and evolve organizational structure, team capacity, role clarity, and leadership coverage as the portfolio grows. * Own workforce planning, hiring, onboarding, performance management, succession planning, career development, the engineering budget, and vendor and contractor relationships for software engineering. * Build a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous improvement, and direct, respectful communication. * Balance durable product alignment with the ability to shift talent across shared components, high\-priority initiatives, and changing business needs. #### **Delivery and Operational Excellence** * Translate company, product, and business\-line priorities into clear engineering roadmaps, staffing plans, and execution commitments. * Establish a consistent operating cadence for planning, prioritization, estimation, delivery, release management, and executive reporting. * Improve the predictability, speed, and transparency of software delivery while maintaining appropriate quality and risk controls. * Proactively identify dependencies, resource constraints, delivery risks, and organizational blockers, and drive them to resolution. * Define and monitor meaningful engineering measures related to delivery, quality, reliability, security, and team health. * Ensure teams own software throughout its lifecycle, from problem definition and design through deployment, monitoring, support, incident response, and ongoing improvement. #### **Software Quality and Technical Execution** * Guide the pragmatic modernization of legacy applications while protecting business continuity and customer experience. * Lead the technical integration of acquired businesses and platforms into Magna's shared capabilities. * Raise standards for software design, code quality, automated testing, observability, documentation, maintainability, and production readiness. * Strengthen engineering practices across APIs, cloud services, distributed systems, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and secure software development. * Ensure software meets the security, privac ality, and predictability. * Strong understanding of modern software architecture, APIs, cloud platforms, distributed systems, CI/CD, observability, security, and production operations. * Experience modernizing legacy systems incrementally while continuing to meet active business and customer commitments. * Ability to lead effectively across a varied technology portfolio. Magna's core platforms are built primarily on Microsoft technologies (C\#, .NET, Azure); working knowledge of this stack and of modern web, cloud, and data technologies is expected. * Strong organizational judgment, including the ability to make sound decisions about team design, capacity, prioritization, and technical investment. * Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate between technical, operational, and commercial audiences. * Demonstrated ability to partner effectively with senior architects and principal\-level technical experts while maintaining clear decision rights and accountability. * Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience). #### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience delivering AI\- or machine\-learning\-enabled products or meaningfully integrating AI into the software\-development lifecycle. * Experience building software subject to HIPAA, SOC 2, or similar regulatory and client security requirements. * Experience in a multi\-product, multi\-business\-line, professional service, legal services, private\-equity\-backed, or acquisition\-oriented environment, including integrating acquired technology platforms and teams. #### **Leadership Profile** The successful candidate will be: * Business\-minded: Connects engineering work to customer outcomes, operational needs, and company priorities. * Execution\-oriented: Creates clarity, establishes accountability, and follows through on commitments. * Technically credible: Understands complex systems and tradeoffs without becoming a bottleneck or displacing technical owners. * People\-centered: Develops leaders, creates healthy teams, and gives clear and actionable feedback. * Pragmatic: Balances modernization, speed, quality, and risk based on business context. * Collaborative: Works effectively across functions and business lines and communicates with candor and respect. * Adaptable: Leads confidently through changing priorities, evolving technologies, and organizational growth. *An employee’s pay position within the salary range will be based on several jobs.title: Staff Backend Engineer FDE
jobs.description: Engineering, Platform Full\-time **About Meeru AI** Meeru AI is building an AI\-native platform that transforms how finance and accounting teams operate. We connect to enterprise financial systems, including ERPs, CRMs, billing platforms, and HRIS, and apply machine learning to turn fragmented operational data into grounded, auditable intelligence for CFOs, controllers, and FP\&A leaders. We deploy on customer terms: SaaS multi\-tenant, SaaS single\-tenant, and on\-premises, across AWS, Azure, and GCP. Our customers are Fortune 500 finance teams who require data isolation, auditability, and compliance. **The Role** The **Staff Backend Engineer** owns the application and API services layer: the services through which everything the platform computes actually reaches a person. Multi\-tenant APIs, authentication and authorization, and the review and approval workflows where a controller accepts a result, challenges it, or sends it back. The computation layer produces the numbers. This layer is where a finance team sees them, interrogates them, approves them, and acts on them. That means your services carry the same correctness and auditability requirements as the computation beneath them, plus the access control and tenancy guarantees that let a Fortune 500 finance organization trust the platform with their close cycle. Every action taken through your services is part of an audit trail that sits next to externally reported financials. Who approved what, when, on the basis of which underlying result, and what changed afterward. That is not logging you add later. It is a product requirement, and it shapes how the services are designed from the first commit. This is hands\-on and high\-ownership. You own major services end to end, set backend patterns alongside the Senior Staff engineers, and partner with data, AI, and product on the contracts between layers. **Key Responsibilities** 1\. **Own the multi\-tenant APIs through which the platform's results are consumed.** Design the service contracts between the application layer and the computation, data, and AI layers, and own the versioning discipline that lets those contracts evolve without breaking consumers who cannot all move at once. 2\. **Build the review, approval, and exception\-handling workflows finance teams operate in.** This is where the product either earns trust or loses it. A controller who cannot see why a number is what it is will not approve it, and will not use the platform twice. 3\. **Build and maintain multi\-tenant isolation at the service layer.** Own authentication, authorization, and role\-based access across the application surface. Cross\-tenant leakage should be impossible by construction rather than prevented by convention. 4\. **Build the audit trail.** Who saw what, who approved what, on the basis of which result. Guarantee that every user\-facing figure links back to its computation and its source, and support the enterprise security and compliance reviews Fortune 500 finance customers run before they buy. 5\. **Build for a multi\-cloud\-ready, multi\-tenant\-ready, customer\-hosted deployment model.** Services that run inside a customer's environment with strong isolation and no data egress. 6\. **Own performance, reliability, and cost of the services you build,** including observability and operational health. You should be able to answer why a request is slow rather than guessing. 7\. **Set backend patterns, review designs, and mentor mid and senior engineers.** Partner with data, AI, and product on cross\-layer service design. **A note on accountability:** this role owns the application and API services, tenancy and access control, and the audit trail. It does not own the core computation layer, the data foundation, the AI layer, or product prioritization. **Requirements** Seven or more years in backend forward deployment engineering, with significant Staff\-level time owning complex production services. Owning them, including what happens when they fail. * Demonstrated ownership of services in a multi\-cloud SaaS environment, and a clear account of how you guaranteed isolation rather than assumed it. * An obsession with correctness and traceability. You treat "who did what, when, and on what basis" as a first\-class requirement rather than an audit checkbox. * Strong API and service design, including versioning, contracts, and backward compatibility. You have evolved an interface other teams depended on without breaking them. * Practical security engineering: authentication, authorization, and tenant isolation. Not theory. * Python * FastAPI, Django, or Flask; PostgreSQL and Redis; * REST API design; Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform * SQL against Snowflake or PostgreSQL. **Nice to Have** * Finance, accounting, or fintech domain, or a genuine willingness to learn how financial statements are built and reconciled. * Multi\-tenant, customer\-hosted deployment at scale. * Supporting SOC 2 or ISO 27001 review. * Building auditable systems in a regulated environment. * Exposure to ML or LLM application patterns, enough to integrate them well. **Benefits** * Health and wellbeing. Medical, dental, and vision insurance, with MeeruAI covering 50 % of employee premiums * Flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts with a company contribution * Unlimited PTO and 12 paid holidays. * 401(k) with company matching

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Cards
jobs.description: As the story goes, in 1949 Frank McNamara finished dinner at a New York restaurant and found he'd left his wallet in another suit. His fix was a card that let members eat now and pay later. That card became Diners Club, widely credited as the first multipurpose charge card. It was a piece of cardboard and a promise: the restaurant trusted the card, the card trusted the member, and someone had to make sure the money actually moved. More than seventy\-five years later, the promise hasn't changed, but the machinery has. When a Mercury customer taps their card, the request goes from the merchant's terminal through an acquirer and a card network to us. In a fraction of a second, we check the balance, apply the customer's spend controls, screen for fraud and say yes or no. After that comes clearing, settlement, disputes and reporting, and every cent has to reconcile. Cards *are* the way Mercury customers spend money. The Cards Integration team owns the whole Mercury card, not just the swipe: issuance, physical card shipping, spend controls, lifecycle management, authorization, money movement, settlement and reporting, and the infrastructure underneath. We're a full\-stack team, and our job is to make the Mercury Debit and IO cards reliable, correct, useful, and innovative. We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who thinks deeply about systems architecture, cares about the customer experience, and will dive into any problem to move the team forward. We value high ownership, working in pairs and teams rather than alone, and attention to detail. Those matter when you run systems held to four nines of reliability, and everyone around you will care about them too. **In this role, you will** * Lead projects from idea to tech spec to implementation to launch, working with your PM, EM, tech lead, and teammates at each stage. When you lead a project, it's yours to see through. * Learn how debit and credit cards actually work under the hood (authorization, clearing, settlement, disputes) and use that knowledge every day. * Build features across the stack, from the card experiences customers use to the backend systems that move money. * Help keep our operations excellent. Our systems are some of the most observable at Mercury, and with great observability comes great responsibility. * Mentor other engineers and raise engineering quality through design reviews, code reviews, and collaboration. * Work with product, design, operations, risk, compliance, sales, and many other teams. **You should** * Have strong full\-stack experience, a product mindset, systems thinking, and a knack for getting things across the line. * Have made architectural decisions on complex systems, and be able to explain your reasoning and the trade\-offs. * Be excited to put new features in customers' hands, and care just as much about keeping existing ones working like a charm. * Care about correctness in systems where failure has real financial consequences. * Communicate clearly, handle ambiguity well, and enjoy mentoring others. * Be comfortable with our tech stack (Haskell and TypeScript) or be ready to learn. * Bonus: experience in fintech, payments, or card issuing. We encourage you to try our demo site if you're interested in applying for the role. * *Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC\-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.* Mercury values diversity \& belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Mercury are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities or special needs. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role. \#LI\-ES1 **Total Rewards** The total rewards package at Mercury includes base salary, equity (stock options/RSUs), and benefits. Our salary and equity ranges are highly competitive within the SaaS and fintech industry and are updated regularly using the most reliable compensation survey data for our industry. New hire offers are made based on a candidate’s experience, expertise, geographic location, and internal pay equity relative to peers. Our target new hire base salary ranges for this role are the following**:** US employees (any location): $166,600 \- $208,300 USD Canadian employees (any location): $157,400 \- $196,800 USD

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Mercury Command
jobs.description: In 1965, an engineer in Scotland was given a mundane task with a tricky problem to it \- banks wanted to close on Saturdays and still serve customers, but they didn’t know how to solve authentication of the right user. James Goodfellow, working at Smiths Industries, uncovered the insight that you needed something you have (a card) and something you know (a PIN). Because someone told him they could only remember 4 digits instead of his proposed 6, today over 3 million ATMs use a card\+4 digit PIN over 60 years later. Like the ATM, Mercury is building technology that pushes forward financial interfaces for the long term. Command is Mercury's LLM\-powered financial assistant, launched to all customers in June 2026\. It lets users understand their finances and take action in plain language, from asking about cash flow to sending payments, issuing cards, and managing invoices. With the product now in customers' hands, the work is to evolve it, extend its capabilities, and find new ways to leverage LLMs to give Mercury customers a more powerful banking\* experience. ### **What You'll Do:** * Ship new capabilities users love * Feel a strong sense of product ownership and actively seek responsibility – help design and ship new Command skills * Partner with product and compliance teams to define what "working correctly" means for each new capability, then build the tests that prove it * Join a small but mighty team of experienced product and AI engineers building the future of Mercury * This list is illustrative. jobs.title: Software Integration Engineer
jobs.description: **Merlin (NASDAQ: MRLN)** is a publicly traded aerospace and defense company building a non\-human pilot to deliver full\-stack autonomy for any aircraft from takeoff to touchdown. The Merlin Pilot autonomy system powers a growing range of aircraft and mission profiles and has been proven through hundreds of autonomous flights from Merlin's global flight test facilities, including Kerikeri, New Zealand; Smithfield, Rhode Island; and soon, Bedford, Massachusetts. Headquartered in Boston, Merlin is expanding its organization to accelerate the development and deployment of its autonomy platform, helping customers solve some of aviation's most pressing challenges, from pilot shortages to improving flight safety. Backed by some of the world's leading investors prior to its public listing, Merlin continues to advance the certification and commercialization of autonomous flight across commercial and defense aviation. ### **About You:** You are a hands\-on software engineer who enjoys connecting software, simulation models, and physical hardware. You take ownership of well\-defined engineering efforts, troubleshoot methodically, and collaborate with teammates to deliver reliable solutions. You are comfortable writing code, working in Linux, and testing directly with laboratory equipment. As part of Merlin’s Virtual Test Environments (VTE) team, you will help develop and maintain hardware\-in\-the\-loop test environments and the software that captures, displays, and replays engineering data. Working alongside our Staff Software Integration Engineer, you will help engineers exercise aircraft systems and resolve integration issues before flight. ### **Responsibilities:** * Develop and maintain C\+\+ and Python software connecting aircraft avionics, simulation models, test hardware, and engineering tools. * Implement software components and hardware interfaces within the architecture established by the Staff Software Integration Engineer, contributing to design decisions and code reviews. * Integrate UEI PowerDNA equipment through vendor SDKs, low\-level I/O APIs, and hardware abstraction layers. * Configure and validate ARINC 429, CAN, serial, analog, and discrete interfaces using aircraft interface control documents, including signal mapping, message encoding, update rates, and error handling. * Support real\-time execution of aircraft simulation models, including periodic processing, I/O exchange, watchdogs, and performance diagnostics. * Develop and maintain telemetry interfaces and data\-processing components that collect, validate, record, and distribute data over UDP, TCP, and messaging systems. * Contribute to asynchronous Rust services for telemetry ingestion, timestamp alignment, flight\-test displays, and session recording, with technical guidance from senior engineers. * Build operator displays and diagnostic tools using technologies such as GL Studio, React, HTML5, SQL, and web APIs. * Build, deploy, and troubleshoot software on Linux hosts and embedded targets using established cross\-compilation, packaging, systemd, and Docker workflows. * Write unit tests, Python\-based smoke tests, and hardware integration tests; help reproduce defects and add regression coverage. * Collaborate with avionics, aircraft software, flight dynamics, and lab engineers to diagnose issues across software, networks, and connected hardware. * Maintain code and configuration changes in Git, track work in Jira, and document interfaces, deployment steps, and troubleshooting procedures. ### **Qualifications:** * Proficiency developing and debugging modern C\+\+ and Python software. * Strong working familiarity with Linux host systems, including command\-line tools, software builds, dependencies, services, permissions, networking, and diagnostics. * Experience integrating software with physical hardware, external systems, or vendor libraries and APIs. * Understanding of resource management, multithreading, synchronization, and error handling in C\+\+. * Familiarity with UDP/TCP networking and binary data formats, including byte order, message framing, and input validation. * Familiarity with timing\-sensitive software concepts such as periodic execution, buffering, latency, and watchdogs. * Ability to interpret technical documentation and interface definitions and translate them into working software and tests. * Experience using Git for collaborative development, automated testing, and Jira or comparable issue tracking. * Familiarity with Docker\-based application deployment. * Willingness to learn Rust, embedded Linux deployment, and avionics interfaces with support from experienced engineers. * Ability to work independently on assigned components, communicate progress and blockers, and seek guidance when needed. * Ability to work regularly onsite in our Boston lab to integrate and troubleshoot physical equipment. ### **Nice to Have:** * Experience with UEI PowerDNA/PDNA SDKs or comparable data acquisition and avionics interface platforms. * Familiarity with ARINC 429, CAN, and RS\-232/RS\-422 serial interfaces. * Experience with embedded Linux, ARM targets, cross\-compilation, CMake, Yocto SDKs, Debian packaging, or systemd services. * Experience with Rust, particularly asynchronous programming using Tokio, serde, or axum. * Experience integrating or troubleshooting low\-level I/O APIs, device drivers, or hardware abstraction layers. * Experience with hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing, aircraft simulation, or integrating generated simulation models into C\+\+ applications. * Familiarity with telemetry systems, timestamp synchronization, IRIG time, or flight\-test displays such as IADS. * Experience with GL Studio, React and JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, SQL, or REST APIs. * Experience with GoogleTest, pytest, parser fuzzing, or continuous integration using GitHub Actions. * Familiarity with ZeroMQ, session recording, S3 storage, or simulation replay workflows. * Aviation experience through professional work, flight simulation, or a pilot’s license. This position is based on\-site at Merlin HQ in Boston, MA. Once you’re here, you’ll enjoy a variety of on\-site perks designed to make your workday enjoyable and convenient. These include catered lunches featuring a rotating menu of delicious options, an assortment of snacks to keep you fueled throughout the day, and a selection of beverages, including coffee, tea, and other drinks, to keep you refreshed. Our goal is to create an environment where you can thrive both professionally and personally. Merlin Labs offers an innovative, entrepreneurial, and team\-focused startup environment. jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager, AI Kernels & Performance Optimization — MTIA Software
jobs.description: Meta designs and deploys its own AI systems. MTIA — the Meta Training and Inference Accelerator — is Meta's family of in\-house AI accelerator ASICs, running recommendation and ranking workloads in production across Meta's data centers today and expanding into generative AI inference and training as successive silicon generations land.The MTIA Software team is part of the AI \& Compute Foundation (ACF) organization within Meta Infrastructure. We build the entire stack a chip vendor would normally supply — compiler and LLVM toolchain, runtime, kernel authoring frameworks and libraries, developer tooling, and deep PyTorch integration — co\-designing it with the silicon teams generation over generation.Within that stack, the AI Kernels and Performance Optimization team (KORE) owns the layer where silicon architecture meets arithmetic. Our mission is roofline\-level performance and programmability at scale: we design and implement high\-performance compute and communication kernels (GEMM, attention variants, normalization, collectives, elementwise and reduction fusions, sparse and quantized paths) against novel architectural features including matrix engines, on\-chip reduction fabrics, and software\-managed memory hierarchies. We ship kernel libraries with broad PyTorch operator coverage, build C\+\+ and Python kernel authoring frameworks and DSL surfaces, and write production kernels against new architectures long before first silicon — turning hardware proposals into measured roofline evidence while the design can still change.We are seeking a Software Engineering Manager to lead a team of kernel and performance engineers doing this work. You will own the performance of workloads that serve billions of people, drive technical strategy for kernel development and optimization, and build a team that can deliver roofline\-level performance on MTIA accelerators. Your team will profile and root\-cause performance across the full stack — instruction scheduling, memory hierarchy and DMA behavior, on\-chip interconnect, multi\-device collectives — and drive fixes to the right layer, whether that is the kernel, compiler, runtime, or hardware. You will partner closely with silicon architecture teams on hardware/software co\-design, quantifying the value of proposed features with real kernels and advocating for the changes the software stack needs. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role where you will contribute directly to architectural decisions while enabling your team to move with speed and clarity. ### **Software Engineering Manager, AI Kernels \& Performance Optimization — MTIA Software Responsibilities:** * Lead and manage a team of systems engineers delivering on multiple concurrent projects across ambiguous, high\-impact areas of Meta's platform infrastructure * Drive roadmap creation and technical strategy for systems\-level software, ensuring alignment with broader product and engineering goals * Contribute directly to technical work including architecture reviews, design documents, and hands\-on coding to maintain credibility and unblock the team * Identify and resolve systemic issues affecting team velocity, including on\-call load, technical debt, and gaps in tooling or automation * Partner with product, design, and data science to ensure engineers contribute across disciplines and deliver outcomes that move business metrics forward * Set clear goals and expectations for individual engineers, provide timely and actionable feedback, and proactively address performance gaps * Manage staged rollouts and feature delivery using feature flagging and A/B testing frameworks, ensuring high engineering quality and system reliability * Recruit, onboard, and develop engineers, building a team structure that minimizes single points of failure and scales with organizational needs * Communicate team goals, technical decisions, and progress clearly to cross\-functional partners and leadership, including written design proposals and postmortems * Participate in org\-wide engineering contributions, sharing effective workflows, tooling practices, and systems engineering patterns across the broader organization ### **Minimum Qualifications:** * 4\+ years of experience in software engineering with a focus on systems\-level software, platform infrastructure, or distributed systems * 2\+ years of experience managing or leading engineering teams, including setting technical direction and supporting engineer growth * Experience driving technical roadmaps and executing against them with measurable outcomes in ambiguous or high\-complexity environments * Experience identifying and resolving engineering efficiency issues such as on\-call burden, technical debt, or gaps in automation * Experience collaborating across product, design, and data functions to deliver software that achieves business and user impact ### **Preferred Qualifications:** * Track record of hands\-on technical contribution as a manager, including authoring  with real kernels, and influencing hardware roadmaps based on software performance analysis * Experience working on customized AI accelerators (TPU, AI ASICs, or similar non\-GPU architectures) with direct involvement in kernel development and roofline enablement * Familiarity with transformer and attention kernel design: FlashAttention\-class algorithms, KV\-cache management, paged and chunked attention, MoE routing and expert dispatch * Experience with distributed execution and collective communication (NCCL/RCCL\-class primitives, tensor and expert parallelism, overlapping communication with compute) * Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies * Experience managing or leading teams working on high\-performance kernel development, accelerator software, HPC, or ML systems performance * Hands\-on experience with kernel development jobs.title: Senior AI Security Researchers
jobs.description: **Overview** Security is one of the most critical priorities for our customers in a world of growing digital threats, regulatory scrutiny, and estate complexity. Microsoft Security aspires to make the world safer by empowering every user, customer, and developer with a security cloud that delivers end\-to\-end, simplified protection. The Microsoft Security organization advances this mission by helping secure digital technology platforms, devices, and clouds across customers' heterogeneous environments, while also protecting Microsoft's internal estate. Our culture is grounded in a growth mindset, inspiring excellence, and enabling teams and leaders to bring their full potential each day. The Microsoft Security Research (MSecR) conducts security research at the intersection of offense, defense, and intelligence. AI is now everywhere: organizations and people across every industry are adopting large language models, copilots, and autonomous agents, and these systems bring a brand\-new attack surface that can be manipulated, misused, and exploited in ways traditional software cannot. In Microsoft Security, we protect AI from these attacks. We are looking for a Senior Security Researcher and a Principal Security Researcher who combines a real security background with a deep, hands\-on understanding of how modern AI works and how it breaks. You will help execute and conduct AI attacks through simulations, using what you find to make AI safer and to inform our security products so they protect customers better. This role is for someone who wants to shape how AI attacks are simulated and defended at scale. You will set methodology, build tooling, influence product direction, and drive innovation in attacking and defending AI systems (Security for AI). Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. *Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.* **Responsibilities** **As a Senior AI Security Researcher, you will:** * Lead the design and execution of simulations aimed at making AI safer, conducting realistic AI attacks whose findings inform our security products and help them protect customers more effectively. * Develop and execute hands\-on attacks against AI systems, including: + 1\) Direct prompt injection and jailbreaks that bypass system prompts, safety instructions, and alignment. + 2\) Indirect (cross\-domain) prompt injection (XPIA), where malicious instructions are hidden in untrusted content the model consumes: documents, web pages, emails, tickets, code, and RAG jobs.description: **Job Description Summary** ‎ Mosaic Health is seeking a hands\-on engineer with strong applied AI experience and deep knowledge of technology infrastructure and data pipelines. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role, not a people\-management position. You will build applications, integrations and automated workflows across apree, CareMore and Millennium Physician Group. Your work will connect operational needs with dependable technical solutions that improve service, reduce manual effort and support the business. You will take initiative and personally carry solutions from discovery through rapid prototyping, pilot deployment and value validation, then partner with IT, data and security teams to industrialize solutions approved to scale. You will spend a substantial portion of your time designing, writing, testing and troubleshooting code, including the data pipelines that support your applications. Success requires independent execution and close collaboration: you will seek input early, work constructively with operational, IT, data and security partners, and keep stakeholders informed. You will focus on a prioritized set of initiatives, understand differences in workflows and systems across the businesses, and build reusable capabilities that can be adapted to local needs. ‎ **How will you make an impact \& Requirements** ‎ **WHAT YOU WILL DO** * Work with operational teams to understand workflows, handoffs, exceptions and sources of data. Turn an agreed business objective into a practical technical plan, identify missing information, and drive the next steps without waiting for fully specified requirements. * Build, collaborate on, and maintain AI\-enabled applications, backend services and integrations. Apply language models, retrieval\-augmented generation, structured outputs and tool calling where they solve a defined operational problem. * Design and maintain data pipelines for ingesting, transforming, validating and delivering structured and unstructured data. Handle data quality, schema changes, retries, duplicate records and backfills, and make data lineage and failures traceable. * Prototype and evaluate models, frameworks and software tools. Compare AI\-based approaches with conventional software and existing products, and recommend solutions based on measured quality, latency, cost, maintainability and operational fit. * Build evaluation datasets and automated tests for model outputs, retrieval quality and complete workflows. * Partner with IT, data and security teams across Mosaic Health on approved architecture, access, integrations and deployment. Build pilots within approved environments and, for solutions approved to scale, work with Technology to transition and industrialize them with appropriate identity and access controls, networking, secrets management, auditability and protection of sensitive information. * Collaborate with consultants and vendors while retaining hands\-on ownership of your deliverables. Review designs and code, contribute directly to implementation, and ensure documentation and knowledge transfer allow you to maintain and extend the work. * Work with business owners and Finance partners on pilot rollout, user feedback and value validation. Establish the baseline and track adoption, cycle time, manual effort, error rates, and realized operational and financial value to determine whether the solution should scale. **WHAT YOU BRING** * Typically, 5\-7 years of software engineering experience, including substantial hands\-on experience building and deploying AI\-enabled applications. Demonstrated ownership of production systems and the ability to explain technical decisions, failures and improvements. * Evidence of personally taking a product or workflow from an initial idea through pilot deployment and value validation, with demonstrated ability to partner on industrialization and ongoing improvement, including integrating language models into real applications. Able to explain what you built, how you resolved obstacles, and how you supported the solution after launch. * Strong backend development skills in Python and/or TypeScript, proficiency in SQL, and experience designing APIs, services and database schemas. * Practical understanding of language model APIs, embeddings, retrieval\-augmented generation, structured outputs and tool calling. Able to design workflows around model limitations and select the appropriate approach for the task. * Experience evaluating AI systems with representative datasets and measurable quality criteria, including retrieval accuracy, unsupported outputs, edge cases and regression testing. Able to balance quality, latency and cost. * Deep understanding of cloud infrastructure and distributed applications, including compute, storage, networking, identity and access management, containers, queues, observability and CI/CD. Experience diagnosing production issues and making reliability, security and cost tradeoffs. * A record of taking initiative and delivering with limited day\-to\-day direction. Able to break ambiguous problems into manageable steps, make sound technical decisions, learn unfamiliar tools, and follow through on implementation and support. Recognizes when to seek input or escalate a dependency, bringing clear options and a recommended next step. * A collaborative working style: listens to frontline users, seeks and incorporates feedback, shares knowledge, and works respectfully across disciplines. Communicates progress and tradeoffs clearly, follows through on commitments, and helps partners resolve shared problems. * Hands\-on experience designing and operating data pipelines, including ETL/ELT, batch and event\-driven processing, orchestration, data validation and monitoring. Understands how source\-system behavior, data freshness, lineage and schema changes affect downstream applications and AI outputs. **QUALIFICATIONS** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field required; advanced degree preferred. * 5\-7 years of progressive software engineering experience, including significant experience serving as a technical lead, software architect, or principal engineer responsible for enterprise\-scale software platforms. * Expert\-level knowledge of software architecture, distributed systems, cloud\-native application development, microservices, API design, engineering automation, CI/CD, secure software development, and enterprise application design. * Demonstrated expertise establishing engineering standards for AI\-assisted software development, including responsible AI adoption, code provenance, data privacy, software quality, and engineering governance. * Deep experience implementing and advancing full\-stack observability capabilities, including application performance monitoring, distributed tracing, telemetry, logging, cloud monitoring, and operational analytics across complex production environments. * Proven ability to influence enterprise technology strategy, lead cross\-functional engineering initiatives, establish technical standards, and build alignment across Product Management, Enterprise Architecture, Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, Information Security, and executive technology leadership. * Exceptional analytical, communication, mentoring, and technical leadership skills with demonstrated technical adaptability and experience evaluating, introducing, and operationalizing emerging software engineering technologies and industry best practices. ‎ **Compensation Range:** $131,243\.00 to $196,865\.00 *The anticipated base salary range represents the Company's good\-faith estimate of the compensation it reasonably expects to pay for this position at the time of posting. jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer, Internal Systems
jobs.description: **ABOUT MINERVA** ----------------- Minerva builds AI for marketing leaders. We work together with marketers to automate and accelerate their workflows with AI agents. Our agents augment the end\-to\-end workflow of the marketer by automating analysis, campaign planning, activation, measurement and reporting. Customers like the NBA, Ramp, Wander, Hard Rock Stadium Group and Luxury Presence use Minerva to develop a better understanding of their customers and introduce AI specifically built to understand the customer into their commercial organizations. Our campaigns outperform other tools because we built the entire stack: from identity to enrichment to data integration as well as agents to action and report on the analysis. We've raised $20M from The General Partnership, 8VC, Lingotto, NBA Investments, Topology Ventures, Future Positive, Background Capital and many others. Our team brings together operators and investors from Citadel, Dentsu, Bridgewater, Meta Superintelligence, Growthloop, Amazon and Lazard, alongside engineers and researchers from Berkeley, MIT, Stanford and Cambridge. **OUR STACK** ------------- * Agents: Claude across the company (in Slack, through the API, with skills and MCP), plus Mastra for the agents we build ourselves and Temporal for long\-running work. * Code: Python and TypeScript, scheduled jobs and webhooks. * The systems your agents work across: Slack, Google Workspace, Notion, and the CRM, recruiting, HR, finance and compliance tools a growing company runs on. **THE ROLE** ------------ We build agents for marketers. This seat builds them for us. Every company our size runs on work nobody sees. Someone copies a new hire's details into six tools. Someone remembers which contract renews next month. Someone answers the same security questionnaire for the fourth time. Most companies hire a coordinator for that work. We're hiring an engineer. You're a forward\-deployed engineer for Minerva itself. Other companies call this an AI operations engineer or an internal AI engineer. Your customers are every team here: operations, finance, people, recruiting, sales and the founders. You sit with them, find the work they'd most like to stop doing, and replace it with a system that runs without them and leaves an audit trail. You report to our COO and work closely with engineering, which owns anything that touches production. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** ------------------ * **Own the company's knowledge agent.** One agent over our docs, Slack, calls and tickets, with Slack as the front end. It answers with sources, and people trust it. * **Automate the processes that run the company.** Hiring, onboarding and offboarding, access provisioning, vendor reviews, customer security questionnaires, contract renewals and billing. Start where the hours or the risk are highest. * **Run the skill library.** Every team gets Claude connected to the tools it uses and a set of skills, each with a named owner on that team, an eval and the right permissions. What one person figures out, everyone gets. * **Own the source of truth.** Decide where each kind of information lives, move it there and keep it findable by people and by agents. When an agent spots something out of date, it proposes the fix and a person approves it. * **Build the plumbing under our operating dashboards:** the metrics, controls and board reporting that today get stitched together by hand from five systems. * **Put the guardrails in first.** Least\-privilege access, a human approval before any agent writes to a system of record, and audit trails that double as compliance evidence. * **Sit with your users.** Watch how a recruiter, a seller or our finance lead actually works, then automate the part they hate. * **Measure adoption.** Which systems get used, by whom and at what cost, including what we spend on models and which agents can touch what. Retire what nobody opens, and write the runbook for what stays. **WHAT YOU HAVE** ----------------- * You've shipped agents or automations that coworkers use every week, and you can show the usage: who stopped doing what, and how many hours came back. * Production Python or TypeScript, with LLMs wired into real APIs. You're comfortable with OAuth scopes, webhooks and scheduled jobs, and with the ways each of them fails. * You know how a company runs. You can talk to a recruiter, a controller and a security auditor in their own terms, and you fix the process before you automate it. * A controls instinct. Before you ship, you've decided who approves what and what happens when the agent is wrong. * You're current. You know what shipped in AI tooling this month, and you can show us your own setup. * You write clearly. People follow your runbooks without asking you. * You're in New York City or willing to relocate. **YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU ARE…** ---------------------------------- * A founder or founding engineer who automated your own company's back office because someone had to. * A chief of staff or bus pped writing specs for engineers. * A solutions or forward deployed engineer who wants the whole company as your customer. * A GTM or internal tools engineer who automated a sales team and wants scope beyond the sales stack. * Or you don't fit any of these neatly, but you've automated your own job at least once. Apply. **NICE TO HAVES** ----------------- * You've rolled out Claude or another model platform to a whole company: access, permissions, usage and cost. * You've been through a SOC 2 or similar audit on the side that produces the evidence. * Hands\-on time with the systems a startup runs on: HRIS, ATS, CRM, billing and spend tools. **WHAT THIS ISN'T** ------------------- * An IT helpdesk. You'll automate the tickets away, not answer them. * Product engineering. Our customer\-facing agents and production infrastructure belong to the engineering team. * An AI strategy role. You ship systems people use. Nobody here needs a deck about transformation. * The owner of the work you automate. Our compliance lead still owns the security answers, and whoever runs sales ops owns the CRM. You build the systems that do the work for them. **WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE** --------------------------- * **First 90 days:** the knowledge agent is live in Slack and used daily. jobs.description: At Mitratech, we are a team of innovators focused on building world\-class products that simplify operations in the Legal, Risk, Compliance, and HR functions. We are a close\-knit, globally dispersed team that thrives in an ecosystem that supports individual excellence and takes pride in its diverse and inclusive work culture centered around great people practices, learning opportunities, and having fun! Our culture is the ideal blend of entrepreneurial spirit and enterprise investment, enabling the chance to move at a rapid pace with some of the most complex, leading\-edge technologies available. For over 35 years, the experts at Mitratech have been focused on solving the complex needs. Today, we serve 20,000 client companies of all sizes globally, representing 30% of the Fortune 500 and over 500,000 users in over 160 countries. As we continue to grow, we're always looking for resourceful, enthusiastic, and fresh perspectives. Join our global team and see what makes Mitratech a truly exceptional place to work! **Job Overview** This is more than a typical engineering position. We are looking for an individual who is excited by the practical application of AI to make the best HR software. You will be empowered to explore and implement background screening technology with a critical sense of user experience. **Essential Duties \& Responsibilities**: * Design, develop, and maintain robust and scalable web services for our core B2B SaaS application. * Write clean, high\-quality, and well\-tested code, primarily in **Go**. * Architect and manage complex database schemas and queries using **PostgreSQL**. * Lead initiatives to research, prototype, and implement **AI\-powered tools** to accelerate our software development lifecycle—from intelligent code completion and automated reviews to advanced CI/CD pipeline optimizations. * Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and fellow engineers to translate complex user requirements into elegant, user\-centric solutions. * Mentor other engineers, champion best practices, and contribute to a culture of technical excellence and continuous improvement. **Requirements \& Skills:** * Deep proficiency in the full stack of b2b SaaS; Front end: **vanilla html/css/js**; Back end: **Go** preferred, **Ruby/Python/PHP** ok; Database: **PostgreSQL** * A product\-first mindset with a demonstrated ability to think from the user's perspective and a keen eye for **user experience and design**. * Excellent problem\-solving skills and the ability to architect solutions for complex, distributed systems. * Strong communication skills and a desire to work in a highly collaborative environment. We will disclose intended pay ranges in our job ads for US\-based opportunities – This role can be performed 100% remote anywhere in the US. **Anticipated Pay Range: $150K to 170K Annually USD** Total compensation includes US employee benefits and annual bonus eligibility. **Benefits we offer:** * Health, Dental \& Vision Insurance \* * 401 (k) \+ Employer Match \* * Open PTO \+ 11 Paid Holidays \+ 4 Annual Paid Global Wellness Days Off * STD, LTD \& Group Life Insurance * Paid Parental Leave * Pet Insurance * FSA \& HSA Options * Employee Assistance Program **Perks we offer:** * Remote Work * Career Advancement \& Professional Development Opportunities * Employee Recognition * LinkedIn Learning Platform ***Mitratech is proud to be an EEOE, M/F/D/V, and we are committed to diversity both in practice and spirit at the corporate level.
