jobs.title: Quality Engineer
jobs.description: Summary: Quality Engineer (QE) is a member of Mitsubishi Turbocharger and Engine America, Inc. (MTEA) Quality Assurance (QA) team that drives a plant\-wide proactive, zero\-defect mindset through robust controls and belief in our QMS process. QE is responsible for managing customer/supplier throughout the product maturity life cycle. Primary responsibilities include coordinating product/component development activities ensuring compliance/readiness to customer expectations, managing post\-launch quality issues and corrective/preventive actions, and monitoring and improving quality performance. QE works cross\- functionally with Design Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Production, and Purchasing to ensure effective collaboration, communication, and alignment with customers/suppliers are maintained, at all times, QE also conducts On\-site audits to select/qualify new suppliers, to ensure compliance, and to montor/control quality performance. Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Act as MTEA's single\-point\-of\-contact for quality to ensure complete and transparent communication and support to build strong working relationships with customers, suppliers, and in\-house development teams. Lead and contribute in cross\-functional team activities for QA to ensure incoming/outgoing quality is proactively planned, prepared, and executed in advance before Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) and production release. Develop and implement quality plans to monitor/improve supply chain and part/process qualification requirements to ensure that manufactured products meet drawing, specifications, and quality/reliability req uirements. Support, evaluate, and approve/reject/amend PPAP or internal Process Sign\-Off (PSO) submissions for new product/component releases and changes to existing ones. Coordinate activities to evaluate and resolve technically challenging engineering and quality\-related problems in assigned areas of responsibility. Investigate defective, damaged, or malfunctioning parts, assemblies, equipment, or systems to determine nature and scope of problem being experienced by customer/supplier. Evaluate findings to formulate containment measures, corrective action plan, and coordinate implementation to ensure resolution. We are currently seeking a AI Architect to join our team in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania (US\-PA), United States (US). Role Summary As an AI Architect at Lead Consultant level, you will lead AI projects from conception through deployment for clients across industries, translating business challenges into working AI solutions. You will design and build the major components of those solutions, and act as the technical lead for the workstreams you own within a client engagement. The role spans the AI lifecycle — from discovery and solution design through proof of concept, production implementation, and operational improvement. The scope includes machine learning, predictive analytics, natural language processing, computer vision, intelligent automation, and Generative AI. This is a hands\-on architecture role. Expect roughly 70% of your time hands\-on — building reference implementations, prototypes, production services, and integration work — and roughly 30% on design, technical leadership, and mentoring. Engagement models vary, and some client contexts require sustained hands\-on delivery alongside the engineering team. Key Responsibilities * Lead assigned AI projects from conception through deployment, owning design and delivery for the workstreams you are accountable for. * Translate business challenges into AI solution designs, and evaluate the business impact and expected return of the approaches you propose. * Design and implement major components of enterprise AI solutions across applications, integration, data, AI/ML, and infrastructure. * Design and build AI solution patterns across ML and GenAI — LLM applications, retrieval\-augmented generation, agents, orchestration, embeddings, vector and graph\-based retrieval, model integrations, and evaluation. * Conduct data preprocessing, feature engineering, and dataset preparation for AI workloads. * Build prototypes, proofs of concept, reference implementations, and production\-ready AI services. * Optimize AI models and inference workloads for performance, scalability, and cost, including on distributed computing frameworks and AI\-optimized hardware. * Design data storage and retrieval approaches for AI workloads across databases, data lakes, and vector or graph stores. * Apply secure\-by\-design practices — authentication, RBAC, secrets management, encryption, private networking, data protection, auditability, and authorization\-aware data retrieval. * Implement responsible\-AI controls, including content safety, PII protection, bias identification and mitigation, prompt\-injection defenses, and human review. * Work within client data governance requirements and applicable data privacy regulation in everything you design and deliver. * Apply MLOps, LLMOps, and GenAIOps practices — CI/CD, version control, model and prompt versioning, infrastructure as code, testing, evaluation, monitoring, tracing, and lifecycle management. * Communicate AI concepts, design decisions, and trade\-offs clearly to client technical, product, and business teams, and collaborate across delivery, data, infrastructure, and security functions to integrate AI solutions. * Mentor engineers and junior team members in AI engineering and architecture practices. * Contribute to reusable patterns, accelerators, and delivery playbooks; stay current with emerging AI technologies; and provide technical input to discovery workshops, solution shaping, and effort estimates. Basic Qualifications The experience periods below overlap and are not additive. * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, data science, information systems, or a related technical discipline. * 8\+ years in software engineering, cloud, data engineering, AI/ML, architecture, or enterprise technology delivery. * 4\+ years designing and delivering production AI or ML solutions. * 1\+ years delivering production Generative AI or LLM\-based systems, including LLM APIs, RAG, embeddings, vector and graph\-based retrieval, evaluation, guardrails, and agentic workflows. * 5\+ years in software engineering with professional\-level proficiency in at least one mainstream language — Python, Java, C\#, C\+\+, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, or equivalent — including designing and integrating APIs and backend services using REST, gRPC, event\-driven, or asynchronous patterns. * 3\+ years delivering technical design and implementation of significant components in complex enterprise environments. * 2\+ years architecting AI solutions across more than one deployment model (public cloud plus private cloud, hybrid, or on\-premises) and establishing operational practice for AI systems — model and prompt versioning, artifact and experiment tracking, automated evaluation, monitoring and tracing, incident response, rollback — n. drive clear build\-vs\-use decisions * Architect and integrate high\-performance data pipelines, RAG systems, vector databases, and GPU\-optimized training and inference workflows. * Lead integration of the AI Data Platform into NVIDIA’s on\-prem AI Factory, optimizing GPU\-to\-storage throughput, data locality, and distributed inference performance. * Establish and enforce robust Agent Governance policies across the platform, covering model/tool usage, data lineage, and ensuring adherence to compliance and Responsible AI frameworks. * Design, implement, and maintain a centralized Agent Safety Toolkit, providing developers with pre\-vetted components for input/output guardrails and prompt injection defenses * Lead and grow a high\-performing team along with a multi\-functional community to standardize procedures and scale adoption **What we need to see:** * Bachelor’s degree in CS/Engineering or equivalent experience * 10\+ overall years in software engineering, including 4\+ years managing high\-performing teams * Strong hands\-on experience with evolving agent architectures and open\-source libraries; deep expertise in LLM/agent architectures—leading POCs and integrating them into real business use cases with measurable adoption/impact * Ability to turn fast\-moving, ambiguous problem spaces into clear platform strategy, roadmap, and outcomes * Proven track record building multi\-team developer platforms (APIs/SDKs, reusable components, reference implementations) * Experience building evaluation/benchmarking systems for agent workflows (metrics, regression, feedback loops) * Strong judgment integrating OSS/3P tools; jobs.title: Corporate Vice President - Technical Product Manager
jobs.description: **Job Description** ------------------- #### **Requisition ID** 95194 #### **Department** Tech Data AI Ventures #### **Job Function** Tech Data AI Ventures #### **Location** New York,New York,United States #### **Role Location Designation** Hybrid \- 3 days per week **Location Designation:** Hybrid \- 3 days per week **Technology, Data, AI and Ventures:** Within the Tech, Data, AI, Ventures (TDAV) organization, our work is guided by a shared vision: deploying the power of technology, data, AI and ventures to accelerate sustainable competitive advantage for New York Life's businesses. We build solutions that power how we serve policy owners, agents, advisors and employees while delivering measurable business outcomes. Across technology, data, AI, cyber, product, digital experience, architecture and infrastructure, TDAV combines the scale and investment of an industry leader, access to leading\-edge technologies and the opportunity to help shape how a world\-class financial services company competes in the AI era \- all backed by the stability and purpose of a mutual company built to last. **Role Overview** We build intelligence products that help field professionals make better decisions — not static reports or generic dashboards, but purpose\-built surfaces that deliver the right context at the point of action. The quality of those surfaces determines whether our work reaches users at all. This role exists because that bar matters, and because getting it right at scale requires someone who can hold the thread from boardroom priorities down to data pipeline behavior. The Senior Technical Product Manager on this team owns the product agenda for Decision Intelligence end to end: the strategic narrative that earns executive sponsorship, the roadmap that a squad of engineers, data scientists, and designers can actually execute against, and the judgment to know when a technical shortcut is a smart trade\-off versus a debt that will sink the product later. You are not translating between business and engineering — you are fluent in both, and you are the person each side trusts to make the call. This is a leadership role inside a small, high\-ownership team embedded in a large enterprise. You will set direction for other product professionals, represent the portfolio to senior leadership, and remain close enough to the technical fabric — data models, APIs, ML outputs, system architecture — to stress\-test what your team proposes before it reaches a steering committee. If you want a role that moves fluidly between a whiteboard with engineers and a slide deck for the C\-suite, this is the right environment. **What You'll Do** ***Strategic Product Vision \& Roadmap Leadership:*** You will set the multi\-year product vision and strategy for the Decision Intelligence portfolio, translating enterprise priorities and field\-professional needs into a roadmap that sequences investment across multiple product lines. You hold the standard for what constitutes a defensible bet, and you are the person who can articulate why a strategy will or will not work — backed by evidence, market context, and a clear\-eyed view of technical feasibility. ***Senior Leadership \& Executive Partnership:*** You will be a primary product voice in front of senior leadership and business stakeholders — framing trade\-offs, defending prioritization decisions, and translating technical constraints into business terms that non\-technical executives can act on. You are comfortable being the person in the room who says no to a popular idea and yes to an unpopular one, and can back either with a clear rationale. ***Cross\-Functional Team Leadership:***You will lead and grow a cross\-functional pod of product managers, designers, engineers, and data scientists — setting working norms, unblocking execution, and coaching more junior product talent. You are accountable for the team's output and its health, and you build the kind of trust that lets you delegate meaningfully rather than review everything yourself. ***Technical \& Data Fluency:***You will partner directly with engineering leads and data scientists on architecture decisions, model design, and data contracts — not as an approver at the end of the process, but as a participant early enough to shape it. jobs.title: Sr Lead, Reliability Engineering
jobs.description: **Job ID:** 18910 **Alternate Locations:** Remote **Newell Brands** is a leading consumer products company with a portfolio of iconic brands like Graco®, Coleman®, Oster®, Rubbermaid®, Sharpie® and Yankee Candle® \- and 24,000 talented teammates around the world. Reporting to the Director, Global Reliability, this role is a field\-level executor of the Newell Brands Strategic Equipment Management Policy (SEMP) — the company's governing framework for how assets are planned, acquired, operated, maintained, and retired across the global supply chain network. The Sr. Manager translates SEMP requirements into site\-level programs, assessments, and improvement plans, ensuring policy intent is operationalized consistently across assigned sites. This role owns hands\-on reliability engineering deliverables: asset criticality assessments, fleet management analysis, condition monitoring program builds, PM optimization, failure mode investigations, and reliability KPI reporting. The Sr. Manager acts as a working technical lead, supporting the fleet management strategy by executing site\-level programs that feed network\-wide asset intelligence — guiding site\-level reliability engineers and maintenance teams through structured improvement initiatives while managing multiple concurrent workstreams and site engagements. This role is a key execution engine for the Global Reliability Program within the ERA Strategic Master Plan. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** Reliability Program Execution * Execute site\-level reliability assessments using the ERA reliability framework: asset registry validation, criticality ranking (FMECA\-based), PM plan audit, and condition monitoring gap analysis across manufacturing sites and DC facilities. * Develop and implement PM optimization plans using RCM principles, condition\-based triggers, and failure mode data; establish PM intervals grounded in equipment OEM data and operational history. * Lead condition monitoring program deployment at assigned sites, including vibration analysis routes, oil sampling schedules, thermographic inspection programs, and ultrasound surveys. * Execute the Tribo Program at assigned sites: conduct Tribo Scorecard assessments, develop site\-level lubrication improvement plans, support development of on\-site tribology SMEs, and track progress against network Tribo standards defined by the Director, Global Reliability. * Conduct and lead root cause failure analysis (RCFA) investigations for chronic failures and high\-impact asset events; own corrective action tracking through closure. * Build and maintain failure mode libraries and asset\-specific maintenance task lists within MicroMain CMMS. Fleet Management Execution * Execute fleet management assessments within assigned site portfolios: document asset populations by class (motors, drives, compressors, conveyors, automation equipment, etc.), validate fleet criticality ratings, and identify fleet\-level PM standardization gaps. * Contribute fleet performance data to network\-level benchmarking; identify poor\-performing assets within a fleet class and recommend lifecycle interventions (condition\-based replacement, refurbishment, or standardization). * Support the Director in developing capital replacement schedules for critical fleet segments; provide site\-level asset condition inputs to long\-range capital planning. * Implement fleet\-based spare parts strategies at assigned sites, including kitting standards and critical spare identification aligned to fleet criticality tiers. CMMS \& Data Management * Drive asset data quality within MicroMain: asset hierarchy integrity, PM plan completeness, labor hour capture, and work order classification accuracy. * Generate reliability KPI reports including PMR, MTBF, MTTR, planned vs. unplanned maintenance ratio, and backlog analysis at site and regional levels. * Support development of reliability analytics dashboards in coordination with the ERA AI \& Digital Enablement team. * Identify data gaps in CMMS cost fields and labor actuals; develop site\-specific data governance improvement plans. Site Engagement \& Coaching * Partner with site Engineering Managers and M d local reliability ownership and PM discipline at the front line. * Execute PEAK EFO pillar assessments at assigned sites, evaluating AM and PM pillar maturity against global standards; document gaps, develop site\-level improvement plans, and track progression through defined maturity stages in alignment with the Director's network\-wide EFO program. * Facilitate reliability\-focused kaizen events, PM standardization workshops, and condition monitoring training at assigned sites. * Support development of site Reliability Engineers through on\-site coaching, structured work plans, and technical mentorship. * Travel to assigned manufacturing sites (domestic and international) on a regular cadence to assess program execution and drive improvement. Program Management \& Reporting * Manage concurrent reliability improvement projects across a portfolio of 4\-8 manufacturing sites; maintain project plans, milestone tracking, and risk logs. * Report site\-level PMR, OEE, and condition monitoring adoption metrics to the Director, Global Reliability on a regular cadence. * Participate in PEAK operating reviews, contributing reliability KPIs and site action plans to the monthly/quarterly cadence. * Support development of reliability investment business cases, cost avoidance analyses, and capital justification documentation. Cross\-Functional Collaboration * Coordinate with ERA Automation and OT teams to integrate condition monitoring sensors and edge devices into the site OT network architecture. * Partner with Operations to align reliability program priorities with production scheduling, planned outage windows, and capital projects. **QUALIFICATIONS** Required * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline. * 7\+ years of experience in reliability engineering, maintenance engineering, or asset management in a manufacturing environment. * Hands\-on experience with condition monitoring technologies: vibration analysis, oil analysis, thermography, or equivalent. * Experience with CMMS platforms for asset management, PM planning, and work order execution. * Working knowledge of RCM, FMECA, PM optimization, and root cause failure analysis methodologies. * Demonstrated ability to manage multiple workstreams and site engagements simultaneously. Preferred * CMRP, CRL, or Category I/II vibration analyst certification (ISO 18436 or equivalent). * Experience with MicroMain or similar CMMS platforms. * Familiarity with PEAK, Lean, or Six Sigma methodologies. * International manufacturing site experience; LATAM or EMEA exposure preferred. * Experience integrating condition monitoring data with industrial analytics or AI platforms. **COMPETENCIES** * Strong hands\-on technical capability in reliability engineering disciplines * Structured problem solver with a data\-driven approach to failure analysis * Effective communicator with site\-level teams and program leadership * The Remote base pay range for this position is from {MIN AMOUNT} to {MAX AMOUNT}. Salary will be based on prior experience related to the skills required for this positionSelf\-directed with the ability to manage multiple priorities across a distributed portfolio * Collaborative team member with a continuous improvement mindset The Remote base pay range for this position is from $123,000 to $169,400\. Salary will be based on prior experience related to the skills required for this position Newell Brands (NASDAQ: NWL) is a leading global consumer goods company with a strong portfolio of well\-known brands, including Rubbermaid, Sharpie, Graco, Coleman, Rubbermaid Commercial Products, Yankee Candle, Paper Mate, FoodSaver, Dymo, EXPO, Elmer’s, Oster, NUK, Spontex and Campingaz. We are focused on delighting consumers by lighting up everyday moments. Newell Brands and its subsidiaries are Equal Opportunity Employers and comply with applicable employment laws. EOE/M/F/Vet/Disabled are encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Security Advocate
jobs.description: **About Nightfall:** Nightfall is the AI\-native, unified data loss prevention and insider risk management platform that protects sensitive data across SaaS apps, GenAI tools, email, endpoint devices, and more. Hundreds of customers, spanning AI innovators to top 10 banks, trust Nightfall to detect and stop data exfiltration at scale. Nightfall enables organizations to innovate freely without the risks of losing intellectual property or exposing customer data. Our agentic platform helps security teams regain their time by putting data loss prevention on autopilot. With automatic remediation, security violations can be resolved automatically before they become incidents, and end\-users can be automatically trained and coached in the moment to self\-heal violations that they introduce. Nightfall is backed by leading VC firms including Bain Capital Ventures (Enrique Salem \- former CEO of Symantec), Venrock (early investors in Cloudflare), WestBridge Capital, Pear VC (early investors in Dropbox and Doordash), and a cadre of cybersecurity leaders including Frederic Kerrest (founder of Okta), Maynard Webb (former COO of eBay), Ryan Carlson (President of Chainguard), Kevin Mandia (founder of Mandiant), and many others. **About the role:** A hands\-on security research role with a public voice: the DevRel function for security operations and data security. AI models and agents give software new ways to access and move company data. We want someone who will test what that makes possible, find where data actually leaks, and show security teams what they found. You might be a detection engineer, incident responder or insider\-risk engineer who enjoys explaining your work. Or a security advocate, researcher or SE who wants more time to build. At Nightfall, you'll own technical investigations end to end and become a trusted public voice for the company with SOC, IR and data security practitioners. **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Run "The Model Did What?" investigations.** Test new models, agents and AI tools against realistic enterprise workflows. Find concrete data exposures, build working reproductions, and show where security controls hold or fail. * **Explain it on camera and in writing.** Open your laptop and walk through what happened. Turn findings into technical videos, blog posts and demos that SOC and data security teams want to watch and share, working with our content team. * **Build open\-source tools.** Ship detections, scanners, labs and utilities that practitioners actually use. Document them, respond to issues, and maintain them after launch. * **Speak and teach.** Give talks at security and engineering conferences (BSides, Black Hat, DEF CON villages and similar). Run hands\-on workshops where participants reproduce the problem and test a defense themselves. * **Build the community.** Host or join podcasts, livestreams and practitioner communities. Bring what you hear from security teams back to product and marketing. * **Equip our sales engineers.** Create realistic, resettable demo environments with synthetic data, plus the scenarios and documentation SEs need to run them on their own. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * 5\+ years in security engineering, detection engineering, incident response, insider risk/DLP, security research or sales engineering. * An established public voice in security: talks, a podcast, research write\-ups, open\-source projects or a following practitioners trust. * You can code, work with APIs and debug across unfamiliar systems. * You understand how enterprise data moves across SaaS, endpoints and AI tools, and how security controls like DLP, CASB, SIEM and EDR work. * You can explain a technical finding clearly and defend it under questioning. * You enjoy talking with security practitioners and engineers, on camera and in person. * You follow through on the software and content you publish. **Nice to have:** experience as a security advocate, evangelist or DevRel at a security vendor; hands\-on work with LLMs, AI agents or MCP; SOC or data security operations experience. Public work can be a small tool, a strong write\-up or a clear demo. We care about the quality of your thinking and what you built, not the title you held. **Environment** Nightfall AI takes pride in being an equal\-opportunity employer. We value a diverse and global talent pool and the collaboration that results from having a diverse and inclusive team. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. Our hiring decisions are based exclusively on merit, qualifications, and business needs. **Compensation** Employee compensation will be determined based on interview performance, level of experience, specialization of skills, and market rate. During the offer discussion, your recruiter will review the finalized base salary, bonus (for applicable roles), benefits \& perks, and stock options as they’ll be reflected in the offer letter. Compensation Range: $150K \- $200K

We give companies real\-time visibility, control, and automation over their digital asset finances so they can grow efficiently without wasting time or money. Backed by top\-tier investors and trusted by companies managing complex cloud environments, North is building the financial operating system for the public cloud. **About the Role** ================== Forecasting sits underneath much of North: projected spend, budgets, and the commitment purchases we make on customers' behalf all depend on knowing where a customer's usage is headed. When a forecast is off, customers feel it, either in missed savings or in commitments that go unused. You'll join the Services team and own the models behind North's internal forecasting service, working with your teammates on the service that delivers forecasts across North's features. You'll shape how the service evolves, from how models are trained and evaluated to how forecast quality is monitored in production. You'll also work closely with data scientists and the teams who rely on forecasts, so results are clear to the people making decisions from them. We're hiring for this role without a fixed level. We'll level you based on experience and on how you work, using our engineering ladder. **What You'll Do** * Build and improve the time series models behind projected spend, budgets, and commitment recommendations, across customers with very different sizes and usage patterns. * Partner with your Services teammates to take models into production as a reliable shared service with clear interfaces. * Shape the forecasting service's architecture, including how models are trained, versioned, evaluated, and served. * Improve how we evaluate, backtest, and monitor forecast accuracy over time. * Build proactive detection and alerting for unusual forecasts and model drift, so issues surface before they affect a decision. * Quantify forecast uncertainty, such as with prediction intervals, so the features that use forecasts can account for it. * Work with data scientists to turn forecast results and model changes into findings product and business teams can act on. * Work with the Commitments, Visibility, and Data teams on what each feature needs from a forecast. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 4\+ years of software or machine learning engineering experience, including shipping time series models to production and owning them after launch. * Deep experience with time series forecasting across classical statistical methods and machine learning approaches, and judgment about when each fits. * Experience with time\-aware validation, backtesting, and forecast accuracy metrics, and an understanding of their tradeoffs. * Experience monitoring production models, including drift, anomaly detection, and retraining. * Fluency in Python and SQL, and experience with large datasets. * Experience collaborating with data scientists, and explaining model behavior and uncertainty to people outside engineering. * Pragmatic, informed use of AI coding tools. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience working as a data scientist, or doing analysis work alongside ML engineering. * Experience with probabilistic forecasting. * Experience forecasting usage, demand, or spend across many accounts with different patterns. * Experience with cloud usage, billing, or pricing data. * Experience with AWS ML services. * Familiarity with FinOps concepts. **Work Setup** Hybrid role based in New York City, with an office in Dumbo, Brooklyn Team members typically work in the office 2–3 days per week OR Remote US **Benefits*** Unlimited PTO * 16 weeks of paid parental leave (birthing parents receive an additional 4 weeks at 50% pay) * Two company\-wide breaks per year: one around Labor Day and one at the end of the year * Aetna Medical plan with the majority of the premium covered by North * Dental and vision insurance * Flexible spending account (FSA) for health expenses and commuter benefits * 30 day sabbatical every 4 years **The pay range for this role is:** 192,000 \- 257,000 USD per year(Brooklyn HQ) 186,000 \- 240,000 USD per year(US Remote)

We pride ourselves on providing competitive benefits: from tuition reimbursement and loan forgiveness to 401(k) matching and lifecycle benefits, our goal is to take care of our employees. Ready to join our quest for better? **Job Description** The **Director, Information Services** reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards. This Director, Information Services position has scope of responsibility for the Consumer Digital Platform, which includes overseeing the architecture and engineering required to modernize NM’s consumer\-facing digital experience. This platform includes the core technology stack, including Sitecore and Azure\-based resources, as well as the software development, machine learning engineering, and data engineering capabilities required to build a modern website, enabled by a knowledge graph, and support scalable digital products for patients, consumers, and internal stakeholders. A successful candidate will have significant experience and domain expertise in leading modern digital platform teams. They will be well\-versed in contemporary web architecture, cloud\-native engineering practices, content management platforms, API\-driven integration patterns, and data\-informed digital product delivery. They will have sufficient technical depth to be an effective leader of software developers, data engineers, architects, and platform partners, while also being able to translate business needs into durable technology capabilities. Northwestern Medicine Information Services drives innovative, high\-value solutions to transform health care. We are committed to supporting the relentless pursuit of better medicine by providing exceptional service to our patients and guests as well as internal clients across the organization. To ensure excellence, our team goes to extraordinary lengths to ensure that our systems work together seamlessly. Northwestern Medicine understands that technology plays an integral role in shaping the future of health care. Information Services strategically supports the organization by: * Leveraging AI, automation and rollout of advanced cyber controls that support digital transformation strategies * Implementing advanced technologies in clinical and administrative areas * Furthering development of the end user support model to help enhance modern infrastructure **Responsibilities:** The key priorities for this leadership position include realizing NM’s Consumer Digital Platform vision: a modern, scalable, cloud\-enabled and AI\-native website and digital experience platform that uses Sitecore, Azure, and knowledge graph capabilities to improve findability, personalization, content governance, and consumer engagement, while maintaining existing operations. This includes: * Overseeing the architecture, design, development, and deployment of robust, scalable, and secure consumer digital platform capabilities across Sitecore, Vercel, Azure, and related integration services * Leading software developers, data engineers, and architects in building a modern website, knowledge graph, data services, APIs, and reusable platform components required to support consumer digital experiences * Managing relationships with vendors and strategic partners, including Sitecore, Microsoft, implementation partners, and other third parties, to realize maximum value from the consumer digital platform * Maximizing the engagement and productivity of technical teams to achieve objectives for platform modernization, operational excellence, reliability, security, and speed to market * Partnering with key stakeholders across NM, including Information Services, Marketing, Communications, Access, Operations, Compliance, Legal, and executive leadership, to align platform investments with consumer experience priorities and enterprise objectives **Qualifications** **Minimum Requirements:** **Education:** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required. **Experience:** * Minimum 8 years industry experience. **Behavioral Attributes:** * Solid understanding and knowledge of healthcare delivery and operations * Excellent verbal and written communication skills. * Outstanding coordination, facilitation, consultation and conflict resolution skills. * Ability to work in a complex, cross\-organizational system. * Demonstrated analysis and problem\-solving skills **Preferred:** * Healthcare technology background * Master’s degree in related field **Additional Information** Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status. **Background Check** Northwestern Medicine conducts a background check that includes criminal history on newly hired team members and, at times, internal transfers. If you are offered a position with us, you will be required to complete an authorization and disclosure form that gives Northwestern Medicine permission to run the background check. Results are evaluated on a case\-by\-case basis, and we follow all local, state, and federal laws, including the Illinois Health Care Worker Background Check Act. **Artificial Intelligence Disclosure** Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used in some portions of the candidate review process for this position, however, all employment decisions will be made by a person. **Benefits** We offer a wide range of benefits that provide employees with tools and resources to improve their physical, emotional, and financial well\-being while providing protection for unexpected life events. Click on or copy and paste URL to your browser to view detailed benefits information https://jobs.nm.org/benefits Please refer to the Benefits Eligibility by Employment Classification to determine benefits eligibility for job postings. **If sign\-on bonus is included in a job posting eligibility is as followed:** Internal employees and rehires who left Northwestern Medicine within 1 year are not eligible for the sign\-on bonus. Exception: New graduate internal employees seeking their first licensed clinical position as a Registered Nurse at NM may be eligible.

jobs.title: Senior Software Support Engineer
jobs.description: The **Senior Software Support Engineer** owns Tier 3 product support for Northwoods applications, serving as the primary technical resource for escalated customer issues. This role diagnoses and resolves complex production issues across application code, databases, integrations, and infrastructure while helping protect feature development teams from unnecessary interruptions. This is a hands\-on engineering role that combines production support, troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, and software development. You'll work primarily with Traverse while supporting other Northwoods applications and will become a go\-to technical resource for understanding product behavior, configuration, and complex customer issues. **This is a hybrid role working 3 days a week out of our Dublin, OH office.** **What you’ll be doing** * Own and prioritize the Tier 3 support queue, providing technical leadership from initial escalation through resolution. * Reproduce and diagnose complex production issues using logs, metrics, traces, database queries, and other troubleshooting tools. * Resolve data, configuration, and application issues, including small code fixes in Ruby on Rails and React/TypeScript. * Identify root causes of recurring problems and drive permanent fixes in partnership with Engineering, QA, DevOps, Product, and Support. * Serve as a technical subject\-matter expert on Traverse and develop working knowledge of other Northwoods applications. * Create and maintain runbooks, known\-issue documentation, and support playbooks that help reduce repeat escalations. * Automate repetitive support work using scripts, administrative tooling, and AI\-assisted troubleshooting and diagnostics. * Contribute to planned engineering work when support capacity allows, including modernization efforts such as AngularJS\-to\-React migration. * Provide technical guidance to interns and junior engineers through pairing, code review, and well\-defined technical work. **What we’re looking for** * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in software engineering, application support, or production support for SaaS applications. * Strong troubleshooting skills with experience diagnosing production issues across application code, databases, and infrastructure. * Hands\-on experience with Ruby on Rails, React/TypeScript, SQL/PostgreSQL, and familiarity with AngularJS. * Experience with Git\-based workflows, code review, CI/CD, logging, monitoring, and root\-cause analysis. * Working knowledge of AWS\-hosted applications, Docker, Kubernetes, and SSO/identity technologies. * Strong ownership and judgment with the ability to prioritize escalations and respond effectively to customer\-impacting incidents. * Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical issues to both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Experience using Claude, GitHub Copilot, or similar AI\-assisted development tools. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Must be authorized to work in the U.S. Nice to Have: * Experience supporting case management, human services, government, or similar SaaS applications. * Experience working in SOC 2 or HIPAA environments. * Experience with AngularJS\-to\-React or similar application modernization efforts. * Experience with automated testing tools such as Playwright. * Experience building AI\-assisted support or diagnostic tooling. * Experience mentoring interns or early\-career engineers. **What we provide** * Medical (includes H.S.A. option with employer contribution), dental, and vision insurance * Short\- and long\-term disability * Company paid basic life insurance * 401(k) with 4% company match and immediate vesting * Free financial education and consultation * Wellness program that helps you earn lower premiums * Robust EAP program that includes free therapy sessions, lifestyle coaching, legal/ID theft services, and more * 12 weeks fully paid parental leave * Up to $5,000 adoption fee reimbursement * $500 wellness reimbursement after 60 days of employment * Generous PTO policy and 10 company paid holidays * Company paid cell phone plan Find yourself checking a lot of these boxes but doubting whether you should apply? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every qualification. At Northwoods, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you are excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. Northwoods is committed to diversity in its workforce and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are excited to work with talented people, period. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, national or ethnic origin, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital or civil status, political affiliation, family or parental status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the jurisdictions in which we operate. **Who is Northwoods?** Northwoods makes software solutions that improve the quality of the life of case managers and social workers in the Health and Human Services (HHS) field. Recognized as one of Columbus’ top places to work, working at Northwoods means being part of a team that’s passionate about making an impact on the lives of HHS professionals and the families they serve. We believe in creating a culture of inclusivity and accountability seeking to hire professional, passionate and driven individuals that believe in the values that we believe in: * Curiosity – Willing to test assumptions, courage to ask questions, and active listening. * Community – Helping and mentoring each other, celebrating diversity and acknowledging our team members’ contributions. * Resourcefulness – Willing to try and fail. Asking for help and trusting the expertise of our team. * Stewardship – Safeguarding Northwoods’ values, culture, mission, and resources. We believe that our team members are all accountable adults, not only to themselves but to each other, and we treat them that way. Our team works incredibly hard and is proven through dedication to their craft and our mission. **Our Solutions** Our products are designed for state and county social care program areas, including child welfare, childcare, child support, economic assistance and adult \& aging agencies. These solutions leverage technology to allow case workers and social workers to easily collect, store, manage, and share case content and data more efficiently. By simplifying processes, our customers can spend more time engaging with the families they serve, make better informed decisions and achieve better outcomes. **Traverse** – A SaaS solution that allows for easy, on\-the\-go access to case files, case work and interview forms and intelligent insights on case content and materials, which lead to better engagement and better outcomes. **Compass** – Compass solution is some of our longer standing software that supports multiple markets for both state and county customers. Our focus on reducing time wasted on paperwork and administrative burdens allows case workers to better serve families in need. **Grove \-** Our trusted team of experienced child welfare professionals becomes an extension of agency staff supporting them with administrative tasks such as referral and records requests, compiling documents for court, and document organization. Workers can focus on fostering healthier families without sacrificing their own well\-being.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Agentic AI
jobs.description: **Company Overview** Orbis is a technology company that delivers sovereign intelligence and decision capabilities to the United States Government and its allies. We convert complex information and operational systems into decisive outcomes, giving public institutions and critical enterprises the tools to move faster, see clearer, and act first in an increasingly contested world. We are not a consulting firm and not a systems integrator. Every Orbis team is built around practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, and every engagement is judged on one thing: whether it produces working capability, not slide decks. Solutions forged from experience; that is how we build, and it is how we hire. **Job Summary** =============== Own the agentic systems at the center of Orbis AI — the orchestration, planning, retrieval, and tool\-use machinery behind the Agent Catalog and the OSINT Agent Harness. You will build agents that hold up under real mission workloads and set the evaluation bar the rest of the organization writes against. This is senior engineering on AI systems: the hard problems are correctness, explainability, cost, and behavior at scale. **Travel**: Up to 15% for customer engagement, integration support, and team collaboration. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== * Architect and ship agents across the portfolio — knowledge agents over customer data, tool agents that wrap external operations, and goal\-driven agents that plan and execute multi\-step analysis. * Own the orchestration layer: planning, tool selection, state and memory, retries, partial failure, and termination behavior. * Design and own retrieval end to end — chunking, embedding, indexing, ranking, and the query\-time behavior that decides answer quality. * Build the provenance and citation paths that let a user see how a conclusion was reached, and treat unexplainable output as a defect rather than a limitation. * Own the evaluation infrastructure for agent quality — accuracy, groundedness, explainability, latency, and cost — and set the standard other engineers write cases against. * Integrate model providers and third\-party tools behind stable internal interfaces, and instrument agents so quality regressions and cost anomalies surface before a customer finds them. * Partner with research engineers to productionize validated results, and mentor engineers moving into AI work from a conventional software background. * Travel up to 15% for customer engagement, integration support, and team collaboration. **Required Qualifications** =========================== * 4\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 2\+ years building LLM\-backed or agentic systems in production * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience * Strong programming skills in Python and/or TypeScript, with substantial production code in at least one * Deep practical experience with retrieval\-augmented generation — embeddings, vector search, chunking strategy, ranking, and the failure modes of each * Demonstrated experience building and debugging multi\-step, tool\-using agents, whether on a framework or from primitives * Proven rigor about evaluation, including harnesses that measured whether an AI change actually improved anything * Willingness to travel up to 15% **Desired Qualifications** ========================== * Experience with knowledge graphs, ontologies, entity resolution, or information extraction * Experience running open\-weight models in constrained or disconnected environments where a hosted API is not an option * Experience with production observability and cost control for model\-backed workloads * Familiarity with OSINT, intelligence, or research workflows and the accuracy and provenance expectations that come with them * Experience mentoring engineers into AI work from a conventional software background * Open\-source contributions, publications, or academic collaboration in applied AI **Physical Requirements** ========================= * Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer * Participation in virtual and in\-person meetings * Ability to attend planned meetings and/or work in classified spaces for extended periods within the specified work regions * **Travel**: Up to 15% for customer engagement, integration support, and team collaboration. **Orbis Benefits** Beyond the opportunity to work alongside practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, joining Orbis means real ownership over outcomes that matter; the chance to build technology that gives the United States Government and its allies a genuine decision advantage, not just another dashboard. From competitive retirement matching to a PTO policy that encourages real time off, we're committed to creating an environment where our team can do their best work and still have a life outside of it. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. A full list of benefits is shared with candidates following an initial conversation with our HR team, so you'll have a clear picture of the support and resources available to you as part of the Orbis team. **Orbis Locations** Orbis works in whatever arrangement the mission requires. Depending on the role, that might mean five days a week on a customer site, full\-time in one of our offices, a hybrid schedule, or fully remote work; our team is spread across 25 states and four countries to match. We make sure every team member has the tools and access needed to do the work, wherever that work happens. Travel is common across many Orbis roles, particularly those supporting customer missions in the field. Orbis is headquartered in McLean, VA, with additional office locations in Taipei, Taiwan, and Canberra, Australia. *Orbis is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We are committed to providing a work environment free of discrimination and harassment, and we make employment decisions based on merit,* *qualifications, and business need. Orbis does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law.* *Orbis complies with all applicable equal opportunity and non\-discrimination laws in every jurisdiction in which we operate. Reasonable accommodation is available to applicants and employees with disabilities upon request.*

jobs.description: **Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human** Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real\-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence. This is an opportunity to do career\-defining work. We're all in on this mission. The team works directly with Todd McKinnon, Okta's co\-founder and CEO, with the opportunity to bring this product to Okta's 20,000\+ customers. You will help shape the product with the ownership and pace of a startup and the resources of a public company. We are hiring two hands\-on architects. One will lead agent execution, harnesses and evaluations. The other will lead backend services, integrations, data and platform reliability. You will write critical code, resolve cross\-team decisions and work with engineers through production rollout. #### **About You** **Hands\-on builder:** You still write production code and test important decisions through implementation. **Practical architect:** You choose a small, clear design and make it easy to extend when the product grows. **Trusted partner:** You earn confidence through useful code, clear feedback and customer understanding. #### **What you will be doing** * Define and implement shared contracts for tasks, events, permissions, approvals, evidence and usage. * Set clear boundaries between model reasoning, agent harnesses, durable workflows and services that enforce authorization. * Select a harness through representative identity tasks, failure tests and operational evidence. Keep model providers and harness components replaceable. * Design integrations with OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, including data boundaries, latency, cost, version changes and measured release quality. * Build reference services for tenant isolation, scoped tool execution, idempotency, long approval waits and verified results. * Define the transactional and analytics data architecture. Keep PostgreSQL application state separate from the planned ClickHouse or BigQuery analytics layer. * Connect Product, Applied AI and Platform engineers through clear ownership and practical APIs. Resolve dependencies that slow delivery. * Write critical implementations, review recovery and security, and guide technical leads through production rollout and customer expansion. #### **What you will bring to the role** * A record of leading architecture and delivery across multiple engineering teams, with recent production code you personally implemented. * Deep knowledge of distributed services, API design, data consistency, cloud security and production operations. * Experience making systems simpler while improving reliability, security or delivery speed. * The ability to explain design tradeoffs, guide senior engineers and remain accountable through implementation. * Depth in at least one of the two role areas below, plus the ability to work across the full product. #### **Role focus** **AI systems architect:** Build and evaluate agent harnesses, context management, model integrations and quality controls. Bring deep production systems experience and practical knowledge of integrating model\-driven workflows. #### **Our stack** Python FastAPI, React and TypeScript, AWS Amplify, Step Functions, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Lambda, SQS, EventBridge and API Gateway. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real\-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence. This is an opportunity to do career\-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk. #### **The Software Engineer Opportunity** The team that built Jeeva AI is building Digital Workers, a new suite of autonomous agents for identity operations and security inside Okta. The team works directly with Todd McKinnon, Okta's co\-founder and CEO, with the opportunity to bring this product to Okta's 20,000\+ customers. You will help shape the product with the ownership and pace of a startup and the resources of a public company. You will build the backend and AWS platform that keep these workers running around the clock. The team owns services, connectors, workflow execution, data and production reliability. You will write Python services and infrastructure code that let workers make approved changes and preserve evidence. #### **About You** **Reliable builder:** You design for failure and prove that recovery works. **Hands\-on engineer:** You write production services and improve the tools engineers use every day. **Strong owner:** You follow changes through deployment, monitoring and production support. #### **What you will be doing** * Build Python FastAPI services, data models and reusable connectors for Okta, AWS, ServiceNow and enterprise applications. * Implement durable execution with Step Functions, SQS and EventBridge. Handle approval waits, rate limits, duplicate events and safe retries. * Manage PostgreSQL schemas, indexes, query performance and pgvector retrieval. Enforce tenant isolation across APIs, storage and credentials. * Build model API access for OpenAI, Anthropic and supported AWS paths, including credentials, quotas, timeouts and cost controls. * Add an analytics pipeline for worker events, traces, tokens, findings and verified outcomes. Evaluate ClickHouse and comparable systems such as BigQuery. * Create reliable usage records and reconciliation. Prevent retries, duplicate findings and incomplete work from being counted as new outcomes. * Build deployment pipelines, infrastructure as code, observability and safe release controls across development, staging and production. * Implement scoped write services, kill switches, audit retention and backup recovery. Test failures and verify that sensitive changes actually took effect. #### **What you will bring to the role** * Experience building and operating production backend or distributed systems, with strong coding skills in Python or a comparable language. * Hands\-on AWS experience with APIs, queues, containers, networking, IAM and databases. * Strong SQL and data modeling skills. Experience diagnosing database performance and asynchronous system failures. * Experience with infrastructure as code, deployment automation, observability and production incident response. * Sound judgment about customer data, tenant isolation, credentials and safe changes to external systems. #### **Scope by level** **Senior:** Own a backend or platform component, including deployment, tests and production operation. **Staff:** Lead a domain such as execution, tenant security, data infrastructure or reliability across teams. **Principal:** Set shared backend and platform contracts, resolve system tradeoffs and implement foundational services. #### **Our stack** Python FastAPI, AWS Step Functions, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, API Gateway and containers. Data and security use RDS PostgreSQL, pgvector, S3 Object Lock, KMS, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch and CloudTrail. The frontend uses React and AWS Amplify. OpenAI and Anthropic model integrations are planned. We are also adding an agent harness and dedicated analytics. ClickHouse is a hiring focus for analytics, and BigQuery or equivalent experience is relevant. The harness and analytics choices remain open. #### **And extra credit for** * ClickHouse, BigQuery or comparable analytics systems, event ingestion and usage metering. * Multi\-tenant SaaS, OAuth, OIDC, SAML, SCIM or enterprise connector development. * Deploying agent frameworks, including Claude Agent SDK, Codex SDK, Strands Agents, Deep Agents or LangGraph. Prior identity experience is optional. P26068\_3596525 \#LI\-RWI **The Okta Experience** * Supporting Your Well\-Being * Driving Social Impact * Developing Talent and Fostering Connection \+ Community We are intentional about connection. Our global community, spanning over 20 offices worldwide, is united by a drive to innovate. Your journey begins with an immersive, in\-person onboarding experience designed to accelerate your impact and connect you to our mission and team from day one. Okta is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, marital status, age, physical or mental disability, or status as a protected veteran. We also consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and convictions records, consistent with applicable laws. If reasonable accommodation is needed to complete any part of the job application, interview process, or onboarding please use this Form to request an accommodation. Notice for New York City Applicants \& Employees: Okta may use Automated Employment Decision Tools (AEDT), as defined by New York City Local Law 144, that use artificial intelligence, machine learning, or other automated processes to assist in our recruitment and hiring process. In accordance with NYC Local Law 144, if you are an applicant or employee residing in New York City, please click here to view our full NYC AEDT Notice.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description: #### **Our mission:** Are you an experienced DevOps Engineer who wants to make a real impact on cloud infrastructure serving millions of users worldwide? You'll work with Kubernetes, automate infrastructure and deployments, and collaborate closely with engineering teams to improve the reliability, scalability, and efficiency of our cloud platform. At Open\-Xchange (OX), we develop open\-source communication and collaboration software used by public sector organizations, telcos, and hosting providers to keep data secure and under their control. Our products cover email, collaboration, DNS security, and related services, and are used by millions of people worldwide.#### **Discover what OX offers you:** * We work in a non\-hierarchical organization that empowers everyone to take responsibility, stay focused, and contribute directly to the company’s success and customer value. * We value expertise and continuous professional development. Our professionals work closely with experienced colleagues, take ownership of their work, and continuously expand their skills. * Openness and diversity are core to OX. Different perspectives, backgrounds, and ways of thinking strengthen our collaboration and help us see the bigger picture. #### **Your team:** The OX Cloud team operates the cloud infrastructure behind our open\-source products, serving millions of users worldwide. We work closely with engineering teams to automate deployments, improve scalability and ensure our platforms remain reliable, secure and observable. We're cloud\-native and Kubernetes\-first, running our platform on our own infrastructure and increasingly on hyperscalers. Our goal is fully automated, declarative and hands\-off operations. We're also evolving our DevOps approach and engineering culture, and you'll play an important role in shaping that journey.#### **Your new job:** * Automate the provisioning of infrastructure, products and configuration with Terraform, Helm and GitOps (Argo CD) in collaboration with other engineering teams. * Run our production environments on Kubernetes, both on our own infrastructure and on hyperscalers. * Develop and maintain Helm charts, support other teams with Helm\-based deployments, and extend the platform with Kubernetes operators where needed. * Contribute to the management and optimization of storage and database infrastructure. * Join our on\-call rotation to handle incidents, troubleshoot issues and improve overall system reliability. * Collaborate with developers and other engineering teams across the product lifecycle, sharing your expertise and helping us continuously improve our engineering practices and culture. #### **This is the tech stack you'll be working with:** * Platform: Kubernetes, on Linux * Automation: Terraform, Helm, GitOps with Argo CD * CI/CD: GitLab CI * Observability: Prometheus, Grafana * Languages: Go, Python, Shell * Databases \& storage: MariaDB/MySQL, Cassandra, S3 #### **Your background:** * Several years of experience with infrastructure\-as\-code and declarative tooling such as Terraform, Helm or GitOps (e.g. Argo CD). A background in software development is a strong plus. * Practical experience operating Kubernetes clusters and workloads, including Helm charts, troubleshooting distributed systems and working with Kubernetes operators. * Solid Linux fundamentals and an understanding of orchestration, automation and declarative, hands\-off operations. * Programming skills in Go, Python or Shell, along with experience contributing to CI/CD pipelines using tools like GitLab or Jenkins. Go is a plus. * Familiarity with databases and storage solutions. Experience with hyperscalers is a bonus. * Strong English communication skills and a collaborative mindset, with an interest in Open Source technologies and working in remote\-first, multicultural teams. * Ability and willingness to work primarily within East Coast US business hours to effectively engage with customers and internal stakeholders. * Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. The company is not able to provide employment visa sponsorship at this time. #### **This is what you get at OX:** * The flexibility to work 100% remotely ensures a work environment that suits you best. * Flexible working hours that allow you to successfully combine your home and family responsibilities with work. * Getting together in\-person for workshops and fun team events. * Time off to volunteer – and mental health support when you need it. * We provide financial relief through corporate benefits and a subsidy for ergonomic chairs and desks. * We can discuss further location\-related benefits together in an initial talk. #### **Join the team:** Join us in our fight for an open internet and deliver added value! Click “Apply now” to submit your application.#### **Your contact person:** Reach out to Justin (recruiting@ox.io) from the People Team. He will be able to discuss current opportunities and tell you more about our exciting vision and mission @OX.

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer, Monetization Platform
jobs.description: Applied AI Engineering \- San Francisco and New York City **About the Team** As AI becomes capable of doing more useful work is a new team within Growth building the systems and experiences that make that possible across the entire suite of OpenAI products. Our mission is to make powerful AI easier to access, its value easier to understand, and new ways of using it easier to bring to market. We work where product experience architecture, and business strategy meet. A new plan or pricing model can change what customers can accomplish—and requires careful engineering across eligibility, entitlements, usage, and subscriptions. We turn that complexity into capabilities that product teams can build on and experiences that customers can trust. Working with Product that can evolve alongside our models and products. This is an opportunity to help define a new team’s technical direction and build systems that expand what OpenAI can offer. **About the Role** We’re looking for experienced Staff\+ and Senior engineers who combine full\-stack product instincts with strong backend and systems depth. You’ll help decide what to build, establish the architecture, and carry ideas through to working products—from a customer’s first interaction with a plan to the services that determine what they can access and use. The work spans new pricing and packaging capabilities, plan and usage experiences, and the shared UIs and tools that make launches repeatable. You’ll partner closely with Financial Engineering to connect these capabilities to subscription and billing systems, keeping customer access and state consistent as offerings evolve. You’ll have substantial ownership over technical decisions and delivery in an area where the roadmap is still taking shape. Your impact will show up in the experiences you ship, the engineering work you eliminate from future launches, and the opportunities your systems make possible. **In this role, you will:** * Define and build shared pricing and packaging capabilities, including plan configuration, eligibility, entitlement integrations, and usage allowances. * Create intuitive plan and usage experiences across the stack, connecting polished interfaces to product APIs and backend services. * Turn new commercial ideas into working prototypes and experiments with Product, Finance, and Data Science, then use what you learn to guide the next iteration. * Design integrations with Financial Engineering that preserve correct access and subscription state through plan changes, migrations, asynchronous updates, and partial failures. * Build reusable components and configuration tools that let teams launch offerings with less custom engineering and fewer dependencies. * Take responsibility for production quality through migration planning, staged rollouts, testing, monitoring, and recovery paths. * Shape the technical roadmap, make clear tradeoffs between immediate launches and shared foundations, and develop other engineers through code and design reviews. **You might thrive in this role if you:** * Have set architectural direction and delivered significant projects involving multiple teams, while remaining an active contributor to the code. * Bring depth in backend or distributed systems and can work across the APIs and interfaces that turn those systems into useful products. * Reason rigorously about data models, lifecycle transitions, consistency, concurrency, and what happens when an operation fails or runs twice. * Have taken loosely defined customer or business problems through discovery, implementation, and production operation. * Combine product intuition with experimentation and analysis, and care about whether customers understand and benefit from what you build. * Enjoy establishing new capabilities: choosing an initial design, shipping something useful, and improving it as the problem becomes clearer. * Build alignment across disciplines, explain technical choices clearly, and help teammates take on greater responsibility. Experience with pricing systems prepares them to learn this domain. **About OpenAI** OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general\-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employeration, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable lawation technology systems and related data security obligations. To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non\-compliant. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology. **Compensation** $266K – $445K \+ Offers Equity The base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factorsance\-related bonus(es) for eligible employees, and the following benefits. * Medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your family, with employer contributions to Health Savings Accounts * Pre\-tax accounts for Health FSA, Dependent Care FSA, and commuter expenses (parking and transit) * 401(k) retirement plan with employer match * Paid parental leave (up to 24 weeks for birth parents and 20 weeks for non\-birthing parents), plus paid medical and caregiver leave (up to 8 weeks) * Paid time off: flexible PTO for exempt employees and up to 15 days annually for non\-exempt employees * 13\+ paid company holidays, and multiple paid coordinated company office closures throughout the year for focus and recharge, plus paid sick or safe time (1 hour per 30 hours worked, or more, as required by applicable state or local law) * Mental health and wellness support * Employer\-paid basic life and disability coverage * Annual learning and development stipend to fuel your professional growth * Daily meals in our offices, and meal delivery credits as eligible * Relocation support for eligible employees * Additional taxable fringe benefits, such as charitable donation matching and wellness stipends, may also be provided. More details about our benefits are available to candidates during the hiring process. This role is at\-will and OpenAI reserves the right to modify base pay and other compensation components at any time based on individual performance, team or company results, or market conditions.

Our work spans cybersecurity, frontier\-risk evaluations, and red teaming, with a focus on turning research and testing into practical tools and reliable systems. We collaborate across research, engineering, and security to investigate model capabilities, identify potential failures, and develop ways to evaluate and improve safeguards. **About the Role** We’re looking for a Software Engineer to build the tools and infrastructure that support this work. You’ll partner closely with researchers and other engineers to translate evolving questions into useful software—from early prototypes to systems that teams can depend on. Projects may include backend services, evaluation infrastructure, data pipelines, and internal applications for running tests, investigating model behavior, and reviewing results. This is a general software engineering role with room to contribute across the stack and develop deeper expertise in AI safety and security. **In this role, you will:** * Design, build, and maintain software that supports cybersecurity research, frontier\-risk evaluations, and red teaming. * Develop tools and workflows that make it easier to run evaluations, inspect results, and investigate failures. * Build services, APIs, data pipelines, and interfaces that help researchers work efficiently. * Turn experimental workflows into reusable, well\-tested, and documented systems. * Own projects from understanding the problem and designing a solution through implementation, deployment, and ongoing operation. * Improve reliabilityance, observability, security, and usability as needs evolve. * Collaborate with researchers, security specialists, and engineers to identify useful problems and make practical technical decisions. **You might thrive in this role if you:** * Have strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building, shipping, and maintaining production software. * Are proficient in a general\-purpose programming language and comfortable learning unfamiliar tools and systems. * Have experience in one or more areas such as backend development, full\-stack applications, infrastructure, or data systems. * Can take an open\-ended problem, clarify what matters, and deliver a useful solution. * Balance rapid iteration with maintainable design and operational reliability. * Communicate clearly and enjoy working with people across technical disciplines. * Are interested in understanding advanced AI systems and helping address their risks. * Experience with securitys, distributed systems, or AI applications would be valuable.
