jobs.title: Creative Technologist (AI Design Engineer)
jobs.description: **Creative Technologist (AI Design Engineer)** ============================================== *Also known as: Creative Workflow Specialist · AI Workflow Designer* **About OpenArt** ================= OpenArt is a leading AI Creative Platform for visual storytelling, used by millions worldwide. We're building the next generation of creative tools powered by cutting\-edge AI, enabling anyone to create videos, images, visuals, characters, and stories with unprecedented speed and imagination. We're bringing those tools together into one agentic creative environment: it understands what you mean, orchestrates the right capabilities, and still leaves you in full control of the work. We believe the future of creativity is AI\-native, and we're shaping that future. **About the Role** ================== We're building tools that expand what's creatively possible — and, increasingly, an agent that does the work: it understands what a creator wants, picks the right models and tools, runs the job, and hands back something they can see, adjust, and finish. For that to hold up in professional production, the agent has to know the work from the inside. That's where you come in. We need someone who sits between creators and product to turn real pain points in professional workflows into solutions that run and can be proven. If you know professional creative production from the inside and you're used to building your own ideas into interactive prototypes with AI, this might be your seat. We're not just looking for someone who makes demos. We're looking for someone who finds the problem, researches the workflow, delivers the prototype end to end, makes the case for it, and then hands it to engineering to ship. **Why Join OpenArt** ==================== * **Your prototypes become products.** What you build won't stop at a demo. Validated prototypes go straight onto the product roadmap and are taken to launch by engineering. * **Work at the frontier of AI and creativity.** You'll be among the first to get hands\-on with new models and capabilities, and as a practitioner, you'll decide what shape they take inside creators' workflows — and what the agent should do with them on a creator's behalf. * **Direct impact on product direction.** Your judgment won't sit in a review queue. From identifying problems to validating prototypes, you'll directly shape what OpenArt builds next. * **Hyper\-growth and huge market opportunity.** OpenArt is one of the largest AI video generation platforms globally, with millions of monthly active users and partnerships with top model players including Google, OpenAI, Anthropic, BytePlus, and Kling. * **Define where creative tools go next.** Generation gets cheaper every month; what creators and clients pay for is finished work. An agent that does the whole job is where the category is heading, and the person who knows production from the inside is the one who decides what it does. **Requirements** ================ * **Fluency in professional creative pipelines.** Hands\-on experience in professional creative production such as advertising, film, or content. You understand every stage from brief to delivery and can pinpoint where the real bottlenecks are. * **Moves fluidly between design and engineering.** AI is your core tool for building. You're proficient with AI coding tools, model APIs, agent frameworks, and lightweight code, and can independently turn concepts into working prototypes fast. * **End\-to\-end delivery.** You can independently take work from problem definition and workflow research through interaction design, visual design, and a usable prototype, delivered to a standard professional users can work with directly. * **Strong product taste.** You hold a high bar for craft, polish, and interaction quality, and you know the difference between something that works and something that works well. * **A body of work that proves it.** A portfolio or GitHub showing the tools, prototypes, products, or experiments you've built. We care far more about what you've made than where you've worked. **Nice to Have** ================ * **Proficiency with professional creative tools.** Editing, compositing, motion, or 3D tools. You don't just know how to use them; you know where they fall short on real projects. * **Background in advertising, film, or content production.** You've felt the pressure of professional production firsthand and know what clients and teams actually need before a deadline. * **Experience at a creative lab, innovation agency, or AI product team.** You're comfortable moving through ambiguity and turning new technology into something concrete and usable. * **You've built with agents.** Tool\-calling, MCP, skills, or your own automations — anything where the AI did part of the job for you, and you learned where it should and shouldn't be trusted. **What You'll Do** ================== * **Identify where workflows break.** Embed in the real production work of our in\-house creative team and enterprise clients to pinpoint bottlenecks — and the places where an agent doing the work first would change what a team can ship. * **Teach the agent the job.** Turn what you learn into workflows the agent can run end to end — a brief into a set of finished ad variants, one video into ten languages, a winning ad into every placement size — and define what "done to a professional standard" means for each, so what comes back is usable without a second pass. * **Turn complex generative workflows into intuitive experiences.** As models and workflows grow more capable and more complex, decide what the agent should simply handle and where a professional needs to step in to see, adjust, and finish — so creators stay in control of the work instead of waiting on a black box. * **Rapidly prototype new concepts.** Use AI tools, Figma, lightweight code, and APIs to explore interaction patterns and validate ideas, taking them from early concept to polished interface, including motion, transitions, and micro\-interactions. * **Define what each prototype needs to prove.** Before each prototype, be clear on the hypothesis it's testing. After, assess what was learned and make a clear call: scale, iterate, or stop. * **Drive from concept to launch.** Work closely with product, model, and engineering teams to turn validated prototypes into shipped features, and build up reusable components and interaction patterns along the way, so the next workflow reaches creators faster. **Compensation** ================ * Competitive TC including base salary, bonus, and equity (based on experience). * Meaningful equity ownership in what you build. **Work Setup** ============== * San Carlos, CA (full\-time, on\-site or hybrid) * Visa sponsorship available Compensation Range: $180K \- $250K

jobs.title: Robot Application Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Robot Application Software Engineer** **Key Responsibilities** * Develop and enhance the AME(Autonomous Mobile Equipment) data platform, including the data portal, dashboards, bot/version tracking, regression reporting, and developer\-facing tools. * Build scalable cloud compute and data pipeline capabilities for robot telemetry, calibration/config uploads, automated reporting, and production analytics. * Support OTA and ROC integration by connecting robot software release data, operational status, remote support workflows, and fleet\-level diagnostics into the AME data ecosystem. * Maintain and improve production data infrastructure across live plants, including database reliability, upload pipelines, data quality monitoring, and incident response. * Supporting AME GUI development where needed, including operator\-facing dashboards, diagnostics views, fleet tools, and data\-heavy web interfaces. * Partner with autonomy, deployment, ROC, OTA, and plant teams to scale AME software/data capabilities for 300\+ production robots across GM plants, and future deployments. * Ship production\-grade software with strong ownership of versioning, change control, observability, debugging, and on\-call support to minimize factory downtime. **Required Skills / Experience:** * UI/Frontend Technologies: Mastery of JavaScript/TypeScript and modern frameworks like React or Angular to build responsive, data\-heavy web interfaces. * Hands on Linux, Docker (for containerized deployments), and Git for version control * Working knowledge of ROS 2 and robotics autonomy software. * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Engineering, or a related field

jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer Remote Nationwide or Office-Based in MN/DC/NJ
jobs.description: Optum Tech is a global leader in health care innovation. Our teams develop cutting\-edge solutions that help people live healthier lives and help make the health system work better for everyone. From advanced data analytics and AI to cybersecurity, we use innovative approaches to solve some of health care's most complex challenges. Your contributions here have the potential to change lives. Ready to build the next breakthrough? Join us in making healthcare work better for everyone through people\-led, responsible AI while **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.** The Provider Digital Technology team delivers a unified, intuitive digital entry point for UnitedHealthcare providers and partners to access tools, services, and information. We build secure, scalable capabilities that simplify how providers discover, navigate, and engage across the Portal, API, EDI, Chat, and Voice channels. Our AI/ML engineering team develops production\-grade intelligent solutions, including generative AI assistants, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), agentic workflows, conversational AI, predictive models, and intelligent automation. We partner across UnitedHealthcare and UnitedHealth Group to integrate enterprise applications and data sources while applying responsible AI, privacy, security, safety, observability, and human\-centered design principles. This work reduces friction, improves provider workflows, and enables faster, more effective problem\-solving across the health care ecosystem. jobs.title: Principal Security Engineer, Security Data & Reporting
jobs.description: The Principal Security Engineer provides technical leadership and hands\-on engineering for security data platforms, reporting applications, and analytics that help operational teams and leadership understand enterprise security posture and make informed risk decisions. The role designs, builds, and operates automated data pipelines, repeatable security metric calculations, and reporting solutions that turn data from multiple systems into accurate, traceable, and actionable information. Working with security subject matter experts, engineering teams, and program leadership, this engineer translates complex measurement needs into secure, reliable, and maintainable solutions. The role resolves integration and data\-quality challenges, applies sound architectural judgment, and independently delivers complex engineering initiatives. It develops and integrates AI\-enabled capabilities to improve analysis and reporting, with appropriate validation, human review, and data\-access controls. The Principal Security Engineer owns solutions from design through deployment, ongoing operation, and continuous improvement, while providing technical guidance and strengthening shared engineering practices. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** ------------------------ ### **Security Data Integration and Engineering** * Designs, builds, and maintains automated integrations that collect data from security tools, enterprise applications, APIs, databases, and other source systems. * Establishes centralized data structures and ingestion workflows that support reliable security measurement, historical analysis, and reporting, with appropriate validation, error handling, monitoring, and recovery capabilities. * Partners with security and engineering teams to assess source\-system coverage, data availability, refresh requirements, integration dependencies, and ownership. * Replaces manual data collection with supported automation while maintaining data quality, validation, and clear accountability. * Evolves the integration architecture to accommodate additional data sources, metrics, and reporting needs while balancing near\-term delivery with long\-term maintainability. ### **Data Modeling and Metric Implementation** * Translates security measurement requirements into documented data models, transformation logic, and repeatable metric calculations. * Normalizes and reconciles data across systems, addressing inconsistent definitions, duplicate records, incomplete coverage, and differences in reporting periods. * Implements and validates metric calculations, baselines, and trends using definitions and targets agreed with security subject matter experts and program leadership. * Maintains traceability from reported metrics to source data, calculation logic, and applicable scope; preserves historical results and manages calculation changes so reporting remains explainable and comparable over time. * Investigates and communicates data\-quality issues, measurement limitations, and assumptions, recommending improvements that strengthen the accuracy and interpretation of security reporting. ### **Dashboard and Reporting Application Development** * Develops and maintains dashboards and reporting applications using Oracle APEX or comparable technologies. * Translates leadership and operational reporting needs into clear, usable views, incorporating stakeholder feedback and perspectives from different reporting audiences. * Provides appropriate drill\-down capabilities so users can investigate results and understand the factors contributing to changes in security posture. * Builds data submission, validation, review, and publication workflows where automated source integration is not yet available. * Evaluates whether visualizations accurately communicate the intended security outcomes and improves reporting usability, performance, and maintainability through iterative development. ### **Automation and AI\-Enabled Analytics** * Designs, develops, and integrates AI\-enabled features into security data platforms, dashboards, and reporting workflows. * Evaluates and applies generative AI, large language models, and other analytical techniques to support natural\-language exploration, contextual analysis, reporting automation, anomaly detection, and forecasting where appropriate. * Connects AI\-enabled functionality to authoritative security data and metric definitions, maintaining source traceability and enforcing audience\-specific access controls. * Establishes evaluation and validation methods to assess accuracy, reliability, and usefulness, with appropriate human review of generated interpretations and recommendations. * Monitors and improves AI\-enabled features as data, models, and requirements evolve, using defined measures to assess effectiveness and guide further investment. ### **Security, Permissions, and Access Controls** * Designs and implements role\-based access and least\-privilege permissions for data contributors, reviewers, administrators,  ambiguity and adjust plans as priorities or constraints change; escalates unresolved issues with an assessment of impact and recommended options. * Expands relevant technical knowledge, mentors colleagues, documents and shares solutions, and contributes to shared engineering practices. **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS** -------------------------- ### **Education and Experience** One of the following: * **11 years of experience** in IT security, developing security reporting solutions, such as cloud, endpoint, or logging; vulnerability and risk assessment; identity and access management; compliance; or a related field. **OR** * **Bachelor’s degree** in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Security, Engineering, or a related field, **and 7 years of experience** in IT security, such as cloud, endpoint, or logging; vulnerability and risk assessment; identity and access management; compliance; or a related field. **OR** * **Master’s degree** in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Security, Engineering, or a related field, **and 5 years of experience** in IT security, such as cloud, endpoint, or logging; vulnerability and risk assessment; identity and access management; compliance; or a related field. ### **Technical and Security Experience** * Demonstrated knowledge across multiple cybersecurity domains and experience working with security subject matter experts to interpret controls, risks, data sources, and measurement limitations. * Strong SQL and relational database skills, including schema design, data modeling, query development, and performance optimization. * Experience building and maintaining automated data pipelines, API integrations, and data transformation processes. * Proficiency in a programming or scripting language used for integration and automation, such as Python. * Experience developing dashboards, reporting applications, or analytical tools for operational and leadership audiences. * Hands\-on experience developing and integrating AI\-enabled application features, including evaluating output quality and implementing appropriate data\-access and security controls. * Experience implementing data validation, reconciliation, and monitoring to support trustworthy reporting. * Understanding of authentication, authorization, role\-based access, and secure handling of sensitive data. * Experience applying testing, version control, documentation, and deployment practices to production solutions. * Ability to translate ambiguous requirements into practical technical solutions, identify dependencies, and communicate tradeoffs clearly. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Experience developing applications with **Oracle APEX** , including SQL and PL/SQL. * Experience with Oracle Database, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, or comparable cloud data and application platforms. * Experience integrating data from multiple cybersecurity domains, such as vulnerability management, asset management, identity and access management, endpoint security, security monitoring, or cloud security. * Experience implementing security posture metrics, executive reporting, and historical trend analysis. * Experience applying AI\-enabled capabilities to enterprise data analysis and reporting, including validating outputs and enforcing appropriate data access controls. * Familiarity with security frameworks such as NIST CSF, NIST 800\-53, ISO 27001, or CIS Controls. * Experience establishing a new data or reporting capability and transitioning manual processes into supported automation. * Experience working across a large organization with distributed data ownership and multiple stakeholder groups. * Relevant security certifications, such as **Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP), Certificate of Cloud Security Knowledge (CCSK), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), or Certified Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Security Professional** .

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Agentic AI
jobs.description: **Company Overview** Orbis is a technology company that delivers sovereign intelligence and decision capabilities to the United States Government and its allies. We convert complex information and operational systems into decisive outcomes, giving public institutions and critical enterprises the tools to move faster, see clearer, and act first in an increasingly contested world. We are not a consulting firm and not a systems integrator. Every Orbis team is built around practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, and every engagement is judged on one thing: whether it produces working capability, not slide decks. Solutions forged from experience; that is how we build, and it is how we hire. **Job Summary** =============== Own the agentic systems at the center of Orbis AI — the orchestration, planning, retrieval, and tool\-use machinery behind the Agent Catalog and the OSINT Agent Harness. You will build agents that hold up under real mission workloads and set the evaluation bar the rest of the organization writes against. This is senior engineering on AI systems: the hard problems are correctness, explainability, cost, and behavior at scale. **Travel**: Up to 15% for customer engagement, integration support, and team collaboration. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== * Architect and ship agents across the portfolio — knowledge agents over customer data, tool agents that wrap external operations, and goal\-driven agents that plan and execute multi\-step analysis. * Own the orchestration layer: planning, tool selection, state and memory, retries, partial failure, and termination behavior. * Design and own retrieval end to end — chunking, embedding, indexing, ranking, and the query\-time behavior that decides answer quality. * Build the provenance and citation paths that let a user see how a conclusion was reached, and treat unexplainable output as a defect rather than a limitation. * Own the evaluation infrastructure for agent quality — accuracy, groundedness, explainability, latency, and cost — and set the standard other engineers write cases against. * Integrate model providers and third\-party tools behind stable internal interfaces, and instrument agents so quality regressions and cost anomalies surface before a customer finds them. * Partner with research engineers to productionize validated results, and mentor engineers moving into AI work from a conventional software background. * Travel up to 15% for customer engagement, integration support, and team collaboration. **Required Qualifications** =========================== * 4\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 2\+ years building LLM\-backed or agentic systems in production * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience * Strong programming skills in Python and/or TypeScript, with substantial production code in at least one * Deep practical experience with retrieval\-augmented generation — embeddings, vector search, chunking strategy, ranking, and the failure modes of each * Demonstrated experience building and debugging multi\-step, tool\-using agents, whether on a framework or from primitives * Proven rigor about evaluation, including harnesses that measured whether an AI change actually improved anything * Willingness to travel up to 15% **Desired Qualifications** ========================== * Experience with knowledge graphs, ontologies, entity resolution, or information extraction * Experience running open\-weight models in constrained or disconnected environments where a hosted API is not an option * Experience with production observability and cost control for model\-backed workloads * Familiarity with OSINT, intelligence, or research workflows and the accuracy and provenance expectations that come with them * Experience mentoring engineers into AI work from a conventional software background * Open\-source contributions, publications, or academic collaboration in applied AI **Physical Requirements** ========================= * Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer * Participation in virtual and in\-person meetings * Ability to attend planned meetings and/or work in classified spaces for extended periods within the specified work regions * **Travel**: Up to 15% for customer engagement, integration support, and team collaboration. **Orbis Benefits** Beyond the opportunity to work alongside practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, joining Orbis means real ownership over outcomes that matter; the chance to build technology that gives the United States Government and its allies a genuine decision advantage, not just another dashboard. From competitive retirement matching to a PTO policy that encourages real time off, we're committed to creating an environment where our team can do their best work and still have a life outside of it. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. A full list of benefits is shared with candidates following an initial conversation with our HR team, so you'll have a clear picture of the support and resources available to you as part of the Orbis team. **Orbis Locations** Orbis works in whatever arrangement the mission requires. Depending on the role, that might mean five days a week on a customer site, full\-time in one of our offices, a hybrid schedule, or fully remote work; our team is spread across 25 states and four countries to match. We make sure every team member has the tools and access needed to do the work, wherever that work happens. Travel is common across many Orbis roles, particularly those supporting customer missions in the field. Orbis is headquartered in McLean, VA, with additional office locations in Taipei, Taiwan, and Canberra, Australia. *Orbis is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We are committed to providing a work environment free of discrimination and harassment, and we make employment decisions based on merit,* *qualifications, and business need. Orbis does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law.* *Orbis complies with all applicable equal opportunity and non\-discrimination laws in every jurisdiction in which we operate. Reasonable accommodation is available to applicants and employees with disabilities upon request.*

Apple iOS and macOS deployment and troubleshooting. ChromeOS deployment and troubleshooting. PSA and/or RMM tools. Printer hardware and software support. jobs.title: AI Transformation Lead
jobs.description: At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state\-of\-the\-art SaaS product, which harnesses Generative AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn’t just in the hands of big brands \- we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too. You will be the strategic and technical owner of transformation engagements on a defined set of accounts. The most informed voice on what Pencil should do for each client and how the work gets done. You set the thesis, structure the engagement from first principles, co\-design the recommendations and timelines with Forward Deployed Engineers and Creative Leads, lead the client through the enterprise\-wide change required to make it stick, and stand behind quality and performance once the work ships. You own the recommendations and the narrative we tell our clients. ***Candidates must be based in North America and have consulting and/or agency experience to be considered for this role.*** **Key responsibilities:** * Implementation Leadership: Own the narrative told to the client and the strategic and tactical plan that drives the engagement, setting the transformation thesis, co\-designing the recommendations with Forward Deployed Engineers and Creative Leads * Structured Problem\-Solving: Take ambiguous client problems and structure them from first principles into a clear set of hypotheses, workstreams, and sequenced decisions everyone can act on. * Change Management Leadership: Lead clients through enterprise\-wide transformation, moving them beyond siloed pilots into integrated, AI\-driven workflows \- navigating complex stakeholder landscapes, identifying blockers and champions, and engineering the buy\-in that scaled AI adoption requires. * AI Process Design: Translate abstract GenAI concepts into clear, repeatable operating processes that client teams can execute confidently day\-to\-day. * Product Feedback Loop: Act as the voice of the customer internally, feeding insights back to Product and Engineering \- what's missing, what's broken, what's worth doubling down on \- so Pencil's roadmap stays enterprise\-ready. * Transformation Blueprints: Codify what works on your accounts into repeatable Blueprints the rest of the team can run, so every successful engagement leaves behind a sharper playbook than the one before it. **Your background:** * Minimum of 5 years’ experience in consulting or an agency setting, in\-house transformation, programme management, or enterprise technology implementation, with exposure to technology, digital strategy, and/or operations. A strong academic record in a quantitative or analytical discipline is preferred. * AI\-native in your day\-to\-day. You already use Claude Cowork; experience with Claude Code or other agentic tooling is a strong plus. You don't wait to be told to automate something. * Tech\-fluent and hands\-on. You're in the Pencil platform yourself \- configuring agents, prototyping, stress\-testing recommendations \- and you can hold your own in a technical conversation with a client's engineers about their stack. Lightweight engineering \- SQL, scripts, reading code \- is a strong plus. * Confident with senior stakeholders. You can carry a client meeting on your own, give direct feedback, and stay composed when scope shifts. * A track record of delivering complex, cross\-functional, often ambiguous work to a high standard and on time. * Marketing, advertising, or agency experience is essential for this role. **You’ll Thrive Here If You…** * Are Provocative and Brave: You aren't afraid to challenge a customer’s existing way of working if it means helping them avoid long\-term implementation challenges. * Are an Ally to Change: You are comfortable with ambiguity and change, and you take pride in being a trustworthy partner who helps others navigate the "new and unknown." * Believe in Enterprise Adoption: You are obsessed with seeing technology move away from “pilot purgatory" and towards an embedded, value\-driving part of a company’s culture and success. * Embody Pencil Values: You lead with transparency, agility, and a focus on measurable impact, ensuring our values are mirrored in the customer’s own transformation journey. **KPIs \& Success Measures** * Enterprise Adoption: Depth and breadth of Pencil usage across a customer's teams, departments, and use cases once the rollout is live. * Time\-to\-Value: Speed at which your accounts reach their first defined success metric or ROI milestone after engagement kickoff. * Quality of Transformation Narrative: How well your transformation thesis and the strategic and tactical planning survive delivery without major rework, and the performance the recommendation drives for the client post\-launch. * Product Feedback Impact: Quality and reach of insights fed back to Product and Engineering that keep Pencil's roadmap enterprise\-ready. * Blueprint Contribution: Successful documentation and internal adoption of repeatable "Transformation Blueprints" based on customer wins. **Benefits:** * 25 days PTO plus public holidays, although we operate a Flexible Time Off scheme * Health insurance / private medical cover * Monthly stipend towards wellness, fitness, and learning and development * Remote \- work from anywhere in your home country * Enhanced parental leave policies, whether you become a parent through birth, adoption or surrogacy * Access to our Pencil office in The Shard, London for UK employees * Flexible working hours

jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer - PVA
jobs.description: The Manufacturing Engineer owns the production machinery in the Paceline PVA department. You will run, maintain and improve the equipment that keeps production on schedule, and set the standards others work to. This is a hands\-on engineering role with technical leadership responsibility. You will write the work instructions and maintenance plans, lead troubleshooting efforts, and drive continuous improvement across department operations. **Key responsibilities** ------------------------ **Equipment operation and ownership** * Serve as the technical owner of all Paceline PVA production machinery, ensuring safe, reliable and efficient operation. * Set up, run and adjust equipment to meet production schedules, quality specifications and throughput targets. * Act as the escalation point for operators and technicians on equipment issues. **Work instructions and standards** * Develop, write and maintain standard work instructions (SWIs), operating procedures and setup/changeover guides. * Keep documentation current as equipment, materials or processes change. * Train operators and technicians on procedures and verify they are followed. **Maintenance planning** * Build and manage preventive and predictive maintenance plans for all department equipment. * Schedule maintenance to minimize production impact, and track completion against plan. * Manage critical spare parts and coordinate with vendors and OEMs on service, parts and upgrades. **Troubleshooting** * Lead diagnosis of mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, hydraulic and control\-system faults. * Perform root cause analysis (5 Whys, fishbone, 8D) on recurring failures and implement permanent corrective actions. * Track downtime and failure data to target the biggest losses. **Optimization and continuous improvement** * Monitor equipment performance (OEE, uptime, scrap, cycle time) and identify improvement opportunities. * Lead continuous improvement projects using Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen and 5S methods. * Review department operations end to end, from material flow and staffing to changeovers and layout, and recommend improvements. * Evaluate and support new equipment, upgrades and process changes from specification through commissioning. **Leadership and collaboration** * Mentor and provide technical direction to operators, technicians and maintenance staff. * Partner with Production, Quality, Engineering and EHS to meet safety, quality and delivery goals. * Champion a safety\-first culture, including lockout/tagout and machine guarding compliance. **Required qualifications** --------------------------- * 5\+ years of manufacturing engineering experience running, maintaining and troubleshooting complex manufacturing machinery. * Proficiency with 3D CAD software such as SolidWorks, Autodesk Inventor or Fusion. * Proven ability to write clear work instructions, SOPs and maintenance procedures. * Experience building and managing preventive maintenance programs. * Strong troubleshooting skills across mechanical, electrical, pneumatic and hydraulic systems. * Working knowledge of PLCs, HMIs and automated control systems. * Experience applying root cause analysis and continuous improvement methods. * Ability to read mechanical drawings, electrical schematics and P\&IDs. * Experience leading or directing the work of technicians or operators. * Strong communication skills, written and verbal. * Working knowledge of OSHA safety standards, including lockout/tagout. * Bachelor of Science (BS) in Mechanical, Electromechanical or Manufacturing Engineering. **Preferred qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience handling thin films, including winding, unwinding, slitting and web tension control. * Experience with textile and knitting machines, including setup, maintenance and troubleshooting. * PLC programming experience in Structured Text (IEC 61131\-3\), preferably with TwinCAT or CODESYS. * Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or higher. * Experience with CMMS platforms for maintenance scheduling and tracking. * Experience with PVA (polyvinyl alcohol) or similar polymer, film or chemical processing equipment. * Experience commissioning new equipment or production lines. * Familiarity with ERP/MES systems. **Success in the first year looks like** ---------------------------------------- * Current, approved work instructions for every major piece of department equipment. * A preventive maintenance plan in place and tracked, with on\-time completion above target. * Measurable reduction in unplanned downtime and improvement in OEE. * At least two completed continuous improvement projects with documented results. **Working conditions** ---------------------- * Manufacturing floor environment with exposure to noise, heat, moving machinery and chemicals; PPE required. * Ability to stand, walk, climb ladders and lift up to 50 lb. * Occasional off\-shift, weekend or on\-call support for critical equipment issues. **Compensation and benefits** ----------------------------- prototyping to development, launch, and post\-launch optimization, ensuring quality and timely delivery. * Define the end\-to\-end automation experience: ingesting orders from multiple channels and formats, extracting structured data, matching customer language to the product catalog, validating against pricing, availability, and business rules, and creating the order in downstream systems. * Define and run the evaluation process for AI systems: build golden datasets, set accuracy metrics, and run regression testing whenever models, prompts, or data change. * Partner and communicate effectively with design, sales, operations, and other stakeholders to prioritize features, resolve complex challenges, and drive adoption and change management, including phased rollouts by customer segment or location. * Establish goals, metrics, and analytics to measure product success, including match accuracy, time to order, error and cost. **What You Need to Succeed:** * 4\+ Years of for AI systems: golden datasets, quality metrics, error analysis, and regression testing across model and prompt changes. * Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts and clearly communicate tradeoffs and decisions. * Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage and recall detailed information in a timely manner. * Deep business acumen with the Later work extends to Angular with .NET (C\#/ASP.NET Core) Web APIs, our standard for internal and future custom apps. The team works in two\-week sprints in Azure DevOps with business\-owned UAT, Salesforce and Dynamics 365 integrations behind the scenes, and AI\-assisted development as part of everyday work. Perry Homes does not build software for sale; what you build serves homebuyers and internal teams directly. **What You'll Do** * Build and run perryhomes.com on Next.js, React, and TypeScript with Contentstack, and design, build, and refine customer\-facing features on MyAccount. * Partner with Marketing and CX stakeholders to shape ideas into wireframes, prototypes, and production UI they have approved. * Own the Figma\-based design system (components, tokens, patterns) and keep it in sync with code so customer\-facing properties look and feel like one brand. * Model Contentstack content and build reusable components so Marketing can create and publish most pages without developer help. * Build and maintain logged\-in user experiences, including sessions, SSO or OAuth, and protected routes. * Build and support Angular applications backed by .NET (C\#/ASP.NET Core) Web APIs, helping establish good patterns as Angular becomes the standard for custom apps. * Own measurable results on performance (Core Web Vitals), technical SEO, and accessibility (WCAG 2\.1 AA) for every release. * Use AI\-assisted development tools (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent) daily to prototype, write, test, and document code. * Deliver in two\-week sprints in Azure DevOps: estimate work, write clear pull requests, review teammates’ code, and ship through Git, CI/CD, and automated tests. * Support business\-owned UAT by walking stakeholders through changes and turning feedback into fixes quickly. * Monitor and improve customer\-facing properties in production, resolving issues and reducing UX friction. **Requirements** **What We're Looking For** * Bachelor’s degree in CS, Design, IT, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 5\+ years of professional front\-end or web development, with a strong focus on UI work. * Portfolio required with application, showing strong visual design, interaction design, and attention to detail. * Strong Next.js, React, and TypeScript on production sites (routing, rendering strategies, data fetching). * 2\+ years on a headless CMS (Contentstack preferred; Contentful, Sanity, or Sitecore XM Cloud accepted). * Experience building logged\-in user experiences (sessions, SSO or OAuth, protected routes). * Strong Figma skills, including building and maintaining a design system and translating it into reusable components. * Proven jobs.title: Software Engineer, Control Plane (Senior/Principal)
jobs.description: **About Positron AI** Positron AI specializes in developing custom hardware systems to accelerate AI inference. These inference systems offer significant performance and efficiency gains over traditional GPU\-based systems, delivering advantages in both performance per dollar and performance per watt. Positron AI exists to create the world's best AI inference systems. **Role Overview** ----------------- We are looking for a Senior or Principal Software Engineer to contribute to control\-plane architecture and hands\-on development for Positron AI inference systems. You will write software that connects low\-level hardware capabilities to system management, diagnostics, security, and firmware updates. Go is our primary implementation language, with C, C\+\+, Python, Bash, and other languages used where they fit the system boundary. This role can fit a senior/principal software engineer or systems architect who remains a strong, current coder and wants ownership grounded in production implementation. You will set technical direction, define stable secure interfaces, and write, review, profile, and debug production code alongside the team. The scope spans a wide swath of the platform. You will own substantial features end to end, from problem definition and architecture through implementation, integration, testing, and production validation.**Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **Platform Architecture and Implementation*** Contribute to the architecture and evolution of the system management services and APIs that control hardware state, resources, diagnostics, updates, and workloads. * Design, write, and review production Go, reaching for C, C\+\+, Python, or Bash at the boundaries where they are the right tools. * Work across the full stack, from web applications and management APIs through Linux services, hardware interfaces, and low\-level protocols. * Refactor critical subsystems to improve modularity, testability, and fault isolation, and to support future hardware generations. * Define stable interfaces and data models for orchestration, diagnostics, management tooling, and customer\-facing workflows. **Hardware and System Integration*** Partner with internal and external hardware, firmware, and systems engineers to turn low\-level capabilities into reliable platform services. * Debug failures at the board and system level across CPU, memory, drives, USB, I2C, SMBus, PCIe, and in\-system accelerators, including FPGAs. * Build safe control paths for reboot state, accelerator reset and recovery, hardware health, and resource allocation. * Integrate management\-controller capabilities, hardware counters, and telemetry into platform APIs and operational workflows. **Diagnostics, Observability, and Reliability*** Expose diagnostics through platform APIs with persistent results, searchable reporting, and periodic archiving. * Build comprehensive metrics, logs, and alerts with configurable sinks, including OpenTelemetry\-compatible systems. * Integrate external health probes so failed hardware or workloads can be isolated, rescheduled, and recovered safely. * Profile system behavior, diagnose performance regressions, and drive root causes through to resolution. **Security and Software Lifecycle*** Implement certificate management, role\-based access control, pluggable authentication, and integrations with HSM\-backed secret stores. * Build secure boot, signed\-artifact, software and firmware update, and rollback workflows. * Secure model acquisition and sideloading with appropriate authentication, secret management, and status reporting. **Technical Leadership and Engineering Practices*** Translate product and hardware roadmaps into software architecture, sequenced execution plans, and clear technical decisions. * Lead design and code reviews across software, firmware, hardware, and security boundaries. * Mentor engineers while remaining directly responsible for critical implementation and debugging work. * Own complex platform features end to end, define what done looks like, and carry them from architecture through implementation, integration, and production validation. * Apply AI\-assisted tools to accelerate implementation, test generation, debugging, profiling, code review, and documentation while maintaining engineering rigor. **Lab Support and Documentation*** Support system assembly, bring\-up, troubleshooting, and racking servers. * Produce architecture documents, test procedures, runbooks, and release notes, and take on related responsibilities as needed to help the team ship and support the product. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including technical ownership of production systems software or infrastructure. * A background in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Computer Science, through a relevant degree or equivalent practical experience with digital systems and board\-level interfaces. *  ts, and update integrity. * A track record of carrying substantial features from architecture through implementation, integration, testing, and production operation. * Demonstrated technical leadership through architecture documents, design reviews, code reviews, mentoring, and cross\-functional execution. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience with BMC, IPMI, Redfish, embedded Linux, or comparable hardware management software. * Familiarity with workload orchestration and service discovery systems such as Consul. * Working knowledge of PKI, secure boot, HSMs, artifact signing, and software or firmware update systems. * Exposure to observability systems such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, or equivalent. * Experience with hardware accelerators, high\-performance computing, or large\-scale AI infrastructure. * Broad\-scope ownership experience outside a traditional engineering role, such as leading a small team end to end, bootstrapping a project, or running non\-trivial self\-hosted infrastructure. ### **Leveling \& Scope** While this role is currently posted at a specific level, we are a growth\-oriented organization and are open to hiring at a more senior level for the right candidate. Please note that this job description serves as a focused but generalized overview of the role; specific responsibilities and impact expectations will be tailored to the experience and seniority of the final hire. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- Within one year, this person will have established a clear and scalable platform architecture, shipped major production Go implementations, improved hardware diagnostics and recovery, and made system security, updates, and fleet operations more predictable. **Why Join Us?** ---------------- * Own the software layer that connects custom AI inference hardware to reliable system operations. * Set architecture and implement critical production code in the same role. * Work across hardware, firmware, systems software, orchestration, and security with direct influence on the product. **Compensation \& Benefits** ---------------------------- The base salary range for this role is Senior: $170,000 – $250,000, Principal: $250,000 \- $325,000\. Please note that the figures provided represent the base salary range only and do not include other elements of our total compensation package, equity, or comprehensive benefits. At Positron AI, we value the unique expertise each candidate brings. While the range above reflects our typical expectation for the position, we reserve the flexibility to exceed this range for candidates whose specialized skills, significant experience, or unique qualifications fall outside the standard scope of the role. Final offers are determined based on a variety of factors, including internal equity, and individual impact. **Benefits \& Perks** --------------------- We want you to do your best work and feel confident that you and your family are taken care of. That means comprehensive coverage, real time to rest, and support for your future.**Health and wellness*** Fully company\-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your dependents. * Company\-paid life and disability coverage, with voluntary options to add more. * Supplemental hospital, critical illness, and accident coverage available. **Time off and flexibility*** Unlimited paid time off, so you can truly unplug and recharge. * 13 paid company holidays. * A company\-provided computer. **Compensation and future*** Competitive salary and equity. * 401(k) with company matching, eligible from day one. **Visa Support** ---------------- This position is open to candidates currently authorized to work in the U.S. We cannot provide new visa sponsorship for this role but are open to facilitating H\-1B visa transfers for eligible candidates. **Equal Opportunity Employer.** If you're excited about the role but don't meet every bullet, we'd still love to hear from you.

jobs.description: **About Us** At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive "sick\-care" to proactive health care. help define standards and processes that support operational excellence in automated and agent\-driven environments. * **Raise engineering quality:** Improve engineering patterns, tooling, documentation, and processes that increase productivity and code quality across multiple teams, incorporating automated code review and refactoring agents. * **Communicate at a senior level:** Clearly articulate complex technical concepts to engineers, product managers, and leadership; serve as a trusted technical voice on modern software practices. * **Manage ambiguity:** Operate effectively in undefined or rapidly evolving situations, bringing clarity, structure, and direction for others, particularly in the transition toward agentic SDLC. **What You'll Bring** * **7\+ years** of experience delivering complex software systems and solving technical challenges. * **Strong backend experience** architecting and building robust services using Python, Flask, and/or FastAPI. * Experience writing comprehensive backend tests (e.g., Pytest) and ensuring strong test coverage. * Familiarity or decent frontend experience with frameworks like React, Next.js, and Typescript is a plus. * Ability to break down complex projects into components or milestones that other engineers can easily pick up. * Motivation to influence our engineering organization to level up the quality, reliability, and performance of the services we ship. * Demonstrated collaboration with co\-workers on cross\-functional teams. * Experience building consumer\-facing applications and internal tools. **Our Values** First: we are **Pioneers** * Transforming healthcare requires divergent thinking, bias for action, disciplined experimentation, and consistent grit and determination to maintain momentum. While Prenuvo facilitates access to the plan, the company does not currently offer matching contributions. * We offer a comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, vision, including Mental Health coverage, to support you and your family * **The base salary for this role ranges from $170,000\-$185,000 in local currency, depending upon experience and geographic location** *We are an equal\-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. As a Main Automation Contractor, we offer comprehensive solutions, supported by our size, expertise, and extensive experience. With a professional team of 1000\+ employees, Prime Controls serves customers nationwide from our Dallas, Texas headquarters and offices throughout the United States. Our mission is to deliver the highest quality professional services while prioritizing our employees’ well\-being and fostering an exceptional workplace environment. Overview: **About Prime Controls** Established in 2004, Prime Controls, L.P. is a family\-owned Systems Integration and I\&C Construction firm dedicated to meeting clients’ industrial automation and control requirements. As a Main Automation Contractor, we offer comprehensive solutions, supported by our size, expertise, and extensive experience. With a professional team of 1000\+ employees, Prime Controls serves customers nationwide from our Dallas, Texas headquarters and offices throughout the United States. Our mission is to deliver the highest quality professional services while prioritizing our employees’ well\-being and fostering an exceptional workplace environment. **Position Summary** Prime Controls is hiring an Associate Developer to build the APIs, integrations, automations, and AI agents that connect our business and engineering systems. This role is designed for an early\-career developer, including a recent computer science or software engineering graduate, who is genuinely fast with modern AI development tooling and uses it to produce working, supportable software rather than one\-off scripts. The work is real and immediate. Prime is standing up API endpoints against internal engineering data, moving field\-facing tools off spreadsheets and manual handoffs, and building AI agents that take repetitive work out of estimating, project controls, purchasing, and document handling. The Associate Developer will write that code, test it, document it, and hand it off in a state someone else can maintain. This is not a help desk role and it is not an infrastructure role. Day\-to\-day support, identity, endpoint management, and network operations stay with Information Technology. This role sits in the Business Technology Group and partners closely with Engineering, IT, platform owners, and the business groups whose processes the work is meant to improve. We expect the person in this role to grow. The intent is to add senior development leadership over time and build a small development function around it, so appetite for mentorship, code review, and rising standards matters more than a polished resume. **Key Responsibilities** **API and Integration Development** * Build and maintain REST API endpoints that expose project and asset data from internal engineering systems to the tools that need it, including project asset lists consumed by field\-facing applications. * Implement authentication and authorization for internal and externally reachable applications using approved patterns such as JWT, Microsoft Entra ID, or issued API keys, following the standard selected with IT and BTG rather than inventing a new one per project. * Develop integrations between enterprise platforms including ERP/MRP, engineering data systems, construction tracking platforms, Microsoft 365, and internal tools, using vendor APIs, file exchanges, and scheduled data movement. * Write integration code that fails visibly and recoverably, including logging, error handling, retries, and alerting that tells someone when data stopped moving. * Document endpoints, payloads, dependencies, and support expectations so integrations are transferable and not owner dependent. **AI Agent and Automation Development** * Build AI agents and assisted workflows against approved platforms, including Claude and the Microsoft AI stack, for defined business processes such as document review, data extraction, exception handling, and routine reporting. * Turn manual and repetitive business processes into automations using Power Automate, Python, PowerShell, scripted jobs, and platform\-native capability, selecting the lightest tool that will hold up. * Define and test guardrails on any agent that touches business data: what it can access, what it can write, what it must escalate to a person, and how its output is verified. * Measure what the automation actually changed. Every agent or automation is expected to carry a before\-and\-after number such as time per transaction, keying error rate, or cycle time. * Evaluate native platform capability before building custom, consistent with BTG governance. **Internal Application Development and Support** * Contribute to internal applications, including JavaScript\-based field and project tools, with a focus on refinement, integration, and stability rather than rebuild * Familiarity with relational databases and SQL sufficient to read a schema, write queries, and reason about data relationships. * Demonstrated hands\-on use of AI development tools to produce working software, with the ability to explain what the tool produced and why it is correct. * Evidence of initiative: projects started and finished without being assigned, problems pursued past the first obstacle, and work shipped rather than shelved. * Ability to communicate clearly with people who are not developers, including field and office staff describing a problem in their own terms. * Willingness to work onsite at the Lewisville headquarters, with occasional travel to regional offices or project sites. **Preferred** * Internship, co\-op, or project experience building or consuming production APIs. * Experience with Git\-based version control and collaborative code review. * Exposure to the Microsoft stack, including Power Platform, SharePoint, Microsoft Graph, or Entra ID. * Exposure to cloud services, containerization, or CI/CD pipelines. * Coursework or project work in machine learning, natural language processing, or agent frameworks. * Interest in construction, industrial automation, controls, or manufacturing environments. * Any experience turning a manual process into an automated one, at any scale. **Initial 90\-Day Priorities** * Complete onboarding to Prime's development environment, source control, AI tooling, and AI governance policy, and understand what data may be used where. * Learn the current system landscape: ERP/MRP, engineering data platforms, internal tools, construction tracking pilots, and the integration points already in place. * Deliver one production API endpoint end to end, including authentication, documentation, and testing, under the direction of the assigned technical owner. * Take ownership of one existing internal application component and close a defined backlog of defects and usability items. * Build one AI agent or automation against a real business process with a measured before\-and\-after result. * Produce documentation for everything touched in the first ninety days, to the standard that lets another developer pick it up. * Identify two additional automation candidates from direct observation of how the business works, with an estimate of effort and expected benefit. Benefits: **What We Offer** We value our employees and offer full\-time team members a benefits package designed to support their health, financial well\-being, and work\-life balance, including: * Health, Dental, and Vision coverage * Flexible Spending Account(s) * Generous PTO * ESOP Program * Numerous company events * 401(k) matching and more! Work Environment \& Physical Demands (Text Only): This role is primarily performed in a professional office environment at the Lewisville headquarters and involves extended periods of sitting and working at a computer. The position requires regular communication and collaboration with office and field personnel and may include occasional travel to regional offices or project sites. Site visits may involve walking, standing, exposure to active construction or industrial environments, and use of required personal protective equipment. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job. EEO: Prime Controls is an Equal Opportunity Employer/Affirmative Action/Veteran/Disabled employer. As a federal contractor, Prime Controls is required to participate in the federal government’s E\-Verify program, which confirms employment authorization of all newly hired employees and most existing employees through an electronic database maintained by the Social Security Administration and Department of Homeland Security. For new hires, the E\-Verify process is completed in conjunction with the Form I\-9 Employment Eligibility Verification on or before the first day of work. E\-Verify is not used as a tool to pre\-screen candidates.

jobs.title: Enterprise Systems Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: Prime Healthcare is an award\-winning health system headquartered in Ontario, California. Prime Healthcare operates 54 hospitals and has more than 360 outpatient locations in 15 states providing more than 3\.0million patient visits annually. It is one of the nation’s leading health systems with over 60,000 employees and physicians. Twenty\-one of the Prime Healthcare hospitals are members of the Prime Healthcare Foundation, a 501(c)(3\) not\-for\-profit public charity. Prime Healthcare is actively seeking new members to join our corporate team! Responsibilities: Responsible for monitoring, installation, configuration, administration, troubleshooting and maintenance of technology solutions. Relies on extensive experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals and a variety of tasks. A wide degree of creativity and latitude is expected. Must have strong Technical, Communication, Collaboration, and Time Management skills. Qualifications: EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, TRAINING Required:* Strong analytical and problem solving skills coupled with verbal and written communication skills. * A four\-year degree or 4 years of related technical experience. * Strong interpersonal skills including written, verbal and problem solving abilities while working collaboratively with clients, peers, and cross functional teams. * Monitor the company's servers to ensure that they are functioning properly, and provide continual maintenance as required to improve security posture and continual integrity of data. * In\-depth experience with console and systems management tooling not limited to SCCM,WSUS, SCOM, Solarwinds, Nagios, Puppet, vCenter,vROps, ESXi, SQL Management Studio, MMC, Citrix Studio/AppCenter, Azure, AWS, etc * Experience in Virtualization technologies including VMware, Hyper\-V, OVM. * Experience in backup software technologies and methodologies not limited to Commvault, Veeam, Veritas Backup Exec, DPM, Tape, Cloud, Agent Jobs, Scripts, etc * Experience in setup, configuration, and troubleshooting of high\-performance, high\-availability technologies not limited to overall infrastructure, servers, appliances, workstations, virtual or physical. * In\-depth knowledge and experience of Microsoft operating systems, Linux, Unix, etc * Assist in the preparation and execution of core ITIL processes: Incident management, Request Management, Change Management, Problem Management, etc. * Troubleshoot wide variety of technology issues, using various internal and external resources. Also, generate innovative approaches and solutions to recurring tasks or problems. * Daily time tracking in various systems including ticket, change, incident, problem tracking, documentation, and root cause analysis * Demonstrable customer focus attitude. Preferred* Industry standard certifications in Microsoft, Citrix, VMWare, Cisco, EMC or others if related may substitute for 1 years work experience each up to 4 years. * Advanced experience with high availability not limited to MSSQL 2012\-2016 AlwaysOn / FCI, MySQL, Oracle, NoSQL, Mogal * Advanced virtualization experience not limited to VMWare, Hyper\-V, OVM, and related cloud environments Azure, AWS, etc * Advanced experience with SAN technologies not limited to DELL EMC, NetApp, IBM, HP, Pure, Nimble, etc * Knowledge or experience with storage networks including VSAN Clusters, iSCSI, NFS, CIFS, HBA, Fibre Channel, Zoning WWN, FCoE. * Advanced server technology experience not limited to blades, chassis, Cisco UCS infrastructure, Fabric Interconnects, etc * Advanced experience with Windows Active Directory, Exchange and Group Policy implementing and managing in a multi\-site environment. * Extensive experience with Active Directory, troubleshooting, design and maintenance. * Scripting / Automation / Development skills not limited to Full\-stack, VB.NET, C\#, ASP.NET MVC, CSS, RESTful API, AutoIT, VBS, BATCH, PowerShell, etc * Extensive experience in a wide variety of server / workstation systems, applications, and infrastructure. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Observability/Site Reliability
jobs.description: PsiQuantum's mission is to build the first useful quantum computers—machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million\-qubit, fault\-tolerant quantum systems. Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries. Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. By leveraging the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry—including partners like GlobalFoundries—we use the same high\-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don't feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber\-optic infrastructure. In 2024, PsiQuantum announced government\-funded projects to support the build\-out of our first utility\-scale quantum computers in Brisbane, Australia, and Chicago, Illinois. These initiatives reflect a growing recognition that quantum computing will be strategically and economically defining—and that now is the time to scale. PsiQuantum also develops the algorithms and software needed to make these systems commercially valuable. Our application, software, and industry teams work directly with leading Fortune 500 companies—including Lockheed Martin, Mercedes\-Benz, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Mitsubishi Chemical—to prepare quantum solutions for real\-world impact. Quantum computing is not an extension of classical computing. It represents a fundamental shift—and a path to mastering challenges that cannot be solved any other way. The potential is enormous, and we have a clear path to make it real. Come join us. **Job Summary** The Observability team builds and runs the telemetry platform that lets PsiQuantum see how its quantum computing systems, and the infrastructure behind them, are behaving. We collect metrics, logs, and traces from on\-premises Kubernetes clusters, cloud infrastructure, and the custom hardware that makes up a photonic quantum computer, including control electronics and cryostats. Engineering, operations, hardware, and research teams rely on this data to run the machine, catch problems early, and work out what went wrong when something fails. We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join the Observability team. You will wire up OpenTelemetry instrumentation and collection, run and scale Prometheus and Grafana, and turn raw signals into dashboards and alerts that people trust. A large part of the job is working with hardware teams: deciding what their devices should report, and getting that data off the device and into the platform reliably. This is a hands\-on role with Staff\-level scope. You will own major parts of the observability stack from design through operation, share the team's on\-call rotation, and set the conventions other teams follow when they instrument their own systems. You will combine hands\-on delivery with technical leadership, sound judgment under ambiguity, and a strong bias toward simple, maintainable systems. **Responsibilities** * Design, deploy, and operate the observability platform across on\-premises Kubernetes and cloud, covering collection, storage, querying, visualization, and alerting for metrics, logs, and traces. * Roll out OpenTelemetry across the fleet: deploy and configure Collectors, design telemetry pipelines, and help service teams adopt OTel SDKs and instrumentation in Python, Rust, and other languages. * Run Prometheus in production, including service discovery, scrape configuration, recording and alerting rules, Alertmanager routing, retention, high availability, and long\-term storage. * Manage Grafana dashboards, alerts, and data sources as code so they are versioned, reviewed, and reproducible across environments. * Work with hardware teams to instrument custom devices, control electronics, cryostats, and other lab equipment; build the exporters and collectors that bring device telemetry into the platform, including from equipment that was never designed to be monitored. * Define and publish telemetry standards \- metric and label naming, cardinality budgets, structured logging, trace context propagation, and resource attributes \- so data from different teams and systems can be correlated. * Partner with service owners and operations teams to define SLOs and alerts that reflect real impact, reduce alert noise, and make every page actionable. * Take part in the team's on\-call rotation: respond to incidents affecting the observability platform, help other teams diagnose production issues with telemetry, and lead blameless post\-incident reviews through to completed fixes. * Run the platform as a production service i ing tradeoffs with the technical lead; unblock other engineers; keep near\-term work aligned with the roadmap. * Apply AI with judgment: Use LLM\-assisted tools for queries, configuration, code, and documentation, then verify outputs to the standard expected for production infrastructure. **Experience** * 8\+ years of professional software, infrastructure, or site reliability engineering experience, including significant time building and operating observability systems in production. * A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a closely related technical discipline is required. * Deep hands\-on experience with Prometheus and Grafana, including PromQL, recording and alerting rules, Alertmanager, exporters, dashboard design, and running both reliably at scale. * Production experience with OpenTelemetry, including the Collector, OTLP, SDK and automatic instrumentation, and semantic conventions. * Hands\-on experience running workloads on self\-managed, on\-premises Kubernetes and in the cloud, with containers, Helm, and infrastructure as code such as Terraform; practical experience with GitLab and GitLab CI is strongly preferred. * Strong programming skills in Python and at least one of Go or Rust, with the ability to write production\-quality exporters, Collector components, and automation rather than only configuring off\-the\-shelf tools. * Solid knowledge of Linux and networking fundamentals, including processes, filesystems, resource limits, DNS, TCP/IP, and TLS, and experience debugging distributed systems from the host up. * Experience carrying a pager for production systems, leading incident response, running post\-incident reviews, and designing alerts people act on. * Staff\-level technical leadership: leading design work, setting standards other teams adopt, mentoring engineers, influencing across teams, and communicating tradeoffs to technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Proficiency with modern AI/LLM engineering tools, such as coding copilots and agents, model APIs, and retrieval workflows; jobs.title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer (OpenTofu) 10/2026
jobs.description: ### **Who You Are** You embrace the ethic of "infrastructure as code" to provide consistency and security for both data center and Cloud deployments. You deliver solutions that are scalable, maintainable and follow the ethos of "cattle, not pets." You hold yourself and your teammates to a high standard when writing clean, performant, and maintainable code for deployments and configuration management. You enjoy finding new ways to improve the design, performance, and testing of the systems and services that you deploy and operate. You work well with cross\-functional teams that include platform engineers, data scientists, security engineers, and product managers. You care deeply about your work and its impact on your team's productivity. You are a top performer who is effective in mentoring other engineers. You have a great work ethic and are able to take on major projects from start to finish, collaborating with other engineers. You value the security of a company with a proven business model and enjoy the opportunities a startup offers. On a personal note, you are fun to work with; you maintain a positive attitude throughout the Agile Sprint cycle. ### **Who We Are** Quantifind helps some of the world's biggest banks catch money laundering and fraud. Quantifind also works with government agencies to use the same platform to uncover criminal networks and combat money laundering committed by internationally sanctioned entities. Unlike other players in this space, Quantifind delivers results as software\-as\-a\-service (SaaS) with consumer\-grade user experiences. Quantifind is a data science technology company whose AI platform uncovers signals of risk across disparate and unstructured text sources. In financial crimes risk management, Quantifind's solution uniquely combines internal financial institution data with public domain data to assess risk in the context of Know Your Customer (KYC), Customer Due Diligence (CDD), Fraud Risk Management, and Anti\-Money Laundering (AML) processes. Today these compliance processes are burdened by ever\-increasing regulatory responsibilities and an expectation of frictionless transactions. Legacy technologies demand increasingly more human resources as the operations expand; Quantifind's SaaS solution offers a way to cut through the inefficiency and enhance effectiveness simultaneously. To help you succeed, we provide a supportive environment that fosters collaboration between teams and team members, where learning and professional growth are considered a key part of your success, and of ours. We offer a flexible work environment with a family friendly work\-life balance. **What a Great Candidate Looks Like:** * 6\+ years of professional industry experience, including 2\+ years at a SaaS startup * Deep background with using Terraform/OpenTofu with a DRY methodology * Strong history of doing infrastructure as code and configuration management with Ansible * Very comfortable in AWS. GovCloud, Azure, and GCP a bonus. * Familiarity with programmatically setting up and configuring firewall instances (ex: Palo Alto) * Experience with owning datacenter infrastructure * Familiarity with RDMBS systems, we are a Postgres shop * Professional experience with secrets storage products such as HashiCorp Vault * Functional understanding of PXE, DHCP, TFTP and how they work together * Very comfortable operating under compliance regimes for SaaS apps * Excellent communication, presentation and collaborative problem\-solving skills * Experience with Docker and Kubernetes for container orchestration, both on prem and cloud * Experience with modern network, host and application security best practices * Experience with uptime / availability engineering, performance metrics, and monitoring * Good technical documentation ability * Experience and comfort with Agile software development best practices * Experience with Cloudflare * Great team player who has a strong desire to change the way people use their data * Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future **The Opportunity We Offer** As a Senior Infrastructure Engineer at Quantifind's HQ in Palo Alto, California, you will play a critical role in managing the infrastructure for Quantifind's applications and services. Our stack includes back\-end services and infrastructure, machine learning modules surfaced through REST APIs, and React\-based front\-end web applications. As a member of our DevOps Team, you will have a big impact on how we build, automate, and scale our technology and processes. You will work closely with DevOps engineers, solving problems, automating deployments, and championing best practices. Our technology includes: Ubuntu, Ganeti, Docker, Kubernetes, Ansible, git, Hadoop, Nagios, PostgreSQL, Jenkins, and in\-house Scala and NodeJS applications. We deploy to our own data centers and to AWS. Quantifind's development team is centered in Palo Alto, California, and we have technology hubs in Atlanta, Georgia, and in Washington, D.C. Quantifind is currently using a hybrid mix of working from home and in the office, with regular in\-person touchpoints and shared office space. **A highlight of our benefits:** * Competitive salary * Company Equity * Exceptional benefits package * Flexible Vacation \& Paid Time Off * Employer\-matched 401(k) plan * A fun environment where work\-life balance is valued The California base salary range for this full\-time position is $155,000 to $195,000\. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location, and the range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location, role\-related knowledge and skills, depth of experience, relevant education or training, and additional role\-related considerations. Depending on the position offered, equity, bonuses, commission, or other forms of compensation may also be provided as part of a total compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and other benefits. We are an equal opportunity employer; we have a fun place to work and a devotion to succeeding together. Will you join us? Apply now!
