jobs.description: While technology is the heart of our business, a global and diverse culture is the heart of our success. We love our people and we take pride in catering them to a culture built on transparency, diversity, integrity, learning and growth. If working in an environment that encourages you to innovate and excel, not just in professional but personal life, interests you\- you would enjoy your career with Quantiphi! **About Quantiphi** Quantiphi is an award\-winning, AI\-First digital engineering and consulting company focused on delivering high\-impact Services and Solutions that help organizations solve what truly matters. We partner with enterprises to reimagine their businesses through intelligent, scalable, and transformative AI—driving measurable outcomes at the very core of their operations. Since our founding in 2013, Quantiphi has tackled some of the world’s most complex business challenges by combining deep industry expertise, disciplined cloud and data engineering practices, and cutting\-edge applied AI research. Our work is rooted in delivering accelerated, quantifiable business value—not just technology for technology’s sake. Headquartered in Boston, Quantiphi is a global organization with 4,000\+ professionals serving clients across key industry verticals, including BFSI, Healthcare \& Life Sciences, CPG, MFG, TME etc. As an Elite and Premier partner to leading cloud and AI platforms such as NVIDIA, Google Cloud, AWS, and Snowflake, we build and deliver enterprise\-grade AI services and solutions that create real\-world impact. For more details, visit: Website or LinkedIn Page. **Role:** Senior Knowledge Graph Engineer **Experience:** 5\+ years of software/data engineering experience **Employment Type:** Full\-Time (US Remote) **Work Location:** US Remote (Up to 25% travel to client sites across the US) **Role Overview** We are looking for a Senior Knowledge Graph Engineer to design, build, and productionize knowledge graph solutions for healthcare and clinical data. Our architecture uses a hybrid graph approach, combining a Labeled Property Graph (LPG) for patient/clinical data with an RDF\-based graph for clinical ontology and semantic knowledge. The role will focus on translating ontology and mapping specifications into scalable graph solutions, including data transformation, graph ingestion, concept/entity linking, provenance, validation, and querying. You will work closely with ontology, terminology, FHIR, clinical/domain, and data engineering teams to translate agreed semantic and mapping decisions into robust technical implementations. **Key** jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About RealSelf** For two decades, RealSelf has been the trusted authority in the aesthetics space. Now, we're evolving into a dynamic digital ecosystem that puts consumers at the center of their aesthetic journey. As the only destination combining verified patient experiences, board\-certified doctor insights, and cutting\-edge technology, RealSelf empowers millions to make confident, informed decisions. **Role Overview** Our NYC\-based engineering team is seeking a Lead Software Engineer to lead a small but mighty engineering squad, with an initial focus on RealSelf's new booking and finance products. You will work across the stack, designing and building the backend services that power booking flows, payments, and financial tooling, while setting the technical direction for a team you will help build and grow. This is a hands\-on engineering leadership role where you will write code, own architecture, and mentor engineers while collaborating with product, design, operations, and finance stakeholders. You'll directly shape how consumers finance and book care, while contributing to the foundation of our next\-generation technology platform. ### **Key Responsibilities** * Design and lead the architecture for RealSelf's booking and finance products infrastructure, including booking and scheduling flows, financing application integrations, and financial collection and reporting pipelines. * Build and scale backend services using Node.js, TypeScript, and SQL that power a high\-traffic consumer marketplace used by millions of people researching and booking care. * Ensure security and compliance across everything that touches money or personal data, including PCI DSS scope reduction, data privacy (GDPR, CCPA), and audit\-ready logging. * Collaborate across engineering, product, and finance to design APIs, data contracts, and reporting feeds used for revenue operations and business decision\-making. * Mentor and guide engineers through code review, architectural reviews, and technical direction. ### **Requirements** * 7\+ years of backend or infrastructure engineering experience, with at least 1\+ year in leading a team * Proven experience designing high\-throughput, low\-latency distributed systems in Python, Node.js, TypeScript, or similar. * Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks for financial data (PCI DSS) and privacy (GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA). * Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred), infrastructure\-as\-code tools (CloudFormation, Terraform, or similar), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD best practices. * Demonstrated ability to lead technically — setting direction, unblocking engineers, and raising the bar through reviews and mentorship. * Proficiency in leveraging AI tools to accelerate code delivery and improve quality. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience working cross\-functionally with product, operations, and finance teams. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience). * Experience with experimentation and growth engineering (A/B testing, funnel optimization, conversion instrumentation). * Previous work in consumer marketplaces, Martech or healthcare tech. ### **Bonus Qualities** * Hands\-on experience with consumer financing providers (Cherry, PatientFi, CareCredit). * Experience building booking, scheduling, or marketplace systems at scale. Evaluated based on experience; opportunity for performance\-based bonus. **Why RealSelf?** ----------------- * RealSelf exists to help people make confident, informed decisions about procedures that can change how they see themselves, and how the world sees them. * Our reviews are raw and honest. Our Q\&A connects people directly with verified experts. We care deeply about trust, safety, and transparency in an industry where those things matter. * On the heels of a major rebrand, RealSelf is entering a new era of rebuilding and reinvention. This role is an opportunity to help shape the future of a culturally relevant, deeply useful product — and leave a lasting mark on a platform that genuinely matters. **Perks \& Benefits** --------------------- * You'll work alongside our inspiring world\-class team to create content and build products that connect and empower millions of people around the world, wherever they may be on their aesthetics journey. * Health benefits: We offer comprehensive benefits for medical, dental and vision — 100% paid for by RealSelf at the employee level. * Work\-life balance: Enjoy paid time off, including no work on your birthday and Summer Fridays, as well as generous leave options for life events such as becoming a parent. * 401(k) matching: Plan for the future and take advantage of our 401(k) plan with a company match. * Treatment reimbursement: At RealSelf, we encourage our team to walk in our audience's shoes. That's why we offer a cosmetic treatment reimbursement program to employees who would like to take on a more active role as the consumer. * Company holidays: We believe in celebrating holidays! Enjoy time off during our 12 company\-wide holidays \+ no work on your birthday! * Hybrid NYC office: We recognize that there's no one size fits all with office culture. That's why we believe in a flexible hybrid schedule for our New York City employees, who can enjoy the benefits of in\-person collaboration in our office as well as deep work time while remote at home. * *Compensation will be evaluated based on experience.* RealSelf is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. **More About RealSelf** ----------------------- * Beautymatter: RealSelf's New “Omnichannel Content Flywheel” Is Quickly Paying Off * Forbes: Inside RealSelf’s Rebrand * Adweek: Cosmetic Surgery Platform RealSelf Appoints New CEO to Spur Editorial Expansion * Tech Crunch: RealSelf, a community for cosmetic treatments, raises $40 million We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Relative Dynamics is seeking a Navigation Flight Software Engineer to support the lunar mission portfolio for a Commercial Space customer. This role requires regular on\-site work in either Houston, TX or Glen Burnie, MD. This role is not eligible for remote work. **What You’ll Get to Do:** * Support real\-time navigation flight software development, HWIL navigation sensor integration, performance, and testing. * Work in a cross\-functional team on the design, development, manufacture, test, and on\-orbit operation of flight and ground support software for the lunar portfolio. * Real\-time flight software jobs.description: **Revvity** Revvity is a developer and provider of end\-to\-end solutions designed to help scientists, researchers, and clinicians solve the world’s greatest health challenges. Join us as a **Principal DevOps Engineer/Lead (AI/ML Infrastructure)**,where you'll play a pivotal role building out, maintaining and operating our AI infrastructure, that is part of the Signals Platform. CI/CD pipelines using tools like GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or Jenkins. * Excellent collaboration and communication skills to work effectively with cross\-functional technical and business teams. jobs.title: Data & AI Engineering Consultant - Roxbury Community College
jobs.description: **Location:** 1234 Roxbury Crossing, MA **Category:** Other **Job Type:** Contract **Posted On:** Thu Oct 22 2026 **Job Description:** **Job Title**: Data \& AI Engineering Consultant **Unit:** Non\-Unit Professional (NUP) **Department:** Office of the CIO, Information Technology Services **Reports to:** Chief Information Officer **Schedule:** Hybrid: 4 days per week in office, 1 day remote. **Date:** November 2026 **Scope of work/position summary:** The Data \& AI Engineering Consultant is responsible for building, owning, and maintaining the Roxbury 2030 Data Portals, RCC's strategic data platform: a governed Databricks\-on\-Azure lakehouse fed by Jenzabar J1, Slate CRM, and Canvas. Phase 1 delivers four parts (Student Portal, SAP Portal, Finance Hub, and Learning Hub), each providing detailed insight into confidential student information, live in production. The role takes ownership of the platform in\-house from the implementation partner and extends it with new views and better data. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** * Portal development and ownership: Own and enhance the Data Portals in production, starting with the Student Portal Databricks App, including UI, queries, performance, and the release cycle; ensure alignment with RCC Institutional Learning Outcomes and departmental workflows. * Data engineering: Build and maintain Silver and Gold layer tables and Unity Catalog metric views, and work with Lakeflow Connect and Auto Loader pipelines bringing in confidential student information from Jenzabar J1, Slate, and Canvas; maintain records, coordinate cross\-departmental operations, and utilize college ERP/SIS platforms. * Query development: Work with SQL Developer and Reports specialist to write, tune, and set standards for SQL against the lakehouse (Serverless SQL Warehouse) for new portal views, reports, and extracts. * Data quality and integration: Identify and resolve duplicate, incomplete, and inconsistent records. Build validation and reconciliation checks across Jenzabar, Slate, and Canvas, and define record\-matching rules between systems. * Security and FERPA: Implement and test Unity Catalog row filters and column masks, verifying that each user sees only the data they are authorized to see. Review and approve data access requests under FERPA, GLBA, and College policy. * Supervision and vendor management: Supervise and mentor co\-ops, interns, and student workers assigned to the portal program. Manage the implementation partner's handoff and recommend technology purchases. * Documentation: Document pipelines, data definitions, report logic, and operating procedures, and set documentation standards so others can pick up the work. * Non\-unit designation: This position is designated a Non\-Unit Professional (NUP) position and is excluded from all College collective bargaining units because it carries the managerial and confidential responsibilities below, consistent with M.G.L. c. 150E, § 1\. These responsibilities are a regular and substantial part of the role. * Access to confidential student information: Has access to confidential student information, including but not limited to student personal details, financial aid information, and payments. * Confidential capacity: Views confidential data across the College's systems and displays it in our shell account. * Independent judgment and authority: Exercises independent judgment in approving or denying data access requests, setting data standards, and directing the work of the implementation partner and vendors. * Supervisory authority: Assigns, directs, and evaluates the work of co\-ops, interns, and effectively recommends their hiring, extension, or release. * Confidentiality obligation: Must hold all confidential student information, including personal details, financial aid information, and payments, in strict confidence. Disclosing it to any unauthorized person is grounds for immediate termination of the engagement. * Changes in duties: Any material change to these duties will be reviewed by Human Resources to confirm the position's non\-unit status. * Backup for this position will be the CIO. Additional backup will be a full stack developer which is a Union position. * Compliance \& Governance: Perform duties in strict compliance with the Commonwealth of Massachusetts regulations, NECHE accreditation criteria, and individual collective bargaining agreements (if applicable). * Perform other related job\-related duties as assigned. **Job Requirements:** **Qualifications:** * Required Minimum Education: Master's degree in computer science, data science, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience. A master's degree is preferred. * Required Minimum Experience: Three or more years of hands\-on data engineering or SQL development, including at least two years leading or owning a project. * Core jobs.title: Finance Transformation Manager
jobs.description: **Who We Are** ============== Serval is an AI\-native automation platform transforming how enterprises operate. We build intelligent agents that understand real\-world workflows and execute them end\-to\-end — replacing manual processes and rigid legacy systems with adaptive, learning software. Founded in early 2024, Serval is already trusted by companies like Fox, Notion, Perplexity, Vercel, and Brex to automate high\-volume, high\-friction operational work across their organizations. At the core of Serval is an agentic AI platform that turns natural language into production\-grade workflows. Our agents don’t just respond to requests — they reason, take action across systems, and continuously improve with usage. What began with operational use cases has quickly evolved into a horizontal AI automation layer used across IT, HR, Finance, Security, Legal, and Engineering. Our mission is to eliminate repetitive, manual work across the enterprise and give teams leverage through intelligent automation. Long term, we’re building the universal AI operations layer — a system of agents that sits across business functions and runs the workflows that keep modern companies moving. We’re backed by leading investors including Sequoia Capital, Redpoint Ventures, Meritech, First Round, General Catalyst, Elad Gil, and others. **The mission** =============== We’re scaling at a historic pace with a lean finance team, which only works if that team runs on systems, not spreadsheets. Today our finance data lives in disconnected places: ERP, CRM, Bill pay systems, our billing and usage data, payroll, and a lot of exports. Reconciliations, close tasks and reporting take more hands than they should. You are the technical backbone of Serval Finance. Think of the role as an accounting automation engineer: you connect our finance data, build the data foundations behind sales, marketing and cost reporting, and automate manual accounting workflows, Serval first. Serval runs on Serval, and you will be one of its most demanding internal builders. The role has two parts: * **Finance transformation (most of your time).** Own the finance systems roadmap, build automations and agents on Serval, and create a single, trusted view of our revenue, go\-to\-market and cost data so leadership can see where to invest, faster. * **Corporate accounting (part time).** Run and automate parts of the close yourself: account reconciliations, complex calculations, and day\-to\-day operations such as Ramp bills and corporate card management. You'll report to Francisco Meyo, VP, Controller, and work closely with our Head of Finance, RevOps, Engineering, Sales and Marketing leadership, and our revenue accounting team. **Who you are** =============== * **A builder at heart.** You scope what matters, prototype it and ship it yourself. You have built agents and automations that run in a real finance operation and that people still use. * **Fluent in both languages.** You understand the close, reconciliations and revenue well enough to spot what to automate, and you can write a spec an engineer respects. * **A systems thinker.** You design for the long run: clean data models, one source of truth, controls and audit trails built in, and workflows that flag their own exceptions. * **Living on the AI frontier.** You bring new techniques to the team as fast as the field moves, and you judge them by hours saved and errors removed, not by novelty. * **Hands\-on and unprecious.** You will reconcile an account or code a Ramp bill today, and make sure nobody has to do it by hand next month. * **Comfortable in ambiguity.** You own your work end to end, set your own priorities from a messy backlog, and move without waiting to be told what to build next. **What you'll do** ================== **Lead finance transformation** * Map manual workflows across Finance, rank automation opportunities by time saved and risk reduced, and own a prioritized backlog and roadmap. * Design and deploy Serval\-first agents and workflows for reconciliations, journal entry preparation, accruals, close task tracking, variance analysis and reporting. * Own project plans, milestones and risks across initiatives, and report status to the VP, Controller and Head of Finance. * Evaluate and pilot new finance tools when Serval is not the right fit, and build the business case for adoption. **Build the data foundations** * Connect Rillet, Salesforce, Ramp, our billing and usage data, payroll and marketing systems into one trusted finance data layer. * Build the data models behind sales, marketing and cost reporting, so bookings, pipeline, spend and unit economics come from one source of truth rather than exports. * Replace manual spreadsheets with automated dashboards that show leadership where we can invest, faster. * Act as Finance's primary partner to Engineering and RevOps on integrations and internal tooling, translating requirements into technical specs. **Run and automate corporate accounting (part time)** * Own a set of close tasks hands\-on, including account reconciliations and complex calculations, then automate them to shorten the close. * Manage day\-to\-day operations such as Ramp bills, corporate cards, vendor setup and spend approvals, and automate the routine flow. * Optimize Rillet as our ERP: chart of accounts, subledgers, workflows and reporting. **Keep it auditable** * Design human\-in\-the\-loop controls, audit trails and documentation so automated outputs are accurate and ready for external audit. * Write runbooks, train the Finance team on new tools, and own what you ship in production. **What you'll need** ==================== * **Experience:** 6 to 10 years combined across accounting or finance operations and finance systems, including leading at least one implementation or transformation from planning through testing, training and go\-live. * **Hands\-on AI build experience:** you have built and deployed AI agents, LLM workflows or automations that run in production. Not AI\-curious; you have shipped. * **Accounting fluency:** strong working knowledge of the close, reconciliations, accruals and revenue, enough to own close tasks yourself and spot what to automate. * **Data skills:** SQL and comfort building data models and dashboards from messy source systems such as an ERP, a CRM and spend tools. * **Scripting:** Python or similar for automation and integration work. * **Integration experience:** APIs, workflow or integration tools, and working directly with engineers on technical requirements. * **Communication:** you can explain a system design or a data gap to a non\-technical executive and get a decision. **Nice to have** ================ * Experience with Rillet, Ramp, Salesforce or a modern data stack (warehouse, dbt, BI tools). * Exposure to Serval, as a customer, user or builder. * Background at a high\-growth software or AI company. * Familiarity with internal controls, SOX or supporting external audits. **What We Offer** ----------------- * **Impact**: Be a key player in shaping the success of our product and company. * **Growth**: Build a fundamentally new AI product offering with the support of our experienced team and investors. Grow rapidly with the company. * **Culture**: Join a culture that values innovation, ownership, accountability, and fun. Compensation Range: $190K \- $235K

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **Help build the next category\-defining AI company** ----------------------------------------------------- AI has transformed how we write, communicate, and build software. The next frontier is even bigger: transforming how businesses actually operate. That's what we're building at Sola. Sola is an AI\-native platform reinventing enterprise process automation and disrupting legacy RPA tools. Our AI agents can execute complex workflows across any application, browser, desktop, or legacy system—free from the limitations and fragility of traditional automation tools. Users simply record their screen, and Sola creates a custom agent to run that process at scale. The opportunity at hand is enormous. Nearly every enterprise, across every industry, runs on processes that are still painfully manual. We're building the technology to change that. And we're just getting started. We're hiring a small group of **Forward Deployed Engineers** to help bring Sola to the world's largest enterprises and rewrite the playbook for how automation is built in the enterprise. **Why Sola? Why now?** ---------------------- ### **A massive market ready for reinvention.** Enterprise automation is one of the biggest opportunities in AI. Legacy automation platforms have been constrained by rigid rules, complex implementations, and brittle workflows.. Sola is changing that with AI agents that can reason, adapt, and execute work across enterprise systems: the next generation of a massive software category. ### **Real traction. Serious momentum.** Sola today powers enterprise workflows across healthcare, finance, legal, logistics, and more, including at Fortune 500 companies. We've closed seven\-figure enterprise deals with a lean team. The product is proven. The market is responding. Now we're building the team to scale it. ### **Build alongside leaders who've done it before.** Work alongside David Fullerton, formerly CTO of Heap (Series C to acquisition) and Stack Overflow (Series A to E), as well as Sola's founders Neil Deshmukh and Jessica Wu. You'll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional engineers and help shape how the company grows. ### **Early\-stage ownership. Exceptional upside.** Backed by Andreessen Horowitz, Conviction, and Y Combinator, Sola has raised more than $20M to build the future of enterprise automation. We’re still early enough that individual contributions can meaningfully influence the company’s trajectory, and you’ll have a direct influence on how the FDE role evolves over time. **What you'll do** ------------------ As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Sola, you'll combine hands\-on technical execution with customer\-facing communication and partnership. * Dive deep on customer workflow failures using logs, browser tools, APIs, and code, then implement and verify fixes * Build custom integrations and contribute production code to Sola's platform, turning recurring customer needs into reusable improvements * Join customer calls alongside Customer Success, ask questions that clarify the problem, and own the solution through resolution * Help customers onboard and adapt their workflows to Sola, including occasional travel for customer onboarding and key projects as needed **Who we're looking for** ------------------------- We're open to early\-career engineers, new graduates with demonstrated programming ability, or strong customer\-facing engineers who are comfortable writing production code. You'll likely be a strong fit if you have: * Strong technical foundations, whether from a CS degree with demonstrated coding abilities, or hands\-on experience in a strong technical environment * Flexibility to move across different customer environments, with a solid understanding of how core web technologies work and the ability to dive into complex desktop or legacy systems * A strong sense of curiosity and a drive to go anywhere needed to solve tricky customer problems * Excellent communication skills, and a demonstrated ability to turn complex technical findings into clear non\-technical explanations You'll work 5 days a week out of our office in NYC (we'll cover relocation!) and occasionally travel to customers as needed. **Compensation \& Benefits** ---------------------------- Sola offers competitive salary plus meaningful equity at Series A stage. Exact compensation is based on experience and level. We offer comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, 401(k) matching, daily meals together in the office, flexible PTO (4 weeks per year), and relocation support for candidates not already based in NYC. Compensation Range: $120K \- $200K

jobs.title: IT Specialist
jobs.description: The IT Specialist provides skilled technical support to end users across a unique BYOD (bring\-your\-own\-device) research environment, and supports the endpoint, identity, and collaboration services that environment depends on. The position independently identifies, researches, and resolves technical problems across endpoints, accounts, collaboration services, connectivity, and workplace technology. It documents, tracks, and monitors work to ensure timely resolution, and works to the account provisioning, security, and endpoint configuration standards owned by the Senior and Lead IT Specialists. Because the Institute is a research organization, the role extends beyond conventional corporate end\-user support. It includes supporting specialized scientific workstations and laboratory computers, access to high\-capacity research storage, research and scientific applications, instrument\-attached systems, and conference\-room and collaboration technology. **Who We Are** The Salk Institute is an internationally renowned research institution that values all (https://www.salk.edu/about/our\-community/) members of our scientific community. We seek bold and interactive leaders passionate about exploring new frontiers in science. Our collaborative community embraces perspectives across discipline, professional acumen, and unique life experiences, fostering innovation, and a sense of belonging. Together, we strive to improve the wellbeing of humanity through groundbreaking research. Founded by Jonas Salk, developer of the first safe and effective polio vaccine, the Institute is an independent, nonprofit research organization and architectural landmark: small by choice, intimate by nature, and fearless in the face of any challenge. Salk's vibrant community has many talented individuals from varied backgrounds, each playing a crucial role in driving our mission forward. From visionary leaders (https://www.salk.edu/about/management\-team/) to dedicated administrators (https://www.salk.edu/administration/) and brilliant faculty members (https://www.salk.edu/science/directory/faculty/), the Institute is united by a shared passion for scientific exploration and innovation. **What Your Key Responsibilities Will Be** * **End\-User Technical Support — Tier 1 and Tier 2** + Serves as first point of contact for end\-user requests received by telephone, email, ticket, remote tools and in person, and provides second\-line resolution for issues requiring deeper diagnosis. + Troubleshoots hardware, software, operating system, application and network connectivity issues across macOS, Windows, Linux and mobile platforms. + Troubleshoots Microsoft 365, business and scientific applications, printers, peripherals, VPN, Wi\-Fi and mobile\-device issues. + Installs, configures and maintains desktops, laptops, mobile devices and peripheral equipment. + Supports specialized scientific workstations, laboratory computers and instrument\-attached systems; provides access to high\-capacity research storage; installs and troubleshoots research and scientific applications. + Provides support across the main campus and remote Institute sites, including scheduled site visits. + Provides user training and guidance in supported technologies and applications, and communicates technical concepts clearly to non\-technical users. * **Endpoint, Identity, Collaboration and Workplace Technology Administration** + Configures and deploys laptops, desktops, mobile devices and peripherals to the Institute’s standard configurations, and applies operating system and application updates. + Supports endpoint\-management platforms such as Intune, Jamf or SCCM/MECM under established configuration standards. + Supports existing user accounts, including passwords, lockouts, multi\-factor authentication, group membership, and permissions in Active Directory and Entra ID, working to the provisioning standards owned by the Senior and Lead IT Specialists. + Supports Exchange Online and Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, Office applications and collaboration services, including mailboxes, calendars, room calendars and distribution lists. + Supports mapped drives, shared folders, OneDrive, Box, SharePoint and external storage, and assists with user data migrations. + Supports telephony extensions, voicemail and call routing, printers, scanners, conference\-room systems, displays and AV equipment. + Verifies that endpoints carry required security controls and remain compliant with institutional configuration standards. * **Diagnosis, Root Cause and Tier 3 Escalation** + Diagnoses unfamiliar and intermittent faults, and determines whether an issue originates in the endpoint, application, account, network or upstream infrastructure. + Recognizes and reports suspected phishing, malware, and compromised\-account activity, and follows the defined escalation procedure to the Cybersecurity Engineer. + Diagnoses wired and wireless connectivity, DNS, DHCP, VPN and basic network pro  and peripheral support experience in a multi\-platform environment. * Minimum two years supporting macOS and Windows operating systems and business applications; working familiarity with Linux. * Minimum two years providing IT support services using a ticketing system, with demonstrated ownership of a personal queue. * Demonstrated experience administering user accounts, group membership and permissions in Active Directory or a comparable directory service. * Demonstrated experience with endpoint deployment, imaging or provisioning, and secure device disposal. **What We Can Offer** **The expected pay range for this position is $31\.25\-$34\.60 hourly.** Salk Institute provides pay ranges representing its good faith estimate of what the institute reasonably expects to pay for a position. The pay offered to a selected candidate will be determined based on factors such as (but not limited to) the scope and responsibilities of the position, the qualifications of the selected candidate, departmental budget availability, internal equity, and external market pay for comparable jobs. **Benefits** Salk Institute offers competitive benefits (https://www.salk.edu/about/careers/benefits/), including medical, dental, vision, retirement, paid time off, tuition reimbursement, patient advocacy services, and transit/parking program. **Salk Values** The Salk Community, both scientists and administrators, worked together to define values that we believe support Salk’s pursuit of excellence. To be truly the best scientific institution requires not only incredible discoveries, but a common understanding of how we should work together to enable those discoveries. The acronym “I CARE” (https://www.salk.edu/about/careers/values/) provides a simple way to remember each of the values and reminds each of us of the importance of what we do each day. **Equal Employment Opportunity Statement** The Salk Institute for Biological Studies is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to providing equal access to opportunities for students, employees, applicants for employment and other visitors. Salk has also adopted and maintains a policy to encourage professional and respectful workplace behavior and prevent discriminatory and harassing conduct in our workplace. Accordingly, the Institute prohibits harassment and discrimination in employment on the basis of, and considers all qualified applicants for employment without regard to, actual or perceived race (race is inclusive of traits associated with race, including, but not limited to, hair texture and protective hairstyles. Protective hairstyles include, but not limited to, such hairstyles as braids, and twists), color, religion, religious creed (including religious dress and grooming practices), national origin, ancestry, citizenship, physical or mental disability, medical condition (including cancer and genetic characteristics), genetic information, marital status, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), reproductive health decision making, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, veteran and/or military status (disabled veteran, veteran of the Vietnam era, other covered veteran status), political affiliation, and any other status protected by state or federal law. Discrimination is prohibited with any intersectionality of the above\-mentioned characteristics, including: * Any combination of characteristics. * A perception that the person has any of the characteristics or any combination of those characteristics. * A perception that the person is associated with a person who has, or is perceived to have, any of those characteristics or any combination of those characteristics. jobs.description: **Associate Digital Solutions Engineer (Associate DSE)** **THE POSITION IN A NUTSHELL** Sciens Building Solutions is seeking an Associate Digital Solutions Engineer (Associate DSEs) that build and test practical AI and automation tools that make everyday work easier for our field and office teams. Associate DSEs take in ideas from across the business, build pilots for the ones that are prioritized, test them with the people who will use them, and measure whether they work. Pilots that prove out are handed to the delivery team for production builds. Associate DSEs are encouraged to try modern AI tools and test ideas quickly. Strong performers can grow into the Digital Solutions Engineer role as they take on more ownership. **WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING (and doing well!)** * Spend time with field and office teams, take in their ideas, and check whether SAP or a tool we already have can do the job before anything new is built. * Build and configure pilot tools using AI, automation, and workflow platforms, starting from use cases prioritized by the Chief Digital Officer. * Test pilots with the people who will use them, measure whether they save time or improve results, and refine them based on what you learn. * Work with the analytics and systems teams to get the data a pilot needs. * Document on how each pilot works, what was tested, and what was learned, and share results in short, clear updates. * Support the handoff of validated pilots to the delivery team for production builds. * Review AI tools that teams and departments build for themselves before they are shared more widely. * Help run tools once they jobs.title: MTS: AI Research Engineer
jobs.description: **Type:** Full Time, Hybrid **Team:** Research **Focus:** AI \& Agent Systems **Who We Are** -------------- We're a team of founders, engineers, researchers, creatives, and operators building what we believe will be one of the defining companies of the AI era. Some of us came from startups. Some from academia. Some from hospitality, defense, design, or completely different worlds. We don’t care how you got here \- we care about your energy, intelligence, curiosity, resilience, and ambition. ### **Who We Are Not** * ***We are not remote.*** We value the spontaneous moments that happen when we’re together \- over dinner, in the hallway, around whiteboards. We like being around each other because the best conversations here rarely happen in meetings. * ***We are not your typical team.*** It’s not just the 10 countries we’re from, the languages we speak or our non\-traditional backgrounds. We’re solving hard problems with people we respect \- we make the most of our time together, we make it special. * ***We are not another “polished” SF startup*****.** We value velocity over speed, raw talent over brands, and genuine human connection above all else. We value being successful, not looking successful. **What You’ll Own \& Build** ---------------------------- As a Member of Technical Staff within the Research Tribe, you’ll be one of the early engineers shaping the core systems that power Seldon. You won’t just build agents \- **you’ll design the infrastructure that governs how they operate: how they coordinate, how they’re evaluated, and how their behavior improves over time**. This is a deeply technical role bridging distributed systems, machine intelligence, and product \- turning stochastic models into reliable, production\-grade systems. * **Multi\-Agent Systems Architecture:** Design and implement agentic systems, rather than prompt chains, at scale. You’ll define agent topologies, robust orchestration layers, structured state management, persistent and scoped memory, tool\-use registries and execution, and build structured, inspectable systems. **You’re building a long\-running harness\-based agentic platform, not wiring together LLM API calls.** * **Behavioral \& Persona Modeling:** Simulate user archetypes with goal\-directed behavior. You’ll design data\-grounded personas, enable “computer\-use” on real interfaces, and develop agents with critique and reflection loops. **You’re producing measurable, actionable behavior.** * **Evaluation \& Prompt Engineering:** Design prompt schemas and reasoning templates as integrated systems. You’ll build frameworks that measure behavioral fidelity and failure modes, and implement automated and HITL feedback. **If it can’t be measured, it doesn’t ship.** * **Signal \& Insight Systems:** Build systems that transform raw agent outputs into high\-signal insights. You’ll cluster observations across runs, implement severity scoring, and map behavioral signals to product decisions. **Turn noisy outputs into decisions.** * **Production Reliability:** Build the infrastructure to operate agents in production. You’ll implement tracing, attribution, and cost monitoring, detect failure modes and design fallbacks, circuit breakers, and evaluation pipelines. **The bar is production reliability.** **Who You Are** --------------- * **Systems, Not Prompts:** You prioritize state machines, orchestration layers, and tool\-use contracts over prompt hacking. You build for reliability, inspectability, and improvability \- you’re uncomfortable with “it just works sometimes.” **If it can’t be measured, it doesn’t ship.** * **Production Experience:** You have 5\+ years building complex software and 2\+ years shipping agentic LLM systems. You’ve built harnesses where agents manage tool selection, error recovery, and multi\-step execution autonomously in production environments that run, break, and evolve. * **Orchestration Systems:** You’re experienced with multi\-agent orchestration, sandboxed execution, and complex backends. You optimize for coordination, scoped memory \& context, and how agents degrade gracefully under pressure. * **Python Mastery:** You’re an expert in async programming and structured data modeling (Pydantic), building maintainable, scalable systems designed for extensibility. * **Fast, Iterative Builder:** You thrive when research and product move together. You’re comfortable shipping quickly, learning from real users, and refining systems in tight loops. * **High Ownership, Low Ego:** You take responsibility for what you build. You’re willing to be wrong, change your mind, and prioritize being effective over being “theoretically right. * **Comfortable at the Frontier:** You’re excited by ambiguous problems. You’re not waiting for best practices \- you’re helping define them. * **Product Intuition:** You prioritize signal over noise because outputs matter. You care that what you build helps someone make a decision. * **All Backgrounds Welcome: S**ome of us are dropouts, some have PhDs. Some are tech veterans, some are first\-timers. What matters \- how you think, how you build, and how you work in teams. **Why Seldon** -------------- * **The People:** Join a global team of founders, engineers, researchers, and adventurers obsessed with human behavior \- we’re curious, willing to be wrong, and privileged to be solving hard problems at the frontier. * **The Problem:** Deep science with real impact. We leverage behavioral modeling, cognitive science, and cutting\-edge AI to solve real product challenges for real customers. * **The Velocity:** Ship fast and learn faster. Work directly with customers and see the impact of your work in hours, not weeks or months. * **The World\-Class Backing:** Backed by top funds including MaC VC, Protagonist, Rackhouse, Blank, and Weekend Fund, as well as scouts at a16z, Greylock and CRV, and product leaders and researchers from orgs. inc. Meta, Airbnb, Google, Discord, Uber and more. * **The Member Of Staff Philosophy:** You don’t care about titles \- you value extreme ownership. **Comp \& Benefits** -------------------- * **Salary:** $180\-250k base \+ equity * **Health** (US only)**:** 100% paid medical, dental \& vision * **PTO:** 28 days (inc 5 company\-wide days on stats) * **Environment:** Beautiful offices in SoMa \& Tower Bridge optimized for deep collaboration * **WFH:** 2 days/week (Mon \& Fri) to catch up on laundry, save time commuting, and let your cat walk across the keyboard * **Adventures:** Team dinners, offsites, and events throughout the year Compensation Range: $180K \- $250K

jobs.title: Associate Validation Engineer - Test Automation
jobs.description: **About Sequel** Sequel, headquartered in Manchester, New Hampshire, is a company developing the next generation of transformative drug\-delivery advancements starting with diabetes. Sequel’s approach is to look at diabetes management holistically to advance systems that make living with diabetes simpler and easier for all. Sequel’s flagship product, the twiist Automated Insulin Delivery (AID) System, launched in July 2025 for people with type 1 diabetes providing them with personalized diabetes management. ### **Job Overview:** Sequel Med Tech is seeking an Associate Validation Engineer – Test Automation to join our growing Salesforce Engineering team. This early\-career role is designed for a software professional with foundational knowledge of computer science or software development who will apply those skills to design, develop, analyze, and maintain automated test programs in a regulated GxP and medical device environment. You will spend most of your time writing code, and using AI\-assisted development tools to write code, that automatically tests our Salesforce configurations and integrations. No prior validation or regulatory experience is required: Sequel will provide structured training, mentorship from senior validation and engineering staff, and ongoing support as you learn Computer System Validation (CSV), Computer Software Assurance (CSA), and FDA requirements. The ideal candidate is curious, detail\-oriented, comfortable learning new technologies quickly, and excited to build automated tests that help ensure our systems are safe, reliable, and compliant. ### **Job Responsibilities and Essential Duties:** Under the guidance of senior validation and engineering team members, support day\-to\-day validation and test automation activities for Sequel's Enterprise Systems. This includes: * Design, write, and maintain automated test scripts and test suites that verify Salesforce configurations, workflows, and integrations against documented requirements. * Use AI\-assisted coding tools (e.g., Cursor and similar) to accelerate test development, while reviewing, understanding, and taking ownership of all generated code. * Translate user and functional requirements into clear test cases, ensuring traceability and comprehensive test coverage. * Execute automated and manual tests, analyze results, and document defects with clear, reproducible detail. * Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines so that testing runs consistently as part of the development and release process. * Learn and apply Computer System Validation (CSV) and Computer Software Assurance (CSA) practices in compliance with FDA 21 CFR Part 11, ISO 13485, and Sequel's quality procedures. * Help prepare validation deliverables such as test plans, test protocols, traceability matrices, and summary reports under the direction of senior validation staff. * Support change management by helping assess the testing impact of configuration changes to validated systems. * Collaborate with full\-stack engineers, Salesforce developers, product managers, and Quality partners to understand requirements and resolve issues. * Participate in training, code reviews, and knowledge\-sharing sessions to build expertise in validation, test automation, and regulated software development. * Stay current with test automation tools, AI\-assisted development practices, and evolving regulatory expectations (CSA, GxP, SaMD). ### **Minimum Requirements (Education and Experience):** * Education: BS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Software Development, or a related field (recent graduates encouraged to apply). * Experience: 0–2 years’ experience in software development or testing; relevant internships, co\-ops, academic, capstone, or personal coding projects will be considered. ### **Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:** * Solid programming fundamentals in at least one modern language such as JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Java, or C\#. * A software development mindset: enjoys writing code, solving problems, and automating repetitive work. * Familiarity with software testing concepts such as unit, integration, functional, and regression testing. * Familiarity with version control (Git/Gitlab) and basic development workflows. * Interest in or exposure to AI\-assisted coding tools and a willingness to use them responsibly. * Exposure to test automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Jest, PyTest, or similar) is a plus. * Exposure to Salesforce (Apex, Lightning, Flows, or Trailhead coursework) is a plus but not required. * Basic understanding of web technologies (HTML, CSS, REST APIs) and frontend/backend development principles. * Strong attention to detail and the ability to document work clearly and accurately. * Good written and verbal communication skills, and comfort asking questions and working in a team. * Eagerness to learn software validation, GxP, and FDA medical device regulations; formal training will be provided. * Interest in medical device, life sciences, or other regulated industries preferred. Sequel Med Tech provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. At Sequel, we believe that when you thrive, we thrive. That’s why our benefits package is designed to support you from day one. Operating with autonomy, you’ll bring clarity to complex, cross\-functional challenges and act as a go\-to expert and point of contact for major initiatives. Set the standard for how we write, review, and test Rust that runs on resource\-constrained devices, with performance, memory efficiency, and safe concurrency as everyday concerns. Guide the evolution of existing code, including where Rust meets legacy C. * **AI Practices \& Vision Collaboration:** Help define how the team uses AI\-assisted development and operational tooling, evaluating where AI can meaningfully improve velocity and quality, and set a forward\-looking vision for responsible AI adoption in the organization. * **Cross\-Functional Partnership:** Collaborate with firmware, security, cloud infrastructure, and product management to keep technical direction aligned with product requirements and business needs. * **Mentor \& Elevate the Team:** Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers at every level, in p capacity * Expert\-level proficiency in Rust, with deep knowledge of ownership and lifetimes, async and multithreaded concurrency, error handling, and writing performant, memory\-efficient code for resource\-constrained devices * Strong systems programming experience on embedded Linux or similar constrained environments, jobs.title: Director, Software Engineering
jobs.description: ### **About SnapLogic** SnapLogic powers the agentic enterprise. The company's Agentic Integration and Applied AI Platform serves as the AI operational layer for the enterprise, securely connecting applications, data, APIs and AI agents across cloud, on\-premise and hybrid environments. With trusted orchestration, governance and enterprise\-grade control, SnapLogic helps organizations accelerate business value and scale AI with confidence. Unlike legacy tools, SnapLogic is built for the AI era and trusted by global enterprises, including AstraZeneca, Adobe, Verizon, and Sony, to modernize operations and power the next generation of enterprise AI. **Join the Agentic Integration movement at** **snaplogic.com****.** The Role: As the Director of Software Engineering, you are a hands\-on, "rock star" Java developer and visionary leader responsible for driving the development of enterprise\-grade cloud SaaS/PaaS distributed applications. You will orchestrate the broader engineering ecosystem by deriving a roadmap that balances commitments, tech debt, and product innovation to mitigate risk. By balancing technical excellence with business ROI, you will spearhead SRE and agile process improvements, mentor team leads, and foster a high\-performing culture. You will also act as the eyes and ears to customer needs, collaborating closely with customers, field teams, and company leadership to continually innovate the product experience. ### **The Role:** As Director of Platform Engineering, you own the platform that every SnapLogic service runs on: the control plane, the data layer behind it, and the operational tooling that keeps it healthy in production. You are a hands\-on technical leader and a people leader. You set the architectural direction, you build and grow the team that executes it, and you stay close enough to the systems to make real decisions about them. This is a role for a leader with real depth in distributed systems and the data layer that backs them. You will hold your team to end\-to\-end understanding of the systems they operate, and you will be expected to have that understanding yourself. SnapLogic runs roughly 50 MongoDB clusters across production and test, holding more than 60TB of data, and that footprint is a core part of the charter. You will derive a roadmap that balances customer commitments, technical debt, and platform innovation, and you will be judged on reliability and scale as much as on delivery. You are also the eyes and ears on platform health for the wider engineering organization, working with SRE, application teams, support, and company leadership. This is a hybrid role based at our HQ in San Mateo, CA, with the requirement to work in the office two days per week### **What You'll Do:** * **Platform Ownership \& Architecture** You own the services that make up SnapLogic's control plane. You set the architectural direction for reliability, performance, and scalability across services, the data layer, and upstream dependencies. You review designs for criticalcomponents, you make the call on build versus buy, and you keep a clear view of risk versus reward on every production change. You decide how much of your own time goes to coding and code review, and you keep enough hands\-on depth to lead the work credibly. * **Engineering Leadership \& Team Building** You have led and managed engineering teams, and you think constantly about team productivity, quality, and health. You own hiring for the team, including the forecast and budget, recruiting strong engineers, and promoting and growing the people already here. You organize the team to make impactful changes, you delegate technical ownership over subject matter areas, you establish leads and empower them to mentor their own reports, and you give direct, constructive feedback. You run regular one\-on\-ones, advocate for career growth, and resolve conflict early. * **Reliability, SRE, \& Production Support** You are accountable for the zero\-downtime SLA. You drive root cause analysis, own SRE process improvements, and make sure those processes are actually followed. You keep your eyes on production at all times and pull in resources before widespread impact is felt. You turn every incident into a durable improvement: better tests, observability, automation, or a design change. You manage support escalations, stay in close contact with the support manager, and join customer escalation calls when needed. * **Cloud\-Native Infrastructure \& GitOps** You understand Kubernetes well beyond deploying workloads: operators and custom resources, policy enforcement, networking, IAM integration, and capacity. You lead the ongoing move of legacy EC2\-based services onto Kubernetes without putting availability at risk. You treat developer self\-service, environments on demand and an internal developer portal as a product your team owns. * **Data Layer at Scale** You own the strategy for a MongoDB footprint of roughly 50 clusters and more than 60 va and/or Python, with the comfort to pick up new languages and stacks * Deep experience operating distributed systems in production: debugging, profiling, capacity planning, and incident response * Track record of taking systems from design through production rollout and owning them after launch * Solid grasp of databases, relational or NoSQL, including query performance, indexing, and schema design trade\-offs * Deep understanding of distributed systems, including HTTP protocols, distributed caching strategies, and observability * Experience being accountable for an availability SLA on a customer\-facing platform * Hands\-on experience running Kubernetes in production at scale, ideally Amazon EKS, including troubleshooting cluster, networking and workload issues * Experience with GitOps delivery (ArgoCD) and infrastructure as code (Terraform or equivalent) * B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience ### **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience with cloud infrastructure, AWS preferred, containers, and CI/CD * Familiarity with observability tooling (metrics, tracing, structured logs) and SRE practices * Experience implementing continuous delivery and cloud deployment solutions * Multi\-tenant public and private cloud experience * Hands\-on experience operating MongoDB, or another NoSQL database, at scale: sharding, replica sets, query profiling, and index tuning * Agile project and release management * A record of accurate, fast decision making under production pressure The above range is the approximate annual U.S. base pay range for this position. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including candidate location, experience and expertise, and may vary from the range listed. In addition to base salaries, certain roles are also eligible for annual cash bonuses or commissions. All of our full time employees receive a comprehensive benefits package.### **Why Join:** There's never been a better time to join our **SnapSquad**! At SnapLogic, we believe in empowering people \- customers and employees alike \- to connect what matters and build what’s next. From competitive salaries to global wellness benefits, we’re committed to your success and well\-being. ### **A Few Reasons You’ll Love it Here:** #### **We’re Innovators** SnapLogic pioneered the first AI integration assistant, SnapGPT, and continues to lead with a full suite of AI\-powered tools across our agentic integration platform \- making integration faster, smarter, and accessible to more people. #### **We’re Recognized Leaders** From being named a Visionary in multiple Gartner Magic Quadrants, leading the market in innovative AI reports from Aragon Research, or being recognized for our AI developments in the SaaS Awards, we’re setting the pace in a rapidly evolving market. #### **We’re Growing Fast** SnapLogic’s revenue growth earned us a place on the 2026 Inc. 5000, recognizing America's fastest growing companies. As we scale globally, we’re creating opportunities for ambitious builders and operators to make a bigger impact, take deeper ownership, and accelerate their careers. #### **We’re Agentic** Our platform empowers everyone across the enterprise to create automated, AI\-connected workflows. That means more impact, less friction, and a bigger role for YOU in driving transformation. **Are you ready to help build what’s next for the enterprise? Let’s talk.** Apply now and help us power the agentic enterprise. We're proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people's lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. **Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world.** **The Role:** SoFi's ability to deliver trusted member experiences, manage risk, meet regulatory obligations, and scale enterprise AI depends on data that is reliable, governed, understandable, and available when it is needed. As a Principal Software Engineer in the Data Platform Group, you will provide hands\-on technical leadership within the Data Trust pillar. Working alongside the Senior Manager and other Principal Engineers, you will design, build, and operate the distributed systems and reusable platform primitives that make data quality, privacy, metadata, lineage, access, and reliability enforceable by construction across the enterprise. Your work will span three connected areas: establishing shared Data Trust capabilities, raising the reliability of data across batch and low\-latency environments, and applying those foundations to a semantic context layer for trusted analytics and AI. By making business meaning, ownership, provenance, quality, freshness, and access policies machine\-readable, you will help end users and AI systems work from consistent, governed context. This is an individual contributor role with broad organizational impact. You will personally contribute code, prototypes, architecture, and operational improvements while setting technical direction across engineering, data, security, privacy, legal, risk, analytics, and product teams. You will build reusable enterprise capabilities and reference patterns that partner teams can adopt, while domain teams retain ownership of their application\-specific use cases and serving paths. **What you will own:** * **Data Trust architecture and strategy:** Define and execute the technical direction for data contracts, metadata and catalog modernization, lineage, data quality, privacy, and access controls. Translate business, regulatory, and engineering requirements into a coherent platform strategy and sequence investments for long\-term impact. * **Declarative enforcement primitives:** Build platform services, libraries, and reference patterns that make contracts, quality rules, privacy policies, and access requirements versioned, testable, observable, and automatically enforceable across the data lifecycle. * **Semantic context for analytics and AI:** Establish the technical foundations for a governed semantic context layer that connects business definitions, metadata, lineage, ownership, quality, freshness, and access policy. Enable trusted discovery, analytics, and AI\-assisted or agentic experiences without turning this role into a model\-development function. * **Reliability across batch and streaming data:** Lead the evolution of Data Trust capabilities across Snowflake, AWS data services, Kafka\-based ingestion, and other batch or low\-latency environments. Establish explicit SLOs, failure modes, correction paths, and operational ownership, supported by automated detection, containment, remediation, and recovery. * **Mission\-critical operational rigor:** Raise the standard for production data systems through observability, integrity checks, audit evidence, incident learning, and safe automation. Help move the organization from reactive troubleshooting and manual compliance activity toward proactive, measurable control. * **Cross\-organizational technical leadership:** Drive multi\-quarter initiatives across teams and functions, earning alignment on difficult architectural tradeoffs and investment decisions. Serve as a trusted technical authority for Data Trust while mentoring senior engineers, strengthening design and implementation practices, and raising the broader engineering bar. #### **What success looks like in the first 12–18 months:** * A clear enterprise architecture and delivery path exists for Data Trust primitives spanning contracts, metadata, lineage, quality, privacy, and reliability. * Priority data domains have materially improved coverage, observability, SLOs, and automated enforcement. * The platform provides production\-ready patterns for governing data in both batch and low\-latency environments. * Initial semantic context capabilities are operating in production and provide more reliable, traceable context for analytics and AI use cases. * Manual investigation, recurring data failures, and compliance evidence\-gathering are measurably reduced re Expertise:** Deep experience designing horizontal, multi\-tenant platform services that other engineering teams depend on. You understand the failure modes of distributed systems, eventual consistency, and how to balance latency, availability, and cost. * **Data Trust \& Governance Depth:** Practical, battle\-tested experience building or managing components of the modern data trust stack, such as data contracts, metadata catalogs, data quality frameworks, end\-to\-end lineage, and fine\-grained access control (RBAC/ABAC). * **Batch \& Streaming Mastery:** Advanced knowledge of modern data ecosystems, specifically Snowflake, Kafka (or similar streaming platforms), and AWS data services. You are comfortable writing production\-grade code, conducting rigorous code reviews, and building declarative infrastructure (Terraform, CI/CD). * **Cross\-Organizational Leadership:** A history of successfully driving multi\-team, cross\-functional technical initiatives. You know how to build consensus across Engineering, Security, Privacy, and Product teams, translating compliance and risk requirements into frictionless engineering primitives. * **Operational Rigor:** Experience managing Tier\-0/mission\-critical infrastructure. You build systems with a "trust but verify" mindset—relying on automated testing, drift detection, and circuit breakers rather than manual processes. **Nice to have:** * **FinTech / Regulated Industry Experience:** Prior experience operating in a highly regulated environment where auditability, data privacy (CCPA/GDPR), and data integrity are architectural requirements, not afterthoughts. * **AI Infrastructure Exposure:** Experience building semantic layers, knowledge graphs, or context engines that ground LLMs and autonomous agents in governed enterprise data. * **Open Source Contributions:** Contributions to relevant open\-source data or metadata projects (e.g., Apache Iceberg, OpenMetadata, DataHub, Amundsen). **Compensation and Benefits** The base pay range for this role is listed below. jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description: **Job Title:** Software Developer **Company:** SMRTR **Location:** United States or Canada, Remote **Employment Type :** Full\-time **About SMRTR** SMRTR builds software that helps businesses run more efficiently. Together with our sister companies Shea, a SYSPRO ERP partner, and DTEC, a distribution ERP provider, we are part of Solen Software Group. Our customers rely on us every day, and our Subscriptions, Renewals, Collections \& Accounting team keeps that relationship healthy, making sure software subscriptions, renewals and services are billed on time and accurately, and that outstanding balances are resolved quickly and professionally. **The Opportunity** We are looking for a software developer with 3–5 years of experience to build product features and integrations for NG and SMRTR TRAC. Our stack is Vue, TypeScript, Node.js and PostgreSQL, with services on the JVM (Scala). Working with our Director of Software Engineering, you will help deliver our 2027 roadmap: connecting our products to the ERP systems our customers run (starting with SYSPRO), AI\-powered document capture, and new NG and TRAC features. You will join a small, experienced team where what you build reaches customers quickly. **Key Responsibilities** **Product development** * Build features across the front end (Vue, TypeScript) and back end (Node.js, Scala/JVM) for NG and SMRTR TRAC. * Design and work with PostgreSQL data models and queries (and some MongoDB), with attention to performance. * Fix defects and improve the reliability of the products you work on. **Integrations and APIs** * Build and maintain REST APIs and integrations between NG / SMRTR TRAC and ERP systems such as SYSPRO, Microsoft Dynamics 365, VAI and NCR, following the team's integration patterns. * Contribute to AI document capture (classification and data extraction) and the print\-to\-NG driver. **Delivery and collaboration** * Turn requirements from Professional Services, Sales and customers into working software, with guidance from engineering leadership. * Estimate your own tasks and deliver to agreed dates. * Support go\-lives and help troubleshoot production issues. **Engineering practices** * Write tested, reviewed and secure code in our GitHub\-based workflow with CI/CD. * Write clear technical documentation and release notes. * Use AI\-assisted development tools to work faster, safely. **What You Bring** **Required** * 3–5 years of professional software development experience. * Production experience with Vue.js, TypeScript and Node.js. * PostgreSQL: schema design, SQL and query performance. * JVM experience, preferably Scala. * Experience building REST APIs and integrating with third\-party systems. * Git\-based workflows, code review and automated testing. * Clear communication with colleagues and, when needed, customers. * Authorized to work in the United States or Canada; set up for remote work. **Nice to Have** * MongoDB. * Android or Xamarin. * ERP integration experience (e.g., SYSPRO, Microsoft Dynamics 365, VAI, NCR). * Document management, OCR or AI document capture. * Experience with manufacturing, distribution or food \& beverage software. **How Success Is Measured** * Features and integrations delivered on schedule * Quality: defects and production incidents in your code * Accuracy of estimates on your own work * Growing ownership of product areas over the year **Compensation and Benefits** * Base salary of USD 65,000–85,000 (United States) or CAD 95,000–110,000 (Canada), depending on experience and location * Benefits according to country of employment (in the US: health, dental and vision insurance and a 401(k) with company match) * Paid time off and company holidays * Fully remote work with a collaborative, experienced team **Recruitment Disclaimer** Solen Software Group will never request payment, banking information, or other sensitive personal or financial details during any stage of the recruitment process.
