jobs.title: Senior Principal Engineer, Data & Machine Learning
jobs.description: **Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?** Sony Interactive Entertainment isn't just the Best Place to Play — it's also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we're part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting\-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity. ### **Sr. Principal Engineer, Data \& Machine Learning** **San Mateo, CA** ### **Why PlayStation Data \& Intelligence** PlayStation reaches more than 100\+ million people. Behind those experiences is one of the largest consumer data estates in entertainment: tens of petabytes under management and trillions of telemetry events a year, powering personalization, experimentation, partner analytics and enterprise decisions across the company. We are in the middle of a multi\-year shift in how that data creates value. Today intelligence often arrives after the moment has passed. Our goal is a connected intelligence layer where trusted context about players, content, partners and the business is built once, reused everywhere, activated at the point of decision, and improved by evidence about what happened next. That includes serving AI models and agents with the same governed meaning, quality and permissions we give to people. This role helps shape how that is built across PlayStation. **The Role** We are looking for a Senior Principal Engineer, Data \& Machine Learning to serve as chief architect for our Data \& Intelligence organization and as the senior technical authority for how SIE builds, reuses and activates trusted data and intelligence. This is one of SIE's most senior individual\-contributor roles. You will report directly to the Vice President of the organization, sit on the leadership team alongside the Sr. Directors who run our two delivery portfolios, chair our architecture review forum, and lead a community of Principal Engineers anchored to the major architectural seams. You will have no direct reports by design; your leverage comes from the architecture, the standards and the decisions the whole organization builds against. This is a hands\-on role. You will author architectures and reference implementations, prototype uncertain approaches, review the designs and code that matter most, and step in directly when a technical problem puts an important outcome at risk. **What You'll Own** You will set the architecture for, and drive reuse across, the initiatives that define the next three years of data and intelligence at PlayStation: * **A single, reusable understanding of the player.** The context, lifecycle and lifetime\-value intelligence that powers experiences and decisions across PlayStation, built once and reused rather than rebuilt per use case. * **Content and game understanding.** Intelligence about titles, experiences and how players engage with them, connected through engagement and content graphs to improve discovery, personalization and new AI experiences. * **Creator and partner intelligence.** Reusable title, launch and lifecycle intelligence available to partners at the point of decision, before launch, while live and after. * **Unified measurement.** Experimentation, attribution and causal measurement so the company knows what changed an outcome, by how much, and what to do next. * **Activation.** Real\-time signals, activation data products and APIs that deliver trusted context into the systems that personalize and act. * **Semantic and conversational intelligence.** A shared layer of business meaning and metrics that people, analytical tools and AI agents can query and trust. * **Enterprise decision data.** Decision\-grade finance and supply\-chain data that accelerates transformation programs across SIE. * **Trusted foundations and golden paths.** Data contracts, certification, lineage, unified events and standard publish\-to\-consume paths, with trust designed into the lifecycle; and launch data readiness so priority launches have their signals and measures from day one. **What You'll Do** * Translate our multi\-year Data \& Intelligence strategy into a coherent technical strategy and target architecture, with clear principles for trusted data products, ML systems, shared intelligence, evaluation, activation and lifecycle management. * Chair the architecture review forum: set its charter and cadence, publish decisions, track adoption and hold the line on non\-conforming designs. * Own the boundary decisions between platform capabilities built for reuse and domain delivery, and keep them stable. * Define and ratify the standards teams build against: data contracts, golden nd machine learning direction in senior leadership forums, partner organizations and, where appropriate, the broader industry. ### **What We're Looking For** * 15\+ years in software, data or machine learning engineering, including 9\+ years leading the architecture and delivery of large\-scale, complex systems. * A track record of authoring architectures, standards or platforms that were adopted across multiple organizations and stayed in use. * Experience taking data, ML or decisioning systems serving tens of millions of consumers into production and operating them at scale. * Experience chairing, or being the deciding technical voice in, an architecture review forum spanning multiple engineering organizations. * Deep expertise in at least two of: reusable data products, semantic and metadata layers and data contracts; ML platforms, lifecycle management, evaluation and decisioning; real\-time signals, distributed inference and activation platforms; experimentation and causal measurement; generative AI, retrieval and agentic systems; responsible AI, privacy and technical governance. * Strong command of distributed systems, cloud, data architecture, APIs, security, reliability, observability and performance engineering. * Demonstrated ability to influence senior executives, engineering and product leaders, and cross\-functional partners without direct authority. * Outstanding written communication. This role leads through documents. * Experience mentoring Staff, Principal or similarly senior technical professionals. * Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent experience. **Nice to Have** * Data and ML applied in gaming, entertainment, media, digital commerce or another large\-scale consumer ecosystem. * Personalization, recommendations, customer intelligence, content intelligence, experimentation or predictive decisioning at scale. * Shared data or ML platforms serving multiple products and organizational domains. * Feature, vector, graph, semantic or knowledge platforms; AI gateways and LLMOps. * Experience translating research or emerging technology into production capabilities. * Contributions to the field through open source, patents, publications, standards or conference talks. **Why You'll Love This Role** * Set the technical direction for data and intelligence across PlayStation. * Own the architecture behind experiences reaching more than 100 million people. * Report directly to the VP and sit on the organization's leadership team. * Build once, reuse everywhere: the mandate is to end duplicated work, not add to it. * Work with strong Principal and Staff engineers, data scientists and product leaders across the company. * Stay hands\-on at the most senior IC level. \#LI\-KS1 Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks. Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights. **Equal Opportunity Statement:** *Sony is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All persons will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender (including gender identity, gender expression and gender reassignment), race (including colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin), religion or belief, marital or civil partnership status, disability, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, trade union membership or membership in any other legally protected category.* *We strive to create an inclusive environment, empower employees and embrace diversity. We encourage everyone to respond.* *Sony Interactive Entertainment is a Fair Chance employer and qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered for employment.*

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: The Software Engineer is a member of Special\-Lite’s IT Delivery team, responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the software that allows customers and sales teams to configure, visualize, and price Special\-Lite products. For approximately the first six months, the role will focus on developing and maintaining our custom product extension in Configura’s CET Designer, written in CM (Configura’s proprietary object\-oriented language), which represents products in 2D and 3D with costing, business logic, and error prevention. As Special\-Lite implements Tacton as its next CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) platform, the role will expand to building and maintaining design automation that connects Tacton to Autodesk Inventor, coding parametric 3D models and drawings so they are generated automatically from configured products. #### **Essential Functions:** * Design, develop, test, and deploy enhancements to SpecialLite’s CET Designer extension, including products represented in 2D and/or 3D with costing, business logic, and error prevention. * Maintain and improve the existing CET code base, ensuring reliability, accuracy, and user satisfaction. * Develop and maintain Autodesk Inventor addins (VB.NET/C\#) that use the Inventor API to drive parametric 3D models and production drawings from Tacton CPQ configurations. * Build and maintain automationready Inventor models, rebuilding flexible/parametric components (e.g., frames of variable height) and reusing static components where appropriate. * Support integrations between Tacton CPQ, Autodesk Inventor, and other business systems using REST APIs and XML/JSON data exchange. * Inherit, understand, and extend code written by others, including thirdparty implementation partners, and write clean, documented, maintainable code for future developers. * Collaborate with sales, engineering, and business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions. * Manage source code and automation assets under version control (Git; Autodesk Vault for CAD assets) and track work in Jira as part of an Agile team. * Troubleshoot and resolve application issues, escalating when necessary. * Create documentation and assist with user training for supported applications. * Apply best practices in security, maintainability, and performance, and contribute toward continuous improvement in both code and process. #### **Position Requirements:** * Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or equivalent experience. * Must have experience in C\#, VB.NET, C\+\+, Java or any other objectoriented language. * Excellent grasp of objectoriented concepts and experience in using them to build applications. * Willingness to learn proprietary languages and platforms, including Configura’s CM language and CET Designer. * Experience using source control (such as Git) and tasktracking tools (such as Jira). * Basic familiarity with REST APIs and XML/JSON data formats. * Must be passionate about programming. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Excellent analytical and problemsolving skills. * Must be a selfstarter and have the ability to work independently on diverse problems. * Must have the ability to gather requirements, consider and explore multiple approaches and suggest effective solutions. #### **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience with the Autodesk Inventor API, including part/assembly modeling and drawing automation, addin development, or iLogic. * Handson Autodesk Inventor modeling experience, including parametric part and assembly modeling. * NET development experience, particularly VB.NET or C\#, using Visual Studio. * Experience with Configura CET Designer and/or the CM programming language. * Experience with CPQ or product configuration platforms, especially Tacton. * Experience with Autodesk Vault or other PDM systems. * Understanding of 3D geometry and coordinate systems. * Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment. #### **Physical Requirements:** * Frequently required to use hands and fingers to handle, feel or operate office equipment, and reach with hands and arms. * Frequently required to talk and hear. * Frequently required to sit for long periods of time. * Required to occasionally stand and walk. * Occasionally required to lift, push, pull and/or move up to 10pounds. * Specific vision abilities required include: close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. Work Location: On\-site or Hybrid – Decatur, MI #### **Non\-Essential Functions:** * Performs other related duties, as assigned. #### **Work Environment:** * Safety glasses are required on the production floor at all times. * Hearing protection is required in designated areas. * Occasionally subject to hazards including a variety of physical conditions, such as proximity to moving mechanical parts, moving vehicles, electric current, and exposure to heat and chemicals. * Occasionally subject to conditions including one or more of the following that affect the respiratory system or the skin: fumes, odors, dust, mists, or poor ventilation. * Occasionally exposed to cold, hot, wet and/or humid shop conditions. #### **Benefits at Special\-Lite:** A competitive salary and opportunities to advance in your career are just the beginning. Special\-Lite offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support you and your family, including: * Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance * ShortTerm and LongTerm Disability Coverage * 401(k) with Company Match * Performance and Holiday Bonuses * Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) * Tuition Reimbursement/Educational Assistance and Professional Development Support * Parental Leave * Paid Vacation, Sick Time, and Holidays #### **About Special\-Lite** We manufacture custom door, frame, and interior solutions for new construction and retrofit projects across educational, commercial, institutional, industrial, and municipal applications—combining hands\-on craftsmanship with advanced technology to deliver exceptional quality, performance, and reliability. Built to last in high usage and challenging environments, our high\-quality and made\-to\-order solutions are unique in the industry. The products we build welcome, protect, and enhance spaces across the U.S. and beyond. You would probably recognize more than a few of our famous customers. As one of the largest volume producers of commercial FRP doors, you may have even already walked through one of our solutions. For more than 55 years, we have been driven to grow through relationships as strong as our products. We are committed to the success of our employees, our customers, and our communities. We stand behind our products with passion and excellent customer service. People. Passion. Performance. Visit special\-lite.com to learn more. We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ethnicity, disability, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, sexual orientation, age, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. #### **About Special\-Lite, Inc.** We don’t just build doors—we build careers. For more than 50 years, we’ve been a leader in manufacturing and engineering architectural products for new construction and replacement installations. Our commercial entrance systems, restroom partitions, and interior products feature a unique blend of hands\-on craftsmanship, cutting\-edge technology, customization, and innovative design. The result? Products built to last and a life\-long career to match. When you join Special\-Lite, you become part of a team that values quality, creativity, and personal commitment. We believe in doing things the right way, not the easy way, and we take pride in building products that help make spaces safer, easier to maintain, more productive, healthier, and inspiring.

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
jobs.description: Spectral Labs is building foundation models for engineering physical systems. We're looking for a deployment strategist to figure out where those models can matter most inside our customers' engineering organizations and to make sure they do: spending time on\-site with mechanical, simulation and manufacturing engineers to learn how they actually work, finding the problem worth solving first, working with our forward deployed engineers to scope and ship the deployment, training the teams who use it, and measuring whether it moved the outcome. You'll present results and next steps to everyone from individual engineers to VPs of engineering, build demos for new customers, scope work in new industries, and bring what you learn in the field back to research and product. You bring comfort with data and enough programming to work with it yourself (Python or SQL), the persistence to dig past the first answer, sound judgment in open\-ended situations with little structure, and a low\-ego focus on outcomes. An engineering degree, time as a CAD or simulation user, or experience in consulting or customer\-facing technical work is a big plus. We're excited about people who can make an impact, whatever their background. This is a fully in\-person role at our office in SF, with frequent travel to customer sites (roughly 25–50%). You must be currently based in the US to be eligible, and we are not able to sponsor visas for this role. Base salary, equity and bonus total $150–220k annually. Benefits include health insurance (with a 100%\-premium option), dental, a 401(k) match, and company\-expensed meals and commuting.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - AI Systems (Go)
jobs.description: Stanbridge University is seeking **Software Engineers – AI Systems (Go)** to design, build, and operate production AI systems that perform complex, multi\-stage work reliably and at scale. This is a hands\-on engineering role focused on a challenging class of problems: long\-running AI workflows that call models, tools, and external APIs; maintain state across extended executions; produce structured content and generated media; interact with human reviewers; recover from partial failures; and consistently deliver accurate results to users. The core engineering challenges extend well beyond prompt development. These systems must account for provider failures and rate limits, interrupted workflows, changing state, non\-deterministic model behavior, incorrect or unsupported outputs, variable latency and cost, and deployments occurring while work is in progress. The successful candidate will combine strong **software and distributed\-systems engineering judgment** with practical experience building and operating **LLM\-backed applications, AI agents, or agent\-based systems in production**. You will join at a stage where significant architecture remains to be designed and built. Engineers in this role will have substantial ownership over the patterns, services, infrastructure, and engineering standards that shape the University's AI systems. **Remote Work Eligibility** This position is eligible for remote work for candidates residing in states where Stanbridge University is currently authorized to employ remote employees. Eligible states currently include: **Arizona, Colorado, Illinois, Indiana, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maryland, Michigan, Minnesota, Nevada, New Jersey, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Tennessee, Texas, and Wisconsin.** Candidates must reside in an eligible state at the time of employment. Remote\-work eligibility is subject to University employment requirements and may change based on applicable state requirements. ### **Engineering Environment** The engineering problems addressed by this team include: * **Durable workflow orchestration:** Long\-running, multi\-stage pipelines using persistent state, job queues, checkpoints, resumability, idempotent execution, and recovery from interrupted or orphaned work. * **Multi\-provider model infrastructure:** Routing across commercial model providers with model registries, token and cost controls, rate\-limit handling, retries, circuit breakers, health monitoring, and provider failover. * **Agent and tool orchestration:** Systems in which AI agents interact with tools, APIs, data sources, application services, and deterministic business logic to complete multi\-step work. * **Prompt engineering infrastructure:** Treating prompts as version\-controlled production artifacts with review, testing, regression protection, and measurable behavior. * **Testing non\-deterministic systems:** Recorded and replayable provider interactions, deterministic fixtures, evaluation harnesses, baselines, and regression testing for AI behavior. * **Correctness and quality controls:** Structured\-output validation, automated evaluation, domain\-specific requirements, evidence checking, and safeguards against confident but incorrect model output. * **Human\-in\-the\-loop workflows:** Review and approval stages within automated processes, including systems capable of safely responding when users modify state or inputs during execution. * **Generated media pipelines:** Systems capable of producing and managing documents, audio, imagery, video, and other generated assets. * **Production service architecture:** Go\-based APIs and backend services, relational data stores, job infrastructure, observability, and integrations supporting user\-facing applications. * **Secure ingestion:** Processing user\-supplied and potentially untrusted documents while maintaining appropriate security and authorization boundaries. ### **Two Engineering Emphases** Engineers will meet the same overall technical bar but may bring deeper expertise in one of two areas: ### **Platform and Pipeline** Focused on distributed systems, workflow orchestration, durable state, job queues, recovery, provider infrastructure, latency, throughput, scalability, reliability, and cost optimization. This emphasis is particularly well suited for experienced systems engineers who view AI models as powerful components that introduce a new set of distributed\-systems and reliability challenges. ### **Agents and Quality** Focused on agent and tool architecture, prompt systems, context management, evaluation frameworks, regression testing, judge models, evidence validation, and end\-to\-end output quality. This emphasis is particularly well suited for engineers who approach AI behavior through experimentation, measurement, testing, and systematic improvement. Candidates may indicate an area of preference; however, specialization in one area is not required. ### **Essential Functions** * Design, develop, test, deploy, an cation, experience, and qualifications and internal equity ### **Conditions of Employment:** * A job\-related assessment may be required during the interview process. * Must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily and be physically present in the office (unless otherwise noted). * **Employment Authorization:** Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Stanbridge University does not provide employment\-based immigration sponsorship or participate in employer\-sponsored or employer\-dependent work authorization programs. * **Sponsorship:** Sponsorship now or in the future could include having Stanbridge University sponsor, complete employer documentation, provide attestations or training plans, or otherwise participate in a work\-authorization or employment\-based immigration program in order for an individual to begin or continue employment. Stanbridge University does not provide any such sponsorship. * Employment verification will be conducted to validate work experience per accreditation standards. * Offers of employment are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check. * Official transcripts are required prior to hire. Degrees earned outside the United States must be evaluated by a recognized credential evaluation service to determine U.S. degree equivalency and applicable subject\-area coursework. * Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions. ### **Work Environment** * Standard professional and technology\-focused work environment. * Duties are typically performed while sitting at a desk or computer workstation. * Position requires extensive interaction with computers, software development environments, cloud services, AI systems, and technical infrastructure. * Subject to collaboration with cross\-functional teams, changing technical requirements, and demanding project timelines. ### **Physical Demands** * Regularly sits for extended periods. * Physical ability to perform department\-related duties. * Proficient in using electronic keyboards and office equipment. * Effective verbal communication via phone, video conferencing, and in person. * Ability to read fine print, operate computers, and understand voices clearly. * Able to lift, carry, and/or move objects weighing 10–25 pounds as needed. ### **Employee Benefits** * Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental \& Vision) * Retirement Plan (401k) * Exciting university events * Seasonal motivational health and wellness challenges * Work/Life Balance initiatives * Onsite wellness program / Staff Chiropractor * Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary \& AD\&D) * Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick \& Public Holidays) * Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity) ### **Institutional Values** **Diversity and Inclusion** Stanbridge University’s motto, “Strength through Diversity,” reflects our deep commitment to honoring the diverse backgrounds of our students, faculty, staff, and surrounding communities. We strive to build an inclusive learning environment and uphold anti\-discrimination practices in all aspects of university life. **Innovation and Technology** We embrace cutting\-edge technology to enhance student learning through interactive, hands\-on experiences, including virtual reality and simulation labs—ensuring students are prepared for the demands of modern healthcare practice. **Community Engagement** Through initiatives such as Stanbridge outREACH, students are empowered to give back to local and global communities, cultivating compassion, civic responsibility, and social awareness. ### **Equal Opportunity Employer** Stanbridge University is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Sr. data engineer
jobs.description: **Job Summary and Mission****As a Data Engineer sr, you will…** Build and support highly available data pipelines across batch/distributed and real\-time processing to enable analytics at scale. Translate strategic needs into working solutions by partnering across teams to define requirements, implement data governance and retention practices, and improve standards and reliability. Build and sustain production\-grade data foundations that power data science products and business decisions at scale, partnering closely with data scientists to understand use cases and ensure data is reliable, well\-defined, and fit for the business use case **Preferred qualifications** * 5\+ years working with SQL platforms * 2\+ years working with (or strong exposure to) NoSQL platforms * 5\+ years working with Apache Spark and large\-scale distributed data processing platforms like Databricks, Snowflake, Fabric (or similar) * 1\+ years implementing data platforms on Azure or AWS (advanced scope may align to 2\+ years) * 1\+ years experience with CI/CD tools and practices (advanced scope may align to 2\+ years) * 1\+ years experience with data orchestration platforms like Airflow or Data Factory (or similar) * 2\+ years exposure to SOA architecture and service integration patterns * Proficiency in Java, Scala, or C\#, Python plus strong debugging, troubleshooting, and performance tuning * Proficiency in shell scripting, logging/monitoring patterns, and enterprise deployment best practices * Experience productionalizing big data implementations (advanced scope may include multiple implementations) * Familiarity with Tableau (or similar) is a plus * Demonstrated ability to mentor others and operate effectively in Agile/DevOps environments As a Starbucks partner, you (and your family) will have access to medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance, and other voluntary insurance benefits. Partners have access to short\-term and long\-term disability, paid parental leave, family expansion reimbursement, paid vacation from date of hire\*, sick time (accrued at 1 hour for every 25 hours worked), eight paid holidays, and two personal days per year. You will also have access to backup care and DACA reimbursement. This list is subject to change depending on collective bargaining in locations where partners have a certified bargaining representative. For additional information regarding partner perks and more detailed information about benefits, go to **starbucksbenefits.com**. * If you are working in CA, CO, IL, LA, ME, MA, NE, ND or RI, you will accrue vacation up to a maximum of 120 hours (190 in CA) for roles below director and 200 hours (316 in CA) for roles at director or above. jobs.title: Controls Programmer – C#/.NET
jobs.description: Description: **Bring Your Software Expertise to Steven Douglas Corp. (SDC)** At **SDC**, we design, engineer, and build custom automation systems that solve complex manufacturing challenges for customers across medical, consumer products, industrial, automotive, and other industries. As a family\-owned and growing business, we are committed to delivering innovative solutions by blending proven engineering principles with creative approaches to automation. We are looking for a Controls Programmer who combines strong C\#/.NET development skills with a hands\-on understanding of industrial hardware. In this role, you will work primarily on advanced test and process equipment we build for one of our key customers in the solar manufacturing industry. Most of these systems are PC\-controlled, meaning the application you build is the sole controller, directly driving sensors, motors, drives, and data acquisition hardware in real time. We are looking for team players who enjoy working side by side with our controls engineers and technicians to design, build, and deploy software that keeps this equipment running reliably. **Why Join SDC?** * **Software That Runs Real Machines:** Your applications won’t sit on top of the equipment; they’ll be the controller, running machines on the plant floor and through months\-long tests. * **Collaborative Environment:** Work closely with our controls engineers, technicians, and project managers from design through debug, runoff, and customer startup. * **Family\-Owned Culture:** Experience a supportive and agile environment that values technical excellence and personal growth. **What You’ll Do** * Design, develop, test, and deploy C\# Windows applications that run on industrial machinery and interface directly with sensors, motors, drives, data acquisition devices, and other controls hardware. * Build and support applications where the PC serves as the primary controller in the system, managing real\-time I/O and device communication. * Work directly with controls engineers to understand machine behavior, hardware interfaces, and operator workflows, and translate them into clean, maintainable software. * Support deployment and troubleshooting of your applications during machine debug, runoff, and customer Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT). * Maintain and improve existing software tools and code libraries, applying good source control and documentation practices. * Collaborate with the controls team to identify where custom software can improve machine reliability, data visibility, or troubleshooting speed. * Travel approximately 10% to support customer startups and project implementation. Requirements: **What We’re Looking For** * 5\+ years of experience designing, developing, and deploying C\# Windows applications in a .NET environment. * Hands\-on experience developing applications that interface directly with industrial hardware, such as sensors, motors, drives, data acquisition devices, or instrumentation, on machinery or manufacturing/test equipment. * Experience building applications where the PC is the primary controller in the system, handling real\-time I/O, device communication, and control logic. * Solid understanding of software fundamentals, including object\-oriented design, application architecture, debugging, and version control workflows. * Comfortable working on the plant floor alongside engineers and technicians to understand machine behavior and translate it into usable software. * Ability to use AI tools and code generation to work more efficiently while maintaining full responsibility for all output. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or equivalent hands\-on experience. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with SQL or other databases for storing and retrieving machine or process data. * Experience with GitHub or other source control platforms. * Working knowledge of Python for scripting, data processing, or test automation. * Experience with other industrial controls platforms, such as Allen\-Bradley PLCs, HMIs, Ignition, robotics, or machine vision systems. * Ability to read and understand electrical schematics. **What Success Looks Like** * Successful Electrical Controls Programmers at SDC: * Deliver reliable, well\-structured Windows applications that operators and engineers can use every day. * Build software that communicates cleanly and reliably with the sensors, motors, and hardware it controls. * Develop software capable of running months\-long tests without interruption. * Communicate clearly with engineers, technicians, and project teams about what the software does and why. * Continuously improve our code libraries, tools, and development practices. * Help make every machine's software as solid as the hardware it runs on. **What We Expect From Everyone at SDC** * Every role at SDC is built on a shared set of expectations that define how we work together. * Demonstrate professionalism, integrity, and accountability in everything you do. * Treat coworkers, customers, suppliers, and partners with respect. * Communicate openly and collaboratively across all departments. * Take ownership by identifying issues early, proposing solutions, and following through. * Adapt to changing priorities while maintaining a positive, team\-first attitude. * Produce high\-quality, detail\-oriented work that supports safety, quality, and continuous improvement. * Be dependable, willing to learn, and ready to support teammates whenever needed. * Contribute to a workplace built on trust, teamwork, and shared success. **Why Join Steven Douglas Corp.?** * Work on challenging, custom automation projects—not repetitive production support. * Collaborate with an experienced team of engineers, machinists, electricians, assemblers, and project managers. * See your designs come to life from concept through customer startup. * Help shape engineering standards and influence how future machines are built. * Grow your technical skills while working with robotics, vision systems, servo motion, AI\-enabled inspection, and advanced automation technologies. * Join a stable, family\-owned company committed to long\-term growth, innovation, and investing in its people. **Benefits** * Competitive salary based on experience. * Performance\-based incentive opportunities. * 100% employer\-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance, with supplemental coverage options. * Company\-sponsored Health Savings Account (HSA). * Employee Assistance Program (EAP). * 401(k) with a 4% employer match per pay period. * Paid vacation, sick leave, and 10 company\-paid holidays. * Ongoing opportunities for professional development and career growth.

jobs.title: Senior Modeling and Simulation Engineer, R&D - NPD (Hybrid)
jobs.description: ### **Why join Stryker?** Looking for a place that values your unique talents? Discover Stryker's award\-winning culture. We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.### **Job description** We are excited to be named one of the World’s Best Workplaces by Fortune Magazine! We are proud to offer you 12 paid holidays annually. For an overview of our benefits and time off, please follow this link to learn more:US Stryker employee benefits. Join Stryker's Joint Replacement division as a **Senior Modeling and Simulation Engineer, R\&D \- NPD**. This **hybrid role is based in Mahwah, New Jersey**, with an expectation of working onsite three days per week and the flexibility to work remotely on other days. Candidates must live within commuting distance of the Mahwah office. At Stryker, we’re transforming orthopaedic innovation through cutting\-edge modeling and simulation technologies. As a Senior Engineer on our Joint Replacement team, you’ll help shape the future of implant design and robotic procedures driving meaningful impact for patients and surgeons worldwide. If you're energized by discovery\-based research and thrive in a collaborative, fast\-paced environment, this is your opportunity to make a difference. To learn more about Stryker’s Joint Replacement portfolio visit: **Joint Replacement** **What You Will Do** * Conduct comprehensive literature reviews to inform analytical methods and assumptions. * Execute advanced finite element analyses, including nonlinear multibody simulations with deformable contact and multi\-physics. * Develop and automate simulation techniques using custom programming tools. * Train machine learning algorithms using simulation data to generate more efficient predictive models. * Analyze simulation results and recommend design, material, or process improvements. * Build and validate analytical models to support research and development initiatives. * Collect and integrate physical testing, manufacturing, and clinical data to enhance model accuracy. * Author technical reports for regulatory submissions and publish findings in peer\-reviewed journals and industry conferences. * Collaborate cross\-functionally to develop next\-generation orthopaedic technologies and devices. **What You Need** **Required** * Bachelor’s degree in a science or engineering discipline. * Minimum 2 years of engineering experience. * Experience in modeling and simulation\-based research. **Preferred** * Master’s or PhD in Mechanical or Biomedical Engineering. * Experience in the medical device industry. * Proficiency with FEA tools (e.g., ANSYS, Abaqus, LS\-Dyna, Hyperworks), CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, Pro/Engineer), and programming languages (e.g., Matlab, Python, Fortran). * Familiarity with musculoskeletal simulation platforms (e.g., OpenSim). * Demonstrated ability to contribute to complex research initiatives from concept to recommendation. * Knowledge of mechanics, engineering principles, and product development processes. * **US20**: $93,200 \- $155,400 USD Annual Health benefits include: Medical and prescription drug insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, critical illness insurance, accident insurance, hospital indemnity insurance, personalized healthcare support, wellbeing program and tobacco cessation program. Financial benefits include: Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs), 401(k) plan, Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), basic life and AD\&D insurance, and short\-term disability insurance. Stryker offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually. Depending on customer requirements employees and new hires in sales and field roles that require access to customer accounts as a function of the job may be required to obtain various vaccinations as an essential function of their role.

jobs.title: Vice President, Engineering
jobs.description: At Submittable, we are transforming how organizations create social impact. Our platform empowers thousands of mission\-driven organizations, from nonprofits to government entities, to make a difference in their communities and beyond. In 2024, our innovative software helped organizations worldwide run **30,000 programs**, welcomed **1\.2 million applicants**, and facilitated the distribution of **more than $10 billion** in funding through our products on behalf of our clients. We are on a mission to help organizations accelerate their impact, so we are proud to partner with organizations focused on Equity \& Social Justice, Children \& Education, Creative \& Arts, Health \& Wellness, Economic Justice \& Opportunity, and Environment \& Climate. At Submittable, technology and purpose converge, offering a unique opportunity to contribute to meaningful change. **About the Role** ------------------ Submittable is hiring a Vice President of Engineering who is deeply technical, works hands\-on, and builds with AI every day. You will report to the CTO and run engineering day to day: delivery, quality, reliability, cost, and the people who make them happen. We want a different VP than the old SaaS playbook produced. That playbook grew output by growing headcount and adding layers of management. We believe AI coding tools now let a small team of strong engineers ship what once took a team several times its size. We intend to run engineering that way. You will keep the organization lean, keep layers few, and raise output per engineer rather than the number of engineers. You cannot lead that change from a slide deck. You need to know firsthand what it is like to ship production software with AI agents, including where they fail. We expect you to have done this yourself in the last 12 months and to keep doing it here. Plan on roughly a fifth of your week going to hands\-on technical work: reading and writing code, reviewing pull requests, working incidents, and building the tools your teams use. We are choosing depth over span. This is a hands\-on leadership role for a small, senior team, not a role leading a large organization through layers of managers. If you want to make architecture calls, contribute and ship code, and help a lean team deliver well beyond its size, we want to talk. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Run engineering day to day.** Turn the CTO's technical strategy and the product roadmap into plans, priorities, and shipped software. * **Stay hands\-on.** Review pull requests, prototype, debug production issues, and write tools. You should be able to pick up a ticket and ship it. Teams should trust your calls because of your technical judgment, not your title. * **Make AI the default way we build.** Expect every engineer to work with AI coding agents (tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot) for design, coding, testing, and review. Show people how by doing it yourself, and remove whatever stops them. * **Measure what AI changes.** Track the four DORA metrics (how often we deploy, how long a change takes to reach production, how often changes fail, and how fast we recover), plus defects that reach customers and engineering cost per release. Report plainly on where AI helps and where it creates new problems, such as oversized pull requests, thinner review, or code no one on the team understands. * **Keep the organization lean.** Grow output faster than headcount. Keep management layers thin, expect managers to stay technical, and favor small teams with clear ownership over large teams that need heavy coordination. Before adding a person, ask whether better tooling or automation solves the problem. * **Automate the toil.** Use AI and automation for test generation, CI/CD checks, code review assistance, release notes, incident triage, and alerting, so engineers spend their time on the product. * **Raise the technical bar.** Set standards for architecture, code review, testing, CI/CD, release management, and incident response. Shipping more code, faster, raises the stakes for review, testing, and observability. Make sure speed does not cost us quality. * **Own platform reliability, security, and cost.** Our products are multi\-tenant SaaS running on AWS and Azure, with Kubernetes. Work with infrastructure and security partners to meet uptime targets, pass SOC 2 audits, and keep cloud spend growing slower than revenue. Simplify our architecture where consolidation pays for itself. * **Build AI into the product.** Work with the CTO and Product to add AI to Submittable so customers can set up programs, review applications, and make funding decisions in less time. Help decide what to build and how to test it for accuracy and fairness, because real applicants' outcomes depend on it. * **Hire and grow a small, strong team.** Recruit engineers and leaders who already build with AI. Coach managers to stay close to the work. Build career paths that reward impact and technical depth, not team s formation during the hiring process, nor extend offers without an interview. All legitimate communications come from official submittable.com email addresses. If you receive suspicious outreach, please report it to people@submittable.com. ***(Please do not submit applications, resumes, cover letters, or other candidacy materials to this email address. Emails of this nature will not be reviewed or considered.)*** **Why Submittable?** ==================== Joining Submittable means becoming part of a forward\-thinking, mission\-driven company that values innovation, collaboration, and growth. We empower organizations working for social good with technology that accelerates their work, amplifies their impact, and drives meaningful change. At Submittable, you'll find a supportive, dynamic work environment where your contributions directly influence our success. If you thrive in a fast\-paced, evolving environment and are excited to be part of a company dedicated to social impact, we invite you to apply! **Benefits:** We are proud to offer highly competitive benefits to our full\-time employees, including: * Comprehensive health and life insurance with optional HSA, FSA, and DCA accounts * 401(k) plan with employer match starting day one * Equity stock options to share in our success * Flexible hours, remote work options, and generous vacation and sick leave * Paid parental leave for mothers, fathers, and adoptive parents * Professional development stipends to support your career growth * Opportunities to participate in community outreach and volunteer programs * Monthly company\-sponsored happy hours and gatherings to connect and unwind **Our Commitment to Inclusion \& Belonging** -------------------------------------------- At Submittable, we believe technology is a force for good, driving social impact and enabling corporate social responsibility on a global scale. To achieve this, we are committed to fostering a workplace that values inclusion and belonging as central pillars of our culture. We embrace the strength of our diverse community by creating a safe space where employees feel empowered to share ideas, celebrate unique experiences, and learn from one another. By prioritizing inclusion, we aim to build an environment where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and make innovative contributions that enable our customers to tackle complex challenges and spread more good. As a globally used platform, we are dedicated to hiring and supporting employees who represent a range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. This includes diversity in ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender, religion, ability, culture, and socioeconomic background. **About Our Process** ===================== Our goal is a fair, efficient, and thorough evaluation process that benefits you and our team and respects your time. As you can imagine, we have received a high volume of applications. Your willingness to participate in I.D. Verification and answer a few questions early allows us to move through the process more quickly. **Let's Talk About AI:** ------------------------ **Guidelines for using AI in our Hiring Process:** At Submittable, we believe that Artificial Intelligence (AI) can be a powerful tool for good. We are committed to leveraging AI technologies responsibly, ensuring their use is equitable, fair and safe. To ensure fairness and accurate skill assessment, we do not allow the use of AI tools (including note takers, transcription tools, or recordings) during take home tests or interviews. If you have questions or need accommodations, please let us know. *For additional information and guidance on using AI to prepare an interview at Submittable, please click****here****.* #### **We believe our approach streamlines the hiring process and respects your time by ensuring that every conversation is substantive and focused on your unique qualifications. We appreciate your cooperation and look forward to learning more about you.**

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.description: **Job Description** Succinct Solutions is seeking a skilled Full Stack Developer to design, develop, test, and maintain modern web applications. The ideal candidate will have experience working across front\-end and back\-end technologies, building responsive user interfaces, developing reliable server\-side services, and integrating databases and APIs. In this role, you will collaborate with technical teams and project stakeholders to deliver scalable software solutions that meet business requirements. You will help implement new features, troubleshoot application issues, improve system performance, and maintain high standards for code quality, security, and reliability. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, develop, and maintain full\-stack web applications. * Build responsive user interfaces using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern frameworks. * Develop server\-side logic, application services, and RESTful APIs. * Design and maintain databases to support application functionality. * Integrate third\-party APIs and external software services. * Troubleshoot defects and optimize application performance. * Write clean, reusable, testable, and maintainable code. * Participate in code reviews and follow established development standards. * Collaborate with designers, developers, and project stakeholders. * Perform software testing and support application deployments. * Maintain technical documentation and recommend improvements to existing systems. * Apply security best practices to protect application data and functionality. **Requirements** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Experience with front\-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. * Familiarity with frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js. * Knowledge of back\-end technologies such as Node.js, Python, Java, C\#, or PHP. * Understanding of REST APIs, database design, SQL, and application architecture. * Familiarity with Git or another version control system. * Strong analytical, debugging, and problem\-solving skills. * Effective communication and collaboration abilities. * Ability to manage development tasks and meet project deadlines. **Preferred Skills** * Experience building and maintaining production web applications. * Familiarity with cloud platforms and deployment workflows. * Knowledge of automated testing and CI/CD pipelines. * Understanding of application security, web accessibility, and performance optimization. * Experience working in an Agile software development environment. **About the Company** Succinct Solutions is the employer named for this proposed Full Stack Developer posting. Its current business activities, technology services, and Houston\-area operations should be verified before publication to ensure that the company description accurately represents the organization. This role is intended for a developer who can contribute across the application stack, collaborate with technical teams, and deliver maintainable software that meets user and business requirements. Pay: $90,000\.00 \- $125,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Health insurance * Relocation assistance * Visa sponsorship * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Title: Cybersecurity Engineer** **Department:** **Information Security \- 84** **Reports to: Chief Information Security Officer (****CISO) –** **Status:** **Exempt Non\-Exempt** **About the Role** ------------------ This role is critical to strengthening cyber resilience in a highly regulated financial environment by combining senior\-level security analysis, incident response, and technical ownership of cybersecurity platforms. As a Cybersecurity Engineer, you will investigate high\-severity alerts and escalated security events while also designing, configuring, tuning, and improving the tools and controls used to detect, prevent, and respond to threats. You will partner across IT, infrastructure, cloud, identity, development, AI, data, and business teams to reduce cyber risk, improve control effectiveness, and support secure operations across the enterprise. **Work Details** ---------------- **Schedule:** Monday – Friday, Work hours may vary based on operational needs and may include early mornings or extended hours as required. **Work Location:** Onsite **Travel:** Occasional (up to 10%) **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Lead investigation and response for high\-severity cybersecurity alerts, escalated analyst cases, suspicious activity, and confirmed or suspected security incidents across endpoint, identity, email, network, cloud, and application environments. * Own and continuously improve cybersecurity platforms, including configuration, tuning, integrations, alert logic, detection coverage, dashboards, reporting, automation, and operational workflows. * Design, implement, and validate technical security controls across enterprise systems to improve prevention, detection, response, recovery, and audit readiness. * Build and refine threat\-informed detections, response playbooks, hunting methods, and control improvements using frameworks such as MITRE ATT\&CK, NIST CSF 2\.0, and other applicable security and regulatory expectations. * Translate threat intelligence, vulnerability findings, incident lessons learned, and control gaps into practical engineering improvements that reduce risk and improve security operations effectiveness. * Partner cross\-functionally with IT, infrastructure, cloud, identity, development, AI, data, and business teams to embed effective security controls into systems, applications, platforms, and processes. * Support audits, examinations, risk assessments, control validation, third\-party risk reviews, and remediation activities by providing technical security expertise and evidence. * Mentor Cybersecurity Analysts, provide escalation support, improve analyst workflows, and help build mature, repeatable security operations practices. **What We’re Looking For** -------------------------- *(Required)* * Demonstrated ability to independently investigate, scope, contain, and coordinate response to complex cybersecurity events and incidents using SIEM, EDR/XDR, NDR, email security, identity, cloud, data governance, or similar technologies. * Hands\-on experience administering, configuring, tuning, or improving cybersecurity tools and platforms in an enterprise environment. * Strong technical understanding of endpoint security, identity and access management, network security, email security, cloud security, logging, vulnerability management, and data protection. * Experience creating or improving detections, alerts, dashboards, response playbooks, security workflows, or automation to improve security operations effectiveness. * Working knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks and threat\-informed defense concepts, including NIST CSF, MITRE ATT\&CK, CIS, and control validation methods. * Ability to translate technical security issues into clear risk\-based recommendations for technical teams, business stakeholders, and leadership. * Ability to operate in a small\-team environment where the role includes senior analyst responsibilities, platform ownership, escalation support, and hands\-on execution. *(Nice to Have)* * 5\+ years of experience in cybersecurity, information security, security engineering, IT security operations, or related technical security roles. * Experience with Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel, Purview, Intune, Proofpoint, Tenable, Snyk, Azure security capabilities, or similar security platforms. * Experience with scripting, automation, SOAR, API integrations, PowerShell, Python, KQL, or other methods used to improve detection, response, reporting, or security operations efficiency. * Experience working in financial services or another regulated industry, including familiarity with FFIEC, GLBA, PCI DSS, HIPAA, or similar requirements. * Experience supporting vulnerability management, secure configuration baselines, cloud security, application security, AI governance, or secure software development practices. * Relevant certifications such as CompTIA Security\+, CySA\+, Microsoft Security certifications, GIAC, CISSP, CRISC, or equivalent practical experience. * Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Why You’ll Love Working Here** -------------------------------- * Collaborative, mission\-driven team focused on protecting customers, employees, and the Bank from evolving cyber threats. * Opportunity to make a direct impact by both operating and improving the security program in a growing, highly regulated financial institution. * Hands\-on exposure to modern security tools, cloud security, AI governance, security operations, incident response, and enterprise risk reduction. **Posting Location(s):** ------------------------ Sunwest Bank Draper Office\- 25 E. Scenic Point Dr, Draper UT 84020 **Physical Demands:** --------------------- In general, the following physical demands are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to allow differently abled individuals to perform the essential functions of the job. (Check the box that applies by double clicking on the box.) * Sedentary: Limited activity, no lifting, limited walking * Moderate: Mostly standing, walking, bending, frequent lifting * Light: Office work, some lifting, bending, stooping or kneeling, walking * Arduous: Heavy lifting, bending, crawling, climbing **The Fine Print** ------------------ This job description reflects the general nature of the role and may change as business needs evolve. We are an equal opportunity employer. Sunwest Bank works with staff members and customers without regard to race, ancestry, national origin, sex, marital status, age, religion, medical condition, handicap, disability or veteran status and to assist the Bank in maintaining its Affirmative Action Program. Compliance with Bank Secrecy Act laws and regulations is considered an extremely serious matter, and it is intended that Sunwest Bank, through the purposeful efforts of its employees and officers, are expected to make every resolute attempt to conform to its Bank Secrecy Act Program and Procedures. Failure to comply will be reflected in their performance review as well as in any bonus compensation programs in which they may participate. Attend and complete all required classroom, computer\-based, web\-based and seminar training. It is the individual responsibility of every employee to maintain a current awareness and understanding of and to fully comply with Sunwest Bank’s “Code of Ethics and Conduct.” Each employee is also expected to maintain an awareness of the laws, regulations, internal policies and procedures that are appropriate for his/her position. Note: The preceding job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level and work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job. All job descriptions can be amended without notice as warranted by business necessity. **Federal Deposit Insurance Act** This position is subject to Section 19 of the Federal Deposit Insurance Act. As such, an employment offer for this position is contingent on Sunwest Bank’s review of criminal conviction history, including pretrial diversions or program entries.

jobs.title: Enterprise Architect – ST
jobs.description: **Who We Are** SwitchThink Solutions is a fast\-growing technology company supporting our parent organization, Desert Financial Credit Union, and more than 175 external credit unions nationwide. Our solutions are built on the Correlation Keystone Platform and complemented by managed services, cloud hosting, disaster recovery, business intelligence, and AI offerings. Our clients trust us. We have maintained zero customer churn for eight years and consistently earn strong client advocacy, with an NPS of 84\. Our employees are equally committed, bringing a collaborative, team\-oriented mindset and a shared passion for excellence. Backed by the financial strength of Desert Financial Credit Union, we offer stability alongside meaningful growth opportunities. **What you will do here:** The Enterprise Architect leads the design of enterprise\-scale solutions across complex business ecosystems, with particular emphasis on business applications, integrations, data flows, and the technology capabilities that support critical operations. This role partners with business and technology leaders to understand strategic objectives, simplify complex environments, and translate business needs into clear current\-state assessments, target\-state architectures, standards, and roadmaps. As a trusted technical advisor and hands\-on architecture leader, the Enterprise Architect serves as the technical point of direction for large, multi\-year, and multi\-domain initiatives. The role is accountable for architecture from discovery and planning through detailed design, working in concert with engineers and delivery teams to build solutions and transition them successfully to operations for ongoing support. The Enterprise Architect also establishes architecture governance, reference architectures, technology standards, roadmaps, lifecycle direction, and exception\-management practices that promote secure, resilient, scalable, and maintainable outcomes. * Partner with business and technology leaders to connect enterprise priorities, business capabilities, operating processes, and constraints to current\-state assessments, target\-state architectures, sequenced roadmaps, and technology investment priorities. * Identify opportunities to simplify the application portfolio, reduce duplication and technical debt, and improve enterprise value. * Lead the planning and development of secure, scalable, and resilient architectures spanning business capabilities, applications, integrations, APIs, enterprise data and information flows, cloud and infrastructure services, security, identity, and operational dependencies. * Ensure data ownership, quality, lineage, interoperability, retention, and appropriate use are addressed as part of enterprise design. * Define and maintain enterprise architecture principles, standards, reference architectures, integration patterns, technology roadmaps, lifecycle positions, and exception\-management practices. * Establish clear architecture decision rights, engagement expectations, and reusable practices that enable consistent decisions across architecture and delivery teams. * Serve as the technical leader and architecture decision owner for large, multi\-year, and multi\-domain initiatives, aligning business stakeholders, architects, engineers, vendors, and operational teams around a coherent design, measurable business outcomes, and clear architecture success criteria. * Evaluate enterprise technologies, platforms, vendor solutions, sourcing approaches, and modernization options for strategic fit, interoperability, total cost of ownership, risk, supportability, vendor viability, and long\-term business value. * Facilitate architecture governance and design reviews; document decisions, dependencies, risks, and exceptions; ensure solutions align with enterprise standards and regulatory, security, resilience, and data\-governance requirements; and strengthen architecture capability by coaching architects and engineers, sharing reusable practices, and promoting consistent architecture methods across teams. * Work alongside engineers and delivery teams to refine and build the approved design, validate architectural intent during implementation, and enable a complete transition to operations with appropriate documentation, support models, and lifecycle ownership. **What you will need:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems or related field **(preferred) OR** equivalent combination of education and experience **required.** * Advanced degree (Master's in a technical discipline, or MBA) **preferred.** * 10\+ years of progressive experience in enterprise architecture, solution architecture, application architecture, integration architecture, or related enterprise technology roles **required.** * 5\+ years leading architecture for large enterprise or transformation initiatives spanning multiple business capabilities, applications, integrations, technology domains, and delivery teams **required.** * 5\+ years working as a trusted technical advisor to business and technology executives, with demonstrated ability to facilitate discovery, navigate ambiguity, influence across organizational boundaries, and communicate complex architectural tradeoffs in clear business terms **required.** * 1\+ years experience in financial services, banking, or credit unions, or another regulated enterprise environment **preferred.** * Prior experience developing enterprise architecture roadmaps, reference architectures, technology standards, and governance practices within a complex enterprise or consulting environment **preferred.** * Enterprise Architecture \& Systems Design * + Broad architecture expertise across business capabilities, enterprise applications, integrations, APIs, data flows, cloud and infrastructure services, security, identity, and operational dependencies. * + Ability to assess complex current\-state ecosystems and produce clear conceptual, logical, and solution architecture designs. * + Strong command of integration patterns, interoperability, platform boundaries, nonfunctional requirements, and technology lifecycle planning. * + Ability to connect business capability maps, process needs, data movement, and technology components into cohesive target\-state architectures **required.** **Business Partnership \& Technical Leadership** * Structured discovery that converts ambiguous business strategies, processes, and requirements into actionable architectural direction. * Executive\-level communication that explains options, dependencies, value, cost, and risk without unnecessary technical complexity. * Facilitation of architecture workshops, design reviews, and decision forums involving business leaders, architects, engineers, vendors, and operations. * Ability to lead through influence and serve as the technical point of direction for large, multi\-year, and multi\-domain initiatives **required.** **Architecture Governance \& Risk** * Development and application of architecture principles, reference architectures, standards, roadmaps, technology lifecycle positions, and exception processes. * Evaluation of architectural decisions against security, regulatory, privacy, resilience, capacity, supportability, and data\-governance requirements. * Clear documentation of decisions, assumptions, dependencies, risks, tradeoffs, and technical debt **required.** **Delivery \& Execution** * Accountability for architecture from discovery and planning through detailed design, implementation guidance, validation, and transition to operations. * Effective collaboration with engineers and delivery teams to convert architectural intent into buildable designs and production\-ready solutions. * Creation of reusable patterns, architecture artifacts, decision records, operational documentation, and support\-transition requirements **required.** * Advanced proficiency with enterprise architecture methods and modeling techniques, including capability, application, integration, information\-flow, deployment, and transition\-state views; experience with architecture repositories or modeling tools is preferred **required.** * TOGAF certification, or a comparable enterprise architecture framework credential **preferred.** * Current cloud or solution architecture certification from a major enterprise technology provider **preferred.** Job Location: Phoenix, Arizona Job Type: Hybrid We are proud to be an EEO/AA employer M/F/D/V. We maintain a drug\-free workplace and perform pre\-employment substance abuse testing. For additional information about our organization, careers, and benefits visit: http://www.desertfinancial.com/careers. \#LI\-Hybrid Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Technical Control Engineer
jobs.description: **Who we are** With its A.I.\-powered robotic technology platform, Symbotic is changing the way consumer goods move through the supply chain. Intelligent software orchestrates advanced robots in a high\-density, end\-to\-end system – reinventing warehouse automation for increased efficiency, speed and flexibility. **What we need** The Technical Control Engineer ensures the smooth operation and reliability of Symbotic’s automated systems at client sites. This role balances reactive support with proactive monitoring, incident ownership, and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate will troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues, act as a technical lead during high priority incidents, and contribute to scalable processes and knowledge management initiatives. This position partners closely with Engineering, R\&D, Implementation, and Customer Operations to transition new sites from “Hypercare” to steady\-state support, ensuring operational excellence and long\-term system reliability. **What we do** The Technical Support Team is part of Symbotic’s Service Operations Organization and is responsible for the successful stand\-up, performance, and continuous operation of Symbotic systems inside customer sites. Our team supports all production\-impacting aspects of the system—including controls, electrical, software, networking, and infrastructure—and serves as the primary escalation point for real\-time system issues. Working cross\-functionally with Engineering, Implementation, and Customer Operations, Technical Support delivers timely troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and sustainable solutions to ensure system reliability and operational excellence. Through rapid response and strong technical ownership, we strengthen customer relationships and keep automated operations running at peak performance. **What you’ll do** * Manage and resolve complex technical support requests from end users via ticketing systems, phone, email, and chat. * Provide advanced remote support for electro\-mechanical, software, networking, and controls\-related issues using remote access tools. * Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to: * Automation and robotic systems * PLCs, motors, VFDs, and motion control systems * Software applications, networking, and scripting * Serve as a technical escalation point and act as the focal lead during major incidents. * Coordinate cross\-functional resources (Software, Controls, Hardware, R\&D, Customer Operations) to restore service efficiently. * Prioritize incoming issues based on customer impact, system criticality, and contractual SLAs. * Provide clear, timely updates to internal and external stakeholders during incidents. * Respond to equipment downtime events and coordinate with external vendors or resources as needed. * Proactively monitor system performance metrics, logs, and trends to identify potential failures before they impact operations. * Drive Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for critical and recurring incidents to reduce Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR) and prevent recurrence. * Identify systemic issues and recurring failure patterns, translating insights into preventative actions and process improvements. * Participate in post\-incident reviews and lead follow\-up actions to ensure sustained resolution * Act as a technical owner during critical events, ensuring accountability from incident intake through full resolution. * Collaborate with R\&D, Implementation, and Customer Operations to transition new sites from “Hypercare” to steady\-state support. * Leverage metrics from high\-impact downtime events to create and improve knowledge base content with measurable value to issue resolution and recurrence prevention.. * Contribute to a scalable KB to enable “shift\-left” resolution, improving self\-sufficiency for customers and on\-site Tier 1 teams. * Support ongoing system maintenance activities, including data backups, trend analysis, and I/O checks. * Interpret electrical schematics, OEM manuals, and system documentation to diagnose integrated system issues. * Stay current on supported software, hardware, tools, and platform updates relevant to Symbotic systems. **What you’ll need** * Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, Controls Engineering, Automation Engineering or related technical field preferred; equivalent hands\-on experience in industrial automation, robotics, or controls may be considered. * Minimum 2 years of experience in technical support, controls, or engineering role supporting complex systems. * Prior field or industry experience in automation, robotics, warehouse, or supply chain environments preferred. * Demonstrated experience providing remote system support (Remote Desktop, SSH). * Strong understanding of TCP/IP networking, protocols, and troubleshooting; familiarity with packet sniffers, network probes, and command\-line diagnostic tools. * Proficiency with Linux shell environments and scripting; working knowledge of SQL scripting and application support. * Familiarity with ISC DHCP, BIND, and server configuration. * Experience with motion control systems (servos, VFDs), Allen Bradley ControlLogix, and programming languages such as Ladder Logic, C, and scripting languages. * Experience with server management, Active Directory, and Windows/Linux patching. * Strong troubleshooting, documentation, collaboration, and communication skills. * Ability to prioritize and perform effectively in high\-pressure, customer\-facing environments. **Our Environment** * Up to 15% of travel may be required. Employees must have a valid driver’s license and the ability to drive and/or fly to client and other customer locations. * The employee is responsible for owning a credit card and managing expenses personally to be reimbursed bi\-weekly. **About Symbotic** Symbotic is an automation technology leader reimagining the supply chain with its end\-to\-end, AI\-powered robotic and software platform. Symbotic reinvents the warehouse as a strategic asset for the world’s largest retail, wholesale, and food \& beverage companies. Applying next\-gen technology, high\-density storage and machine learning to solve today's complex distribution challenges, Symbotic enables companies to move goods with unmatched speed, agility, accuracy and efficiency. As the backbone of commerce the Symbotic platform transforms the flow of goods and the economics of supply chain for its customers. For more information, visit www.symbotic.com. We are a community of innovators, collaborators and pioneers who embrace our differences, because we know unique perspectives make us stronger and smarter. Every perspective matters.
