jobs.title: AI Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **POSITION SUMMARY** TSi is hiring an AI Automation Engineer: an early\-career, hands\-on developer who has built AI agents and wants to grow in building them securely. This person helps design, build, and maintain AI agents and integrations for TSi's internal operations and for TSi clients. **This is a builder role, not an AI user role.** Technology direction and cybersecurity are owned by the CTO and Senior Director of Technology. This developer builds within that framework and, with guidance from senior staff, writes agents that are secure and privacy\-protective by design — least privilege, controlled data access, human approval where it matters, and full auditability. Applicants must have personally built and deployed at least one AI agent using APIs, tool/function calling, or agent frameworks. During the interview process, you will be expected to demonstrate your work, discuss architectural decisions, and explain how you addressed security and privacy considerations. Applicants who cannot provide a portfolio, repository, demo, or walkthrough of an AI agent they personally built will not be considered. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** **AI Agent Development** * Build, test, and deploy AI agents that automate multi\-step business workflows using tool calling, function calling, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP). * Integrate agents with TSi business systems (e.g., NetSuite, ServiceNow, CPQ, Smartsheet) through APIs and secure connectors. * Support the deployment of AI agents and applications to cloud environments (Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud), including configuring services, managing secrets, and monitoring performance. * Maintain code in source control, participate in code review, write automated tests, and document deployments. This position requires hands\-on software development. Daily work includes writing Python and/or TypeScript code, integrating APIs, debugging issues, reviewing code, and deploying solutions. This is not a no\-code or low\-code AI role. **Secure Agent Engineering** * Scope every agent to least privilege: only the tools, data, and permissions the task requires. * Build defenses against prompt injection, data exfiltration, insecure output handling, and excessive agent autonomy (per the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications). * Require human\-in\-the\-loop approval for high\-impact actions (financial transactions, record changes, external communications). * Manage API keys and credentials through approved secrets management; never hard\-code secrets. * Log agent actions, tool calls, and decisions to support auditing and incident investigation. * Test agents for security issues before release, including basic red\-teaming with guidance from senior staff; document risks and mitigations for review by the CTO and Senior Director of Technology. **Privacy by Design** * Minimize, mask, or redact employee and client PII before it reaches a model or third\-party service. * Follow TSi data classification policy on which data may be used with which models and vendors. * Build with applicable privacy obligations in mind, including state privacy laws and biometric privacy laws (e.g., BIPA) for video and identity data. **Collaboration \& Compliance** * Follow TSi cybersecurity and IT policies and escalate security concerns. * Assist with AI vendor and tool evaluations by providing technical input. * Write clear documentation and runbooks so agents can be supported and audited. * Train end users on the agents you build. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** * **Proof of work:** Has built at least one working AI agent (personal, academic, or professional project). A portfolio, repository, or walkthrough is required. * Familiarity with Git or equivalent version control. Please be prepared to share a repository (e.g., GitHub, GitLab) that shows your commit history on a personal, academic, or open\-source project. * 0–2 years of software development experience, including internships or substantial personal projects. * Proficiency in TypeScript and/or Python; solid with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, and SQL. * Hands\-on experience (professional or project\-based) with a major model’s APIs (e.g., Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI). * Familiarity with agent frameworks and tooling such as the Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, or equivalent. * Working understanding of secure development practices for AI: prompt injection mitigation, least\-privilege tool design, secrets management, input/output validation, and audit logging. * Ability to explain technical decisions and risks. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Experience integrating with ServiceNow, NetSuite, or Microsoft 365 / Copilot. * Experience with MCP servers/connectors. * Experience with cloud deployment (Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud). This is a growth area we will help you develop. **CORE COMPETENCIES** * **Builder:** Focused on getting working agents into use, and learns quickly from feedback. * **Security mindset:** Treats security and privacy as design requirements, not afterthoughts. * **Accountability:** Works independently on well\-scoped tasks in a remote environment, takes ownership of assigned work, and asks for help early. * **Communication:** Explains complex topics in plain language; documents thoroughly.

jobs.title: Sr. Data Engineer
jobs.description: Our Senior Data Engineer is a hands\-on, client\-facing technical lead. You’ll own data pipelines and integrations for several clients at once. That means translating their business goals into data solutions, setting clear expectations on scope and effort, and bringing a point of view on how their data should work for them. This is an individual contributor role reporting to the SVP of Tech and Data. You’ll lead through expertise and influence rather than direct reports, keeping engineering work on agreed architectural paths. We’re looking for a modern\-day ETL/ELT developer who works comfortably in today’s analytical environment and understands the marketing landscape, where disparate data is everywhere. You build with AI\-assisted coding tools every day and help the team use them well. We do whatever it takes to solve problems, while embracing change each day. **What you will do** -------------------- **Lead client work** * Own data engineering for multiple clients and projects at once, from requirements through delivery and ongoing support * Work directly with clients to understand their business goals, and give them a clear, specific point of view * Negotiate scope and level of effort with clients and internal teams so everyone agrees on what gets delivered and when * Collaborate closely with analysts, engineers and managers across the agency * Look past day\-to\-day tasks to the business results the work needs to deliver **Build and own data platforms** * Design, build and maintain data pipelines and integrations with complex source data and API services * Take ownership of established client pipelines: reverse engineer existing SQL and pipeline code to understand its business logic, and document it as you go * Move and model data across platforms using established ETL/ELT patterns, orchestrated with Apache Airflow * Recommend and design database solutions, and handle performance tuning, troubleshooting and capacity estimation * Keep engineering work on agreed architectural paths and follow our data warehouse development standards * Maintain documentation for data movement and transformation processes, including process flows and data mapping **Manage priorities, access and quality** * Set priorities for your projects and tasks, and push back when needed to protect the right priorities and workflow * Set the criteria for who is added to or removed from client data services and systems * Create and manage audit reporting and quality checks so data is delivered accurately and consistently **Solve problems** * Identify challenges and limitations in the tools we use, and propose fixes * Spot roadblocks early that could affect deadlines * Break complex work into clear tasks and coordinate them with the team * Work with teammates and external partners to troubleshoot quickly and keep delivery on track **Stay ahead** * Use AI coding assistants as a core part of your development work, and contribute to the team’s AI best practices * Identify relevant new technology and share what you learn with the team **What you should have** ------------------------ * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience preferred, in computer science or information systems * 4–5\+ years of hands\-on data engineering experience * Experience with RDBMS and cloud data warehouses such as PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Snowflake and Google BigQuery * ETL/ELT development in SQL and Python, with orchestration in Apache Airflow; familiarity with dbt is helpful * Experience with AWS and GCP, with strong hands\-on experience in at least one * Advanced SQL, including stored procedures, indexing and database IO performance tuning * Solid understanding of data warehouse design principles and relational and non\-relational data models * Regular use of AI\-assisted coding tools in your development work, with sound judgment about reviewing and testing what they produce * Experience working directly with clients or business stakeholders on requirements, scope and timelines * Proven ability to own several projects at once through delivery * Ability to proactively identify, troubleshoot and resolve complex data integrity issues * The ability to leverage cut and paste proficiently * Strong analytical skills, with the ability to explain technical details to non\-technical audiences * Excellent verbal and written communication skills * Ability to work with minimal supervision in an agile environment and pivot quickly as analytical needs change **A big plus if you have any of the following** ----------------------------------------------- * Agency and marketing data experience * API development * DBA duties and responsibilities * Experience taking over and documenting systems someone else built **Here is a little bit about us** --------------------------------- Tandem Theory is an agency with a winning culture. We believe that when the agency wins, Theorists win too. Winning happens through collaboration, personal growth, industry recognition, and operational excellence that makes our work stronger and more efficient. Most importantly, a winning culture thrives on feedback \- helping each other improve so we can all achieve more together. We’ve built our culture around three core behaviors: Teamwork, Transparency, and Trust. They’re not just words on a poster. We apply them every day to guide our internal and client relationships, and our clients tell us they feel the difference. Headquartered in Dallas, Texas, Tandem partners with several leading brands. These brands value working with an agency led by a proven team that provides simple but impactful solutions, transparent pricing, and performance\-based compensation. **Other than waking up and being excited to get to work each day, here are some additional benefits** ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- The salary for this exempt\-level position will be based on experience and qualifications within an established pay range. Benefits include 85% employer paid medical, eligibility to participate in vision and dental insurance as well company paid STD, LTD coverage plus a flat amount company paid toward Basic Life and AD\&D, as well as a generous 401(k) retirement contribution plan eligible after 90\-days of employment. **Working Conditions** ---------------------- We operate as a work, not live, from anywhere model and utilize the office space as a co\-working space as needed. You are expected to communicate effectively (verbal and written), and maintain professionalism under stress. Occasionally you will need to bend, pull, push and/or reach to access job\-related materials. You will also be expected to work with frequent interruptions such as Slack messages, emails, phone calls, drive\-by visits to your desk, whether that is from a co\-worker at the office or your dog barking while working remotely. All our calls are held on video, as it is important to see facial expressions and reactions to work in a collaborative environment. **Eligibility** --------------- All new employees must provide documented proof of their identity and employment authorization and pass a background screening process. No work Visa sponsorships available at this time. We are currently not accepting applicants that reside in the State of California. **Here is where we are located in case you are curious:** --------------------------------------------------------- Tandem Theory, LLC 15400 Knoll Trail \#503 Dallas, TX 75248 \#LI\-JOB

jobs.title: Wireless Algorithms Engineer (MAC Layer Scheduling)
jobs.description: **Join the Team That's Redefining Wireless Technology** At **Tarana**, we're more than just a fast\-growing tech company—we’re a team of bold innovators on a mission to revolutionize broadband. Our groundbreaking Fixed Wireless Access technology is delivering **fiber\-class internet speeds** worldwide, bridging the digital divide in ways previously thought impossible. We are looking for engineers we can grow into this role. You do not need wireless experience. What matters is that you learn quickly, think deeply, and are excited by problems where the answer is not already known. You will be working on the MAC scheduler, the software that decides, thousands of times per second, how spectrum and antenna resources are allocated among users on a sector. It is a hard problem, and it's still evolving. You will work with engineers designing the algorithms running in our product today. You will start by fixing real bugs in production code, which is the fastest way to learn a system of this scale, and you will own a sub\-component. Later, we expect you to propose algorithmic changes that directly affect the performance of our deployed network. This is an opportunity to go from learning an unfamiliar system to shaping the algorithms at its core. **What You’ll Do:** * Learn wireless from the ground up: how signals propagate, why interference happens, what a scheduler is actually optimizing * Read a lot of code written by people who thought hard about it, and get your own code reviewed by them * Debug problems on real hardware, where the answer is often not in the software * Work with field telemetry from a live network and learn to find signal in it * Build simulations to test whether an idea works before anyone commits to building it **What You'll Need:** * Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field * Strong fundamentals in algorithms, data structures, and the mathematics underneath them: probability, linear algebra, and enough comfort with proofs to reason about why something works * You can already program well. C\+\+ or C preferred, but if you are strong in another language and have written performance\-sensitive code, we will take that seriously * Evidence that you build things because you want to, not because they were assigned. A project you took further than the class required, something you wrote to solve your own problem, a system you built and kept improving * The ability to explain your reasoning clearly, including the parts you are unsure about **What Would Make You Stand Out** * Wireless or communications coursework, including signal processing or information theory. * Optimization, control theory, or applied machine learning. * Embedded or systems programming, or experience where performance and memory constraints mattered. **What we offer:** **We don’t just build next\-gen wireless technology — we build people.** The salary range for this position is: $90,000 to $120,000 Compensation will be determined based on several factors, including, but not limited to, skill set, years of experience, and the employee’s geographic location. Tarana provides competitive benefits to employees in this role, including medical, dental, and vision benefits, 401K match, flexible time off, and stock options. **Join Tarana and help shape the future of wireless connectivity.** **About Us** Tarana’s mission is to accelerate the deployment of fast, affordable, and reliable internet access around the world. Through a decade of R\&D and over $400M of investment, the Tarana team has created and continues to enhance a suite of next\-generation fixed wireless access (ngFWA) technologies. Its unique ngFWA platform delivers game\-changing advances in broadband economics in mainstream and underserved markets, using both licensed and unlicensed spectrum. Tarana’s ngFWA technology has been embraced by more than 300 service providers in 24 countries. Tarana is headquartered in Milpitas, California, with additional research and development in Pune, India. Learn more at www.taranawireless.com. P7cUsmpBPr

Your work directly affects customer success, company growth, and the hardening of our core platform. ### **Responsibilities** * **Data Strategy:** Help customers define and execute their data strategy for model post\-training, diagnose data quality issues that limit model performance outcomes, and provide recommendations for data generation for post\-training scale * **Algorithm Selection:** Recommend the right post\-training approach for each use case * **Experiment Design \& Hyperparameter Tuning:** Design well\-controlled experiments and tracking methods; diagnose training instabilities, reward hacking, and regressions. * **Evaluation:** Build evaluation frameworks with customers, including task\-specific benchmarks, LLM\-as\-judge pipelines, and held\-out test sets. Make sure gains are reproducibly aligned with production success metrics. * **Model Selection:** Guide base model selection methodology ahead of post\-training efforts and baseline quality evaluations to guide post\-training objectives. Interest in self\-directed research of newly released open source models, particularly as they relate to post\-training. * **RL Workload Sizing:** Scope and size RL and fine\-tuning workloads, partner with sales and capacity teams to shape deals and capacity forecasts. * **Strategic Customer Alignment:** Serve as the primary post\-training technical point of contact for aligned strategic accounts. Lead technical execution from scoping to production and make sure we hit critical milestones. * **Product \& Research Feedback Loop:** Shape our fine\-tuning and RL product roadmap with insights from the field. Contribute code, recipes, and reference implementations where needed, and drive early adoption of new features and research with strategic logos. ### **Requirements** * **Experience:** 5\+ years in a technical role in ML engineering, Applied AI, Forward Deployed Engineering, or Solutions Architect, with recent hands\-on experience post\-training LLMs. * **Post\-Training Depth:** Expert\-level, hands\-on experience with fine\-tuning and/or RL for LLMs, including SFT, LoRA, DPO, and RL (GRPO, PPO, etc).. * **Experimental Rigor:** Strong track record designing experiments, running ablations, and building evaluations that separate real improvement from noise. * **Data Intuition:** Proven ability to build and iterate on training datasets * **Model Landscape Awareness:** Broad knowledge of state\-of\-the\-art open\-source models and strong judgment on which base model to post\-train for a given customer requirements * **Coding Proficiency:** Strong Python skills; comfortable working in production environments. * **Experience leading complex, customer\-facing technical projects**, with exceptional project management and communication skills. Able to work in a highly X\-functional environment. ### **About Together AI** Together AI, the AI Native Cloud, is purpose\-built for AI engineers. AI application developers get high\-performance inference that scales reliably, fine\-tuning and reinforcement learning for creating frontier\-level specialized models, and pre\-training at massive scale for fully custom intelligence, all around a marketplace of leading open models that teams can run, adapt, and own. Trusted by Cursor, Decagon, ElevenLabs, Salesforce, and Zoom, Together serves 400\+ trillion tokens a month. ### **Compensation** We offer competitive compensation, startup equity, health insurance, and other benefits, as well as flexibility in terms of remote work. The US base salary range for this full\-time position is: $270,000 \- $300,000 OTE \+ equity \+ benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by location, level and role. Individual compensation will be determined by experience, skills, and job\-related knowledge. ### **Equal Opportunity** Together AI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and more. Please see our Privacy Policy at https://www.together.ai/privacy

jobs.description: **About Trajan Wealth** With over $3 billion in assets under management and advisement, Trajan® Wealth is one of the fastest\-growing Registered Investment Advisor firms in the country. What sets us apart is our fully integrated, in\-house model \- combining fee\-only wealth management, estate planning through Trajan Estate, and tax strategy through Trajan Tax. We don't refer out critical components of a client's financial life. We bring them together under one fiduciary standard \- the Family Office. **Role Overview** We are seeking a Senior Full Stack Engineer with deep API management experience to help build, scale, and secure the digital platforms that power our financial services products. You will work across the stack, from designing customer\-facing web experiences to architecting the API gateway, authentication, and integration layer that connects our internal systems, partner banks, and third\-party data providers. This role sits at the intersection of product velocity and platform reliability. You will partner with product managers, designers, security, compliance, and SRE teams to deliver features that meet the regulatory bar of financial services while still moving at the pace our customers expect. Your work will directly influence how the firm exposes capabilities to internal teams, fintech partners, and end clients. This role would be 100% onsite at our Scottsdale corporate headquarters. **How We Work** * Small, autonomous product squads with clear ownership and meaningful end\-to\-end scope. * Trunk\-based development, CI/CD, and a culture that prefers small, reversible changes over large, risky releases. * Genuine investment in engineering quality: paved roads for common patterns, internal platform teams to lean on, and time set aside for tech debt and learning. * Blameless incident culture, with the expectation that postmortems lead to real change. **Duties and responsibilities** * Design, build, and operate full\-stack features end\-to\-end \- from React/TypeScript front ends, through Node.js / Java / Python (or similar) backend services, to data persistence and event\-driven integrations. * Own the API lifecycle: design RESTful and event\-driven APIs, manage versioning, deprecation, and backward compatibility, and curate the developer experience through OpenAPI/Swagger documentation and SDKs. * Configure and tune our API gateway platform (MuleSoft). * Implement and maintain authentication and authorization patterns appropriate for financial services: OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, mTLS, JWT validation, scoped access tokens, and consent management for open\-banking\-style flows. * Partner with security and compliance to ensure all systems meet relevant standards (e.g., SOC 2, PCI DSS, GLBA, GDPR / CCPA, SOX where applicable) and pass internal audits and external regulatory reviews. * Build observability into everything: structured logging, distributed tracing, metrics, alerting on golden signals (latency, traffic, errors, saturation), and meaningful SLOs for the services you own. * Write production\-quality, well\-tested code, and uphold engineering standards through thoughtful code review, pairing, and mentorship of mid\-level engineers. * Participate in an on\-call rotation for the services you own, drive incident response when issues arise, and lead blameless postmortems that translate into durable system improvements. * Collaborate with product to translate business and regulatory requirements into clean technical designs, and be a credible voice in trade\-off conversations around scope, risk, and timeline. * **Qualifications** **Required:** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with meaningful time spent on both frontend and backend systems. * Strong proficiency in a modern frontend framework (React preferred; Vue or Angular acceptable) with TypeScript, and in at least one backend language commonly used in financial services (Java, Python, Go, Node.js, or C\#). * Working knowledge of Dagster (or a comparable orchestration framework such as Airflow or Prefect) and Snowflake, including building data pipelines, modeling warehouse data, and integrating analytical workloads with operational APIs. * Hands\-on experience designing and operating APIs in production at scale, including REST and ideally one of GraphQL, gRPC, or event\-driven (Kafka, EventBridge, etc.). * Direct experience with a commercial or open\-source API management platform (MuleSoft, AWS API Gateway, Azure API Management or similar). * Solid grounding in identity and access standards: OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, JWT, mTLS, and API key management. * Cloud experience on AWS, Azure, or GCP, including containers (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes or ECS). * Working knowledge of relational and at least one non\-relational database, and comfort reasoning about data consistency, transactions, and idempotency in financial workflows. * Demonstrated ability to ship in regulated environments, comfortable with code reviews, change management, audit trails, and the discipline that financial services demands. * Clear written and verbal communication; ability to explain technical concepts to product, business, and non\-technical stakeholders. **Nice to Have:** * Experience integrating with core banking platforms, payment rails (ACH, SWIFT, FedNow, card networks), market data providers, or KYC/AML vendors. * Familiarity with open banking standards (FDX in the US, PSD2 / Open Banking in the UK/EU) and consent\-driven data sharing patterns. * Exposure to financial\-grade API security profiles (FAPI) and mutual TLS in production. * Experience contributing to a developer portal, internal API marketplace, or platform\-as\-a\-product model. * Background working with event sourcing, CQRS, or ledger\-style data models. * Prior experience as an on\-call leader or as the engineering point of contact during incidents impacting regulated services. **Benefits** * $108,000 to $140,000 base salary plus bonus * 401(k) with a matching contribution up to 13%. * United Healthcare PPO medical coverage for employees, paid by the company. * Delta Dental PPO, United Healthcare Vision, Short Term Disability, Long Term Disability, Life Insurance, and many more voluntary options. * Generous holidays and PTO. * Future career growth opportunity. **Come and join a team that is making a difference in their clients and employee's lives!**

Ultimately, we appreciate the uniqueness of a company where talented professionals work collaboratively in a positive environment — one focused on helping people look forward and plan for the best life possible while providing tools and solutions that make it easier to get there. **Who We Are** We believe everyone deserves to live their best life. More than a century ago, we were among the first financial services companies in America to serve everyday people from all walks of life. Today, we’re part of an international holding company, with millions of customers and thousands of employees worldwide. Our insurance, retirement, and investment solutions help people make the most of what’s important to them. We’re empowered by a vast agent network covering North America, with diversity to match. Together with our nonprofit research institute and foundation, we tune in, step up, and are a force for good — for our customers and the communities where we live, work, and play. United in our purpose, we help people create the financial freedom to live life on their terms. **What We Do** Transamerica is organized into three distinct businesses. These include 1\) World Financial Group, including Transamerica Financial Advisors, 2\) Protection Solutions and Savings \& Investments, comprised of life insurance, annuities, employee benefits, retirement plans, and Transamerica Investment Solutions, and 3\) Financial Assets, which includes legacy blocks of long term care, universal life, and variable and fixed annuities. These are supported by Transamerica Corporate, which includes Finance, People and Places, General Counsel, Risk, Internal Audit, Strategy and Development, and Corporate Affairs, which covers Communications, Brand, and Government and Policy Affairs. Transamerica employs nearly 7,000 people. It’s part of Aegon, an integrated, diversified, international financial services group serving approximately 23\.9 million customers worldwide.\* For more information, visit transamerica.com. **Job Description Summary** The Senior Data Engineer is responsible for the design, architecture and support of systems, services and applications required for the collection, storage, processing, and analysis of all forms of data to enable data\-driven decisions and outcomes across the enterprise.**Job Description** **Responsibilities** * Work collaboratively with other engineers, data scientists, analytics teams, and business product owners in an agile environment. * Architect, build, and support the operation of Cloud and On\-Premises enterprise data infrastructure and tools. * Design robust, reusable, and scalable data driven solutions and data pipeline frameworks to automate the ingestion, processing and delivery of both structured and unstructured batch and real\-time streaming data. * Build data APIs and data delivery services to support critical operational processes, analytical models and machine learning applications. * Assist in selection and integration of data related tools, frameworks, and applications required to expand platform capabilities. * Understand and implement best practices in management of enterprise data, including master data, reference data, metadata, data quality and lineage. **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, math, engineering, or relevant technical field * Four years of collective experience in the application of data engineering, data analytics, data warehousing, business intelligence, database administration, and data integration concepts and methodologies * Three years of experience architecting, building, and administering big data and real\-time streaming analytics architectures in on\-premises and cloud environments * Two years of experience architecting, building, and administering large\-scale distributed applications * Two years of experience with Linux operations and development, including basic commands and shell scripting * Two years of experience with execution of DevOps methodologies and continuous integration/continuous delivery * Expertise in SQL for data profiling, analysis, and extraction * Familiarity with data science techniques and frameworks * Creative thinker with strong analytical skills * Results oriented with a strong customer focus * Ability to work in a team environment * Strong technical communication skills * Ability to prioritize work to meet tight deadlines * Ability to learn and keep pace with the latest technology advances and quickly grasp new technologies to support the environment and contribute to project deliverables **Preferred Qualifications** * Master’s degree in a technical field (e. Experience with data analysis and using data visualization tools to describe data * Relevant technology or platform certification (AWS, Microsoft, etc.) * Software development experience in relevant programming languages (i.e. Java, Python, Scala, Node.js) **Working Conditions** * Office Environment * Occasional Travel \<10% *This job description is not a contract of employment nor for any specific job responsibilities. The Company may change, add to, remove, or revoke the terms of this job description at its discretion. Managers may assign other duties and responsibilities as needed. In the event an employee or applicant requests or requires an accommodation to perform job functions, the applicable HR Business Partner should be contacted to evaluate the accommodation request.* **What We Offer** For eligible employees, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support both the personal and financial well\-being of our employees. Compensation Benefits * Competitive Pay * Bonus for Eligible Employees Benefits Package * Pension Plan * 401k Match * Employee Stock Purchase Plan * Tuition Reimbursement * Disability Insurance * Medical Insurance * Dental Insurance * Vision Insurance * Employee Discounts * Career Training \& Development Opportunities Health and Work/Life Balance Benefits * Paid Time Off starting at 160 hours annually for employees in their first year of service. * Ten (10\) paid holidays per year (typically mirroring the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) holidays). * Be Well Company holistic wellness program, which includes Wellness Coaching and Reward Dollars * Parental Leave – fifteen (15\) days of paid parental leave per calendar year to eligible employees with at least one year of service at the time of birth, placement of an adopted child, or placement of a foster care child. * Adoption Assistance * Employee Assistance Program * Back\-Up Care Program * PTO for Volunteer Hours * Employee Matching Gifts Program * Employee Resource Groups * Inclusion and Diversity Programs * Employee Recognition Program * Referral Bonus Programs **Inclusion \& Diversity** We believe our commitment to diversity and inclusion creates a work environment filled with exceptional individuals. jobs.title: Transformation Engineer
jobs.description: **Shape the Future with TribalScale** ===================================== TribalScale is a digital innovation firm that helps organizations adapt and thrive in a rapidly changing world. We partner with clients to build transformative digital products, modernize technology platforms, and apply emerging technologies—including artificial intelligence—to meaningful business challenges. Our teams work closely with clients from strategy through execution. We value curiosity, ownership, practical innovation, and people who are comfortable turning ambiguity into action. **Our Digital Expertise** * **Transformation Experts:** We transform traditional business models into agile, AI\-powered ecosystems. * **Strategic Visionaries:** We navigate the uncharted waters of technological evolution. * **Product Virtuosos:** We orchestrate the creation of world\-class digital solutions. * **Code Optimizers:** We leverage AI to refine and perfect digital systems. **Our Technological Toolkit** * **Mobile \& Web Development:** (iOS, Android, React Native, React, Node.js) * **Voice\-Activated Platforms:** (Amazon Alexa, Google Home) * **Connected Ecosystems:** (Cars and Homes) * **Streaming Platforms:** (Roku, Fire TV, Android TV, tvOS) **The TribalScale Professional** You thrive in challenging environments where innovation is key. Your passion for technology is matched only by your drive to redefine its limits. You seek more than a job; you seek a calling—a chance to make a lasting impact on the digital landscape. **The Opportunity** ------------------- We're looking for a Transformation Engineer to join our growing team at TribalScale. In this role, you will be embedded with a client organization of approximately 500 employees, serving as a hands\-on AI platform builder, technical leader, and educator over an extended engagement. You will help establish and continuously improve the organization's AI knowledge foundation—its "company brain"—while building production\-ready agentic systems, advancing Claude Code practices, and enabling teams across the business to adopt AI workflows. Success means not only shipping working systems, but also making them secure, maintainable, useful, and widely adopted. This is a hands\-on engineering and organizational transformation role for someone who can move quickly from ambiguity to production, partner across functions, and own outcomes over time. **What You'll Do** ------------------ ### **AI Knowledge Systems \& Agentic Memory** * Design, build, and maintain an LLM\-powered company knowledge base ("company brain" or LLM wiki) that captures institutional knowledge and makes it usable by employees and agents. * Architect agentic memory and context strategies: define what agents remember, how knowledge is retrieved and refreshed, and how access permissions are enforced. * Develop practical retrieval, indexing, knowledge\-quality, and lifecycle processes that keep information accurate, relevant, and secure. ### **Production Agentic Engineering \& Claude Code** * Design, build, deploy, and operate agentic applications and production harnesses, including evaluations, observability, guardrails, testing, human oversight, and ongoing iteration. * Serve as the organization's Claude Code expert: establish conventions for CLAUDE.md, skills, subagents, hooks, MCP integrations, and repeatable team workflows. * Build reusable developer tooling, integrations, APIs, and automation that improve engineering productivity and software delivery. * Deploy and maintain solutions on AWS, applying IAM permissions, security controls, monitoring, reliability practices, and cost management. ### **Organization\-Wide Enablement \& Adoption** * Design and deliver a structured training program for an approximately 500\-person organization, covering agentic memory, harnesses, Claude Code, and practical AI workflows for technical and non\-technical audiences. * Run workshops, hands\-on demonstrations, office hours, and tailored onboarding; create documentation and reusable learning materials. * Develop internal AI champions and support managers and teams as they embed new practices into day\-to\-day work. * Define and monitor adoption and impact measures, such as active usage, workflow uptake, proficiency, productivity, and feedback; improve the program based on results. ### **Long\-Term Transformation \& Delivery** * + Partner with stakeholders across engineering, IT, security, and business functions to prioritize use cases and align technical work with organizational needs. + Own solutions from discovery and rapid prototyping through production deployment, maintenance, and iterative improvement. + Establish practical AI governance covering data access, privacy, security, reliability, and responsible use across hundreds of users. + Balance speed, quality, maintainability, and change management while helping the organization build sustainable internal capabilities. **What You Bring** ------------------ * Strong hands\-on s iver practical solutions in fast\-paced environments. We recognize that strong candidates may not meet every qualification listed. If this role excites you and your experience is adjacent to what we have described, we encourage you to apply. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience leading AI adoption or platform transformation in a mid\-sized organization, particularly one with approximately 200–2,000 employees. * Experience with LangGraph, LangChain, or other agent orchestration and evaluation frameworks. * Claude Certified Architect certification or other relevant AI engineering credentials. * Experience building internal communities of practice, champion networks, or measurable enterprise enablement programs. * Experience with CI/CD, DevOps, infrastructure as code, and operating secure AI systems at organizational scale. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- In your first few months, you will have built trusted relationships with client and TribalScale teams, developed a strong understanding of the client's operating environment, and contributed working software to a meaningful business challenge. As you grow in the role, you will: * Turn loosely defined client needs into clear, executable technical plans. * Deliver AI\-enabled products that perform reliably outside of controlled demonstrations. * Establish evaluation and observability practices that make quality measurable and regressions visible. * Improve agent behavior by refining harnesses, loops, tools, graphs, context, and safeguards—not only by changing prompts or models. * Help client teams understand what their AI systems can do, where they can fail, and how they should be operated responsibly. * Create reusable technical patterns that accelerate future TribalScale engagements. * Become a trusted partner who can navigate uncertainty, solve difficult technical problems, and help promising ideas reach production. **Why TribalScale** ------------------- * Work on high\-impact challenges across industries and technology domains. * Build real products and production systems—not just recommendations or presentations. * Work directly with clients and see the impact of your decisions. * Explore emerging approaches to AI, agentic systems, product development, and software delivery. * Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams that value experimentation and continuous learning. * Influence both client outcomes and TribalScale's evolving technical practices. * Join an environment where ownership, diverse perspectives, and thoughtful innovation are encouraged. **Why Choose TribalScale** At TribalScale, collaboration is at the heart of our innovative approach. We don't simply work for clients; we form partnerships, building transformative solutions that redefine what's possible. Our team, once at the forefront of the mobile revolution, now leads the charge in AI\-driven innovation. We empower each team member to be a catalyst for change, adhering to our principles of meritocracy, empowerment, and transparency. Diversity isn't just celebrated—it's fundamental to our strength. Our mission to "Right the Future" is a call to action to make a significant impact in the world of innovation. **Diversity: Our Collective Strength** TribalScale proudly stands as a beacon of equal opportunity in employment and workplace culture. We are steadfastly committed to equal employment opportunity, transcending the boundaries of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, able\-bodiedness, or gender identity. We not only welcome but actively encourage applications from individuals of all abilities, ages, citizenships, marital statuses, and gender identities. jobs.title: Senior Quality Systems Engineer/APQR Lead
jobs.description: Description: Tris Pharma, Inc. (www.trispharma.com) is a leading privately\-owned U.S. biopharmaceutical company with a focus on development and commercialization of innovative medicines in ADHD, spectrum disorders, anxiety, pain and addiction addressing unmet patient needs. We have \>150 US and International patents and market several branded ADHD products in the U.S. We also license our products in the US and ex\-US markets. We have a robust pipeline of innovative products spanning neuroscience and other therapeutic categories employing our proprietary science and technology. Our science and technology make us unique, but our team members set us apart; they are the engine fueling Tris’ passion and innovation. Our colleagues understand the criticality of operating a successful business and take pride in the company’s success. Equally importance to each team member is how we interact with one another on a daily basis. We believe in each other and in respectful, open and honest communications to help support individual and team success. Located in Monmouth Junction, New Jersey, Tris has an immediate opening for a Senior Quality Systems Engineer/APQR Lead **SUMMARY:** Senior Quality Systems Engineer/APQR Lead supports and assists the Quality Assurance (QA) function by merging product data evaluation under FDA 21 CFR 211\.180(e) with technical engineering controls to ensure commercial products consistently meet safety, identity, strength, quality and purity standards. The incumbent leads the statistical trending, data collection and aggregation and drafting of Annual Product Quality Reviews /Annual Product Reviews (APQRs/APRs) to monitor product/process stability and make data\-driven continuous improvement across various production processes in accordance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMPs), Food and Drug Administration (FDA) standards and batch record specifications. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:** * Maintains all appropriate Quality related documentation, as assigned while ensuring adherence to, and compliance with, established company quality policies, practices, SOPs and cGMPs * Leads the evaluation of annual product quality data to identify emerging quality risks, process variability, adverse trends and opportunities for continuous improvement; Utilizes statistical methods and quality risk management principles to transform manufacturing, laboratory and stability data into actionable business and compliance decisions; Collaborates with various departments, functions and appropriate Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to submit all sub\-reports in a timely, accurate and complaint manner * Hosts APR risk assessment meeting, tracks attendance and takes appropriate actions on team recommendations * Performs Advanced Trend Analysis for Intermediate, In\-process, Finished Product and Stability batches: Evaluates critical quality attributes (CQAs) and critical process parameters (CPPs) using statistical methods; Verifies consistency of existing processes and identifies trends; Properly addresses and reports all negative trends * Analyzes and interprets large datasets from Manufacturing, Packaging, Laboratory departments, complaints, deviations, Corrective Action Preventive Action (CAPAs), change controls and stability programs to identify statistically significant trends, process shifts and emerging quality risks including, but not limited to: analyzing Deviation and Rejection Profiles, trending manufacturing deviations, batch failures, yield losses and Out\-of\-Specification (OOS) laboratory findings (i.e., dissolution, uniformity, particle size), etc. * Applies statistical methods including control charts, process capability analysis, regression analysis, Pareto analysis and trend modeling to evaluate process performance and product lifecycle health * Evaluates cumulative impact of deviations, CAPAs, change controls, complaints, stability trends, analytical changes and validation activities on product quality throughout product lifecycle * Recommends revalidation and determines the need for process revalidation or changes to registered specifications based on APQR/APR data and conclusion * Drives Root Cause Investigations by partnering with QA Investigations, Production, Laboratory, and Technical Services teams to investigate deviations using appropriate tools (i.e., Fishbone, 5 Whys and Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA)); Mitigates specific product risks by addressing unique technical challenges to company dosage forms and its associated intermediates * Monitors process capability and calculates and analyzes process indicators such as Process Capability Index (Cpk) and Process Capability Index (Ppk) to monitor process variability * Maintains all appropriate Quality related documentation, as assigned, while assuring adherence to, and compliance with, established company quality policies, practices, SOPs and cGMPs pertaining to documentation and records management  NS** Minimum education and years of relevant work experience Bachelors degree in Chemical Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, or a related scientific discipline and minimum 5 years in quality systems, process validation, product quality review or quality engineering in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry in positions of increasing technical responsibility OR combination of education and related quality systems, process validation, product quality review or quality engineering in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry in positions of increasing technical responsibility. Special knowledge or skills needed and/or licenses or certificates **required** * Deep understanding of FDA 21 CFR Part 210/211, ICH Q8 (Pharmaceutical Development), ICH Q9 (Quality Risk Management), and ICH Q10 * Familiarity with laboratory testing equipment such as automated dissolution testers, High Pressure Liquid Chromatography (HPLC), particle size analyzers and viscometers/rheometers, etc. * Ability to translate statistical observations into quality risk assessments and business recommendations using risk management tools and structured decision\-making methodologies * Proficiency in statistical analysis platforms such as Minitab, JMP or SAS for process trending and control charting * Demonstrated experience applying statistical methodologies including, but not limited to: Control charting, Process capability analysis, Trend analysis, Regression analysis, Hypothesis testing, Analysis of Variance (ANOVA), Sampling plans, Statistical interpretation of manufacturing and laboratory data, etc. * Validation Knowledge: Strong foundational knowledge of Process Validation lifecycle stages (Stage 1, 2, and Stage 3 Continued Process Verification). Experience developing, monitoring, and interpreting Continued Process Verification (CPV) data and process performance indicators * ASQ Certification: Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) or Certified Quality Auditor (CQA) * Proficiency with Microsoft Office * Excellent verbal and written communication and skills * Ability to work independently and collaboratively, as required, in a fast paced, matrixed, team environment consisting of internal and external team members * Analytical thinking with excellent problem\-solving skills and the ability to adapt to changing priorities and deadlines * Excellent planning, organization and time management skills including the ability to support and prioritize stability program * Fluent in English (verbal and written) * Ability to identify and distinguish colors * Ability and willingness to work additional hours as required by business needs Special knowledge or skills needed and/or licenses or certificates **preferred** * Experience working with various dosage manufacturing (oral solid or liquid dosages, delayed or extended release products, etc.) * Lean Six Sigma: Green Belt or Black Belt certification * Experience with data visualization and reporting tools such as Power BI, Tableau, JMP Live, Spotfire, or equivalent platforms **Travel requirements** * 0% **Physical requirements** * Office / Laboratory based position * Ability to lift up to 30 lbs * Ability to use Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) * Ability to stand for extended periods **Anticipated salary range:** $100k – $145k. Base salary offered is contingent on assessment of candidate’s education and experience level relative to requirements of the position and a review of related industry standards and internal equity. **Additional benefits:** In addition to base salary, full\-time employees are also eligible for incentives, including, but not limited to: bonus eligible, medical, dental, vision, Rx insurance, 401K with match, life insurance, paid Company Holidays, PTO, Paid Volunteer Time and Employee Resource Groups. Tris Pharma, Inc. offers a highly competitive compensation and benefits package. To build and enhance our diverse workforce, we encourage applications from individuals with disabilities,

jobs.title: AI & Process Automation Developer
jobs.description: Truliant’s mission is to improve lives by putting our members first, providing great service and straightforward financial solutions. Our core values of Member Focus, Service, Guidance, Relationships, and Community define how we interact with members to fulfill our mission of improving lives and providing a foundation on which we conduct ourselves. Our Promise to Our Teammates: Truliant strives to provide all teammates with an enjoyable place to work where they feel valued, empowered and rewarded for all that they do. * **This position is remote within our NC, SC, VA footprint. Although this position is primarily remote, there are occasional events and meetings that may require you to work on\-site at one of our Truliant locations.** **Why this role matters** ========================= At Truliant Federal Credit Union, better technology helps our teams work more efficiently and creates a smoother experience for our members. As an AI \& Process Automation Developer, you’ll help turn business needs into secure, reliable automation and AI solutions that reduce manual effort and improve how work gets done. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys solving real business problems, building practical technology, and learning alongside experienced developers, architects, and business partners. **What you’ll do** ================== In this role, you’ll help design, build, test, deploy, and support enterprise automation and AI solutions. Your work may include robotic process automation, workflow automation, system integrations, intelligent document processing, and conversational AI. **Day to day, you’ll:** * Build and maintain reusable automation workflows, attended and unattended automations, and conversational AI capabilities using established development standards. * Connect solutions with enterprise applications through REST APIs, SOAP services, SQL databases, message queues, and enterprise connectors. * Test, document, deploy, troubleshoot, and support solutions across development, testing, and production environments. You’ll also partner with developers, architects, business stakeholders, and cross\-functional teams to understand requirements, assess automation opportunities, and deliver solutions that are secure, scalable, and maintainable. **What you bring** ================== We’re looking for a hands\-on developer who combines solid programming and integration experience with a practical understanding of AI and automation. You can move an idea from requirements through testing and support while asking thoughtful questions and working well with both technical and business partners. **This role is a great fit if you have:** **Required Experience:** * 2\+ years of foundational experience with AI or automation technologies such as RPA, workflow automation, conversational AI, intelligent document processing, or an equivalent platform. * 3\+ years of experience using source control, CI/CD processes, and modern software development tools. * 1\+ years of automation development, systems integration, or related experience designing, developing, testing, deploying, and supporting technical solutions. * 2\+ years of experience with REST APIs, SQL, JSON, XML, and system integration concepts. * 3\+ years of experience with Python, Java, React JavaScript, Node.js, or similar programming languages. **Required Skills:** * Develop, test, deploy, troubleshoot, and maintain automation solutions using reusable components and established development practices. * Build and support integrations using APIs, databases, services, and enterprise connectors. * Use source control and CI/CD practices to manage reliable software changes across environments. * Translate business requirements into technical designs, workflow diagrams, specifications, deployment instructions, and support documentation. * Apply unit, integration, and regression testing practices and support User Acceptance Testing. **Education/Certifications required within one year:** * UiPath Advanced Developer Professional Certification. * Kore.AI Automation AI / XO Platform, Kore.AI Agent AI, \& Kore.AI Agent Platform Builder advanced training or developer certification. You should also be comfortable working within Agile delivery, SDLC, DevSecOps, secure coding, change management, and enterprise governance standards, while collaborating closely with senior developers and cross\-functional partners. **What sets you apart** ======================= **You don’t need to check every box, but here’s what will help you thrive in this role:** * A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. * 2\+ years of experience working within Agile development teams. * 2\+ years of exposure to cloud\-based platforms, services, and development environments. * 2\+ years of experience in financial services, healthcare, government, or another regulated industry. * Curiosity about emerging technologies such as Generative AI, Retrieval Augmented Generation, prompt engineering, and Agentic AI. **What you’ll get** =================== We believe in supporting our team members both professionally and personally. **In this role, you can expect:** * Meaningful work that improves operational efficiency and supports a better member experience at Truliant Federal Credit Union. * Hands\-on opportunities to build across automation, integrations, conversational AI, and emerging AI technologies rather than being limited to one type of solution. * Collaboration with experienced developers, architects, and business partners who can help you strengthen both your technical skills and business understanding. * A team environment that values secure, maintainable solutions, thoughtful problem\-solving, continuous learning, and high\-quality service. **Ready to Apply?** =================== If you have a passion for member service and would like to invest in a meaningful career with opportunity for growth, we encourage you to apply to Truliant! jobs.description: About the role: At Uber, Frontend Engineers build the web experiences that power how people move and get things delivered around the world. As a Software Engineer II on the OFD Feed UX team, you will build and ship user\-facing features on the Uber Eats Home Feed on the web, the first thing millions of customers see when they decide what to order. You will work with design, product, backend, and data science to turn ideas into fast, accessible, and reliable experiences. You will own features end to end, from technical design and implementation through experimentation, launch, and iteration. About the Team: The OFD Feed UX team owns the Uber Eats Home Feed experience. Our mission is to make Home Feed the most useful starting point for discovery \& inspiration: helping customers make better decisions, explore the breadth of what Uber Eats offers across restaurants, grocery, and retail, and find more of what they care about. We build the surfaces that shape discovery for millions of customers, including carousels, shortcuts, billboards, store and item collections, and innovative new UX formats. What You'll Do: * Build, ship, and iterate on Home Feed features for Uber Eats web using technologies like React, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS. * Own features end to end, from technical design and implementation through A/B experimentation, launch, and follow\-ups. * Partner with designers, product managers, backend engineers, and data scientists to turn product ideas into polished, data\-driven experiences. * Improve web performance, accessibility, and reliability, including page load, rendering latency, and observability. * Write clear design docs and conduct thoughtful code reviews to keep quality high. * Share ownership of the systems the team runs, including on\-call, operations, and maintenance. Minimum qualifications: * Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or related field **OR** 2\+years full\-time Software Engineering work experience, **WHICH INCLUDES** 1\-year total technical software engineering experience in one or more of the following areas:Programming language (e.g. JavaScript or TypeScript) * Modern web frameworks (e.g. React, VueJS, or Angular), plus HTML, CSS, and web APIs Technical skills: Required: * Understanding of modern web application architecture, including rendering strategies, state management, and client\-server data flow * Algorithm and data structure fundamentals, including hash tables, trees, stacks, queues, linked lists, DFS, and BFS * Strong written and verbal communication skills in English Preferred: * Experience with back\-end systems (e.g. Go, Python, or TypeScript/Node.js) to work across the stack * Web performance optimization (e.g. Core Web Vitals, server\-side rendering, bundle size) * Experimentation and analytics (A/B testing, metrics, observability tools such as Grafana) * Experience with large\-scale consumer products such as e\-commerce, marketplaces, or discovery/feed experiences * Using AI tools (e.g. Cursor, Claude) across the development cycle, including code generation, testing, and documentation For San Francisco, CA\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $171,000 per year \- USD $190,000 per year. jobs.description: **About the role and team** Operating across key business areas like grocery and food, the Consumer Incentives team drives Uber's growth and long\-term profitability. We deliver products that create seamless, affordable, and enjoyable customer experiences by building AI/ML\-powered intelligence and sophisticated distributed systems at scale for hundreds of millions of global users. **What you’ll do** As a Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer, you will shape the technical vision and long\-term ML strategy for Consumer Incentives. You will tackle fundamental questions about how to personalize incentives, understand their incremental impact on consumer behavior, and optimize investment to deliver customer value and sustainable business growth. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role spanning machine learning, optimization, experimentation, and large\-scale systems. You will lead initiatives across team boundaries, partner with engineering and cross\-functional leaders to define the roadmap, and translate advances in ML into reliable products with measurable business impact. Building on our established capabilities in deep learning and constrained optimization, you will also help identify and develop opportunities for reinforcement learning, foundation models, and generative AI. * **Set technical direction**: Define the long\-term ML vision, architecture, and technical roadmap for Consumer Incentives, aligning investments with consumer needs and business priorities. * **Lead strategically important initiatives**: Turn ambiguous problems into actionable technical strategies, and drive execution across teams from problem formulation and offline This position will collect, organize, validate, and maintain information from regional teams, bringing it together into consistent reports that help leadership understand business and project performance. jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer

You will own the end\-to\-end ML lifecycle, from feature engineering and model deployment to monitoring, governance, and continuous retraining. You will also help establish enterprise MLOps capabilities such as a Feature Store, Model Registry, automated CI/CD/CT pipelines, and real\-time scoring. You will work closely with data scientists, data engineers, software engineers, and business stakeholders, ideally in a regulated industry such as banking, financial services, healthcare, insurance, or telecom. * Engagement: Contract assignment with a reputed banking client * Location: Cincinnati, OH (hybrid, 3 days per week on\-site) * Contract Duration: 6 months, with potential extension * Employment Type: W2 only **Responsibilities** * Design, build, and optimize scalable, reusable ML platforms and production\-grade ML systems that cover model development, training, validation, strategies. * Optimize ML systems for performance, reliability, maintainability, and cost efficiency. * Implement MLOps governance and ensure compliance with security, privacy, risk, and regulatory jobs.title: AI Engineer - Go To Market
jobs.description: ### **When you join Verizon** You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife. **What you’ll be doing...** You will be working to design, deploy, and optimize Generative AI solutions that eliminate friction in our Go\-To\-Market (GTM) engine. You will move beyond traditional data analytics and modeling to build agentic workflows and RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) systems, applying the latest advancements in Foundation Models to create intuitive, AI\-native tools that supercharge our sales and marketing teams. Responsibilities include: * Building and refining LLM\-powered features and autonomous agents to enhance our revenue capabilities. * Designing and implementing RAG pipelines to connect our proprietary data (e.g., playbooks, product documentation, past successful call transcripts) with large language models for high\-accuracy, context\-aware outputs. * Exploring and eliminating other GTM friction points by rapid prototyping AI solutions for lead enrichment, personalized outreach, and CRM automation. * Integrating AI workflows into the modern sales stack (e.g., Salesforce, Gong) to ensure seamless adoption by our sales reps. * Developing and maintaining production\-grade infrastructure for AI orchestration, including prompt management, low\-latency streaming APIs, and model evaluation frameworks. * Rapid "Vibe Coding" \& Prototyping: Use tools like Claude Code, Codex, Lovable, LangSmith Agent Builder, to go from idea to deployed full\-stack MVP in days, not weeks. **What we’re looking for...** You are a builder at heart with a "hacker" mindset and a passion for revenue operations. You are eager to bridge the gap between raw model capabilities and polished tools that actually help sales teams win. You are proactive, iterate quickly, and enjoy the challenge of "taming" non\-deterministic AI outputs in high\-stakes, real\-time environments. You’ll need to have: * Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience. * Six or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training. * Strong proficiency in Python/TypeScript and experience building web services or integrating complex APIs (especially CRM, VoIP, or sales engagement platforms). * Solid understanding of the LLM stack, including experience with orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain/LangGraph, Strands Agents, CrewAI). * Knowledge of modern AI concepts: Prompt Engineering, few\-shot learning, and the difference between fine\-tuning and RAG. * Experience with standard software development tools (Git, Docker) and CI/CD processes. * A product\-oriented and revenue\-focused mindset: the ability to deeply empathize with a BDR's workflow and design AI outputs that are instantly actionable during a live call. Even better if you have one or more of the following: * Domain expertise in Go\-To\-Market, RevOps, or Sales tech stacks (Salesforce, Hubspot, Gong, Apollo, Clearbit). * Experience building real\-time audio/speech\-to\-text processing pipelines (e.g., WebRTC, Deepgram, Whisper) for live transcription and analysis. * Fearless "Hacker" Mindset: You aren't afraid of code you didn't write. You are comfortable generating 80% of your code with AI and crafting the remaining 20% with high precision. * Contributions to open\-source AI projects or a portfolio of "weekend" prototypes built with an AI\-native toolchain. * Exposure to cloud\-based AI services (e.g., AWS Bedrock, Azure AI Studio, or GCP Vertex AI). * Experience with Vector Databases and semantic search concepts. * Experience with AI evaluation and observability tools. * Knowledge of "agentic" design patterns. If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above. ### **Where you’ll be working** In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.### **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40### **Equal Employment Opportunity** Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics. ### **Benefits and Compensation** Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD\&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home \& auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award\-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part\-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances. The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job\-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part\-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours. The annual salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full\-time schedule is: $120,500\.00 \- $231,000\.00\. The annual salary range for the Illinois location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full\-time schedule is: $132,500\.00 \- $231,000\.00\.

jobs.title: Firmware Release & Test Automation Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Who We Are** Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy\-sensitive AI\-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. We've got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100\+ of the Fortune 500\), a $5\.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it. You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform's impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI\-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that's alerted to a threat in real\-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We're rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170\+ countries. ### **About the Role** As a Firmware Release \& Test Automation Engineer, you will own the final mile between embedded code development and physical deployment across our global fleet of connected devices. In this hybrid role, you sit at the intersection of build infrastructure, automated validation, and release governance. You won't just run test suites or push buttons on a deployment train—you will architect the continuous integration pipelines, design Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop (HIL) and Software\-in\-the\-Loop (SIL) automation fixtures, define gatekeeping qualification criteria, and orchestrate safe, staged over\-the\-air (OTA) updates. You will work closely with firmware engineers, hardware validation teams, and cloud backend developers to ensure that every build that lands on a customer's wall, ceiling, or door controller is stable, secure, and reliable. We are committed to a thriving in\-office culture. This role requires you to be onsite at our HQ in San Mateo, CA. ### **What You'll Do** * **Own the Release Lifecycle:** Define, maintain, and optimize the end\-to\-end release pipeline for embedded Linux and RTOS builds across our devices. * **Build Automated Validation Systems:** Design, build, and scale automated Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop (HIL) and Software\-in\-the\-Loop (SIL) test harnesses to catch regressions before firmware ever reaches external hardware. * **Set Quality \& Gatekeeping Standards:** Establish clear go/no\-go qualification gates, track test flakiness, and lead triage for release\-blocking bugs alongside core firmware developers. * **Orchestrate Safe Deployments:** Drive staged fleet rollouts, canary deployments, and automated telemetry monitoring to catch field anomalies early and execute fast rollbacks when needed. * **Drive Developer Productivity:** Build tools and CI/CD automation that speed up firmware compile, packaging, and local test cycles. * **Self\-motivated problem solver:** At Verkada, you will tackle large, complex edge\-case bugs spanning silicon, firmware, networking, and cloud services with no clear answers. * **Teach and learn:** You will take technical ownership of major validation systems while collaborating with and mentoring peers across software, firmware, and hardware engineering. ### **What You Bring** * BS or graduate degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field. * 3\+ years of experience in software/firmware build infrastructure, embedded test automation, or release engineering. * Strong programming proficiency in Python and Bash for automation, scripting, and test framework development. * Working knowledge of C/C\+\+ in embedded Linux or RTOS environments. * Hands\-on experience building or maintaining CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, TeamCity) for embedded systems. * Experience with automated test execution on physical hardware targets (HIL testbeds, serial/UART logging, JTAG/SWD, network power switches). * Understanding of modern version control workflows (Git branching models, tagging, release trains) and build systems (Yocto/BitBake, CMake, Make, Bazel). * Must be willing and able to work onsite five days per week at our San Mateo HQ. * Must be willing to travel at least one week a year to our engineering office in Krakow, Poland. ### **Nice to Have** * Working knowledge of Go. * Experience with secure boot workflows, cryptographic firmware signing, and Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) generation. * Familiarity with over\-the\-air (OTA) update frameworks and dual\-partition (A/B) fallback mechanisms. * Experience monitoring fleet health telemetry (DataDog, Grafana, Prometheus, or ELK). * Knowledge of standard embedded communication interfaces (I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, Ethernet) and Wi\-Fi/cellular networking. ### **US Employee Benefits** Verkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive wellness perks, benefits, and resources. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to: * Healthcare programs that can be tailored to meet the personal health and financial well\-being needs \- Premiums are 100% covered for the employee under at least one plan and 80% for family premiums under all plans * Nationwide medical, vision and dental coverage * Starting January 2027, Verkada will match a portion of an employee's 401(k) contributions based on eligible earnings. Match vests on 2 year anniversary * Health Saving Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) with tax saving options * Expanded mental health support * Paid parental leave policy \& fertility benefits * Time off to relax and recharge through our paid holidays, firmwide extended holidays, flexible PTO and personal sick time * Professional development stipend * Wellness/fitness benefits * Healthy lunches provided daily * Commuter benefits ### **Additional Information** * We do sponsor and take over sponsorship of employment visas for this role. If we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa. ### **Verkada Is An Equal Opportunity Employer** As an equal opportunity employer, Verkada is committed to providing employment opportunities to all individuals. All applicants for positions at Verkada will be treated without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law. *Your application will be handled in accordance with our* *Candidate Privacy Policy**.*
