jobs.title: Mechanical Design Engineer, Frontier AI Hardware
jobs.description: **Mechanical Design Engineer, Frontier AI Hardware** **About us:** Voyant Photonics is pushing the boundaries of silicon photonic chips that steer and switch light at high speed. They power next generation, chip\-scale FMCW LiDAR for robotics and autonomy, and optical circuit switches (OCS) for AI data centers. Based in NYC, we’re a hands\-on team designing, building, and deploying frontier hardware to solve problems that matter, from how machines see to how AI scales. **About the Role:** We are looking for an experienced Mechanical Engineer to design, document, and release the mechanical hardware for our LiDAR sensing products and the tooling used to build and test them. You will own parts and assemblies from concept through release and support the alignment and assembly processes that bring our sensors to life. In a startup environment, speed matters, and so does getting it right the first time. **What You'll Do:** * Design mechanical components, housings, assemblies, and development platforms for LiDAR sensors in SolidWorks * Create clear, complete, manufacturing\-ready drawings with proper GD\&T per ASME Y14\.5 * Perform tolerance stack\-up analyses to verify fit, function, and optical alignment budgets * Translate system‑level requirements into robust mechanical architecture and detailed designs * Design fixtures, jigs, and tooling for assembly, alignment, inspection, and test * Support and improve lens alignment stations and related optical assembly processes * Manage engineering change requests and revisions (ECR/ECO), keeping documentation and BOMs accurate * Work with suppliers to resolve manufacturability questions and ensure part quality * Drive design\-to\-cost and value engineering efforts to reduce part cost and complexity without compromising performance * Collaborate with optical, electrical, and manufacturing engineers to turn requirements into robust designs * Iterate quickly through prototypes and builds, then move designs toward production **What We're Looking For** * B.S. in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent practical experience * Minimum of 4\+ years of mechanical design experience for precision hardware products * Strong proficiency in SolidWorks, including assemblies, detailed part modeling and drawings * Working knowledge of GD\&T and its practical application to functional and inspection requirements * Experience performing tolerance stack\-up analysis (worst\-case and statistical) * Experience with tool and fixture design **Nice to Have** * Experience with precision optomechanical design, such as lens mounting and adhesive bonding. * Experience with thermal analysis and structural FEA, especially for compact electro\-optical packaging * Hands\-on machining, , assembly, or test experience **Life at Voyant** We build frontier hardware \& systems from our lab and office in Midtown Manhattan, where optical tables, lab benches and electronics sit alongside traditional office space. Our work is hands\-on and primarily in person, but we don’t run on a rigid 9\-to\-5\. We partner with customers across time zones, so some calls start early or run late, and we adjust schedules around them. We run a high\-trust, high\-accountability environment: you’ll own meaningful work, move quickly and often wear more than one hat. Voyant provides catered lunch every day at HQ, and we’re a diverse group of food lovers from around the world who enjoy sharing food, culture and technical ideas around the lunch table. **Equal Opportunity Employer** Voyant Photonics is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. jobs.title: Lead Data Engineer

This is a hands\-on role, but not a heads\-down one. Reporting to the SVP, DATA, you'll lead key technical parts of our data stack and be a strategic partner on where it goes next: what to build, what to buy, what to fix, and what actually matters to the business. You don't need a lot of direction and are comfortable working through ambiguity. The role grows as you do. Near term, you'll work alongside our team and external partners to extend and strengthen the platform. Over time, you'll take on more of the technical ownership and help lead what comes next. And as the practice scales, you'll build and lead a small data support team handling tier 1 and tier 2 triage. **What You Will Do (Responsibilities):** **Data Engineering** * Build and maintain pipelines and dbt models in Snowflake that are tested, documented, and trusted * Integrate data from paid media, web analytics, SEO, CRM, and business systems using tools like Fivetran or Airbyte and direct APIs * Find and fix breaks at the root, before an account team or client finds them * Maintain data governance: access controls, privacy, and consent requirements * Structure and document data so AI agents can use it reliable: clear semantic layers, consistent definitions, and metadata that tells an agent what a table or metric actually means * Build governed access patterns for agentic tools (scoped, read\-only, permission aware) so agents only query the data they're allowed to, and their answers can be traced back to the source **Strategy \+ Partnership** * Work with the SVP, DATA on architecture, roadmap, and build\-vs\-buy\-vs\-partner decisions * Translate business and client needs into data designs that hold up, and push back when a request won't * Make data usable for analysts, reporting, and AI\-driven tools through well\-modeled, well\-governed layers **Team Leadership** * Build and lead a small data support team handling tier 1 and tier 2 triage, including the playbooks and escalation paths behind it * Eventually build out the team as needed for various functions to drive better accuracy, performance and data tools for the business **What You Bring (Requirements):** You've spent 7\+ years in data engineering, enough of it in lean environments where you owned real things without much hand\-holding. You can go deep on a broken pipeline in the morning and talk through a roadmap tradeoff in the afternoon, and you're good at both. You are a clear communicator, and work to understand needs beyond the technical with empathy and a 'here's what's possible' mindset. You find problems, fix them, document them, and explain them without making them more complicated than they need to be. * + 7\+ years in data or analytics engineering, including time as the lead or senior technical owner on a production data platform + Deep, hands\-on Snowflake experience + Strong dbt, advanced SQL, and working Python + Experience integrating SaaS and marketing APIs (ad platforms, GA4, Salesforce, HubSpot) through ELT tools and custom pipelines + A track record of shaping technical direction, not just executing tickets + Clear communication with technical and non\-technical people alike**Strong Pluses** + Agency or B2B marketing data background + Data governance and privacy experience (role\-based access, masking, consent data) + Experience making data usable for AI and LLM\-driven tools + Experience leading or mentoring others + Comfortable using AI like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and bringing new ways of working within the data and privacy guardrails of the business **What We Offer (Compensation \+ Benefits):** * **Starting Salary: $155,000 \- $175,000** * + Base salary is only a part of the total rewards package. Placement on the salary scale will be determined by a variety of factors to ensure internal equity. + Starting salaries are not inclusive of a full range of compensation for this role and are instead meant to reflect the expected beginning salary for a new hire. Merit\-based increases can be earned after time in role. * **Bonus Potential:** This role will be eligible for a bonus based on company performance. * **Growth Opportunities:** Clear career paths, mentorship programs, and learning events to help you grow professionally. * **Flexible PTO and Hybrid Work:** Take time as needed for vacations, mental health, or personal days. Includes 8 paid holidays, half\-day summer Fridays, and a week off between Christmas and New Year. * **Health Coverage:** Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans. Mental health resources, pet insurance, and more. * **Retirement Savings**: Employer\-matched 401(k) and access to financial planning services. * **️ Additional Protection:** Life insurance, disability coverage, and other benefits that provide added financial security. * **Employee Assistance Program (EAP):** Free, confidential support for you and your household, including counseling, mental health resources, and help navigating life's everyday challenges. * **Family Support:** Paid leave for new parents and caregivers, plus policies for fertility treatment, pregnancy loss, adoption challenges, and more. * **Performance \& Coaching:** Regular performance reviews, clear goal\-setting, and ongoing coaching to help you understand expectations, grow your skills, and make progress in your career. * **Milestone Sabbatical:** Celebrate five years with a two\-week sabbatical and a $2,000 gift. * **Community \& Belonging:** Employee resource groups, volunteer opportunities, and programs designed to build connection across the agency. * **Culture:** Our agency offers an award\-winning culture. Read more on our website here! **We strongly encourage people of color, lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer and non\-binary people, veterans, parents, and individuals with disabilities to apply. As an equal opportunity employer Walker Sands is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion and welcomes everyone to our team.** **In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (For example – she/her/hers, he/him/his, they/them/theirs, etc).** **If you need reasonable accommodation at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.**

jobs.title: Full Stack Web Developer
jobs.description: Warmoth Guitar Products, Inc. has been building custom guitar and bass parts in Puyallup for over 45 years. We are a family owned and operated business located in Puyallup on South Hill. Much of what we sell is configured by the customer on Warmoth’s website before it gets made. We love guitars and our customers love them too. Our website is the businesses primary platform and we are seeking a developer to manage it. **Hours:** Full\-time, Monday – Friday, 8:00am – 4:30pm, onsite **Compensation:** $90,000 \- $130,000/yearly, DOE **Benefits:** Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Employee Assistance Program, Employee Discount Program, 401(k) with up to a 4% employer match, Paid Holidays, Vacation and Sick Leave **The Job** You will manage the Company website and internal web applications. This includes the Magento 2 (Adobe Commerce) storefront and its custom configurator, the Node.js tools the shop runs on, and much more. The site sits behind Cloudflare that you will manage, to include DNS, WAF, bot rules, and caching. When bots hit the configurator at 2am, you will be the one responsible for figuring out what they are doing and shutting them down. You would design, build, test, deploy, and fix the website when it breaks. You keep the website up for customers around the clock and hold to Company security and compliance standards while doing so. **Primary Job Duties/Responsibilities Include, but are not limited to:** * Manage and maintain the Magento 2 (Adobe Commerce) architecture, including custom modules, themes, and third\-party extensions. * Troubleshoot and debug code across Magento 2 (Adobe Commerce), PHP, and JavaScript. * Develop and support internal web applications built on Node.js and Postgres. * Build and consume REST and GraphQL APIs for the storefront and internal systems. * Implement SEO techniques and use site data to increase traffic and performance. * Work web tickets through our help desk and track projects in Trello daily. * Ensure the website is operating properly and cross compatible across various browsers and mobile devices. * Manage Cloudflare: DNS, WAF rules, bot mitigation, caching, page rules, watching traffic, spotting abuse, and tuning the rules. * Synchronize and update development and production environments; deploy through CI/CD. * Utilize Claude and other approved AI tools to accelerate coding, debugging, documentation, and testing. * Proactively identify and suggest opportunities for web\-related improvements. * Maintain strict adherence to internal and external security and compliance standards. **Requirements** * Skills: + Excellent verbal and written communication. + Excellent organization and attention to detail. + Excellent time management. + Confident decision making. + Strong analytical and problem\-solving. + Professional email and phone etiquette. + High level of integrity and professionalism * Able to: + Operate efficiently and stay focused in a sometimes\-distracting environment. + Prioritize tasks while adapting to shifting workloads and changing priorities. + Handle sensitive, confidential and proprietary information properly. + Type 40\+ wpm and 10 key by touch. + Navigate and use Excel, Word, Outlook, (Microsoft Office Suite). **Required Experience** * 3\+ years of professional web development * 3\+ Magento 2 (Adobe Commerce) experience (themes, modules, customization) in a production environment. * PHP 8\+. * JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3\. * Node.js for internal applications and service\-layer work. * MySQL: schema design and query writing. * Postgres Database Management * Git: feature branching, rebasing, merge workflows. * Linux and Windows command line: file system, scripting, process control. * REST and GraphQL APIs, both consuming and building. * Daily use of AI coding tools in your development workflow. Warmoth’s approved tool is Claude. You need solid judgment on when to trust output, when to verify it, and what data never leaves the company. * Basic networking and server concepts: DNS, ports, firewalls, Apache/Nginx. * Cloudflare or equivalent CDN/WAF: DNS management, firewall rules, caching. **Preferred Experience** * Vue.js or React. * Sass/Less, Bootstrap, jQuery. * Docker. * CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or equivalent). * Python, Java, C\+\+, C\#, or another object\-oriented language. * Kanban\-style project tracking (Trello or similar) and help desk ticketing. **Working Environment** This position does not supervise other positions and is a team of one that reports directly to the Chief Operating Officer (COO). It is full\-time, onsite, Monday – Friday from 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM, and may be expected to work as needed for emergencies. This position works in a temperature\-controlled office environment with four to five other people. This individual will work both independently and with other employees, as needed. This position will spend most of the day sitting or standing at a desk, working at a computer, speaking on the phone, or with individuals in person. **To Apply** * Resume. * A link to a portfolio, GitHub, or a live site you built or maintain. * 2–3 references, at least 2 from work\-related experience. * A short description of which Requirements you meet and how they would benefit Warmoth.

jobs.title: Application Developer
jobs.description: **About WRG** Water Resources Group is a family of self\-performing civil construction companies, including Rice Lake Construction Group and Rice Lake West. For more than 40 years, we have built water and wastewater treatment infrastructure, along with heavy civil and commercial/industrial projects, across the Upper Midwest and Mountain West. Our team of roughly 420 employees delivers more than 45 active projects a year, backed by an award\-winning safety program. **Position Summary** The Application Developer builds, maintains, and improves the internal business applications our employees rely on every day. This is a hands\-on development role for someone who enjoys both writing code and talking with the people who use it: you will sit down with employees and business leaders, understand what they need, and turn it into practical, reliable solutions. Working alongside WRG’s technology leadership, you will keep existing applications running smoothly, enhance them as they move into broader use, and take on growing responsibility for deployment and production support over time. **Essential Responsibilities** **Development** * Develop and enhance internal business applications, features, APIs, reports, and user interfaces. * Meet with employees with company systems, databases, authentication tools, and shared technology. * Write and optimize SQL queries, reports, and database views. * Use modern development tools, including AI\-assisted tools, while reviewing and validating the resulting code. **Maintenance \& Support** * Maintain and support applications currently in use, troubleshooting issues involving code, data, databases, retiring legacy deployments as applications are replaced. **Standards \& Documentation** * Follow and help improve standards for application development, deployment, security, and support. * Apply troubleshooting guides. * Build applications that others can support, so no system depends on the knowledge of a single person. **Qualifications** **Required** * 3–6 years of experience developing and supporting business applications in a production environment. * Strong proficiency in Python and experience building web\-based applications. * Working knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. * Strong SQL skills and experience with relational databases. * Experience using Git for source control and version management. * Experience with REST APIs, testing, and application troubleshooting. * Ability to understand, maintain, and improve applications written by others. * Clear communicator who works well with both technical and nontechnical employees. * Strong problem\-solving and documentation skills. **Preferred** * Experience deploying and supporting applications in Docker/Linux environments. * Experience with Microsoft SQL Server, ODBC connectivity, or SSO. * Experience with ERP/accounting systems, especially Sage 300 CRE or Sage Paperless. * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or a related field; equivalent experience will be considered. **Success disruption. * Existing applications are stable, current, and well documented. * Code and documentation are clear enough for others to support and build on. **Compensation \& Benefits** The pay range jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: **Webull is a leading digital brokerage platform built on next generation global infrastructure. At Webull, we believe that everyone should have an equal opportunity to control their own financial future. Our vision has always been to empower individual investors with the tools and resources they need to succeed financially. This commitment remains at the heart of everything we do. From low\-fee trading and robust market data to advanced analytical tools, we are committed to providing a seamless, top\-tier trading experience.** **About The Role \& Team** Webull is a cloud\-native fintech leader, with our global trading platform powered by AWS. As we continue to expand our trading platform and technology infrastructure, we are seeking a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to help ensure our cloud environments remain highly available, secure, scalable, and resilient. In this role, you will play a critical part in maintaining the reliability and performance of the infrastructure supporting our 24/7 global trading operations. You will work closely with our Development, Security, and Network teams to optimize AWS production environments, troubleshoot complex infrastructure challenges, strengthen monitoring and incident response capabilities, and drive automation to improve operational efficiency. We are looking for someone with strong technical expertise in AWS cloud infrastructure, a proactive approach to problem\-solving, and a passion for building reliable, high\-performing systems. The ideal candidate takes ownership of technical challenges, thrives in a fast\-paced environment, and is excited to contribute to the continued growth and stability of Webull's global brokerage platform. **In This Role, You Will** * Operate and maintain Webull’s AWS production environments (EC2, VPC, ELB/ALB, Route 53, S3, RDS/Aurora, ElastiCache, MSK, EKS) across multiple regions, ensuring 99\.99% availability for our 24/7 trading platform. * Build and tune monitoring, logging, and alerting with CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK/OpenSearch; define SLIs/SLOs and reduce alert noise so on\-call engineers act on what matters. * Participate in the on\-call rotation, lead L2/L3 incident troubleshooting for cloud and network issues, and drive post\-incident root\-cause analysis and follow\-up actions. * Provision and change infrastructure through Terraform/CloudFormation and GitOps workflows; standardize environment builds and eliminate manual console changes. * Operate EKS/Kubernetes clusters, including upgrades, capacity planning, autoscaling, and Helm/ArgoCD\-based deployments. * Manage IAM roles and policies, Security Groups, KMS, Secrets Manager, and certificate lifecycles; support SOC 2, FINRA/SEC audit requests and remediate findings from Security Hub, GuardDuty, and AWS Config. * Maintain VPC design, subnets and routing, Transit Gateway, VPC peering, PrivateLink, and Site\-to\-Site VPN connectivity with third\-party vendors. * Design, document, and regularly test backup, cross\-region failover, and DR runbooks to meet RTO/RPO targets. * Track cloud spend with Cost Explorer and tagging, rightsize resources, and manage Savings Plans and Reserved Instances. * Write Python/Shell/Go tooling, Lambda functions, and AI\-assisted runbooks to automate repetitive operational tasks. **The Skills You Bring** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field. * 4\+ years of hands\-on experience in cloud operations, SRE, or DevOps, including 3\+ years running production workloads on AWS. * Solid knowledge of core AWS services: EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, ELB, Route 53, RDS, CloudWatch, and EKS. * Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills; good understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, load balancing, VPN, and TLS. * Production experience with Docker and Kubernetes. * Working experience with Terraform or CloudFormation, and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or ArgoCD. * Proficiency in Python or Shell scripting; Go is a plus. * Familiarity with MySQL, Redis, and Kafka in production environments. * Experience in broker\-dealer, electronic trading, or other regulated financial environments. * Willingness to join an on\-call rotation and support global trading sessions outside regular hours when needed. **What Makes You Stand Out** * AWS Certifications: * + AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate/Professional + AWS Certified SysOps Administrator + AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional, or CKA. * Experience with AWS Organizations, Control Tower, and landing\-zone design. * AI\-Forward Thinking: Interest in using AI agents or LLMs for operational automation. * Fluency in Mandarin and English to work with our global engineering hubs. **Why Webull?** Webull is more than a fintech company—we’re a global community of innovators, collaborators, and trailblazers. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, FL, Webull operates in 16 regions worldwide, serving over 20 million users. At Webull, your ideas matter, your voice is heard, and your work makes a real impact. Investing in our people is a top priority for us, which is why we have a comprehensive benefits package that includes: * **Comprehensive Health Coverage**: 100% paid medical and dental insurance for employees and dependents, vision insurance, and more! * **Financial Support**: 401(k) match, commuter benefits for NY positions, and short\-term disability coverage. * **Work\-Life Balance**: Generous time off that increases with tenure, paid parental leave, personal days, sick time, volunteer days and company holidays. * **Wellness \& Pet Care**: Fitness and wellness benefits, plus pet insurance for your furry friends. * **Investing in Your Future:** We provide tuition reimbursement to help you pursue relevant degrees, certifications, and training that align with your career goals. * **Dynamic Office Perks**: Catered breakfast (every Monday) \& lunches (every Friday), fully stocked kitchens, and monthly happy hours to connect and collaborate. This role is based in ourSt. Petersburg, FL Global HQ, where in\-person collaboration fuels growth, mentorship, and innovation. At Webull, we’re committed to fair, equitable, and transparent compensation. The base salary range is $90,000\-115,000 annually, plus a discretionary bonus and full benefits. Final offers consider experience, location, and relevant qualifications. **EEOC Statement** Webull is an equal opportunity employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team where all backgrounds, perspectives, and talents are valued.

jobs.title: Product Director - Modelling Portfolio
jobs.description: Wood Mackenzie is the global leader in analytics, insights and proprietary data across the entire energy and natural resources landscape. For over 50 years our work has guided the decisions of the world’s most influential energy producers, utilities companies, financial institutions and governments. Now, with the world’s energy system more complex and interconnected than ever before, sector\-specific views are no longer enough. That’s why we’ve redefined what’s possible with Intelligence Connected. By fusing our unparalleled proprietary data with the sharpest analytical minds, all supercharged by Synoptic AI, we deliver a clear, interconnected view of the entire value chain. Our trusted team of 2,700 experts across 30 countries breaks siloes and connects industries, markets and regions across the globe. This empowers our customers to identify risk sooner, spot opportunities faster and recalibrate strategy with confidence – whether planning days, weeks, months or decades ahead. Wood Mackenzie Intelligence Connected **WoodMac.com** **Wood Mackenzie Brand Video** **Wood Mackenzie Values** * Inclusive – we succeed together * Trusting – we choose to trust each other * Customer committed – we put customers at the heart of our decisions * Future Focused – we accelerate change * Curious – we turn knowledge into action **About the role** ================== Wood Mackenzie's trading customers act on our forecasts and analytical models every day, across power, gas and oil markets. We are turning that modelling estate into a portfolio of products in its own right: versioned, documented, commercially packaged, and consumable by machines as readily as by analysts. The Director of Modelling Products owns that portfolio. You set the strategy for what we model and why, you own the commercial case for investment across commodities, and you lead the product leads who hold each market. You will not build the models yourself and you will not own the engineers who implement them. You decide what the portfolio should contain, hold the standard it is judged against, and make the case for what we invest in next. **What you will own** ===================== * **The portfolio strategy.** Which models we build, rebuild, retire or acquire across power, gas and oils. You own the investment case and the sequencing, and you defend both. * **Productization of analytical assets.** Moving models and their underlying features from research outputs into products, with versioning, documented methodology, reproducible outputs and a defined release cycle. This is the central program of the role. * **The modelling product leads.** Senior product people holding market specific depth in their commodities. You hire them, develop them, set their objectives, and hold a consistent methodological standard across them. * **Methodology governance.** One standard for validation, change control, backtesting and documentation, so that a colleague or a customer can understand what a model does and how much to trust it. * **Commercial packaging and distribution.** How modelling assets reach customers: in applications, through APIs and data platforms, and as inputs to our own analysts. You work with commercial teams on pricing and packaging. * **The partnership with central engineering and modelling functions.** Development capacity is provided centrally and built to your specification. You set requirements, review implementations and hold the quality bar without managing the developers. **What we are looking for** =========================== * **A quantitative background you can draw on.** A degree in a mathematical, engineering or scientific discipline, and real experience with linear programming, econometric or machine learning modelling. You need to be able to discuss, validate and challenge a methodology on its merits rather than take it on trust. * **Portfolio level product leadership in analytics or data.** Ten years or more in product, including ownership of a multi\-product portfolio and the investment tradeoffs across it. * **Experience leading product managers,** including senior ones. Your leverage in this role comes through other people. * **A track record of productizing analytical or research assets.** Taking work built for internal or bespoke use and turning it into something repeatable, documented and commercially viable. * **Machine consumable delivery.** APIs, streaming, data platforms and workflow integration. Our customers increasingly want the model and the data rather than the report. * **Commodity or energy market context preferred.** Deep subject matter expertise is not a prerequisite, since market specific depth sits with peers or the leads reporting to you. You do need enough market and commercial literacy to prioritize well. * **Comfort operating without direct control.** Development, data engineering and market expertise all sit with teams you do not manage. Clear specifications, credibility and influence are how this role works. **What this role is not** ========================= * Not a modelling role. You will not be building or running models. You direct, prioritize and hold the standard. * Not an engineering or data science management role. Those capabilities are provided by central functions. * Not a research leadership role. Our analyst teams produce market views and commentary. You own the models they and our customers depend on. * Not a finished portfolio. The scope will expand across commodities as the function develops. *The salary range for this position is $160,000\- $190,000, which represents base pay only and does not include short\-term incentive compensation or commission. When determining base pay, as part of a final compensation package, we consider several factors such as location, experience, qualifications, and training. This base salary maps to the Boston Location.* **Equal Opportunities** We are an equal opportunities employer. This means we are committed to recruiting the best people regardless of their race, colour, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, disability or protected veteran status. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry's digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity. Xometry is looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our Core Platform team. This role is a strategic technical leadership position focused on the architectural evolution of our flagship enterprise partnership. While our current plug\-ins function as external add\-ons, you will be responsible for re\-architecting Xometry's core application services to live natively within our partner's digital ecosystem. You will shape the technical direction of multiple products, establishing the engineering patterns that allow Xometry's AI—trained on millions of parts—to operate directly on our partner's native 3D geometry. Your goal is to move the architectural framework toward a "target state" where users experience zero\-latency DFM feedback and one\-click procurement without ever leaving their primary enterprise design environment. This role requires a hybrid schedule (3 days a week) at our North Bethesda, MD or Waltham, MA office location. **How You'll Contribute** ------------------------- * **Software Development and Technical Craft:** You will design high\-performance solutions that extend beyond a single org, establishing the organizational standards for how Xometry\-AI is embedded into external PLM environments. You will advance our architectural framework to ensure it is extensible, scalable, and adheres to strict enterprise SLIs/SLOs. * **AI Fluency:** You will lead the effort to integrate production ML pipelines into the application layer, ensuring the "science fiction speed" promised in our vision is realized through optimized model serving and real\-time geometry analysis. In addition, you'll champion AI\-assisted development practices across the team, actively mentoring engineers on effective use of AI tools to accelerate delivery, improve code quality, and reduce toil. * **Problem Solving and Decision Making:** You will solve significant and unique challenges regarding data gravity and security. You'll create formal networks between our partner's and Xometry's engineering groups to develop new ways of conducting operations—specifically regarding "ring\-fenced" data governance where part files remain securely within the partner's network infrastructure. * **Scope and Impact:** You are responsible for establishing the strategic direction and leading the execution of this core integration. You will be a technical and business role model, ensuring that the integration of DFM (Manufacturability) and IQE (Pricing) AI engines creates a distinct, defensible edge for the partnership. * **Collaboration and Communication:** You will facilitate technical discourse across the entire Xometry organization, leading to durable, well\-documented decisions. As a primary point of contact for senior leadership, you will guide risk/reward conversations and champion cross\-functional development across our marketplace and data science teams. * **Operational Excellence:** You will define the reliability and security standards for our enterprise\-grade deployments, whether partner\-hosted or Xometry\-hosted, ensuring seamless multi\-tenant management. **What You'll Bring to Xometry** -------------------------------- * **Experience:** 12\+ years of professional software development experience, with a history of scaling complex platforms. * **Deep Technical Expertise:** Expert\-level mastery of Python, AWS infrastructure, and modern frontend frameworks (React/NextJS) used for complex enterprise applications. * **Systems Architect:** Proven experience shaping the technical direction of multiple teams and establishing engineering patterns as organizational standards. * **Strategic Roadmap Execution:** A track record of securing endorsement for 6\-12 month initiatives and driving them to successful production deployment. * **Communication Excellence:** The ability to influence senior leadership and external partners on technical strategy and long\-term technology investments. * **Education:** Bachelor's in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience. **You Would Be A Great Fit With** --------------------------------- * **Platform Experience:** Background in building "Software as a Service" (SaaS) platforms or complex B2B integration hubs. * **Industrial Tech Background:** Experience with manufacturing, logistics, or CAD/PLM software ecosystems. * **Security \& Governance:** Deep understanding of enterprise data controls, dedicated tenants, and SOC2/ISO compliance within a cloud environment. * **Distributed Systems:** Experience architecting large\-scale ML platforms or high\-frequency marketplace engines. **Compensation \& Benefits** ---------------------------- The estimated base salary range for new hires into this role is $170,000 – $195,000annually \+ annual bonus, depending on factors such as job\-related skills, relevant experience, and location. The total compensation package includes base, bonus, and equity. We also offer a competitive benefits package, including: * 401(k) match * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * Life and disability insurance * Generous paid time off including vacation, sick leave, floating and fixed holidays * Maternity and bonding leave * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and other wellbeing resources * A stipend for catered lunch on Tuesdays and Thursdays Xometry is an equal opportunity employer and participates in E\-Verify. \#LI\-Hybrid Xometry is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status. For US based roles: Xometry participates in E\-Verify and after a job offer is accepted, will provide the federal government with your Form I\-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

jobs.description: Description: York Solutions, LLC is seeking an experienced Senior Business Systems Developer to design, develop, maintain, and enhance business\-critical applications, databases, and financial systems. This position requires advanced expertise in Microsoft SQL Server, .NET development, systems integration, and a strong understanding of accounting processes and financial data. The successful candidate will work closely with accounting, operations, and technology teams to understand business requirements, develop reliable and efficient solutions, and support the systems essential to the company's daily operations. Responsibilities include database development, application programming, system integrations, reporting, troubleshooting, and ongoing system improvements. This is a hands\-on senior technical position offering the opportunity to assume increasing ownership and responsibility for the company's business applications, databases, and integrations. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong problem\-solving abilities, sound technical judgment, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work independently while developing a comprehensive understanding of York Solutions' business processes and technology environment. **Technology Environment** York Solutions maintains a diverse technology environment supporting its accounting, staffing, reporting, and business operations. The successful candidate will work with a combination of established business applications, custom\-developed solutions, and modern integration technologies. **Our current technology environment includes:** * Database Management: Microsoft SQL Server, T\-SQL, stored procedures, SQL Server Agent, linked servers, and database performance optimization. * Application Development: VB.NET, .NET Framework, Windows Forms, and custom business applications. * Data Integration: REST APIs, ODBC connections, ETL processes, third\-party integrations, and automated data synchronization. * Business and Financial Systems: Bullhorn, Sage Intacct, and internally developed accounting and operational applications. * Reporting and Analytics: Tableau, Microsoft Power BI, SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS), Microsoft Excel, and custom reporting solutions. * Legacy Systems: Microsoft Access applications, existing Windows\-based applications, and legacy SQL Server environments. The ideal candidate will be comfortable maintaining and enhancing existing systems while identifying opportunities to improve performance, reliability, automation, and long\-term maintainability. Requirements: **Key Responsibilities** * Design, develop, optimize, and maintain Microsoft SQL Server databases, tables, views, stored procedures, functions, triggers, and queries. * Design, develop, maintain, and enhance custom business applications using VB.NET, Microsoft .NET technologies, and SQL Server, including existing Windows\-based applications and future application development initiatives. * Develop secure and reliable integrations between accounting platforms, internal applications, third\-party systems, and reporting tools. * Translate accounting and business requirements into technical specifications and software solutions. * Support financial processes involving the general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, billing, and financial reporting. * Create ETL processes, data imports, exports, conversions, interfaces, and automated workflows. * Analyze and improve SQL query performance, indexing strategies, database structures, and application response times. * Develop reports, dashboards, and data extracts that support financial and operational decision\-making. * Validate data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and reconciliation across multiple systems. * Troubleshoot complex application, database, integration, and production issues. * Implement appropriate security controls, audit trails, error handling, logging, and data\-access jobs.description: Headquartered in Silicon Valley, California, Archer is a leader in the next\-gen aerospace sector building an end\-to\-end advanced air mobility platform that delivers air taxis, unmanned aircraft systems ("UAS"), aviation\-related physical artificial intelligence ("AI") solutions, and other technologies to customers worldwide across the commercial aerospace and defense sectors. metrology tools (FARO arms, surface plates, optical trackers) to verify physical hardware. * **Cross\-Functional Bridge:** Partner closely with Design, Aircraft Integration, and Test Operations to feed flight line learnings back into manufacturing and engineering design loops. **What You Need:** * **Education \& Experience:** Bachelor's degree in Aerospace, Mechanical, Electrical, or Industrial Engineering (or equivalent technical experience) with 5\+ years of hands\-on quality or manufacturing engineering experience in aerospace or flight test environments. * **Flight Line Operational Depth:** Direct, hands\-on experience supporting active flight lines, flight test centers, or aircraft hanger operations. * **GD\&T \& Metrology Fundamentals:** Applied working knowledge of ASME Y14\.5 Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD\&T) and experience verifying complex physical assemblies against engineering models. * **Conformity \& Quality Assurance:** Proven experience with AS19102 First Article Inspections (FAI), MRB dispositioning, and FAA conformity inspection processes. * **Digital Ecosystems:** Experience navigating PLM, MES, and ERP platforms (e.g., Teamcenter, SAP) to execute inspection plans and disposition non\-conformances. * **Startup/Prototype Mindset:** Demonstrated ability to work independently, solve complex technical problems with minimal guidance, integration. * **Advanced Quality Tools:** Hands\-on experience with APQP methodologies (AS9145\), PFMEAs, Control Plans, and Statistical Process Control (SPC). * **Industry Standards:** Familiarity with AS9100, AS9102, AS9103, and AS6500 standards. * **Certifications:** ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), Certified Quality Auditor (CQA), or Six Sigma Green/Black Belt. * **Industry Background:** Exposure to electric vertical takeoff and landing (eVTOL), urban air mobility (UAM), or prototype aircraft development programs. jobs.title: Junior Software Developer — Integrations and AI-Driven Development
jobs.description: **About the Role** BOSS is looking for a junior software developer who wants to grow into a senior engineering role while helping build and maintain the integrations behind a production platform supporting payroll, invoicing, onboarding, compliance, and other business\-critical workflows. AI\-assisted development is central to how we work. You'll use modern coding agents and AI development tools to explore the codebase, implement features, review changes, write tests, and investigate problems. You'll learn how to combine the speed of AI\-assisted development with careful engineering judgment, effective validation, and a strong understanding of the underlying systems. You'll work extensively with third\-party APIs and services while gaining experience in code review, testing, debugging, performance, and production operations. You'll help build and maintain reliable integrations, ensure new features fit cleanly into existing workflows, investigate issues when they arise, and strengthen the tools and practices that keep the platform reliable. This is an opportunity to work closely with company leadership, learn a complex business domain, and see the direct operational impact of your work. As your judgment, system knowledge, and production experience grow, you'll take on progressively greater ownership and develop toward a senior engineering role. **Responsibilities** * Review backend and frontend changes for correctness, maintainability, security, and compatibility with existing workflows. * Build, maintain, and troubleshoot integrations with payroll, banking, document, payment, email, and other third\-party services. * Work with REST APIs, webhooks, authentication, data mapping, pagination, rate limits, retries, and error handling. * Design integration workflows to be observable, recoverable, and safe to retry without duplicating financial or operational activity. * Investigate discrepancies between BOSS and external systems and reconcile failed or incomplete transactions. * Use AI coding agents to investigate the application, develop solutions, generate tests, and accelerate routine engineering work. * Review and validate AI\-generated changes for correctness, security, maintainability, and unintended effects. * Improve the instructions, documentation, context, and feedback that help AI tools produce more reliable results. * Identify inefficient database behavior, including N\+1 queries, missing indexes, unnecessary work, and other performance risks. * Test changes across related workflows rather than evaluating features only in isolation. * Help diagnose production issues across the application, database, background workers, integrations, and deployment environment. * Develop well\-scoped production fixes and, with appropriate review, help deploy them safely. * Add practical automated tests and repeatable manual checks for critical behavior. * Review schema and data changes for deployment, rollback, and production\-data risks. * Monitor application behavior and improve logging, documentation, and incident\-response procedures. * Document defects, technical risks, and recommended corrections in clear language. * Learn the business rules behind payroll, invoicing, onboarding, and related financial workflows. * Work directly with company leadership to turn product ideas into reliable, supportable software. **Required Qualifications** * Foundational experience with Python and web application development through professional work, internships, education, or substantial personal projects. * Experience consuming web APIs and working with HTTP, JSON, authentication, and asynchronous workflows. * Practical experience using AI coding tools while retaining the ability to understand, test, and explain the resulting code. * Working knowledge of relational databases and SQL, preferably PostgreSQL. * Ability to follow application code and database queries methodically while investigating a failure. * Familiarity with Git\-based development and code review. * Understanding of common web security, data\-integrity, and error\-handling concerns. * A methodical debugging approach and willingness to escalate when the cause or safest repair isn't yet clear. * Clear written and verbal communication, especially when describing risk or challenging an implementation. * Willingness to learn a mature application with interconnected business rules and legacy behavior. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Django or a similar Python web framework. * Experience with TypeScript, JavaScript, or SvelteKit. * Experience building or supporting third\-party integrations, webhooks, scheduled synchronization jobs, or data\-import pipelines. * Familiarity with OAuth, API keys, request signing, idempotency, rate limiting, and resilient retry strategies. * Familiarity with Linux production environments, Nginx, Gunicorn, background\-job systems, and Vercel. * Experience investigating slow queries, N\+1 behavior, worker exhaustion, or other application\-performance issues. * Experience writing automated tests or introducing tests into an application with limited existing coverage. * Familiarity with production deployments, rollback procedures, backups, monitoring, and incident response. * Experience designing effective prompts, project instructions, or agent workflows for software development. * Knowledge of payroll, accounting, banking, invoicing, employer\-of\-record services, or financial operations. **What Success Looks Like** In the first several months, you'll build a working understanding of the application's major workflows and external services, contribute to a consistent review and validation process, and learn to diagnose common integration and production failures with support. As you grow, you'll take increasing ownership of integrations, reviews, incident response, system design, and technical decision\-making. The long\-term goal is for this role to develop into a senior engineering position with broad knowledge of the platform and business. **Role Boundaries** This position supports code quality and production reliability but won't initially be the company's sole owner of architecture, security, infrastructure, or incident response. Significant production changes and high\-risk incidents will have a defined escalation path and support from the designated technical owner. Those boundaries can expand deliberately as the developer gains experience. Pay: $35\.00 \- $50\.00 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 per week Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Summary:** The Cybersecurity Engineer serves as the primary cybersecurity resource for the i3 Broadband and is responsible for advancing the security of the organization's infrastructure, systems, applications, endpoints, identities, and data. Reporting to the IT Infrastructure Manager, this position balances cybersecurity program coordination with hands\-on technical execution. This role identifies and evaluates cyber risk, recommends practical security improvements, coordinates remediation with responsible departments, and works directly with Infrastructure and other technology teams to implement security controls. This position is expected to spend most of its time performing hands\-on cybersecurity engineering, monitoring, vulnerability management, security administration, incident response, and remediation activities while supporting cybersecurity program objectives. As the organization continues to mature its cybersecurity program, this role will have the opportunity to contribute to the evolution of security processes, technologies, and resources. The Cybersecurity Engineer partners with Infrastructure, Network Engineering, Software Engineering, Helpdesk, application owners, business stakeholders, managed security providers, and vendors to improve security visibility, reduce risk, and strengthen incident preparedness. **Key Responsibilities:** Cybersecurity Leadership \& Governance: * Serve as the organization’s cybersecurity engineering resource and provide guidance to Information Technology leadership and stakeholders. * Identify cybersecurity risks, recommend priorities, and translate technical findings into clear business impact, remediation options, and practical next steps. * Develop, maintain, and improve cybersecurity policies, standards, procedures, technical guidance, and program documentation. * Collaborate with cybersecurity initiatives across Infrastructure, Network Engineering, Software Engineering, Helpdesk, application owners, business departments, and third\-party partners. * Support the continued development of the cybersecurity program through participation in process improvement, reporting, metrics development, and security initiatives. Security Operations \& Incident Response: * Monitor security tools, alerts, logs, threat intelligence, and managed security service notifications; investigate and validate suspicious activity. * Coordinate and perform incident response activities, including detection, containment, eradication, recovery, escalation, documentation, and post\-incident review. * Maintain incident records, response procedures, communication paths, and lessons learned. * Participate in an on\-call rotation or provide after\-hours support for significant cybersecurity incidents and planned security changes as needed. Vulnerability \& Risk Management: * Administer or support vulnerability scanning and assessment platforms and maintain an accurate view of identified vulnerabilities and exposures. * Review, validate, prioritize, and communicate vulnerabilities based on technical severity, business impact, exploitability, and operational context. * Coordinate remediation with infrastructure, network, application, software, and vendor owners; validate completed remediation and track exceptions or accepted risks. * Support external security assessments, penetration tests, public exposure monitoring, and remediation planning. Security Engineering, Identity \& Access: * Assess systems, endpoints, identities, cloud services, and infrastructure for security gaps, unsupported configurations, and control weaknesses. * Partner with Infrastructure to advise on, configure, test, and implement security improvements involving Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Entra, Fortinet firewalls and VPN services, endpoint protection, identity controls, and related technologies. * Support multi\-factor authentication, conditional access, privileged access, administrative account hygiene, access reviews, and least\-privilege initiatives. * Develop and validate security configuration standards and harden baselines for supported technologies. * Improve security logging, alerting, endpoint visibility, and monitoring coverage across the environment. * Provide secure configuration guidance and practical implementation support to technical teams. jobs.title: Senior Manufacturing Data Science & Machine Vision Engineer
jobs.description: Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award\-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles. Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office. Oura is seeking a Senior Manufacturing Data Science \& Machine Vision Engineer to build an intelligence layer for global manufacturing. In this hands\-on, supplier\-facing role, you will integrate factory images, deploy ML models, equipment signals, MES data, test results, and material genealogy into reliable production capabilities.You will deploy machine\-vision and machine\-learning solutions to enhance inspection, yield, process control, root\-cause analysis, and traceability across contract manufacturers and suppliers. This role suits an engineer capable of working across factory floors, Python notebooks, and production data pipelines to deliver practical, robust analytics. ### **What You Will Do:** * Build manufacturing data foundations * Architect and integrate end\-to\-end manufacturing data systems (MES, testers, cloud) across the supplier network to capture accurate production data. * Standardize data models and improve traceability to ensure data integrity from raw components through to final product shipment. * Establish robust data\-quality checks, validation rules, and monitoring frameworks to drive reliable operational decision\-making. * Develop machine\-vision systems for the factory * Identify and implement high\-value machine vision and image\-based inspection opportunities across factory operations. * Design and deploy end\-to\-end vision systems, covering hardware specifications (optics, cameras, lighting) and the development of robust classical and deep\-learning algorithms. * Establish data\-labeling workflows and model validation frameworks to translate vision insights into actionable manufacturing decisions that optimize yield and quality. * Automate manufacturing analysis * Build and deploy automated analysis engines and ML/Vision models to detect process drift, defects, and anomalies directly in the production environment. * Implement automated dashboards and alerts, correlating images with process parameters and test data to accelerate root\-cause analysis and prevent yield loss. * Develop reusable analytics libraries and tools to scale data\-driven insights across Oura’s manufacturing programs and partner network. * Explore digital\-twin and simulation approaches to model manufacturing scenarios, line capacity, and process flows to optimize production before hardware availability. * Drive deployment and strategy * Lead the technical execution of data, machine\-vision, and analytics workstreams through all NPI phases, from EVT and DVT to mass production and sustaining. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, contract manufacturers, and equipment vendors to define technical requirements, acceptance criteria, and robust deployment/maintenance standards for production systems. * Identify and prioritize high\-impact opportunities in industrial AI, vision, and connected manufacturing to address production pain points and optimize quality, yield, and cycle time. * Define and communicate the long\-term manufacturing intelligence roadmap, establishing reusable data/vision standards and effectively influencing leadership and stakeholders on technical investments. This is a hybrid role out of our San Francisco office. ### **What you'll bring** * 5 to 8 years of relevant experience in manufacturing software, industrial data science, machine vision, automation, test engineering, supplier development, or an equivalent combination of experience. * Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, manufacturing engineering, robotics, data science, or a related field. * Experience deploying software, analytics, or machine\-learning solutions in a factory, lab, warehouse, or other production environment. * Strong Python programming skills and experience with data\-processing and machine\-learning libraries such as pandas, NumPy, scikit\-learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow. * Experience with computer vision and image\-processing techniques, such as OpenCV, image classification, object detection, segmentation, OCR/OCV, anomaly detection, or metrology. * Understanding of MES, manufacturing test systems, equipment interfaces, PLC or industrial\-control data, and unit\-level traceability concepts. * Experience with statistical methods, design of experiments, process capability, SPC, measurement\-system analysis, or manufacturing\-quality analysis. * Demonstrated ability to work directly with contract manufacturers, suppliers, equipment vendors, and cross\-functional engineering teams. * Willingness and ability to travel regularly to manufacturing sites in Asia and other supplier locations. ### **Nice to have:** * Experience integrating cameras, lighting, lenses, barcode readers, robots, PLCs, motion systems, or automated inspection equipment. * Experience with digital manufacturing, discrete\-event simulation, digital twins, or factory capacity modeling. * Experience with electronics, battery, precision assembly, SMT, molding, coatings, laser processing, or other high\-volume consumer\-electronics manufacturing processes. * Strong technical writing and stakeholder\-management skills, including the ability to influence without direct authority. ### **Benefits** At Ōura, we care about you and your well\-being. jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - Product Engineer
jobs.description: **About Warp** At Warp Sciences, our mission is to help the world discover new medicines faster—and build the capacity to do it here in America. We bring AI, robotics, and life sciences together in automated labs that design, run, and learn from experiments, with each experiment making the next one better. We’re not developing drugs of our own. We’re building the infrastructure for the people who do. We're looking for an experienced full\-stack software engineer to take technical ownership of the software that connects people to our autonomous laboratories. In this product engineering role, you'll own staff\- and customer\-facing workflows from scientific objectives and experiment planning through execution and results, with hands\-on responsibility for the frontend, backend services, APIs, and data models. You'll combine AI\-native full\-stack engineering with strong product sense: work directly with chemists, researchers, operators, and customers, decide what to build, and carry it through to reliable production use. We're looking for someone who has already led substantial software initiatives and can turn an open\-ended problem into a technical plan, ship it, and improve it based on real use. **What You'll Do** * Lead full\-stack delivery of scientific workflows, from understanding user needs and defining scope through architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation. * Independently scope initiatives spanning multiple months and engineers. Write technical designs, identify dependencies and risks, and break the work into milestones that deliver useful software along the way. * Work directly with chemists and customers to capture objectives, constraints, procedures, and exceptions. Translate those needs into clear requirements and usable workflows for automated experimentation. * Build user interfaces, backend services, APIs, and data models that connect experiment planning, robotic execution, and analysis. Work with other engineers to integrate across our internal systems. * Own the reliability and maintainability of what you ship. Add tests and monitoring, investigate production failures, and make deliberate tradeoffs among delivery speed, performance, and technical debt. * Make experiment status, results, uncertainty, and failures understandable so users can investigate problems and guide automated work. Use feedback and usage data to improve task completion and reduce manual effort. * Provide technical leadership through architecture discussions, code reviews, and mentoring while continuing to write production code. Use AI development tools to accelerate work and verify the correctness of their output. **What We're Looking For** We're looking for someone who has set technical direction for a product area, independently identified and scoped important problems, and led multiple engineers through delivery while remaining hands\-on. You should be able to point to substantial systems you personally helped build, the decisions you owned, and the outcomes they delivered. * You're an experienced full\-stack engineer who has delivered and maintained production web applications, with substantial hands\-on contributions to frontend interfaces, backend services, APIs, and data models. * You've personally led significant projects from an ambiguous problem to production adoption, with impact across a product area or team. You can explain what you owned and implemented, the tradeoffs you made, and how the work improved user or business outcomes. * You've served as a technical lead for work involving multiple engineers over multiple months: defining the approach, sequencing delivery, coordinating dependencies, and staying accountable through launch and follow\-up. * You have strong software engineering foundations and have designed systems for reliability, performance, and maintainability. You can point to architectural decisions you've made and how those decisions held up in production. * You demonstrate product sense and sound judgment about user experience. You've worked directly with users, identified the underlying problem, and made scope and interaction decisions that helped them accomplish their work. * You communicate technical plans and tradeoffs clearly to engineers and non\-engineers, and have helped other engineers deliver better work through code review, technical guidance, and mentoring. * You use AI development tools effectively and critically, with responsibility for understanding, testing, and maintaining the resulting code. * You've operated software after launch, used monitoring and user feedback to diagnose problems, and followed through on fixes and improvements. * Prior experience with chemistry or the life sciences is not required; curiosity and enthusiasm for learning are mandatory. **Helpful, but Not Required** Experience in any of the following is a plus: * Scientific software, laboratory workflows, or tools for technical users. * Domain knowledge in chemistry, drug discovery, or related scientific disciplines. * Robotics, automation, or products that interact with physical systems. * Complex workflow tools, operational interfaces, or collaborative applications. * Data visualization, experiment tracking, and communicating uncertainty. * AI\-powered products and interfaces for guiding, reviewing, or correcting automated work. **Example Problems You Might Work On** * Build a workflow for customers to specify scientific goals, constraints, and success criteria that our experiment\-planning systems can act on. * Turn a chemist's procedure, including exceptions and judgment calls, into a reviewable plan for robotic execution. * Build an experiment monitoring and results interface that helps users understand uncertainty, intervene when needed, and use what they learned to plan the next experiment. **Equal Employment Opportunity** Warp is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, reproductive health decision\-making, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. **Reasonable Accommodations** Warp provides reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants with disabilities in accordance with applicable law. If you need an accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact **recruiting@warp.xyz** **Fair Chance Hiring** Warp considers qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with the California Fair Chance Act and other applicable laws. **General Notice** This job posting describes the position generally and does not constitute an offer of employment or an employment contract.
